title: 3D Computer Vision Research Engineer, Geospatial Visual Localization
descriptionHtml:
About Niantic Spatial

AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time.

That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.

In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.

Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.

About the Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer to help develop our Geospatial Visual Localization technologies, which allows people and robots to accurately localize themselves anywhere on the planet.

This is an end-to-end applied research role. You will develop new approaches to open problems alongside our researchers in 3D vision and machine learning, and publish your work at leading conferences. You will help build and train large models on large-scale multi-modal datasets, including our proprietary collection of 30 billion posed images and ship them into production, to be used by people and robots from all over the world.

Our team works with heterogeneous captures from phones and other handheld devices, 360 cameras, vehicles, and drones, as well as aerial and satellite imagery, LiDAR, and external geographic data. Your focus will be to improve accuracy and robustness across urban and rural locations, cameras, seasons, weather, and capture quality. The system must remain reliable with noisy GPS, in GPS-denied environments, and with outdated reference maps. Each pose estimate comes with an uncertainty that our customers rely on, and keeping it well calibrated across these conditions is part of the work.

What You'll Do

  • Design, implement, and evaluate novel visual localization algorithms, combining 3D vision and deep learning.

  • Train large models on multi-modal data at scale, and build the benchmarks that measure their accuracy and robustness.

  • Develop robust solutions for difficult real-world conditions: noisy or denied GPS, changing appearance, varying capture quality, large geographic extents, and imperfect reference maps.

  • Work side-by-side with leading researchers in visual localization, 3D computer vision, and mapping, as well as engineering and product teams, to identify the highest-impact problems and turn research into end-to-end solutions that operate at production scale.

  • Communicate results clearly through technical writing, design reviews, internal presentations, and publications.

What You'll Bring

  • Strong grounding in 3D computer vision, deep learning, robotics, photogrammetry, or a closely related field.

  • Demonstrated experience with multi-view geometry and related problems, such as camera pose estimation, monocular depth estimation, SfM, SLAM, georeferencing, point-cloud registration, or sensor fusion.

  • Knowledge of transformer models for 3D vision, such as vision foundation models, feed-forward 3D reconstruction, or multi-view and multi-modal attention.

  • Knowledge of geospatial data and coordinate reference systems.

  • Ability to formulate ambiguous real-world problems, choose appropriate mathematical or learning-based tools, and evaluate solutions rigorously.

  • Strong Python skills and experience training deep learning models at scale, with libraries such as PyTorch, NumPy, and SciPy.

  • Strong software engineering skills, with the ability to turn research prototypes into reliable, scalable, and maintainable systems.

  • Experience taking an algorithm from research idea and experimental prototype through evaluation, benchmarking, and deployment on real-world data.

  • Clear written and verbal communication and the ability to collaborate across research and engineering disciplines.

Nice to Have

  • A PhD in computer vision, robotics, machine learning, photogrammetry, geodesy, remote sensing, or a related field, or equivalent research or industry experience. A PhD is not required.

  • A strong publication record or substantial active involvement in the research community, especially at venues such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR, SIGGRAPH, SIGGRAPH Asia, 3DV, ICRA, RSS, or related conferences and journals.

  • Experience with aerial or satellite imagery, GNSS/GPS, IMUs, LiDAR data, geodesy, mapping systems, or large-scale spatial data.

  • Evidence of technical leadership, mentorship, or successful cross-functional delivery.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary: Competitive market rate. Compensation also includes an annual bonus, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Location & Work Model

This role is based in our London office, with three days per week in office.

Inclusive Application

We know the strongest candidates don't always tick every box. If you're excited about this role and believe you could do it well, we encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't match every qualification listed - you may be exactly who we're looking for.

Equal Opportunity

Niantic Spatial is an equal opportunity employer. Individuals seeking employment at Niantic Spatial are considered without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, creed, age, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding or related medical conditions), marital status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected category under applicable laws. title: (2027 PhD/ABD graduates) Senior Associate (Antitrust & Competition Economics) - European Union
descriptionHtml:
About Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that offers economic, financial, and strategic expertise to major law firms, corporations, and governments around the world. Since 1965, CRA experts have combined rigorous cutting-edge research, state-of-the-art methodology, and proven experience to address our clients’ most complex challenges.

CRA's European Competition practice specialises in providing economic advice on matters of competition policy and regulation. We assist firms and their legal advisors in all types of competition proceedings before competition authorities and courts: mergers and acquisitions, abuse of dominance allegations, cartels, restrictive commercial agreements, market investigations, litigation and disputes, intellectual property or state aid. We also provide advice to regulatory authorities in similar matters.

Learn more about our work by reviewing our Services and Industries on our website.

The Antitrust & Competition Economics is hiring for the following European Union offices in Brussels, Belgium; Dusseldorf and Munich, Germany; Paris, France.

Position Overview

Senior Associates work closely with senior consultants on project teams and will have the opportunity to immediately work on some of the largest, high profile and most significant competition cases in Europe, playing a key role in shaping the economic analysis and thinking of these cases. Successful candidates have a strong knowledge of economic concepts and a range of research and quantitative skills. A typical Senior Associate would:

  • Identify and conceptualise issues, specifying rigorous economic models to analyse market issues and data, undertaking statistical and econometric estimation, and managing the work of research associate staff and colleagues;
  • Supervise, train and mentor research associate staff;
  • Assist in the development and presentation of client deliverables, including expert reports and white papers summarising opinions, conclusions, and recommendations using market, industry or client-proprietary data;
  • Act as a primary point of contact for lawyers and other industry or government clients on a variety of practice-relevant issues;
  • Program, build models and/or perform regression analyses in statistical analysis programs (such as Stata, Python, R, SAS, Matlab, and Mathematica), including large data projects requiring use of cloud computing;
  • Ensure the integrity and accuracy of analyses and opinions; and
  • Contribute to practice-building activities (training, recruiting, publication, expertise sharing, etc.).

Explore how CRA can help you launch your career and learn why PhDs choose CRA.

Desired Qualifications

  • PhD degree in economics with a completion date of December 2026/Summer 2027 and an academic focus on Applied Microeconomics or Applied Microeconometrics, with specializations like industrial organization, labor, health, behavioural and public economics, or other quantitative areas;
  • Experience in Excel, Stata, Python, R, SQL, SAS, ArcGIS/ArcPy, or Cloud computing (Databricks/Spark, Google Cloud, Azure, AWS);
  • Demonstrated understanding of, and ability to explain, economic, financial and/or accounting concepts, and quantitative and qualitative analysis methods;
  • Curious and analytical thinkers who bring creative approaches to non-standard problems;
  • Effective written and oral communication skills;
  • Eagerness to learn new skills and programming languages;
  • Demonstrated high level of initiative and leadership;
  • Strong teamwork and collaboration capabilities;
  • Excellent time management and task prioritization skills; and
  • Clear and demonstrated interest in consulting through coursework, work experience, activities, or attendance at CRA recruiting events.

As much of our work occurs in our offices, minimal travel is required.

To Apply

To be considered for a position in Europe, submit through this posting:

  • Resume/CV – please include current address, email and telephone number;
  • Covering letter – please describe your interest in CRA and how this role matches your goals. Also, please note if you have a location preference;
  • Research/Job market paper – please submit your original research or dissertation;
  • Letters of Recommendation – please have three (3) LORs submitted directly to -----

To apply for one of our other global locations, please visit our Careers Site to view available jobs.

Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis. Candidates focusing their search on industry and consulting who need to be considered early should indicate that in the CRA online application and submit all materials as early as possible.

Career Growth and Benefits 

  • CRA’s robust skills development programs, including both formal and informal programs, encourage you to thrive as an individual and team member. Beginning with project management skills, training continues with team management/development, client presentation skills, internal seminars, and career mentoring and performance coaching from an assigned senior colleague. Additional leadership and collaboration opportunities exist through internal firm development activities.
  • We offer a comprehensive total rewards program including a competitive salary and superior benefits package (plus a sizeable performance bonus), wellness programming to support physical, mental, emotional and financial well-being, and in-house immigration support for foreign nationals and international business travelers.

Work Location Flexibility

CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognize that individuals realize a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently expect that individuals spend at least 3 to 4 days a week working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to client meetings), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.

Responsible AI Use in Recruiting

We believe that recruiting is fundamentally a human process, and we are committed to a hiring process that is consistent, transparent, and people-focused. While AI and other technology-enabled tools help our team operate more efficiently, we strive to provide every candidate with a personalized, thoughtful, and high-touch experience. As CRA invests significant human effort to find qualified members for our teams, we expect candidates to invest corresponding human effort to learn about CRA, prepare thoughtful application materials, and engage with our interviewers. Read more about appropriate hiring manager, recruiting team, and candidate AI at CRA on our website.  

Our Commitment to Diversity

Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer. As part of our focus on equity and inclusion, we work to ensure a fair and consistent hiring process. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to an inclusive work environment.

title: Account Development Representative - France
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained — both on the job and through formal programs led by a world-class Sales team — to take on your next role as a closing Account Executive.

On a daily basis, you will build and work a portfolio of target accounts for our EMEA business in France: researching each account for commercial signal, prioritising which contacts to approach and in what order, and running a connected, multi-touch outbound motion that generates qualified pipeline rather than one-off meetings.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France and the United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CET. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: your efforts will result in real-world impact — helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: if you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You're excited by AI: you'll use cutting-edge AI tools every day and sell some of the most advanced AI in the physical operations space.
  • You think several moves ahead: you'd rather build a real relationship across an account than force a single contact to a decision they're not ready to make.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: one day you'll be researching a transport operator, the next a food distribution centre. Our best reps dig into the businesses they support to make a sharper case for why Samsara matters to them specifically.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: in this role you will get hung up on and told no. You need the resilience to prepare, call again, and adjust.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go further than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Research target accounts before outreach — pulling commercial signal out of public information (financials, news, hiring activity, compliance or safety pressure) to build a specific, defensible point of view on where Samsara adds value.
  • Build and prioritise an account-level contact plan, identifying who to approach first across a range of stakeholders (e.g. MD, Operations/Transport Manager, Compliance/H&S, Finance) and being able to justify that choice.
  • Run a connected, multi-touch outbound motion across phone, email and LinkedIn — using early conversations to gather information and multi-thread the account, not just to book a meeting at any cost.
  • Write personalised, researched outreach (including cold emails) that carries a specific point of view into every call, rather than working from a generic script.
  • Read what a contact gives you on the call and adapt in real time — including recognising when the right move is to gather information and position a follow-up with someone else, rather than push for a meeting the contact can't actually commit to.
  • Keep meticulous account and contact records in Salesforce.
  • Become a product expert and represent the Samsara brand at trade shows and events.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1–3 years professional experience, ideally in customer-facing roles
  • 6–12 months experience in a sales or equivalent target driven role
  • Highly motivated and committed, with a strong desire to work in target-driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding targets in previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Curious, and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and fluent in French
  • AI literacy and ability to showcase examples of leveraging AI in your work

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Comfort turning unstructured information (an annual report, a website, a news article) into a clear commercial argument
  • Experience multi-threading or navigating multiple stakeholders within a single sale
  • A genuine willingness to prepare — to research and write — before a call, rather than relying on improvising well under pressure
  • Experience in closing-sales roles or similar target driven environment
  • A proven track record of achievement beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space.

ADR pathways

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility. With emphasis on continued professional development, training doesn't stop after onboarding — we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and competitors, develop hard skills, and work with mentors to progress through three levels:

  • ADR I — focus on inbound leads: a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with interested prospects. Learning opportunities include call sessions with senior Sales team members, tool training (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, and objection handling.
  • ADR II — work on top-of-funnel movement, creating high-quality sales engagements, and supporting Account Executives. Enrolled in specialised training including professional writing, persona-based messaging, cold calling 2.0, and AE collaboration.
  • ADR III — work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers. Partner on large accounts, implement territory plans, join weekly strategy meetings, and schedule/attend customer demos, alongside a mentorship program ahead of an AE interview.

Please submit an English CV with your application.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. title: Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
About Rivia

Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital.

Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated.

Over the past two years, European and US based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital.

Rivia’s ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end.

 

The Role

As an Account Executive, you will drive the growth of Rivia by identifying and closing new business opportunities within the Biotech and pharmaceutical sectors. You will own the full sales cycle—from lead generation to closing deals. Your ability to understand client needs, present Rivia’s value proposition, and build lasting relationships will be key to your success. You’ll collaborate closely with the marketing and product teams to align go-to-market strategies and help shape the future of Rivia's customer base.

  

Responsibilities

  • Identify, target, and close new business opportunities within the Biotech and pharmaceutical sectors.

  • Develop and execute a strategic sales plan to achieve sales targets and expand Rivia’s client base.

  • Conduct thorough research and market analysis to identify potential clients and understand their needs.

title: Account Manager / Key Account Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Die Baubranche ist eine 14-Billionen-Euro-Industrie, die noch immer auf E-Mails, Excel-Tabellen und eingescannten PDFs läuft. Cosuno ersetzt das durch KI. Generalunternehmer schreiben ihre Projekte auf unserer Plattform an mehr als 250.000 Nachunternehmer aus, und unsere agentische KI findet die passenden Firmen, erkennt Auffälligkeiten in Angeboten und vergleicht jeden Preis mit 6,5 Millionen Datenpunkten aus über 136 Milliarden Euro verarbeitetem Angebotsvolumen. Jede Ausschreibung macht die KI klüger. Die Ergebnisse sind messbar: Generalunternehmer senken ihre Kosten um rund 6 %, Nachunternehmer gewinnen 22 % mehr Aufträge, und jeder neue Generalunternehmer-Kunde hat sich in diesem Jahr für unser KI-Produkt entschieden. 2019 in Berlin gegründet und von Cherry Ventures und Spark Capital mit über 40 Millionen Euro finanziert, skalieren wir mit diesem Kapital jetzt Sales, Customer Success und Marketing. Und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Die Rolle

Du übernimmst ein eigenes Book von rund 70 bis 90 Generalunternehmern, Bauträgern und Planern und stellst gemeinsam mit unserem Consulting-Team eine erfolgreiche Aktivierung sicher. Du sicherst die Verlängerung, baust Nutzung und Vertrag aus und merkst früh, wenn ein Kunde abrutscht. Wo ein Kunde noch nicht richtig angekommen ist, holst du ihn gemeinsam mit dem Consulting-Team in die Nutzung.

Verlängerungen, Upgrades und Cross-Sell verhandelst du selbst, mit Geschäftsführung, Einkauf und Kalkulation. Jede Vertragsfrist der nächsten zwölf Monate hast du im Blick, ab 120 Tagen davor läuft dein Renewal-Ablauf, und deinen Forecast pflegst du jede Woche.

Als Key Account Manager machst du das für unsere größten Kunden: Unternehmensgruppen mit mehreren Gesellschaften und Standorten, vielen Entscheidern und längeren Deal Cycles.

Woran wir dich nach 12 Monaten messen

  • Dein Book trägt mehr ARR als zu Beginn: Verlängerungen, Upsell und Cross-Sell sind größer als Kündigungen und Downgrades.

  • Die Kündigungen in deinem Book liegen unter deinem Ziel, und jede Frist der nächsten zwölf Monate hat eine Renewal-Opportunity mit Forecast-Kategorie.

  • Dein Forecast steht jede Woche, ohne dass jemand nachfragen muss.

  • Warnsignale in deinem Book, etwa sinkende Nutzung oder ein weggefallener Key User, haben schnell einen Plan.

  • Als Key Account Manager: Mehr Gesellschaften und Standorte deiner Kunden arbeiten mit Cosuno, und deine großen Renewals landen dort, wo du sie vorhergesagt hast.

Wer bei Cosuno erfolgreich ist

  • Ownership. Du sprichst über eigene Fehler, bevor jemand fragt, und darüber, was du daraus geändert hast.

  • Speed. Du löst Probleme pragmatisch und heute, nicht perfekt und nächstes Quartal.

  • Drive. Wenn du zur Monatsmitte unter Ziel liegst, rufst du mehr Kunden an, nicht weniger.

  • Low Ego. Du teilst, was bei dir funktioniert hat, damit das Team besser wird.

Diese Rolle ist für dich, wenn

  • du ein Book mit vielen Kunden lieber selbst steuerst, als fünf Großkunden zu betreuen.

  • du Verlängerungen verhandelst und dabei den Preis hältst, statt Rabatt zu geben.

  • du schon einmal den echten Kündigungsgrund hinter dem genannten gefunden hast.

  • du deine Zahlen kennst und sie dich motivieren.

  • du mit Geschäftsführern im Mittelstand auf Augenhöhe sprichst und verstehen willst, wie am Bau eingekauft wird.

Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn

  • du Customer Success als Beziehungspflege verstehst und Verkaufen vermeidest.

  • du aus Support, Service oder reinem Onboarding kommst und noch nie eine eigene Zielzahl hattest.

  • du zehn Enterprise-Accounts gewohnt bist und 70 Kunden als zu viel empfindest.

  • du lieber über Transformation präsentierst, als einen Vertrag zu verlängern.

Harte Anforderungen

  • Rund 2 bis 3 Jahre im Account Management, Customer Success oder Sales im B2B-Umfeld, idealerweise SaaS, davon mindestens ein Jahr mit eigener Verantwortung für Bestandskunden und Umsatz.

  • Belegbare Ergebnisse bei Verlängerungen, Upsell oder Kündigungen in den letzten Perioden.

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau. Gutes Englisch und Erfahrung mit Bau, Immobilien oder Vertical SaaS sind ein Plus.

  • Für Key Account Manager zusätzlich: 3-5 Jahre Erfahrung mit Unternehmensgruppen oder Konzernkunden, mehreren Entscheidern und längeren Deal Cycles.

Vergütung

70-110k OTE - inkl. Ungedeckeltem Bonus mit transparenter Provisionsregelung; die Höhe richtet sich nach dem Level.

Was wir bieten

  • Klarheit: Ein eigenes Book, klare Ziele, direkter Einfluss auf dein Ergebnis.

  • Rückhalt: Ein eigenes Consulting-Team übernimmt das Onboarding, du konzentrierst dich aufs Halten und Ausbauen.

  • Entwicklung: Vom Account Manager zum Key Account Manager oder Team Lead, mit regelmäßigen 1:1s, Entwicklungsgesprächen und offener Feedbackkultur.

  • Vertrag: Unbefristet, moderne Ausstattung.

  • Arbeitsort: Remote innerhalb der EU möglich, Berlin-Kreuzberg bevorzugt.

  • Team: Firmen- und Teamevents, online und offline.

So läuft dein Bewerbungsprozess

  1. Kennenlernen mit unserem Head of Customer Success (45 Minuten)

  2. Gespräch mit unserer Geschäftsführung / CRO (30 Minuten)

  3. Case Study an einem realistischen Kundenfall, dazu ein Gespräch mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus dem Team

title: AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About us

People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry.

Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality.

Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies.

 

How we work

  • Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents.

  • Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate.

  • At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work.

  • End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it.

  • In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication.

  • Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.

  • Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues.

     

The role

We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding and expanding our product surface, and we are hiring software engineers across product, AI and platform to do it.

You will build products that do freight forwarding work alongside our customers' teams, operating across the entire shipment lifecycle. You will work across the stack in Python, TypeScript and React, and directly with customers and founders on what gets built.

Everyone here works across the stack, but each engineer has a spike: the area where they set the bar for the team. You spend most of your time where yours is, and lean on your colleagues where theirs are.

  • Product: You build best in class products for the core jobs in freight forwarding, one job at a time. You work as a design partner with our customers to understand the work deeply, turn that understanding into a product they would choose over anything else, and feed what you learn back into the platform everyone builds on.

  • AI: You raise the ceiling on what our AI can do and the floor on how reliably it does it. That spans high volume tasks like classification and extraction and deep workflow tasks that run for hours. You design for performance, reliability, explainability and control, set up the gyms and evals to measure them, and build the harness that runs our agents in all of our products.

  • Platform: You own the foundation every product stands on: the runtime for thousands of concurrent agents and workflows, the way they communicate and scale, the controls for how they access data with permissions that hold, and the observability to see and measure all of it. You ensure the rest of the team can move fast without fear.

     

What we look for

  • A spike, with evidence. Something you have been exceptional at and proof of it. We hire on slope rather than years, so there is no experience threshold in either direction.

  • Strong fundamentals. In the AI-assisted era, having good technical judgement is key. You have shipped production systems people depend on, seen them fail and learned from it.

  • High agency and ownership. You take an ambiguous problem, make a call, and see it through.

  • Humility and learning velocity. You want to get better and you change your mind when the evidence says so.

  • Interest in the problem. You do not need a freight background, but you need to find messy real-world operations interesting rather than a chore.

     

Why join

You will shape the product, the architecture and the company, working alongside an engineering team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will work directly with the businesses using what you build, on AI applied to an industry that has resisted software for decades. You will get meaningful equity, so when this works you share in it.

title: AI-for-Hardware Engineer, Frontier Tech
descriptionHtml:
About Hexa

Hexa (formerly eFounders) gives entrepreneurs the best chances to build outstanding companies.

We are a pioneering, world-leading startup studio born in Europe that designs, builds and launches category-defining startups. We are today recognized as one of the best venture studios in the world, with a track record comparable to tier-1 VC funds.

We have created 60+ companies (including 3 unicorns) with a combined valuation of over $5 billion, among them Aircall, Spendesk, Front, Swan and Yousign.

Hexa is in full growth mode, with three early-stage activities: our Ventures programs Hexa Start and Hexa Sprint which help entrepreneurs go from zero to one, and a PE program, Hexa Scale, which takes majority stakes in existing startups and pushes them to new thresholds.

The hardware vertical at Hexa: Frontier Tech

Frontier Tech is Hexa’s studio focused on physical tech, led by Guerric de Crombrugghe.

We build companies that move atoms: real machines, deployed in the field, often for defense, energy, space and critical infrastructure. A few examples of what is on the bench today include containerized atmospheric water generators, expendable turbojets, and ship-borne satellite ground stations.

Our edge is velocity. We go from idea to working hardware with small teams and lean budgets, against legacy players with hundreds of engineers and decade-long programs. AI is now the biggest lever we have to widen that gap, today by speeding up how we build, and tomorrow by shaping what kind of companies we build.

Why this role, why now

AI for hardware is moving faster than any team can track. Our internal map now tracks close to 200 tools, from text-to-CAD, AI-native electronics and physics surrogates to manufacturing, test data, procurement and the MCP connectors that let agents drive CAD and EDA tools directly.

Most of these tools will not matter. A handful will cut weeks off our programs. We need someone whose job is to find those, prove them on our real parts, and put them in the hands of our founders before our competitors do.

The mission

We’re looking for an industrial hardware engineer who is 100% AI-pilled, with a dual objective:

  • Adopt AI inside our startups. Make every Frontier Tech venture the fastest-moving hardware team in its category, using the best AI tools available today.

  • Build companies that grow with AI. Design products and business models that are both AI-enabled (they get better with every new generation of models) and AI-enablers (they feed AI with the data, compute, energy or infrastructure it needs), and run the companies themselves on AI from day one. The goal is a positive feedback loop: the more AI grows, the more our companies grow.

Adoption is the immediate focus. The role splits into two:

80%: deploy AI inside our ventures

Hands-on, embedded in the teams, measured by weeks saved.

  • Map the bottlenecks. Sit with each venture and map its engineering workflow, from requirements to design, simulation, electronics, firmware, test, manufacturing and documentation. Find the steps that cost the most weeks.

  • Do the engineering. You are part of the team, not an advisor. You will run the CAD, set up the simulations, push the PCB, write the firmware agent, build the digital twin, produce the documentation, build the tools that automate technical pre-sales material that wins a contract. You ship parts and files, not slides.

  • Run the shared AI infrastructure. Set up and maintain the agents, repos and connectors between tools (CAD, EDA, simulation, data), with a common setup across ventures, so founders spend their time engineering rather than configuring.

  • Make it stick. Start with hands-on workshops on each team’s real problems, then train founders and engineers, write the playbooks, and track real adoption so tools are used every day rather than demoed once.

20%: studio radar and partnerships

  • Keep the map alive. Track the AI-for-hardware landscape and what frontier labs ship, and maintain our living map of tools, maturity and pricing.

  • See beyond the hype. Our founders want evidence, not promises. Benchmark tools on our own parts and problems, not on vendor demos, and tell the studio plainly where the value is and where it is not.

  • Close partnerships. Negotiate studio-wide deals with key players (early access, design-partner status, credits, preferential pricing) so every Hexa hardware venture starts with better conditions than it could get alone.

  • Build the default stack. Turn what works into a reusable AI toolkit that every new Frontier Tech venture gets on day one.

  • Design AI-native companies. Work with founders from day one on where AI sits in the product, how the business model captures value as models improve, which data to capture and own, and which workflows run on agents so the team scales without headcount growing in step with revenue.

Who we’re looking for

  • An industrial hardware engineer. 3 to 7 years designing, building and testing physical products in aerospace, defense, energy, automotive, industrial equipment or a hardware startup. You have taken parts from CAD to the shop floor and know tolerancing, DFM, test campaigns and suppliers.

  • 100% AI-pilled. You use AI agents every day, you have built your own automations, and you have already tried text-to-CAD, AI simulation or AI electronics tools on real work. You switch setups as soon as something better ships, and you have opinions on how a hardware company should be built when much of its engineering is done by agents.

  • A skeptical builder. You judge tools by measured time saved, not by launch videos. You are as happy killing a tool as adopting one.

  • High agency and fast. You figure it out and ship without waiting to be told how. You are comfortable jumping between projects in the same week.

  • Commercial sense and pedagogy. Comfortable in front of founders, engineers and vendors, able to run a workshop that turns skeptics into users, and to negotiate a partnership that actually benefits our ventures.

  • Languages and location. Working in English, based in Paris or Brussels, with regular days physically with the founding teams.

Recruitment process

  • First call with Laure, Talent Partner at Hexa

  • Interview with Guerric: mutual introduction, deep dive into the role and how we work.

  • Case study: a real engineering problem from one of our ventures with Tanguy, Hexa's CTO. Propose an AI-augmented workflow and run it as a short hands-on workshop with the founders, with at least one tool working live

  • Cultural fit interview with Matthieu (CEO)

  • Coffee with team members & Reference checks

We are hiring an AI Researcher (f/m/d) to join our Pre-training team and help advance the architecture and training of our next generation of foundation models. If you are excited about how large models learn, want to run experiments that feed directly into production training runs, and want hands-on time on large-scale clusters (thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs), we would love to hear from you.

Team Culture
We foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. We collaborate closely on complex technical problems, working in pairs or using mob programming to resolve challenging issues. New team members learn through real work: from your first weeks you will pair with experienced researchers on live problems, and take on more ownership as you grow into it.

About the Role
As an AI Researcher in Pre-training (f/m/d), you will work on the technical levers that determine the success of our next-generation models: architecture, optimization, stability, and scaling.

Working at the intersection of research and engineering, you will learn to translate mathematical reasoning and empirical observations into principled training decisions, from small-scale proxy experiments to multi-thousand-GPU runs. You will start with well-scoped problems alongside senior researchers and progressively take ownership of larger parts of the training recipe.

We are looking for someone with strong fundamentals, sharp experimental instincts, exceptional skills, and the drive to go deep fast. You learn as much from a failed run as from a paper, you write code others can build on, and you want to become an expert in large-scale pre-training.

Your Responsibilities

  • Recipe & Architecture Experiments: Design and run ablations on core elements of the training recipe (optimizers, schedules, initialization), and implement PyTorch-based architectural changes. Evaluate their effect on convergence, stability, and training efficiency.

  • Scaling Experiments: Run and analyze small-scale proxy experiments, and contribute to the hyperparameter scaling laws and scale-up methods we use to predict behavior at multi-thousand-GPU scale.

  • Run Monitoring & Debugging: Help monitor large-scale training runs and investigate convergence issues such as loss spikes and divergence. Work with the team to track down distributed training failures.

  • Research to Practice: Follow the literature, reproduce promising results at small scale, and bring ideas worth testing to the team.

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Work with the Compute Performance, Data, Evaluation, and Post-Training teams to understand how hardware constraints and the rest of the model lifecycle shape pre-training decisions.

Core Qualifications

  • You are proficient in Python and have hands-on experience with PyTorch.

  • You have a strong foundation in machine learning, shown through research (e.g., a PhD, a strong MS'c thesis, or publications), open-source contributions, or substantial professional or substantial personal projects.

  • You have a solid mathematical background (linear algebra, probability, optimization) and enjoy reasoning formally about why models train the way they do.

  • You understand how transformers work and have pre-trained LLMs from scratch yourself, even at small scale.

  • You design experiments carefully, report noisy and negative results honestly, and can explain clearly what your evidence does and does not show.

  • You have a track record of picking up unfamiliar technical areas quickly and going deep, for example by reimplementing papers, ramping up on a large new codebase, or debugging a problem well outside your comfort zone.

  • You write clean, maintainable code and care about reproducible experiments.

  • You communicate clearly, raise problems early, and actively seek out and act on feedback.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Distributed Training: Experience training models on multi-GPU or multi-node setups, or familiarity with distributed frameworks (e.g., Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, torchtitan) and parallelism strategies (data, tensor, pipeline, expert).

  • Training Dynamics: Familiarity with scaling laws, hyperparameter transfer (e.g., µP), or recent work on optimizers and training stability.

  • Efficient Architectures: Exposure to Mixture-of-Experts, efficient attention variants, or other inference-efficient designs.

  • Research Output: Publications at top-tier venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) or contributions to open-source ML training libraries.

  • Systems Curiosity: Low-level kernel optimization is not required, but we highly value a strong curiosity about the hardware and systems constraints that shape scale.

title: AI Scientist - Domain Expert Crashworthiness
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the job

Mistral AI is looking for a Domain Expert in crashworthiness simulations to help build AI-accelerated simulation capabilities for industrial engineering.

You will work at the intersection of industrial simulation, physics modeling, machine learning, and engineering workflows. Your role is to bring deep solid-mechanics expertise into the design, training, evaluation, and deployment of AI Physics Models for real engineering use cases.

This is a hands-on technical role. We are looking for someone who understands industrial structural simulation not only conceptually, but through direct experience with simulation models, solver workflows, data generation, validation, and engineering decision-making.

You will work with research, product, and customer-facing teams to ensure that our models are useful against real engineering standards — not only benchmark metrics.

Relevant application areas may include automotive crashworthiness, aerospace structures, consumer-electronics drop/reliability, manufacturing, durability/fatigue, and other nonlinear structural mechanics problems.

What you will do

  • Work with our research team to define, generate, and iteratively improve simulation datasets for training and evaluating crashworthiness foundation models, balancing coverage of relevant physical scenarios, simulation fidelity, and computational cost.

  • Design and run high-fidelity simulation campaigns using structural mechanics solvers such as Abaqus, LS-DYNA, Ansys Mechanical, Radioss or equivalent tools.

  • Define the relevant variation space for training data: geometry, mesh resolution, material behavior, boundary conditions, loading, contact, joints, failure modes, and engineering KPIs.

  • Build or guide automated pipelines for simulation setup, execution, post-processing, dataset creation, and model evaluation.

  • Work with research teams to train and evaluate AI models on simulation data, and diagnose failure modes caused by data gaps, poor coverage, numerical artifacts, or model limitations.

  • Evaluate model outputs against industrial engineering needs, including field-level accuracy, scalar KPIs, deformation modes, load paths, energy absorption, stress/strain fields, failure indicators, uncertainty, and out-of-domain behavior.

  • Work with industrial customers to understand their simulation workflows and engineering priorities, define use cases and success criteria, and incorporate their feedback into model development and validation.

About you

  • You have deep expertise in crashworthiness, solid mechanics, and structural mechanics, with substantial experience in industrial simulation workflows.

  • You have a Master’s degree or equivalent technical depth in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, civil/structural engineering, computational mechanics, applied physics, or a related field.

  • You have 4+ years of relevant industrial experience (or PhD +1 years) in domains such as automotive, aerospace, and consumer electronics.

  • You have hands-on experience with explicit dynamics for crash or impact simulation and understand nonlinear FEM and related topics such as contact, plasticity, structural dynamics, buckling, material modeling, fracture/damage, fatigue, crashworthiness, or durability.

  • You have direct experience with simulation validation, correlation, model quality, numerical sensitivity, and engineering KPI definition.

  • You are a strong Python developer who can build and maintain reliable tools for simulation automation, data processing, and model evaluation. You apply sound software engineering practices, including version control with Git, automated testing, code review, and clear documentation.

  • You have hands-on experience working in Linux and HPC environments, including submitting and monitoring batch jobs, selecting appropriate compute resources, and troubleshooting simulation workflows. You can run simulation campaigns efficiently across a compute cluster.

  • You are comfortable operating in ambiguous technical environments and turning poorly defined industrial problems into scoped datasets, experiments, metrics, and execution plans.

  • You communicate clearly with both deep technical experts and non-specialist stakeholders.

It would be great if you

  • Have experience applying machine learning, surrogate modeling, reduced-order modeling, optimization, or data-driven methods to simulation problems.

  • Have contributed to reusable internal tools, open-source code, simulation automation frameworks, or production-quality engineering workflows.

  • Have experience working directly with industrial customers, product teams, or engineering decision-makers.

  • Have publications, patents, internal technical leadership, or recognized contributions in engineering, simulation, computational mechanics, or ML-for-physics communities.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. title: Art Director Performance Creatives (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Wir sind eine Performance Marketing Agentur mit einem großen Fokus auf Creative Design. Wir entwickeln datengetriebene Ad Creatives, Creative Strategien und skalierbare Produktionsprozesse für Social Ads, vor allem auf Meta und TikTok, und produzieren dabei über 1.000 Creatives im Monat.

Kurz zur Einordnung, weil der Begriff Performance Creatives oft ein bisschen unklar ist: Damit meinen wir ganz einfach Werbeanzeigen für Social Media, also Bilder, Videos und UGC Ads für Instagram, Facebook und TikTok. Für YouTube erstellen wir die auch, unser größter Fokus liegt aber ganz klar auf Meta Ads (Instagram und Facebook) und TikTok Ads.

Dabei arbeiten wir mit richtig großen Playern zusammen und begleiten sie strategisch, zum Beispiel Nivea, Sixt, Shop Apotheke, mymuesli, Steiff, Gothaer, Finanzguru, Pixum und Olavson.

Jetzt suchen wir einen Art Director in Vollzeit, der bei uns die kreative und strategische Leitung übernimmt. Das ist für uns eine extrem wichtige Rolle. Du entwickelst nicht einfach schöne Designs, du entwickelst Creative Strategien, die auf Research und Daten basieren, bist ganz nah an unseren Kunden dran, bereitest Reportings auf und leitest unser Design Team.

Beim Thema AI sind wir extrem weit vorne. Unser Setup basiert auf Claude, Figma und Higgsfield, nicht auf Adobe, und wir setzen einfach viel daran, jedem im Team richtig gute AI Prozesse an die Hand zu geben. Du kannst bei uns also super viel lernen. Wichtig ist nur, dass du in diesen Tools wirklich selbstständig arbeiten kannst.

Genau deshalb arbeiten wir zielbasiert und nicht nach Zeit. Flexible Arbeitszeiten sind bei uns ganz normal, und wenn du es schaffst, deine Prozesse smart zu optimieren, hast du neben dem Job auch einfach ein richtig gutes Leben.

Aufgaben

  • Strategie: Du entwickelst Creative Strategien für unsere Kunden. Der Kunde schickt eine Kampagne, du arbeitest die Strategie dahinter aus, inklusive Kampagnenkonzept, Angles, Testing Ansätzen und Messaging

  • Research: Du tauchst richtig tief in Researches ein, also Zielgruppe, Wettbewerb und Plattformen. Welche Ads schalten die Wettbewerber, wie sind die aufgebaut und was funktioniert gerade auf Meta und TikTok

  • Creative Deconstruction: Ads systematisch zerlegen und verstehen, welche Hooks funktionieren, was Aufmerksamkeit erzeugt und wie man die Zielgruppe bestmöglich abholt

  • Reportings: Performance im Ads Manager analysieren, Learnings ableiten und daraus Creative Reportings und Strategy Präsentationen für unsere Kunden aufbereiten

  • Kundenkontakt: Du bist regelmäßig im direkten Austausch mit unseren Kunden, führst Calls, präsentierst Konzepte und Ergebnisse und bist kreative Ansprechperson

  • Teamleitung: Du leitest unser Design Team (Grafikdesigner, Motion Designer, Video Editoren, Copywriter), briefst, gibst Feedback und entwickelst das Team weiter

  • Kapazitäten: Du stimmst Kapazitäten, Prioritäten und Deadlines im Design Team ab und sorgst dafür, dass alle Projekte sauber laufen

  • Qualitätssicherung aller Werbemittel, visuell und mit Blick auf Performance, inklusive Safe Zones und plattformgerechter Umsetzung

  • Du entwickelst unsere AI Workflows mit Claude, Figma und Higgsfield ständig weiter und trägst Learnings ins Team

Qualifikation

  • Mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung (mindestens 3 Jahre) in Art Direction, Creative Strategy oder als Creative Lead, idealerweise im Performance Marketing oder Agenturumfeld

  • Wirklich hohe Kreativität: Du entwickelst eigene, unverwechselbare Ideen, keine Copy Paste Ads

  • Sicheres Auftreten: Du präsentierst Ideen klar und überzeugend vor Kunden und triffst im Team auch mal Entscheidungen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit allen gängigen Designprogrammen, vor allem Figma

  • Sehr gute AI Skills: Du nutzt Claude und Figma im Arbeitsalltag und arbeitest darin komplett selbstständig. Erfahrung mit Higgsfield, ElevenLabs und Co ist ein großes Plus

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Ad Creative Konzepten für Meta, TikTok o.ä. (PFLICHT, bitte im Portfolio zeigen)

  • Du kannst mit Zahlen arbeiten: Ads Manager Daten lesen, CTR, Hook Rate, ROAS interpretieren und daraus Strategien ableiten

  • Führungserfahrung: Du hast bereits ein kreatives Team geleitet und Kapazitäten geplant

  • Strukturierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise, auch wenn mehrere Kunden gleichzeitig laufen

  • Du beschäftigst dich auch privat mit Social Ads, Trends und Plattform Updates

  • Sprache: Deutsch mind. C1, Englisch mind. B2

Benefits

  • Arbeite mit wirklich großen Marken wie Nivea, Sixt, Shop Apotheke, mymuesli und Steiff, und zwar strategisch, nicht nur ausführend

  • AI Vorsprung: Wir sind beim Thema AI extrem weit vorne, du lernst bei uns super viel und bekommst die passenden AI Prozesse an die Hand (Claude, Figma, Higgsfield)

  • Zielbasiert statt nach Zeit: flexible Arbeitszeiten und Remote first

  • Datengetriebenes Umfeld, jede kreative Entscheidung wird messbar

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Du formst die kreative Ausrichtung der Agentur mit

  • Urban Sports Mitgliedschaft

  • JobRad

  • Mehrere Workations pro Jahr

  • Regelmäßige Team Events

Unser Prozess

Weil die Rolle für uns so wichtig ist, gehören eine Testaufgabe und ein Interview fest zum Prozess dazu.

  1. Bewerbung einreichen (CV + Portfolio/Case Studies)

  2. Kennenlerngespräch mit Gerrit (GF)

Onshore–Offshore Delivery Model

Unser Kunde ist ein inhabergeführtes Systemhaus im Bergischen Land mit Sitz zwischen Düsseldorf und Wuppertal. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 100+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next!

Mission of this role

The Netherlands is Rentman's biggest customer base, and DACH is our second-biggest. As an Implementation Specialist (German-speaking) on our Professional Services team, you make sure our German-speaking customers get the same excellent, hands-on support as everyone else.

You are the solution expert who helps customers realize the full value of Rentman. You deliver paid trainings to existing customers that accelerate onboarding, boost account health and broaden usage across teams. Everything comes from our standardized service catalogue: the offering is standard, the application is tailored to each customer. These services come on top of what every Rentman customer already gets free of charge: support, the support center and for some a dedicated CSM.

When you're not delivering customer trainings, you help the wider team stay useful year-round: you build standardized video trainings based on the most common questions coming out of our support center, and you're available to represent Rentman at customer events or trade shows in German-speaking markets.

title: Builder
descriptionHtml:
Why this role exists

Manufacturing is Europe’s backbone, and it’s under pressure. More than half of manufacturing cost is decided in procurement, yet the function still runs on Excel.

Tacto is building the intelligence layer between bits and atoms, connecting the digital world of engineering with the physical world of manufacturing. It’s how AI gets into the real economy. More than 300 industrial companies already run on Tacto. We’re the category leader in DACH, backed by Sequoia and Index, and we’re just getting started.

 

What you'll do

Find the problems worth solving, then solve them end to end. Sit with buyers and procurement leads, work out what actually costs them money, decide what's worth building, and ship it to production, with AI doing much of the heavy lifting. You're done when it drives revenue, not when it's released. Don't wait for a PRD: make the case, or skip the case and show the prototype.

 

What we mean by Builder

Because of AI, we only hire Builders. No specialized roles. At Tacto, some of our Builders come from product, some from engineering, some from founding their own company. They all have one thing in common: they take a messy, unclear problem and own it from start to finish, whether it's a customer problem or a business problem. They decide what is worth doing, test the risky parts early, and see it through until it pays off. When it works, they share it, we double down, and everyone gets better.

We care about outcomes, not code quality for its own sake. What makes this fun is the loop from idea to reality, and AI just made that loop 10x shorter. There’s no room here for “my job is to solve interesting technical problems.”

 

What a week can look like

  • A call or a plant visit with a procurement team to see how they really buy

  • A prototype built with Claude Code or Cursor the next morning

  • Shipping with a team of 1-3 Builders on one of the quarter's bets

Who we're looking for

Hungry, creative people who care about the result more than anything else.

  • You've built something people used and owned the outcome: as a founder, in a fast-growing product team, or with a side project that you launched.

  • You have commercial sense and product taste. Agency and taste are the main differentiators in today's AGI age.

  • You build with AI every day. Cursor, Claude, Codex and agents are your default and you've made something real with them that wouldn't exist otherwise.

  • You have strong technical intuition: you reason about data and systems rather than getting caught up in the details of code.

  • You're comfortable in front of industrial customers. You are fluent in German; English is strong plus.

  • You want to be in a room full of people who are fired up about what they’re building.

  • Early in your career? Great. We love to bet on people with a steep learning curve.

 

How the process works

  1. Say Hello (20 min): get to know each other and the role

  2. Hiring Manager Interview (45 min)

  3. On-site day: a case with three Builders and Pool Leads (1 hour), Meet the Team (30 min)

How we work

We’re in our Munich office four days a week, with 100+ people building together every day. We measure outcomes. Trust is high and feedback is direct. We offer competitive salary and meaningful equity.

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

  • Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

  • Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

  • Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

  • Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

  • Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

  • Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

title: Business Development Representative (BDR)
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Zefir is building an AI autopilot for home sales in Europe, starting in France: an AI agent runs the entire sale and purchase journey end-to-end, orchestrating local brokers, portals, buyers, and documents.

Backed by €60 million from top-tier investors Sequoia Capital and Kima Ventures, we're committed to accelerating life changes for millions of current and future European homeowners.

The role

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you are the first commercial point of contact with our prospects. You join Zefir's Sales team and reach out to homeowners who have run a valuation on our website but have not booked an appointment yet.

The core of the role is reactivation: these homeowners showed interest, then stopped there. You are the one who gets them moving again, on the phone, one by one.

Your goal as a BDR: create the sales opportunities that feed our revenue directly.

What you will do

  • Handle around 100 calls per day, with a target of 3 to 4 meetings booked daily.

  • Run qualification calls of about 20 minutes: understand the client's project, present Zefir's value proposition, and book a follow-up meeting with an Account Executive.

  • Keep rigorous track of your pipeline and move leads through the Sales funnel.

  • Work closely with Account Executives to maximize conversion and contribute directly to Zefir's growth.

Career path

We are transparent on this. A BDR role can open the door to an Account Executive role internally, but there is no automatic progression and no guaranteed timeline. Any move depends on three things: performance, behavioral fit, and team needs.

What we can commit to: our Consumer Account Executives, the role a BDR grows into, and our Sales Managers are filled exclusively through internal mobility. We never open these roles externally. Top performers are rewarded, with uncapped variable pay and real visibility.

Who we are looking for

  • 0 to 2 years of experience. This role is designed for a junior profile who wants to learn sales on the phone, fast and in the fiel d.

  • Master's level graduate from a business school, an engineering school or a university, or a first experience as a BDR, SDR or sales rep in a structured environment.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication. Fluency in French is required. Fluent English is a plus, not a must-have.

  • Rigorous and well organized, able to sustain a high volume of client interactions over time.

  • Energized by performance and intensity, with a client and results orientation.

  • Resilient, and able to take feedback to improve quickly.

One honest note: this role is intense and repetitive by design. Around a hundred calls a day, every day, with rejection along the way. That is what makes you improve fast at sales, and it is not for everyone.

Compensation and working setup

  • €47K package: €35K base plus €12K of uncapped variable, on top of the BSPCE granted to everyone.

  • Three days on-site, two days of remote work per week, at our Le Peletier office in the 9th arrondissement. Being in the room matters on this role, you learn to sell by hearing others sell.

Hiring process

  • Screening: a first 15-minute conversation with a member of the Talent team.

  • Use case: two written questions (15 minutes of work) to send back within 4 days.

  • Role interview, at our offices: 60 minutes on the role with the Sales Manager.

  • Culture interview: 45 minutes with a member of the Sales team.


Benefits

The following is for permanent employees only. For other contracts (interns, apprentices, fixed-term..), please, check with your recruiter.

  • Competitive salary: You can run your own simulation with our salary calculator.

  • BSPCE (Stock Options): Available for everyone, with monthly vesting after year one, over a 4-year period.

  • Healthcare plan: Full coverage with Alan for team members, their partners, and children.

  • Office in Le Peletier, Paris (9th arrondissement): With flexible remote work options.

  • Swile meal card: €11 per worked day.

  • Swile mobility card: €45/month to support sustainable transportation (metro, carpooling, biking…).

  • Team events: Monthly Mixers to connect and share good times, and quarterly All Hands to celebrate wins across the company.

Our Operating Principles

🏔️ Steep Mountains Are Steep: Setting ambitious goals and working hard to achieve them.

🌊 Ride Reality: Actively seeking challenges and thriving by adapting flexibly to changes.

🏀 Play for the Front of the Jersey: Prioritizing team success over individual recognition.

Application & Process

We welcome applications from anyone, regardless of background, gender, sexual orientation, religion, age, or experience. Our team values authenticity and diverse perspectives.

For all roles, our interview process emphasizes hands-on exercises, case studies, or discussions about specific examples of your previous work. We ensure objectives and expectations are clearly communicated at every step.

Compensation: €35K – €47K • Offers Equity

title: CDI - Senior Context & Analytics Engineer - Paris
descriptionHtml:
Mission

Un agent ne vaut que ce que valent les données et les connaissances sur lesquelles il répond. Pipelines, modèles de données, définitions de métriques, droits d’accès : vous créez et gouvernez ce socle, et les applications et les agents de nos clients s’appuient dessus. Quand un analyste ou un agent demande un chiffre, la réponse est celle de l’équipe finance, accompagnée de sa définition et de sa source.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez que les métiers et les agents puissent se fier aux données, et les utilisent.

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Context & Analytics Engineer.

Activités et responsabilités

Avec les équipes métier et les analystes, il s’agit de définir ce que signifie chaque métrique et de vérifier que les données y correspondent. Sur ce socle, les Product Engineers et les AI Engineers construisent applications et agents.

Les Platform Engineers exploitent l’infrastructure sur laquelle tournent vos pipelines. Les échanges avec les data owners et les équipes de gouvernance du client, la relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues complètent le quotidien.

Vos responsabilités :

  • Construire des pipelines d’ingestion et des modèles de données, avec dbt par exemple.
  • Mettre en place des contrôles de qualité des données et maintenir le lineage.
  • Construire la couche sémantique et les définitions de métriques, pour que les personnes et les agents utilisent les mêmes chiffres, y compris en text-to-SQL.
  • Définir les règles de gouvernance et les droits d’accès.
  • Construire des pipelines de connaissances pour le RAG : indexation, chunking, métadonnées, permissions.
  • Préparer le contexte exploitable par les agents : métadonnées, définitions, lineage et permissions.

Profil recherché

Les indispensables :

  1. Vous écrivez du SQL avec aisance et modélisez les données pour l’analyse.
  2. Des pipelines de données planifiés, testés et surveillés figurent à votre actif.
  3. Aux côtés des équipes métier, vous définissez les métriques et vérifiez que les données veulent bien dire ce que tout le monde croit y lire.
  4. La qualité des données, la documentation et les droits d’accès comptent pour vous.
  5. Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.

Un plus, pas un prérequis :

  • Python pour le traitement de données.
  • Une plateforme de données cloud, comme BigQuery, Snowflake ou Databricks.
  • Une couche sémantique ou un metrics store.
  • La préparation de documents pour le RAG : chunking, indexation, métadonnées.
  • Des outils de data catalogue ou de lineage.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Dans un métier où deux tableaux de bord affichent parfois deux chiffres différents, ce poste consiste à rétablir la confiance : un chiffre juste, une définition partagée, une source identifiable. Ce travail, discret quand il réussit, conditionne tout ce que les autres archétypes construisent au-dessus.

Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.

Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.

Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.

Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.

Le reste s’apprend sur les projets, avec les AI Engineers et l’appui de la communauté Context & Analytics Engineer, notamment le context engineering, c’est-à-dire le travail qui rend les données exploitables par les agents d’IA. À partir de 2027, l’archétype Context & Analytics Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (évaluation de l’IA, responsabilité en production).

Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme les chapters AI Architect et AI Product Manager.

Processus de recrutement

Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.

  1. Entretien RH (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.
  2. Appel avec le CTO (15 à 30 min, à distance).
  3. Screening technique (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.
  4. Code review et live coding (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.
  5. Cas technique (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.
  6. Entretien final (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.

Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.

Rémunération : 53 000€ à 63 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + jusqu’à 5 000€ de variable selon expérience et séniorité

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.
