title: Certification Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

Required qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

  • 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

  • Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

  • Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

  • Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

  • Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

  • Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

  • Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

Preferred qualifications and personal profile

Nice to have

  • Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

  • Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

  • Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

  • Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

  • Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

  • Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

  • Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

  • Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end

Start date: Immediately

title: Chief Strategic Architect
descriptionHtml:
About Workato

Workato is the leading Control and Execution Platform for Enterprise AI — the neutral platform enterprises trust to put AI to work across their business. Workato unifies data, applications, and processes into a single platform so AI can reliably orchestrate business processes in production at enterprise scale. Built on more than a decade of running mission-critical processes for over half the Fortune 500 — including Nasdaq, Amazon, Cisco, Vodafone, Atlassian, and Lucid Motors — Workato turns over 14,000 enterprise systems AI needs to act on into one governed execution layer. For more information, visit workato.com.

Why join us?

Ultimately, Workato believes in fostering a flexible, trust-oriented culture that empowers everyone to take full ownership of their roles. We are driven by innovation and looking for team players who want to actively build our company. 

But, we also believe in balancing productivity with self-care. That’s why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment along with a multitude of benefits they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives. 

If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you!

Also, feel free to check out why:

  • Business Insider named us an “enterprise startup to bet your career on”
  • Forbes’ Cloud 100 recognized us as one of the top 100 private cloud companies in the world
  • Deloitte Tech Fast 500 ranked us as the 17th fastest growing tech company in the Bay Area, and 96th in North America
  • Quartz ranked us the #1 best company for remote workers

Responsibilities

We are seeking a visionary Regional Chief Strategic Architect to serve as Workato's technical authority and strategic advisor to our most critical prospects, customers, and the broader market within their assigned region. The Chief Strategic Architect operates at the nexus of technical credibility, executive influence, and market thought leadership, acting as the external-facing voice of Workato's innovation and technical vision.

This is not a sales role. It is a strategic, hybrid operator-advisor-influencer position. Chief Strategic Architects act as extensions of the executive team in the field, elevating conversations with senior leaders and positioning Workato as the essential platform for enterprise integration, AI orchestration, and intelligent automation.

This role is accountable for building technical trust across the customer lifecycle - from initial engagement through strategic expansion - while simultaneously shaping how the market understands enterprise integration, AI orchestration, and intelligent automation. The Chief Strategic Architect influences deal outcomes, product direction, and industry perception, ensuring Workato is recognized as the definitive leader in Enterprise Orchestration.

First 90 Days

Learn & Align (Days 0-30)

  • Deep immersion into Workato's AI vision, product roadmap, and GTM strategy

  • Shadow at least 10 executive customer conversations

  • Develop initial point of view for engagement with CIO/CTO/CDO personas

Engage & Formulate (Days 30-60)

  • Lead first strategic engagements with enterprise accounts

  • Co-develop executive playbooks with Sales and Product teams

  • Establish feedback loops with Product and Engineering teams

Influence & Scale (Days 60-90)

  • Cultivate trusted relationships with C-level executives in 5+ strategic accounts

  • Co-create first AI-driven integration use cases with customers

  • Establish thought leadership presence through content and speaking opportunities

Technical Trust & Executive Relationships

  • Engage directly with C-level executives (CIOs, CTOs, Chief Data Officers, Chief AI Officers) at enterprise accounts to shape integration strategies that solve complex business challenges

  • Serve as trusted technical advisor throughout the customer lifecycle - from initial engagement through expansion - providing strategic guidance rooted in real-world operator experience

  • Build lasting peer-to-peer relationships that position you as the go-to expert on enterprise integration, AI orchestration, and automation at scale

  • Act as technical closer in competitive deals, articulating why Workato's architecture differentiates us from competitors like MuleSoft and Boomi

  • Influence enterprise architecture decisions and multi-year technology strategies at the executive level

AI, Agentic Automation & Enterprise MCP Strategy

  • Shape and guide customers' AI and agentic automation journeys, leveraging Workato's AI capabilities and ecosystem

  • Advise on the design and adoption of agent-based workflows, human-in-the-loop models, and decision automation frameworks

  • Partner with customer executives to define enterprise MCP (Model Context Protocol) strategies including context management, secure AI orchestration, and governance

  • Translate emerging AI capabilities into practical, scalable enterprise use cases that drive measurable business outcomes

  • Position Workato as the integration and orchestration backbone for enterprise AI transformation

Domain Expertise & Thought Leadership

  • Establish yourself as the recognized authority across iPaaS, API Management (APIM), data orchestration, EDI, and AI/Agentic automation

  • Lead "Art of the Possible" workshops that fundamentally shift how customers think about enterprise integration and intelligent automation

  • Represent Workato at industry conferences, customer advisory boards, analyst briefings, and partner events

  • Create high-impact thought leadership content: blogs, white papers, webinars, reference architectures, and technical videos

  • Shape industry narratives and best practices that establish Workato as the category leader

Deal Acceleration & Commercial Impact

  • Accelerate deal velocity through technical validation, competitive differentiation, and executive trust-building

  • Identify and shape strategic expansion opportunities by uncovering automation, integration, and AI-driven transformation initiatives

  • Partner with Account Executives and Sales Leadership on account strategy, competitive positioning, and C-level engagement tactics

  • Articulate compelling ROI narratives and business case frameworks that accelerate buying decisions

  • Demonstrate measurable impact on win rates, deal size, and sales cycle length in strategic opportunities

Strategic Advisory & Technical Leadership

  • Lead high-impact customer engagements requiring executive-level judgment, architectural vision, and industry expertise

  • Guide prospects and customers through Enterprise Orchestration vision and roadmap development

  • Develop prioritization frameworks for integration, automation, and AI use cases

  • Lead technology evaluation and vendor selection processes with enterprise customers

  • Design governance, scalability, and enterprise operating models for automation initiatives

Product Influence & Market Intelligence

  • Act as the voice of the customer to Product and Engineering teams, channeling field insights into actionable roadmap input

  • Identify capability gaps, competitive threats, and market opportunities based on executive-level customer conversations

  • Develop and refine competitive positioning, objection handling, and differentiation strategies

  • Define reusable patterns, reference architectures, and technical frameworks that accelerate customer success

  • Influence industry analysts and thought leaders to strengthen Workato's market position

Internal Enablement & Team Development

  • Educate and enable Sales Engineers, Account Executives, and Customer Success teams on complex technical capabilities and emerging trends

  • Develop strategic frameworks, competitive positioning, and executive engagement playbooks for enterprise accounts

  • Mentor technical team members, helping them develop deeper domain expertise and executive engagement skills

  • Create scalable technical enablement content and programs that amplify your expertise across the field organization

  • Drive customer reference creation and participation in case studies, speaking opportunities, and advisory boards

Requirements

Qualifications / Experience / Technical Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

  • 20+ years of technology transformation experience, including integration, middleware, or API management platforms

  • 15+ years in an Enterprise Architect, CTO, VP Engineering, or similar senior architecture/leadership role

  • Demonstrated experience advising C-level executives on technology strategy and enterprise transformation

  • Strong understanding of enterprise security, governance, and operating models

  • Proven track record of driving platform expansion and value realization in enterprise accounts

  • Excellent executive communication skills, including board-level presentations and strategic documentation

  • Ability to operate independently in complex, ambiguous environments and take ownership of outcomes

  • Travel to client sites up to 50%, with flexibility based on regional needs

Soft Skills / Personal Characteristics

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business, or related field

  • Deep knowledge of key enterprise applications: Salesforce, NetSuite, Workday, ServiceNow, SAP, Oracle

  • Experience with cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, and GCP

  • Hands-on experience with AI/ML platforms and agentic automation frameworks

  • Experience in a high-growth startup or scale-up environment

  • Established personal brand and thought leadership presence in the integration/automation space

Measures of Success

Long-term success for this leader will be measured by their ability to:

  • Embed Workato at the heart of technology strategy conversations across the region's most influential enterprises

  • Cultivate sustained engagement with senior technology and engineering leaders ensuring Workato becomes synonymous with Enterprise Orchestration and AI orchestration

  • Create a robust pipeline of seven-figure opportunities tied to transformation initiatives

  • Reframe Workato in the minds of decision-makers and analysts as the essential platform for AI-enabled enterprise integration

  • Leave behind scalable playbooks and repeatable narratives that enable go-to-market teams to engage enterprise audiences with authority and credibility.

title: Commercial Associate
descriptionHtml:
🏷️ Title: Commercial Associate

👫 Department: Found, Commercial. Reporting to the Head of Commercial, Found

💰 Salary: OTE £75,000 - £105,000 (£50,000 - £70,000 base) + equity

🎁 Benefits & Culture: See here

📈 Equity: A very generous EMI share offering

🌴 Holiday: 26 days + bank holidays

💗 Mission: Elevate later life for everybody and build the care sector of the future

💻 Office Policy: Hybrid with a minimum of 2 core office days per week

🌍 Office Location: London Bridge, London, UK

 

🔍 The Opportunity:

Lottie is building the AI operating system for social care. Families find care through our marketplace. Providers use Found to manage enquiries, occupancy and finances, with Eliza, our AI agent, answering family calls and chats on their behalf.

We're launching Found for Specialist Care, a brand new vertical alongside Care Home and Home Care, and we're hiring our first Commercial Associate to build it from the ground up. There's no playbook, no team and no set way of doing things yet. You'll write them.

Sales is at the heart of the role. You'll be the one opening doors, running demos and closing providers. But you'll also sit at the intersection of Commercial, Product and Customer Success: working out what this market needs, shaping how we talk about Found, and making sure what you hear from providers shapes what we build next.

We have a head start: 7-8 specialist care providers already use Found, plus a pipeline we previously turned away. You'll work closely with Tom Frost, our Head of Commercial, with direct access to product and our founder. If you want to build something from nothing and stretch well beyond a typical sales role, this is it!

 

💻 What does this role involve?

  • Sell: own conversations with specialist care and supported living providers from first call to demo to close, against MRR targets with uncapped commission on ARR closed

  • Build pipeline: prospect through calls, emails, LinkedIn and events, re-engage providers we've spoken to before, and grow our existing customers

  • Build the go-to-market: test messaging, learn what lands and turn it into a repeatable playbook others can follow

  • Be the voice of the market: bring provider insight back to Product and Engineering and help shape the roadmap for Found for Specialist Care

  • Connect the dots: work across Commercial, Product, Marketing and Customer Success so providers get a joined-up experience from first call to onboarding

💪 What problems will you be solving?

  • Taking a vertical from a handful of customers to a real, repeatable revenue line

  • Understanding a largely local-authority-funded world, where buying decisions and ROI look different to private-pay care

  • Selling honestly while the product is still evolving, and turning feedback into what we build next

  • Working out what to build, sell and say first, with no blueprint to copy

👀 We think you’ll be a great fit if…

  • You have a strong sales spike. You're confident on the phone, love outbound and have a track record of hitting targets in a B2B commercial role

  • You're a natural generalist. You're as happy digging into a market, writing messaging or giving product feedback as you are closing a deal

  • You've built something from scratch before, such as a new territory, product line, process, society or side project, and you enjoy the ambiguity

  • You work well across teams and can translate between providers, product and engineering

  • You build genuine relationships: empathetic and consultative rather than "salesy"

  • You explain value in plain language to people who aren't always tech-savvy

  • You're motivated by targets and commission, and want to own this vertical for at least 12 months

  • Bonus: startup experience, B2B SaaS, or exposure to regulated or publicly funded sectors. Care sector experience is not required

Sound like you but not quite 100%? Apply anyway. We're looking for potential and passion, not a perfect CV match.

  

💔 This role isn’t for you if…

  • You want an established playbook, a structured process and constant guidance

  • You want to focus purely on closing and aren't interested in the wider commercial and product picture

  • You're not comfortable with outbound prospecting

  • You're looking for a stepping stone and want to move into something different in 6 months

 

💻Application

We'd love to see a short video (2-3 minutes) answering this question:

Introduce yourself, tell us why you’re interested in Lottie and what makes you a good fit for this role.

We appreciate this takes time. We receive a high volume of applications and this helps us assess you on more than your CV.

🔢 Lottie’s Interview Process

  1. First Interview with Lottie's Talent Acquisition Lead - 20 mins (remote)

  2. Case Study with Tom Frost (Head of Commercial, Found) and a member of the Commercial team - 1h presentation with additional pre-work (remote)

  3. Final interviews with Will Donnelly (Lottie's Co-Founder & CEO) and Tom Frost (Head of Commercial, Found), 1h30 total (in-person)

🤩 Candidate Experience:

  • Pre-Screen & First Interview: You'll receive an email notification, but no specific feedback will be provided at this stage.

  • Case Study: If you are not successful after the assessment, you'll receive constructive feedback via email and be offered a debrief call with our Talent Lead.

  • Final Interview: For final-stage candidates who are not offered the role, we will provide your feedback live via a phone call.

Founded with a mission to build the care sector of the future, Lottie is creating the AI operating system for social care - designed to unlock profitability for care providers and to make finding care as easy as booking a holiday on Airbnb.

title: Compliance Analyst - Alternance (Contrat de 24 mois)
descriptionHtml:
🦊 À propos de Green-Got :

Green-Got est une institution financière française qui permet à chacun de choisir ce que son argent finance.

Nous construisons l’infrastructure financière du monde qui vient, au service de la transition écologique.

Depuis janvier 2026, Green-Got est un Établissement de Paiement agréé par l’ACPR, supervisé par la Banque de France. Nous proposons un compte de paiement associé à une carte, ainsi qu’une gamme de placements pour investir dans les entreprises de la transition.

La Compliance est au cœur de ce modèle : c’est le socle de notre crédibilité vis-à-vis de nos membres, du régulateur et de la mission que nous portons.

Lieu : Paris (75) + Télétravail partiel Contrat : Alternance Niveau : Master 1 Poste à pourvoir : Janvier - Février 2027

Chez Green-Got, la Compliance est un pilier stratégique. Nous voulons la faire évoluer vite, avec les bons outils, les bonnes personnes et une vraie culture de la donnée.

Nous recherchons un profil hybride, capable de concilier la rigueur du traitement opérationnel et la puissance de la data. Au-delà des acquis académiques, c’est la posture qui fera la différence : autonomie, initiative sincère et envie d’avancer dans un environnement qui bouge vite.

Tu es méthodique sur le fond et réactif dans l’exécution. Les deux à la fois.

Une mission au service de notre raison d’être

La transition écologique est notre mission principale : permettre à chacun de choisir ce que son argent finance, et orienter nos placements vers les entreprises qui font avancer la transition. La Compliance rend cette mission crédible et durable.

Tes missions

Au sein d’une équipe Compliance à taille humaine (nous sommes 5 aujourd’hui), tu es en interface directe avec les équipes Customer Care, Produit, Tech, Data, nos partenaires et nos membres.

Nos missions vont évoluer avec notre offre et avec une année 2027 qui s’annonce très dynamique. Le descriptif de ce poste bougera donc certainement, mais l’objectif restera le même : rester conforme à nos obligations tout en faisant avancer l’entreprise.

Production et gestion des dossiers Compliance (80 %)

  • Traitement des dossiers KYC et de l’entrée en relation : tu analyses les dossiers, vérifies la cohérence des informations et prépares les décisions de validation ou de refus.

  • Vigilance sur les flux et les alertes : tu qualifies les alertes, identifies les situations à risque et proposes les mesures à prendre.

  • Déclarations de soupçon (TRACFIN) : tu participes à la préparation et à la transmission des déclarations, sous la supervision de l’équipe.

  • Relation avec les membres et les partenaires : tu réponds aux questions de conformité avec un discours clair, pédagogique et ferme.

  • Traçabilité : chaque action est documentée. Dans un environnement réglementé, ce qui n’est pas tracé n’a pas été fait.

Outils et amélioration continue (20 %)

  • Maîtrise de nos outils internes : tu utilises Notion au quotidien pour documenter, suivre et partager le travail de l’équipe. C’est un outil central de notre fonctionnement que tu dois maîtriser rapidement.

  • Automatisation : tu repères les tâches répétitives et proposes des solutions pour les réduire, en lien avec l’équipe Data & IA.

  • Veille et documentation : tu suis les évolutions réglementaires et contribues à maintenir nos procédures à jour.

Ta montée en compétences

Les premiers mois sont consacrés à une immersion forte dans la production. Nous te donnons un cadre clair pour gagner en autonomie :

  • Mois 1 : comprendre Green-Got, notre application et les fondamentaux de la Compliance.

  • Mois 2 : maîtriser les outils et les sujets opérationnels.

  • Mois 3 : être autonome sur les cas simples, continuer d’apprendre sur les cas complexes.

  • Mois 4 : être pleinement autonome sur l’opérationnel et contribuer aux projets de l’équipe.

Ton profil

Nous recherchons un esprit agile et curieux, prêt à grandir avec nous : quelqu’un de passionné par les enjeux réglementaires et par les sujets data et IA, qui veut voir l’impact concret de son travail sur une infrastructure financière que nous construisons avec conviction.

Tu as une vraie envie de travailler, d’avancer et d’évoluer. Tu es prêt à un rythme soutenu, car la charge de travail peut être importante.

  • Maturité et autonomie : tu avances sans attendre qu’on te guide pas à pas. Tu identifies les problèmes, tu proposes des solutions et tu prends en charge tes sujets jusqu’au bout.

  • Sens de l’initiative : ton rôle dépasse l’exécution. Tu questionnes, tu améliores, tu contribues.

  • Curiosité et débrouillardise : tu apprends vite, seul comme en équipe, et tu es à l’aise dans un environnement qui change souvent.

  • Niveau d’exigence : tu ne te contentes pas de l’à-peu-près. La précision est un réflexe.

  • Appétence pour l’IA et la data : tu utilises déjà ces outils pour travailler plus vite et mieux, et tu as envie d’aller plus loin. Ce n’est pas la mission principale du poste, mais c’est une compétence que nous attendons.

  • Intérêt pour la conformité : tu veux comprendre les mécanismes KYC, LCB-FT et RGPD, et t’y investir sur la durée.

  • Aisance rédactionnelle et relationnelle : tu sais expliquer une situation complexe simplement, à un membre comme à un collègue.

  • Esprit d’équipe : la Compliance se construit collectivement, le partage d’information fait partie de notre culture.

  • Formation : tu démarres un Master 1 (ou une année équivalente en école de commerce, d’ingénierie ou de droit), idéalement avec un ancrage en finance, risques, audit ou droit.

  • Anglais opérationnel, indispensable pour échanger avec l’équipe technique et nos partenaires.

  • Bonus : une première expérience ou un projet personnel qui te fait fier. Un lien à partager est le bienvenu.

Chez Green-Got, nous sommes rusés, responsables, nous recherchons constamment le progrès, nous allons vite et le collectif passe avant l’individu.

Ce que nous t'offrons

Avec notre agrément ACPR, nous construisons nos propres standards de Compliance, avec les personnes qui nous rejoignent maintenant.

  • Un rôle avec de vraies responsabilités : dès les premiers mois, tu portes tes sujets, et ton travail a un impact direct sur notre dispositif.

  • Un apprentissage de terrain : aux côtés d’une équipe qui transmet ses savoir-faire opérationnels, au contact de l’ensemble des équipes (Customer Care, Produit, Tech, Data).

  • Une équipe exigeante et soudée, qui sait aussi passer de bons moments ensemble.

  • Un environnement en forte croissance, où les profils les plus engagés progressent vite.

Le package

  • Cadre : alternance basée à Paris, minimum 4 jours au bureau par semaine.

  • Rémunération : selon la grille légale en vigueur (variable selon l’âge, le niveau de formation et le type de contrat).

  • Santé : mutuelle Alan.

  • Cohésion : une journée d’équipe chaque semestre.

Déroulement des entretiens

  • Envoie-nous ton CV, une courte présentation de toi, ton calendrier d’alternance et, si possible, le montant de tes frais d’inscription.

  • Nous t’appellerons rapidement pour faire connaissance, dès que ton profil aura retenu notre attention. Si ça matche, nous t'enverrons un Business Case à préparer.

  • Entretien en visio avec Justé (Compliance Manager) et un futur collègue pour analyser le Business Case, évaluer tes compétences et faire connaissance..

  • Échange de 15 min avec un autre membre de l’équipe pour le fit culturel.

  • Entretien avec Adèle (Head of Operations).

  • Entretien final avec Andréa (CEO).

Nous avons hâte de te rencontrer !

title: Compliance Director
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Compliance Director and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.

You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

  • Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

  • Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

  • Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

  • Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027.

  • Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution.

  • Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale.

  • Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes.

  • Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections.

  • Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast.

  • Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools.

  • Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues.

  • Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania or the FNTT.

  • Knowledge of Lithuanian AML law and Bank of Lithuania instructions.

  • Experience with clients across several EEA countries.

  • CAMS (ACAMS) or ICA certification.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • People who copy policies from templates without fitting them to the business.

  • People who say no without offering a compliant way forward.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

descriptionHtml:
À propos de Culinary Agency

Passionné(e) par la gastronomie, la création vidéo et les univers premium ? Vous souhaitez mettre votre créativité au service de belles maisons, de restaurants, d’hôtels et d’acteurs de la gastronomie ?

Dans le cadre du développement de notre activité et de notre portefeuille clients, nous recherchons un(e) Content Creator capable d’imaginer, de produire et de monter des contenus visuels de qualité, avec un véritable sens du détail et de l’esthétique.

Vos missions

En lien étroit avec les équipes de l’agence et en binôme avec un Content Creator Junior, vous serez au cœur de la production de contenus pour nos clients.

1. Organisation et préparation des tournages

  • Organiser et planifier les sessions de tournage chez nos clients.

  • Veiller au bon déroulement des tournages et au respect des plannings.

2. Création de contenus vidéo

  • Réaliser des prises de vue directement chez nos clients : restaurants, hôtels, chefs et maisons premium.

  • Imaginer et produire des contenus adaptés aux codes des réseaux sociaux, notamment Instagram et les formats courts (Reels).

  • Mettre en valeur les lieux, les équipes, les produits, les gestes et les expériences à travers un regard créatif et soigné.

  • Être capable de produire un volume important de contenus tout en maintenant un haut niveau de qualité.

  • Être présent(e) sur le terrain environ 3 à 4 jours par semaine pour réaliser les tournages chez nos clients.

3. Montage et post-production

  • Assurer le montage des vidéos et leur adaptation aux différents formats.

  • Sélectionner les meilleures séquences, travailler le rythme et soigner les détails visuels.

  • Organiser et suivre les étapes de montage, en garantissant le respect des délais et des attentes clients.

4. Suivi, coordination et relation client

  • Participer au suivi des stratégies de contenu définies pour les clients.

  • Travailler en binôme avec le Content Creator Junior et coordonner les différentes étapes de production.

  • Être force de proposition et contribuer à faire évoluer la qualité créative des contenus de l'agence.

La relation client est une dimension essentielle du poste : votre capacité à créer du lien, à instaurer la confiance et à faire vivre une expérience agréable à nos clients contribuera directement à la réussite des projets.

Le profil que nous recherchons

Nous recherchons avant tout une personne créative, organisée, rigoureuse et à l'aise sur le terrain, capable de passer rapidement d'un univers client à un autre.

Vous vous reconnaissez dans les points suivants :

  • Vous avez une expérience en création de contenu vidéo, tournage et montage.

  • Vous maîtrisez la captation vidéo, notamment avec un iPhone, et connaissez les codes des réseaux sociaux.

  • Vous possédez un véritable œil esthétique et savez identifier les images qui valorisent un lieu, un produit ou une expérience.

  • Vous êtes extrêmement organisé(e), rigoureux(se) et capable de gérer plusieurs productions en parallèle.

  • Vous savez produire du contenu en volume sans sacrifier la qualité.

  • Vous avez un excellent relationnel et êtes à l'aise pour représenter l'agence auprès de clients exigeants.

  • Vous aimez créer du lien, instaurer une relation de confiance et entretenir des relations professionnelles de qualité.

  • Vous soignez votre présentation et adoptez une attitude professionnelle en toutes circonstances.

  • Vous êtes polyvalent(e), autonome et capable de vous adapter à des environnements et des interlocuteurs variés.

Une expérience à l'international est un vrai plus, tout comme une sensibilité particulière aux univers de la gastronomie, de l'hôtellerie haut de gamme, du luxe et de l'art de vivre.

Ce que nous proposons

  • Présence terrain : environ 3 à 4 jours par semaine chez nos clients pour les tournages.

Vous rejoindrez une agence en plein développement, au sein de laquelle vous pourrez participer à des projets variés, rencontrer de belles maisons et contribuer directement à la qualité des productions.

Notre processus de recrutement

  1. Premier échange en visioconférence : un entretien de préqualification pour faire connaissance, comprendre votre parcours, vos expériences et vos motivations.

  4. Entretien final avec le CEO : une dernière rencontre pour échanger sur votre vision du poste et votre envie de rejoindre Culinary Agency.

title: Customer Operations Director
descriptionHtml:
Customer Operations Director

Do you know how to combine customer focus, commercial awareness and operational excellence?

As Customer Operations Director, you will lead our customer service, order management and sales support teams across our international Building Automation markets.

Your goal is to make sure customers and partners get fast, reliable and consistent service, from their first question to final delivery.

This role is for a leader who sees the bigger picture and knows how to turn it into effective day-to-day operations.

What will you do?

You are responsible for the full customer journey after first contact. That covers answering customer questions and requests, processing orders, following up on quotes, and coordinating deliveries and service. You work closely with Sales, Technical Support, Supply Chain and Finance.

You will:

  • Lead and develop teams across multiple countries: set clear roles, coach team leaders, and manage capacity and service levels.

  • Bring customer service, order management and sales support together into one way of working, with clear ownership and smooth handovers between teams and countries.

  • Support Sales: handle incoming requests, follow up on quotes and orders, and keep customer data in the CRM accurate. Sales keeps ownership of accounts, pricing and targets.

  • Set up a clear process for technical customer questions with our Technical Support team, from first response to escalation.

  • Work with Supply Chain on product availability and delivery dates, and keep customers and Sales informed when issues come up.

  • Simplify processes, reduce manual work, and standardize ways of working across countries while respecting local language and market needs.

  • Work with IT to improve how teams use our CRM, order management system and customer portals.

title: Customer Success Director EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About EDITED

EDITED is the world’s leading AI-driven retail intelligence platform. We empower the world’s most successful brands and retailers with real-time decision making power. 

By connecting internal business and external market data, EDITED infuses intelligence into every retail decision. We help retailers increase margins, generate more sales, and drive better business outcomes through AI-powered market and enterprise intelligence that fuels automation. 

At EDITED, we foster a dynamic and inclusive culture where creativity thrives and collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Our environment is dynamic and supportive, encouraging team members to take initiative, innovate, and continuously grow. We value diversity, transparency, and a shared commitment to excellence, creating a workplace where everyone's voice is heard and contributions are recognised. 

We believe that achieving a positive work-life balance is key to driving innovation and success. Our flexible working options—including hybrid working, flexible hours and a work from anywhere policy—empower our team to perform at their best. 

The Opportunity

A dynamic and results-driven Director of Customer Success who will lead our EMEA customer success strategy and team, responsible for > $10M in ARR, reporting directly into the Global Head of Customer Success. This role will be pivotal in driving customer retention, satisfaction and expansion initiatives across our SaaS customer base. The EMEA Director of Customer Success will be responsible for building a world-class customer success organization that delivers exceptional value to our customers throughout their entire EDITED platform journey.

The candidate will possess a demonstrated history of success in leading and scaling customer success organizations within the B2B SaaS space, and most importantly, experience in growing complex SaaS businesses. This includes a demonstrated ability to enable the creation and implementation of a repeatable, scalable customer journey that drives predictability in retention, expansion and customer advocacy. Additionally, experience in building and leading high-performing customer success teams, fostering a data-driven culture, and effectively managing resources to optimize efficiency and scalability are crucial. The ability to navigate complex organizational structures, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and secure executive buy-in is also essential for success in this high-growth environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Retention and expansion of the EMEA book: full accountability for Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) and Net Revenue Retention (NRR) targets across the portfolio.

  • Direct management of a team of Account Managers and Retail Strategists. Managing the personal development of the team in service of delivering world-class customer service that directly supports retention and expansion goals.

  • Own the key leading indicators of churn risk: data quality/adoption within the platform, KPI attainment, executive sponsor engagement, and health scoring — and intervene early on at-risk accounts.

  • Guide a deal cycle to a successful outcome

What You’ll Bring:

  • Direct experience managing both technical/delivery talent and commercially-oriented account management talent under one team.

  • Comfort operating in a data-driven, metrics-first culture — you can build and defend a GRR/NRR forecast, not just describe customer sentiment.

  • Ability to navigate complex organizational structures, influence cross-functional stakeholders (Product, Sales, Finance), and secure executive buy-in.

  • Strong relationship-building skills, internally and with senior client stakeholders.

  • Ability to move fluidly between tactical, day-to-day account issues and longer-term strategic planning.

  • At least 3 years of management experience actively coaching a dynamic team(s) to achieve both organisational and individual goals.

  • A minimum of 5 years experience working within a B2B SaaS organisation.

  • Retail industry background or deep familiarity with retail/merchandising working practices and pain points required.

 

Behaviours That Are Important:

  • Product evangelist who leads by example

  • Solutions-focused, bias to action

  • Strong time management and prioritization across a varied portfolio

  • Nurturing, hands-on coach to the team

  • Collaborative, low-ego mindset

 

What We Offer You

title: Customer Success Manager
descriptionHtml:
monday.com is the AI work platform powering the most ambitious teams. 250,000+ customers across departments use us to bring people, workflows, and AI agents together on one flexible platform where AI doesn't just assist, it executes. We move fast, build things that matter, and foster an ownership-driven culture where you're empowered to shape how organizations work and outpace their competition.

About The Role

As a Customer Success Manager, you are responsible for the business objectives your customers set to achieve through their AI transformation journey.

This is not the SAAS CSM role we know. Rather than driving adoption and holding the relationship, you reverse-engineer the use cases a customer already runs on the platform and agentify them: you take an existing business process and drive it into the AI era, placing the right AI capabilities in the right places so humans and applied AI work together. You build beside the customer’s own team until the workflow runs. It requires a can-do mindset, strong business acumen backed by technical fluency.

Please note that this is a hybrid position with three days/week in our Munich office.

What You’ll Do

  • Translate use cases: Inventory the use cases an account already runs and agentify them, placing the right AI capabilities in the right places so humans and agents work together.

  • Diagnose workflows: Map where decisions get made and work moves forward, and turn it into a sequenced transformation plan with the customer’s executives and process owners.

  • Build beside the customer: Run working sessions where the customer’s own team builds the workflow, and stay in the room until it runs.

  • Route by account maturity: Use the account maturity audit and Path A readiness to decide what gets built beside the customer and what becomes a scoped engagement.

  • Partner on services: Source engagements for Deployment Strategy with the business context established, and stay connected through delivery so every build lands back into the account plan.

  • Forecast outcomes: Forecast credit burn against entitlement at business-unit level, and diagnose any shortfall: an unbuilt workflow, an unadopted one, or a process that never changed.

  • Advise on governance: Own the permissioning, data boundaries, agent oversight, and approvals that move agents from pilot to production.

  • Lead change with sponsors: Hold the relationships with the sponsors who drive change, tie every workflow to the outcome they need to show, and lead the operating-model shift that makes it stick.

  • Prepare renewals: Evidence delivered outcomes on the T-120/90/60/30 cadence, and surface risk and expansion signals to the Account Owner early enough to act.

How Success Is Measured

The core success component is our ability to drive business outcomes for our customers through the different monday.com layers of operations.

But when breaking it down to the actual day2day we can find :

* Retention of all paid components: seats, AI credits, and services.
* AI consumption growth: adoption of AI capabilities into new and existing use cases, measured as credit burn against entitlement across the account.
*Growth in new AI capabilities usage that drives commercial growth.

What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of professional experience

  • Experience in customer success, consulting, solutions, or a similar customer-facing role in SaaS, ideally with enterprise accounts.

  • Ability to diagnose how a business process really runs and redesign it with AI and humans working together.

  • Hands-on experience building workflows, automations, or AI agents, and comfort building alongside customers rather than only advising.

  • Credibility with multiple business owners and executives, not only IT or platform owners.

  • Strong commercial and analytical skills: tying usage to business outcomes, forecasting consumption against entitlement, and making a renewal case with evidence.

  • Working knowledge of applied AI governance topics such as permissioning, data boundaries, platform automation, LLMs and agent oversight.

  • Clear communication and the ability to lead change with sponsors across a customer organisation.

  • Experience with high-paced operations and large enterprise customers is an advantage.

descriptionHtml:

Brunswick is accelerating its use of AI to strengthen the advice we give clients and how we operate. We are looking for a Data Architect to join our AI Lab and shape the technical and data foundations that enable us to build and scale proprietary AI products securely and effectively.

This is a hands-on, influential role spanning architecture and practical delivery. You will take a portfolio-wide view of how data, applications, models, APIs and shared components fit together, creating reusable patterns and capabilities that help engineers move faster while maintaining high standards of security, resilience and maintainability.

Working closely with AI Engineers, Infrastructure, Security, Data and other technology teams, you will ensure the Lab has the architecture and underlying platform it needs to innovate at pace while aligning with Brunswick’s wider technology environment.

About the Role

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

  • Design and evolve the data and technical architecture underpinning the AI Lab’s portfolio of proprietary products.
  • Define scalable patterns for how applications, data sources, models, APIs and enterprise systems connect and interact.
  • Design approaches to data modelling, access, storage, movement and governance, particularly for sensitive or business-critical information.
  • Identify opportunities to create reusable services, components and data capabilities that accelerate development across multiple products.
  • Establish standards and patterns for data pipelines, APIs, integration, environments, deployment and observability.
  • Work closely with engineers to translate architectural principles into practical solutions, balancing scalability with rapid prototyping and delivery.
  • Partner with Infrastructure, Security, Data and other technology teams to ensure solutions meet Brunswick’s security, privacy, governance and architectural standards.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify the data landscape, reduce duplication and improve interoperability across the firm.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and architectural approaches that could strengthen the Lab’s platform or unlock new capabilities.
  • Help build the scalable data foundations Brunswick needs to develop and deploy AI responsibly, securely and effectively.

What We’re Looking For

You will combine strong data and solution architecture skills with a practical engineering mindset and the ability to operate in a fast-moving product environment. You will be comfortable moving between strategic architecture and detailed technical decisions, making pragmatic trade-offs between long-term scalability and speed of delivery. The successful candidate will bring:

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in data architecture, solution architecture, data engineering, software engineering or a related technical role.
  • Strong experience designing scalable data and application architectures, ideally in cloud environments.
  • Experience designing data models, APIs, integrations and data flows across databases, SaaS applications and enterprise systems.
  • Strong knowledge of modern data architecture, including data modelling, ETL/ELT pipelines, storage, access patterns, data warehouses, lakes/lakehouses and governance.
  • Experience with cloud platforms; Microsoft Azure experience is particularly relevant.

title: Digital Product Manager SAP HR (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Notre équipe Corporates Operations recherche un·e Product Manager SAP HR (f/m/d) en CDI basé·e à Lille.

Au sein de la direction Corporate Operations (200 personnes), qui pilote l'ensemble du SI RH & Finance, notre équipe SI RH est au cœur d'une transformation d'envergure internationale : l'implémentation globale de Workday dans tous les pays Decathlon. Nous gérons un écosystème de produits critiques (Core RH, Talent, Recrutement, Paie) avec pour ambition de concilier excellence opérationnelle locale et rationalisation globale. Un défi technologique et humain passionnant où chaque membre de l'équipe a un impact direct sur le quotidien de nos collaborateurs.

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

En tant que Product Manager SAP HR, ta mission sera de garantir la stabilité et la performance du RUN de tes produits, tout en les faisant évoluer pour accompagner les projets stratégiques et la transformation internationale de l'entreprise. Tu seras responsable des produits SAP HR (calcul de la paie France et Espagne pour 40 000 utilisateurs) et SAP BW (reporting de paie).

Tes responsabilités principales s'articuleront autour de 4 grands piliers :

  • Pilotage du RUN & Excellence Opérationnelle : Garantir la qualité et la conformité légale de la paie France & Espagne (et des futurs pays où sera déployé la solution SAP HR). Tu seras l'interlocuteur·trice privilégié·e des équipes payroll locales pour écouter, challenger et traduire leurs besoins en spécifications fonctionnelles.
  • Animation de l'écosystème & Agilité : Animer au quotidien une équipe d'experts (3 développeurs ABAP, TMA HR Path et TMA Winch Consulting). Tu piloteras les rituels agiles, la priorisation du backlog sur JIRA et le suivi des livrables.
  • Flux de données & Écosystème digital : Être le·la garant·e des échanges de données fluides et sécurisés entre l'outil de paie et les outils digitaux de Core RH, de planification des collaborateurs, de rémunérations diverses, ainsi que les outils financiers.
  • Modernisation, Sécurisation & Projets Majeurs :
  • Mener le projet stratégique de migration de SAP HR & SAP BW vers la version RISE S4, en étroite collaboration avec l'éditeur SAP et les équipes techniques SAP internes de Decathlon.
  • Gérer l'application des Support Packages (patchs) de sécurité et coordonner les impacts avec le métier.
  • Piloter l'intégration technique avec Workday (stabilisation pour la France, construction du flux pour l'Espagne avec l'intégrateur Shapein).
  • Gouvernance, Économie & Stratégie : Assurer le pilotage budgétaire de ton produit (licences, TMA, projets). Tu participeras également aux réflexions stratégiques autour de l'initiative "SAP United" pour conseiller et étudier le déploiement de SAP HR dans d’autres pays, notamment avec le Royaume-Uni et la Malaisie en remplacement de leurs solutions locales.

CE QUE TU APPORTES

  • Expérience : Minimum 5 ans d'expérience sur un scope et des responsabilités similaires.
  • Expertise Métier : Une expérience significative sur un outil de paie et une forte appétence pour les enjeux techniques et légaux liés aux RH. Une connaissance de SAP HR est un sérieux atout.
  • Product Management & Agilité : Maîtrise de la méthodologie Agile (JIRA), vision orientée valeur produit, et capacité éprouvée à gérer des dépendances complexes et des roadmaps techniques.
  • Soft Skills : Excellente communication, leadership d'influence pour animer des tiers (éditeurs, intégrateurs) et collaborer avec des opérationnels experts. Esprit critique, orientation décisionnelle et forte capacité à prendre du recul.
  • Langues : Français & Anglais courant indispensable pour évoluer dans notre contexte international.

STACK TECHNIQUE

  • SAP HR & SAP BW HR
  • Environnement RISE S4
  • Écosystème SIRH (Workday, Etemptation) 
  • JIRA

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS

  • Organisation de travail hybride ;
  • Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac ou Windows) ;
  • Une équipe de projet locale au sein d'un réseau mondial (possibilité de carrière internationale) ;
  • Développement des compétences et accompagnement (diversité des projets, formations internes et externes, etc.) ;
  • Package de rémunération (actionnariat salarié, bonus mensuels/trimestriels).

NOTRE ENGAGEMENT EN FAVEUR DE L'INCLUSION ET DE L'ACCESSIBILITE

Chez Decathlon, nous reconnaissons l'immense valeur qu'apporte la diversité à nos équipes et nous nous efforçons continuellement de favoriser et de cultiver un lieu de travail inclusif et équitable : c'est pourquoi l'Inclusion est l'un de nos Fondamentaux Humains. Nous encourageons les personnes de tous horizons et de toutes capacités à postuler, car nous sommes convaincu·es que la diversité des pensées, des cultures, des identités et des expériences vécues nous rend plus fort·es.

Decathlon s'engage également à offrir un processus de sélection inclusif et accessible à tous les candidat·es. En cas de besoin d'aménagement, tu peux en faire la demande via le formulaire de candidature, celle-ci sera confidentielle. Ces demandes n'affectent pas le résultat du processus de recrutement.

DECATHLON DIGITAL 

Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

Changeons la donne pour de bon. Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. C’est pourquoi nous nous engageons à bâtir un modèle technologique plus durable, en réduisant notre impact direct sur l'environnement, et en créant un espace sûr et inclusif pour apprendre et nous épanouir ensemble. title: Directeur.rice des Finances
descriptionHtml:
283 – Directeur.rice des Finances

Premier opérateur public européen de traitement et de valorisation des déchets, le Syctom, l’agence métropolitaine des déchets ménagers, est un acteur majeur de l'économie circulaire et de la ville durable.

Au service de 81 communes franciliennes et de près de 6 millions d'habitants, le Syctom accomplit sa mission de service public avec pour objectif de faire des déchets une ressource.

Une mission exigeante qu'il conduit grâce à ses 145 collaboratrices et collaborateurs et 7 apprenti.es, en lien étroit avec les collectivités adhérentes (Ville de Paris et 10 Etablissements publics territoriaux du Grand Paris) en charge de la collecte des déchets et l'ensemble des acteurs de la filière.

Le budget annuel s’élève à 822 M€ et le Plan des Investissements 825 M€ d’ici 2030.

Le Syctom traite et valorise chaque année 2,2 millions de tonnes de déchets ménagers dans ses unités de traitement innovantes (3 unités de valorisation énergétique - UVE -, 5 centres de tri, 2 centres de transfert et une future unité de Biométhanisation). Le patrimoine du syndicat, alliant performance industrielle et exemplarité environnementale, est exploité sous contrat par des entreprises privées ou des SemOp présidées par un.e élu.e du syndicat.

Acteur responsable et innovant, le Syctom est engagé en première ligne dans la dynamique de transition écologique française. Il accompagne le développement de la collecte des déchets alimentaires, développe des solutions de traitement et de valorisation, agit en faveur de la réduction et du tri des déchets et s’engage dans la réduction des émissions de gaz à effet de serre (GES) liées à ses activités de transport et de logistique.

La Direction générale adjointe Ressources et moyens (DGARM) pilote les moyens financiers, humains, informatiques, juridiques et logistiques ainsi que du fonctionnement de l’institution et des actions œuvrant à la qualité de vie au travail. Elle accompagne les directions opérationnelles au quotidien, pilote des processus et démarches collectives et participe au projet stratégique de la collectivité, qui définit des orientations communes afin que le Syctom accompagne au mieux le territoire dans ses ambitions de développement durable.

Acteur clé de la performance et de la soutenabilité financière du Syctom, la Direction des Finances assure le pilotage des ressources financières de l’établissement. Elle accompagne les projets stratégiques de la collectivité en apportant son expertise en matière de planification et d’ingénierie financière, de construction budgétaire, de tarification et de financement des investissements, dans un environnement institutionnel, réglementaire et économique contraint et en constante évolution.

Dans un contexte de structuration et de modernisation de ses fonctions ressources, le Syctom mène actuellement un audit stratégique visant à renforcer la fonction financière et à développer une culture de pilotage et de contrôle de gestion. Celle-ci vise à consolider les capacités d'analyse et d'anticipation de l'établissement, à développer une culture de pilotage de la performance et à renforcer les outils d'aide à la décision au service de la Direction générale et des élu.es.

Missions

Sous la responsabilité du Directeur général adjoint Ressources et moyens, vous pilotez la définition et la mise en œuvre de la stratégie financière et budgétaire de la collectivité. Le budget 2026 s’élève à 479 M€ en fonctionnement et 343 M€ en investissement. Le montant de la contribution acquittée par les collectivités membres du syndicat est de 268 M€.

A partir d’hypothèses que vous coordonnez et documentez en lien avec les directions opérationnelles, vous réalisez des prospectives financières pluriannuelles. Dans ce cadre, vous êtes chargé.e de structurer un dialogue de gestion budgétaire qui permette d’optimiser les moyens financiers du Syctom et de piloter au plus juste le montant de redevance acquittée par les collectivités membres. Vous proposez un cadrage financier et pilotez les processus et calendriers budgétaires en lien avec les directions opérationnelles.

Dans le cadre de la feuille de route, vous êtes force de proposition et préparez, sous la responsabilité de la Direction générale, les travaux et décisions des élu.es quant à la trajectoire financière et tarifaire du syndicat. Vous conduisez les analyses financières en vue de déterminer les risques et opportunités à court et long termes, et proposez des scénarios à la Direction générale. Vous construisez et pilotez des indicateurs financiers clés et proposez des outils d’aide à la décision pour la Direction générale et l’exécutif, en développant le SI décisionnel financier.

Avec une dette de près d'un milliard d'euros, vous définissez et proposez à la Direction générale une stratégie de financement à long terme garantissant la soutenabilité financière des projets du syndicat. Vous supervisez la gestion active de la dette, de la trésorerie, des recettes et des financements externes.

Vous assurez également le pilotage financier du patrimoine industriel du Syctom et accompagnez la définition des trajectoires financières nécessaires au financement des charges futures induites par les investissements structurants, notamment en matière d'amortissements, de fiscalité et de coûts d'exploitation des nouvelles installations.

À ce titre, vous apportez une expertise de haut niveau en matière de fiscalité locale et de fiscalité des activités industrielles. Vous pilotez les démarches d'optimisation et de sécurisation des charges fiscales du syndicat et contribuez à la mise en place de processus et d'outils fiabilisés, en lien avec les directions techniques, patrimoniales et d'exploitation.

Le Syctom s’est engagé dans la création de SemOp pour l’exploitation de ses sites, dans le cadre de marchés publics. Vous participez activement à la mise en place des moyens de suivi et de contrôle financier de ces structures pour le compte du Syctom, en lien avec la gouvernance et les équipes qui qui en assurent la maîtrise technique et le contrôle des contrats. Vous assurez également le suivi des structures desquelles le Syctom est actionnaire (Semardel, Sigeif Mobilités).

Vous accompagnez la Direction générale dans le dialogue financier avec les collectivités adhérentes et contribuez à la pédagogie des enjeux financiers du syndicat auprès des élu.es et partenaires institutionnels tels que les établissements bancaires ou les agences de notation.

Dans un contexte de transformation de la fonction financière, vous encadrez une équipe et participez à des projets structurants visant à renforcer les outils de pilotage et le contrôle de gestion, avec l’opportunité de contribuer directement à l’évolution de l’organisation, des pratiques et des processus du syndicat.

Ce poste offre ainsi l'opportunité de contribuer directement à la transformation financière du premier acteur public européen du traitement des déchets ménagers, dans un environnement conjuguant enjeux industriels, financiers et environnementaux de premier plan.

Profil

De formation supérieure (Bac+5) en Finances publiques, vous disposez d'une expérience réussie en direction ou en pilotage financier et budgétaire d’un organisme public.

Vous détenez une expertise dans le domaine de la préparation et l'éxécution budgétaire comme dans la stratégie financière. Aguerri.e aux outils et processus associés, vous savez également les faire évoluer dans une perspective d'amélioration continue, et détenez une appétence pour les questions organisationnelles.

Vous avez une vision stratégique des enjeux financiers et budgétaires d’une collectivité, et avez la capacité à synthétiser et proposer une feuille de route et des options à des fins d'aide à la décision pour la Direction générale.

Pédagogue, réactif.ve et proactif.ve vous savez impulser et mener un dialogue de qualité avec les directions opérationnelles. Vous savez porter un projet et aider à la décision. Vous faites preuve de qualités managériales, d’un excellent sens relationnel et avez le goût du travail collaboratif et en équipe.

Recrutement par voie statutaire (cadre d’emplois des attaché.es ou administrateur.rices territoriaux.iales 1er grade) ou, à défaut, contractuelle (CDD de droit public).

Poste à pourvoir en janvier 2027.

Le Syctom est investi dans l'accompagnement des collaborateur.rices reconnu.es travailleur.ses handicapé.es.

Dans le cadre de sa démarche en faveur de l’égalité professionnelle et de la diversité, le Syctom s’engage contre toute forme de discrimination.

Le Syctom :

Facilite l’organisation des temps :

  • Forfait cadre
  • Possibilité de télétravailler jusqu’à 2 jours par semaine

Participe aux frais :

  • de télétravail avec l’allocation forfaitaire de télétravail (aux montants maximum permis dans la fonction publique)
  • de restauration : accès au Restaurant Inter Entreprise du siège du Syctom (prise en charge du Syctom à hauteur de 7,26 €) et attribution de tickets restaurant pour les jours de télétravail (d’une valeur de 12,10 €).

Encourage les déplacements les plus écologiques :

  • Mise en place du forfait mobilités durables

Participe à la santé et l’action sociale :

  • Participation à la Mutuelle et à la Prévoyance (contrats groupes conclus avec le CIG de la Grande Couronne)
  • Accès au Comité National d'Action Sociale (CNAS)

title: Director of Cloud Infrastructure & Security
descriptionHtml:
Vestiaire Collective is the leading global platform for desirable pre-loved fashion and a pioneer in transforming how people consume fashion. Our mission is simple: make circular fashion the norm, not the exception.
Through technology, expertise, and a highly engaged global community, we enable millions of people to buy and sell fashion in a more sustainable way. Founded in Paris in 2009, Vestiaire Collective is now a globally scaled marketplace with offices in Paris, London, Berlin, New York, Singapore, and Ho Chi Minh City, and logistics hubs across Europe, Asia, and the US. Today, we are a team of around 600 people from over 50 nationalities, united by a shared ambition: to drive meaningful change in the fashion industry. Our values, Activism, Transparency, Dedication, Greatness, and Collective, shape how we build, collaborate, and grow every day.

About the Role:

Vestiaire Collective runs a global marketplace on AWS and GCP — Kubernetes, Kafka, Terraform, Vault, Cloudflare, Datadog, a large PHP application under active modernisation, a series of microservices in different tech stacks (Goland, PHP, Node) and a fast-growing surface of AI-powered services.

As Director of Cloud Infrastructure and Security, you will lead a small team of six senior individual contributors across Cloud Infrastructure (DevOps/SRE) and Security. This is a hands-on Director role: alongside setting the strategy and roadmap, you will work directly with the team on architecture, technical decisions, incidents and delivery. You will be accountable, alongside Product Development teams, for the reliability, cost-efficiency and security posture of everything we run in production.

What you will do:

Leadership across two teams

  • Directly lead, develop and retain a small team of six (6) experienced engineers across Cloud Infrastructure and Security. This is a player-coach role without multiple management layers, so you will remain close to the team’s technical work and day-to-day priorities.

  • Define a joint roadmap for both teams, aligned to business priorities and risk appetite, and make explicit calls on what we will not do.

  • Establish clear KPIs, SLOs and risk metrics, and report regularly to leadership on reliability, cost and security posture.

  • Set the operating model: what product teams self-serve behind guardrails versus what your teams own centrally.

  • Foster a culture where reliability and security are shared accountabilities, not tickets thrown over a wall, including establishing a Security Champions model across engineering.

Cloud infrastructure, reliability and platform

  • Own our AWS and GCP footprint end to end: EKS, networking, secrets (Vault), data stores (RDS/Aurora, MSK, ElastiCache, MongoDB Atlas, OpenSearch) and the edge (Cloudflare).

  • Establish real reliability engineering practice: SLOs and error budgets, capacity planning, and a business continuity plan.

  • Drive infrastructure-as-code maturity: Automating Terraform change application, advancing our move to GitOps (ArgoCD), and enforcing guardrails at creation time with policy-as-code (Kyverno/OPA) so provisioning is safe, self-serve and reviewable.

  • Consolidate observability into a single source of truth for metrics, logs and traces.

  • Improve developer experience and delivery throughput: CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions), paved roads, test environments on demand, and delivery metrics that hold up.

  • Own FinOps: infrastructure cost per unit of business value, cost accountability pushed back to each team, and continued run-rate reduction. Cost discipline is a first-class objective.

  • Support the modernisation of our core platform: Tech migrations, runtime and framework upgrades, and continuous database and Kubernetes upgrades.

  • Attack toil systematically: automate the recurring requests, and hand safe self-service back to product teams rather than absorbing the work.

  • Grow the foundations for AI-augmented engineering and operations

Security

  • Own security strategy and posture across cloud, application, identity, detection and response, building and improving the governance: risk register, published roadmap, remediation SLAs, and a recurring reporting cadence for leadership.

  • Strengthen cloud security posture management (CNAPP) and secure-by-default configurations across all environments.

  • Improve Embedding security into the SDLC and CI/CD: establish full static-analysis and dependency-scanning coverage with clear criteria for when critical findings block a release.

  • Mature vulnerability management, penetration testing and our bug bounty program into one prioritised program with SLAs and aging reports that measurably reduce risk.

  • Advance identity and access management toward least privilege and zero trust: automated provisioning from groups, and periodic access reviews.

  • Mature logging, detection and incident response, closing SIEM coverage gaps

  • Set guardrails for safe AI adoption (shadow AI outside approved paths, data and prompt leakage, prompt injection, model abuse) and defend against AI-enabled fraud and phishing.

  • Ensure compliance with GDPR, PCI DSS v4, NIS2, and CIS v8, including a maintained, reusable evidence library rather than evidence gathered on request.

  • Collaboration with legal and finance teams on compliance and forensic investigation topics

  • Manage third-party and supply-chain risk with vendor tiering and a recurring review cadence.

  • Own the security-built services your team already runs (back-office authentication and ACL, banning/fraud tooling, phone verification) and decide what to keep, hand over or retire.

  • Own endpoint security and partner closely with Corporate IT on device and identity coverage.

  • Keep security awareness and training relevant to a threat landscape that now includes AI-enabled social engineering.

Who you are:

  • 8+ years with a Significant experience in Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, DevOps, SRE or Cloud Security, including experience leading engineers.

  • You may currently be an Engineering Manager, Senior Engineering Manager or Head of who is ready to broaden your scope and step into a first Director role.

  • Strong practical experience with public cloud, ideally AWS, Kubernetes and Infrastructure-as-Code, with the willingness to remain close to architecture, incidents and technical delivery.

  • Track record establishing reliability practice at scale — SLOs, incident management, on-call, capacity planning, disaster recovery.

  • Demonstrable cloud cost optimisation / FinOps results at meaningful scale.

  • Strong grounding in cloud and application security fundamentals — IAM, network security, secrets management, CSPM, OWASP Top 10 — and the judgement to know when to hire the depth you don't have.

  • Working knowledge of compliance frameworks (GDPR, DORA, PCI DSS, NIS2) and how to turn requirements into practical controls.

  • Experience leading through incidents and security events under pressure.

  • Excellent communication skills: able to make a technical trade-off legible to a CFO and a risk decision legible to an engineer.

  • Comfortable operating with a lean team — ruthless prioritisation, automation over headcount, pragmatism over perfection.

Our Tech Stack includes:

  • AWS cloud (primary), GCP, Kubernetes, Vault, Cloudflare, Datadog, ArgoCD, Okta. Applications are built on top of PHP 8, Golang and Node.js, using MariaDB, MongoDB and Kafka.

What We Offer

  • Purpose-driven work at scale

descriptionHtml:
Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, where you gain a tremendous amount of responsibility? Do you want to be part of an exceptional entrepreneurial team with young, motivated and extremely driven people? And are you curious or passionate about people? If so, you might be our next Director of Marketing.

About us

United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. To this date, we have organically launched six companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

As our Director of Marketing, you get the unique opportunity to take ownership of our content. You'll be working in-person in our HQ in London where you will constantly be pushed out of your comfort zone. To ensure a never-ending growth curve, we provide you with:

  • The opportunity of having a real impact - You'll be getting operational experience in a start-up where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matter to the business.
  • Inspiration and guidance - A chance to work closely with our high-performing team as well as with the CEO and founder of our company.
  • Unlimited growth potential in our company - we strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally.
  • Market-competitive compensation.
  • Travel opportunity: You will be joining our conferences overseas.
  • Invaluable transferable skills - boost your interpersonal, research, organisation, outreach and project management skills through experience and training.

Your Responsibilities

Responsibilities in this job will vary however, they will be mostly centred around:

  • Team Leadership: Manage and mentor the marketing team, fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment. Set clear goals and expectations and evaluate team performance regularly. Recruiter and onboard your team.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with sales, product development, and other teams to ensure alignment of marketing strategies with overall business objectives.
  • Campaign Management: Oversee the planning and execution of marketing campaigns across various channels, including email marketing, social media, website etc.
  • Strategic Planning: Develop and implement a comprehensive marketing strategy aligned with the company's overall objectives. Conduct market research to identify trends, opportunities, and challenges.

What we expect from you

We are looking for candidates who:

  • Have +10 years of work experience with outstanding performance in the industry.
  • Have a relentless drive and desire to be the very best at what they do;
  • Possess an unparalleled work ethic with a high sense of urgency;
  • Take ownership of everything they do, are proactive and follow through on commitments;
  • Are curious about people and love to speak, build and nurture relations;
  • Are an excellent communicator (especially) verbally and in writing;
  • Are well-organised and display the ability to structure and prioritise their work.

Start date

Flexible

Monday - Friday we work from our office (next to Victoria Station) and do not offer remote work.
