title: Director of Product, AML & Fraud Prevention
descriptionHtml:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

At Vinted we are devoted to making second-hand the first choice worldwide. Vinted Pay is the regulated payments entity that makes it possible through enabling Vinted users to spend money, receive money, keep money and payout, while keeping them safe from financial crime.

We are establishing a new AML & Fraud Prevention product domain within Vinted Pay. As a regulated financial institution operating across Europe, our obligations grow as we grow: anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing controls, sanctions screening, KYC, transaction monitoring are protecting our members and our balance sheet from fraud and other illegal activities. Today these capabilities sit across several teams and tools. This domain will own them end to end, and turn financial crime prevention into a mature product: controls that satisfy regulators without adding friction for the honest majority.

This is a newly created domain. As its leader you will work with your functional peers (Engineering, Data, Design) to assess the status quo and construct the long-term vision. You will be responsible for setting domain goals, delivering on already identified opportunities, hiring, and executing the product vision.

You’ll report to the leader of Engineering/Product/Design/Analytics at Vinted Pay, and partner with Product Directors across Vinted Pay and the wider marketplace, as well as with our Compliance, Legal, Risk, Risk Operations, Engineering, Design and Analytics functions.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Drive and align the AML & Fraud Prevention domain on a single, unified vision, expressed through measurable objectives and key results
  • Own the product roadmap across AML/CTF, sanctions and PEP screening, KYC, transaction monitoring and fraud prevention, build alignment across product teams, cross-functional partners and the leadership
  • Partner with our MLRO, Compliance, Risk and Legal teams to translate regulatory obligations into product requirements and make the case for automated solutions where manual controls are in place
  • Manage multiple competing objectives and provide clarity to the delivering organisation 
  • Use and analyse data to size risk, identify product opportunities, and build the right capabilities at the right time
  • Own build-vs-buy decisions, then assess and collaborate with the vendors in building and maintaining AML/Fraud prevention solutions
  • Get ahead of regulatory change: the EU AML package and AMLA, PSD3/PSR, evolving sanctions regimes, rather than reacting to it
  • Build, mentor, lead and scale a team of Product Managers
  • Implement best in class product development and managerial practices

About you 

  • 7+ years of experience in product management, with a substantial part of it in AML, financial crime, compliance, risk or fraud, ideally at a regulated financial institution, e-money institution, PSP, bank or fintech
  • 4+ years of developing people and managing teams, including Product Managers
  • Deep working knowledge of the AML domain: KYC and identity verification, customer risk scoring, sanctions and PEP screening, transaction monitoring and alert handling, SAR/STR reporting, and the regulatory frameworks behind them (EU AML directives and the AML package, national transpositions, FATF standards)
  • Hands-on experience with fraud and scam prevention: detection models and rules engines, account takeover controls, chargebacks and disputes, and the trade-off between loss reduction and false positives
  • A proven track record of successful product launches (at least two substantial projects with a 6–9 month minimum duration)
  • Comfortable operating in a regulated environment: you have worked alongside compliance officers, internal and external auditors and supervisors, and you know how to move quickly without creating regulatory exposure
  • Able to deliver from 0 to 1, and not afraid to build your own tools to achieve your goals
  • Exceptional leadership skills and substantial experience building high-performing teams of 10+, ideally not only in product (and we’d expect your former teams to still be singing your praises!)
  • Strong business judgement, analytical skills and long-term planning skill
  • Both quantitative and qualitative: able to assess and understand complex systems quickly, to integrate usability studies, research and market analysis into product requirements, and to be a product ambassador to the rest of the organisation
  • Well organised, with a collaborative attitude and a strong sense of ownership
  • An excellent communicator, including in written and spoken English

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Digital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP)
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per working day
  • Access to a discounted gym membership plan
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Comprehensive Medical Insurance
  • Group Life and Income Protection Insurance
  • A matched pension scheme up to a set limit.

Working at Vinted 

Individual Learning Budget

We invest in your professional growth! As part of our commitment to continuous learning, we offer an annual learning budget to support your personal and career development through courses, certifications, workshops and more.

Hybrid Work 

We’ve adopted a hybrid workplace model where 2 days in the office are recommended but not enforced. It’s up to you and your team to decide on the exact days you’ll spend working together in person.

Equal Opportunity

The Vinted Group is committed to building an inclusive workplace where people from all walks of life feel a sense of belonging. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and life experiences. At Vinted, all applicants are treated fairly without regard to their race, age, religion or belief, sex, national origin, citizenship, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

 This role requires a background screen that is relevant and proportionate to the role’s requirements, and carried out in line with applicable local law and data protection requirements.

The annual gross salary range for this position is:£105,800—£143,200 GBP

title: Director of Self Serve
descriptionHtml:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.


The Role

Self-serve today represents a meaningful part of Paddle's revenue. This role owns the commercial mandate to grow that significantly. Not just to run self-serve, but to build the strategy for where and how it scales, and execute against it.

We're hiring a Director of Self-Serve to take full commercial ownership of Paddle's self-serve motion, running and scaling it as a business line. Self-serve is a material and fast-moving part of our revenue, and it needs an owner who thinks in unit economics, not just funnel metrics.

You'll set the strategic direction, and work across Finance, Product, Engineering, Demand Generation, Partnerships, and RevOps to align everyone behind it. Getting this right is a genuinely cross-functional endeavour, and your ability to bring people with you will be just as important as your commercial acumen.

You'll operate with a small, focused team including engineering capacity. This is a role for someone who wants to build and run the engine hands on, not manage through layers.


What you'll do

Own the line. Carry the commercial number for self-serve end to end, from acquisition through adoption, to revenue and net retention. Own the unit economics, and how they improve.

Set the strategy. Form a clear commercial view of where self-serve creates value, ensure Finance and Product alignment, and translate it into a plan the business can execute against.

Own activation and time-to-value. Evolve who and how we onboard through self-serve, how we nurture them through lifecycle stages, and the in-product experience that gets them to value fast. Increasing volume while decreasing time-to-value, not trading one for the other. You fundamentally approach the self-serve experience as a product, running structured discovery and experimentation, not defaulting to only marketing levers.

Shape the demand. Define the customer profile that makes the economics work and work collaboratively with Demand Generation on the targeting you need, co-owning a single funnel against a shared ICP.

Orchestrate cross-functionally. Codify the work into clear streams with clear owners, influence the Product, Engineering, and Risk roadmaps, and run a regular business cadence that keeps people aligned on priorities and impact.

Deepen partner integrations. Work hand-in-glove with Partnerships to turn distribution relationships into deep well-integrated channels, owning the commercial outcome of partner-sourced volume.

Build and run the engine. Design and run the experimentation, tooling, and tracking to improve funnel codification, time-to-value, activation, and conversion using AI where it raises velocity and quality, applied to the right customer. As the motion scales, you'll shape the team around it.

Make the economics stack up. Working closely with finance you own self-serve pricing and packaging as a lever, to ensure profitable scale.


How you operate

Go get the answer yourself. When something doesn't add up, you pull the data, run the analysis, and don't wait to be handed a conclusion. Self-reliance is core to how you operate, not a fallback when support isn't available.

You interrogate, not just observe. Live the ‘five whys’ principle, with the ability to take a plausible looking number, trend, signal and stress-test it until you've found the actual driver, not the first explanation that fits. You default to hypothesis and experiment before you default to opinion or output, treating the funnel as something to be iteratively shaped, not just optimised within.

Given a mission, you don't let go of it. You have a real hunger to find and unlock value you believe is there, working through blockers, organisational, technical, or data.


We'd love to hear from you if you are

  • Deeply experienced in a PLG or self-serve motion in a high-growth tech business, where you've built and owned the funnel rather than a sales-assisted or enterprise motion, and have been accountable for the number, not adjacent to it.

  • A commercial operator who has owned a revenue line, channel, or segment. Someone who operates in founder mode with the instinct to understand the economics, not just the funnel beneath them.

  • You think like a product manager: prioritizing ruthlessly, scope experiments tightly, and see the boundary between growth and product as something to work across.

  • Fluent at moving from data to a commercial conclusion, with the discipline to separate signal from noise and turn analysis into a clear decision rather than a list of observations.

  • A sharp critical thinker who interrogates the brief rather than taking it at face value, challenges assumptions (including ours), and is as willing to conclude "this isn't where we should be investing" as to confirm the plan.

  • A genuine cross-functional leader who has brought structure to messy, multi-team programmes, influenced roadmaps you don't control, and run the cadence that holds a programme together.

  • A credible presence in front of senior stakeholders up to executive level; you communicate with clarity and authority and can take a room with competing priorities to a clear decision.

  • Equally comfortable operating at altitude and dropping into the detail, and always coming back up with a point of view, not just findings.

  • Able to use AI pragmatically; dynamic onboarding, predictive scoring, real-time segmentation, as a means to commercial outcomes, not an end in itself.

Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we're committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer, we don't care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you're from. We're more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you'll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don't match every part of the job ad, especially if you're part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there's anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We're committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let's grow together.

Why you'll love working at Paddle

We're a diverse, growing group of Paddlers who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We live and breathe our values, which are:

  • Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us”

  • Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple”

  • Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs”

We offer a full suite of benefits, including attractive salaries, stock options, unlimited holidays, enhanced parental leave, retirement plans, private healthcare and well-being initiatives.

We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

Connecting at Paddle

We're a 'digital-first' company, which means our Paddlers always have the freedom to choose where, when and how they work within our hub locations.

We recognise that where our Paddlers do their best work is unique to them and we provide trust and autonomy for everyone to work in a way which fits them best. We also value the power of connection and have invested in global hubs which help local communities flourish and bring us together for focused collaboration.

Our Paddle hubs:

  • In Europe: UK (London headquarters), Portugal (Lisbon hub), Netherlands and Ireland (Dublin hub)

  • In North America: Austin, TX (USA) and Toronto (Canada)

  • In APAC: Singapore

Our hub philosophy creates an engaging experience for all Paddlers, wherever, whenever and however we choose to work. To support this, we focus hiring within our hubs and will always openly share the available locations for each open position on our job description.

title: Director of Silicon Characterization
descriptionHtml:
At Kandou, we are redeﬁning the economics of AI infrastructure. Our mission is to democratise AI by signiﬁcantly reducing the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) of hardware systems — a critical barrier to scalable adoption.

 

Our proprietary MIMO-over-copper technology powers a high-performance, chiplet-based AI memory fabric that is both scalable and energy-efficient. Unlike traditional interconnects, our solution reduces power consumption signiﬁcantly while preserving high bandwidth and ultra-low latency — unlocking unprecedented efficiency for AI training and inference at scale.

 

Kandou’s architecture is not just an incremental improvement — it’s a foundational shift in how AI hardware is built for the future.

 

Job Title: Director of Silicon Characterization

Location: Saint-Sulpice, Switzerland

Responsibility

  • Own the silicon characterization strategy and execution for multiple product programs, from first silicon through validation closure and release readiness.

  • Lead development of comprehensive validation plans, schedules, resource allocation, and execution tracking across projects and locations.

  • Oversee development of scripts, automation frameworks, and program infrastructure for IC validation, characterization, and ATE interfacing.

  • Ensure rigorous and timely execution of silicon bring-up, debug, validation, and characterization for SerDes-based and other high-speed products central to Kandou AI’s portfolio.

  • Drive the definition, specification, and review of evaluation boards and reference hardware required for lab validation and customer enablement.

  • Support customer demos, technical evaluations, and issue resolution involving silicon, EVMs, and validation data.

  • Co-own silicon validation, characterization, and test reporting, ensuring clear communication of status, risks, correlation, and readiness.

  • Partner closely with design, product engineering, quality, applications, and operations teams to accelerate debug cycles and improve silicon learning.

Required Skills

  • Strong understanding of validation and characterization requirements for high volume semiconductor products and IP.

  • Ability to define validation coverage from product specifications and translate it into structured test plans, milestones, and resource plans.

  • Effective collaboration with analog, digital, DfT, product, and applications teams to review and finalize validation strategy.

  • Ability to lead teams and coordinate execution across multiple sites and external partners.

  • Sound judgment in selecting methods, tools, and trade-offs for technical problem solving.

  • Experience evaluating lab and test equipment, managing vendors, and supporting procurement decisions.

  • Good understanding of budgeting, lab investment planning, productivity, and cost management.

  • Flexible, pragmatic, and execution-oriented when addressing unexpected silicon or lab issues.

Required Experience

  • 10+ years of experience in the semiconductor industry, with deep expertise in IC bring-up, validation, characterization, and ATE interface development.

  • Strong hands-on experience in high-speed or high-frequency signal measurement, lab automation, and validation environments.

  • Proven expertise with instruments and methods used for electrical and compliance testing, including BERTs, oscilloscopes, and signal analyzers.

  • Experience with SerDes-based products is strongly preferred and especially relevant for Kandou AI’s technology roadmap.

  • Good understanding of high-speed multilayer reference PCB or evaluation board design for products with demanding signal integrity requirements.

  • Experience supporting customers through evaluation, debug, demonstrations, or product adoption activities.

Education

  • Bachelor´s or Master’s degree in Electronic Engineering or relevant field.

title: Director, Sales - Data & AI Security
descriptionHtml:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

About the Role:  

Veeam, following its acquisition of Securiti AI - the leader in AI-powered data security posture management (DSPM) - is seeking a Director, Sales to drive double-digit growth and lead high-performance teams, oriented around the Securiti AI portfolio. 

The Director, Sales DACH will lead Securiti AI's sales organization and drive revenue growth across the region. This senior leader will be responsible for developing and executing sales strategies, building and managing high-performing teams, and establishing Securiti AI as the leading provider of Data and AI Security, Privacy, and Compliance solutions.

  • Collaborate with Product, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to ensure alignment on go-to-market strategies, product roadmap, and customer needs, providing valuable market feedback to inform company direction 

What You’ll Bring:

  • Proven track record of consistently exceeding revenue targets in enterprise SaaS sales
  • Extensive experience selling complex technical solutions in security, privacy, compliance, or related fields

  • Track record of building and maintaining strategic partnerships with major consulting firms and system integrators

title: Direktor für Kreislauf- und Abfallwirtschaft (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
SIERA gestaltet Zukunft mit verantwortungsvoller Ingenieurleistung, innovativen Ideen und internationaler Zusammenarbeit. Als Unternehmen für Umweltingenieurwesen und Beratung entwickeln wir nachhaltige Lösungen für Klima, Wasser, Umwelt und Infrastruktur.

An über 33 Standorten in Deutschland arbeiten mehr als 800 Mitarbeitende über vier Kontinente hinweg an Projekten mit langfristiger Wirkung.

„Engineering for a Better Tomorrow“ ist unser festes SIERA-Motto. Gemeinsam schaffen wir Fortschritt für Umwelt, Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft.

Über die Position

Für die deutschlandweite Weiterentwicklung unserer Leistungen in der Kreislauf- und Abfallwirtschaft suchen wir eine erfahrene Führungspersönlichkeit. Sie verbinden technisches Wissen mit strategischem Denken und entwickeln Lösungen, die Abfälle vermeiden, Wertstoffe zurückgewinnen und Ressourcen langfristig im Kreislauf halten.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Fachliche und strategische Weiterentwicklung des Bereichs Kreislauf- und Abfallwirtschaft
  • Erstellung und Qualitätssicherung von Abfallwirtschafts- und Entsorgungskonzepten – von Sammlung und Transport bis zu Behandlung und Wertstoffrückgewinnung
  • Entwicklung von Konzepten für mechanisch-biologische Behandlung, Kompostierung und anaerobe Vergärung
  • Planung zirkulärer Geschäftsmodelle, beispielsweise Rücknahme-, Leasing- und Nutzungsmodelle
  • Beratung zu Ökodesign, langlebiger Produktgestaltung, zirkulärer Materialauswahl und digitalen Produktpässen
  • Entwicklung von Lösungen für hochwertiges stoffliches Recycling entlang der Lieferkette
  • Bewertung von Umweltwirkungen und Stoffströmen, insbesondere mithilfe von Lebenszyklusanalysen und Materialflussanalysen
  • Einordnung rechtlicher Anforderungen und Begleitung komplexer Projekte mit unseren Fachbereichen

Ihr Profil

  • Fundierte Erfahrung in der Kreislaufwirtschaft, Abfallwirtschaft oder Ressourcenplanung
  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und fachlichen Prüfung von Abfallwirtschafts-, Behandlungs- oder Recyclingkonzepten
  • Kenntnisse zirkulärer Geschäftsmodelle sowie gängiger Bewertungs- und Planungsmethoden

title: Electrical Engineer (Launcher)
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

Overview

Harmattan AI is developing new hardware products within the Launcher module: field-deployable drone launchers designed to be deployed and operated autonomously in demanding field environments. These products require dedicated electronics design with complex architecture in a constrained environment – PCBs integrating power conversion, energy management, control and communication interfaces – optimised for cost at volume. The Launcher team is seeking a dedicated hardware engineer to own electronics design end-to-end and accelerate the path to production milestones.

Ideal candidate

A senior hardware engineer who has designed and shipped complex PCBs, ideally mixing digital and significant power (hundreds of watts), into production. They are rigorous on schematics, layout, and bring-up, and have a strong instinct for cost and manufacturability. They design with real-world operating conditions in mind - temperature, moisture, surges - and an interest in battery thermal management; direct experience of outdoor-deployed equipment is a plus rather than a prerequisite. They are comfortable working autonomously in a small team and can bridge hardware and firmware.

Skills required

  • PCB schematic and layout design (Altium Designer preferred)

  • Power electronics design: ~300 W DC/DC conversion, protection, derating, efficiency and thermal budgets

  • Thermal regulation: temperature sensing and control loops, battery storage temperature management, heatsinking

  • Power over Ethernet (IEEE 802.3af/at/bt): combined power and data delivery, isolation, cable budgets

  • Mixed-signal design: power management, MCU interfaces, communication buses (SPI, I2C, UART, USB, CAN, Ethernet)

  • Hardware bring-up and debug: bench equipment proficiency

  • DFM/DFA for PCB manufacturing and assembly

  • Component selection and BOM management

  • Experience in lightning and surge protection is a plus

Responsibilities:

  • Schematic Design - Design complete schematics for mixed-signal and power boards, from power stages to digital and communication sections.

  • PCB Layout & Routing - Perform or lead board placement and routing with attention to signal integrity, EMC, and power-path constraints.

  • Power & Thermal Architecture - Define and validate the power architecture of the product and the thermal strategy, including battery temperature management.

  • Environmental Robustness - Ensure the electronics withstand outdoor deployment conditions and define the associated qualification plan.

  • Component Selection & BOM Optimization - Select components with cost, availability, and reliability in mind; drive BOM cost reduction for mass production volumes.

  • Hardware Bring-up & Debug - Lead board bring-up, debug issues with oscilloscopes, power bench equipment, and other bench equipment; write bring-up scripts when needed.

  • EMC & Safety Compliance - Address EMC challenges; ensure signal integrity across the board and electrical safety of the power and battery sections.

  • Collaboration with Embedded SW - Work closely with the embedded software engineer to define hardware/software interfaces; support firmware bring-up.

  • Collaboration with Mechanical - Ensure seamless PCB integration into mechanical enclosures (connectors, mounting, thermal, sealing, shielding).

  • Supplier & Manufacturing Ramp-up - Qualify PCB manufacturers and assembly houses; support DFM/DFA review for production; manage NPI transitions.

  • Documentation - Maintain schematics, layout files, test procedures, and hardware specifications.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Embedded Linux Engineer (Yocto Specialist)
descriptionHtml:
About Genesis

Genesis is a physical AI lab and full-stack robotics company building general-purpose robots, with teams in Paris and the Bay Area. Our people have built some of the most widely used platforms in robotics research including the open-source Genesis simulator, pioneered generative simulation and led foundation-model work at some of the world's leading AI labs. We own the whole stack: hardware, embedded systems, simulation, data and robot foundation models.

The Role

Every Genesis robot runs on a custom jetson thor compute board and every piece of software we write: control, perception, learned policies, depends on the Linux image underneath it. We are looking for a senior engineer to own that image end to end: build it, ship it to the robot, keep it updatable, and make it easy for the rest of the team to compile and deploy on top of it.

This is an in-house ownership role. You will be the reference for embedded Linux at Genesis, working closely with our embedded, robotics and application-software engineers in Paris and with our hardware partners. The job is to provide a reliable, well maintained and up to date os image, customized to our needs.

What You'll Do

  • Build, own and maintain the production Yocto/OpenEmbedded distribution for our robot's custom board: BSP, kernel, device tree, rootfs, toolchain and custom layers.

  • Bring up new hardware on NVIDIA Jetson-class platforms, integrating drivers and peripherals. Including hands-on debugging of components such as Wi-Fi, cameras, audio devices and buses on the physical robot.

  • Own the full image lifecycle: reproducible builds, versioned releases, secure and robust over-the-air (OTA) updates, and long-term maintenance as hardware and software evolve.

  • Deliver a development kit and workflow (SDK, cross-compilation, deployment tooling) so engineers can build and ship their software onto the robot quickly.

  • Integrate GPU and AI-accelerator inference stacks so that our models run efficiently on the robot.

  • Speed up the team's build and CI pipeline for image generation and validation. Builds are long, so caching and automation matter, as well as removing unnecessary dependencies.

  • Document the system and make it approachable, so the image is never again a black box that only one person (or contractor) understands.

Your First Three Months

  • Build a custom Yocto image for the robot's custom boards.

  • Flash, boot and validate it on real hardware, working through driver and integration issues on-site.

  • Set up the cross compilation workflow, caching, CI automations to streamline the robotics team work

What You'll Bring

  • Passion for your craft and demonstrated excellence in embedded Linux engineering.

  • 5+ years of hands-on embedded Linux experience, including shipping at least one Yocto-based image to production not only a prototype.

  • Proven ownership of an image through its lifecycle: maintenance, release management and remote/OTA updates.

  • Deep experience with Yocto internals: layers, recipes, BitBake, machine and distro configuration, SDK generation.

  • Strong board bring-up and low-level debugging skills: kernel configuration, device trees, drivers, boot chain.

  • Hands-on experience with the NVIDIA Jetson family (JetPack / L4T, meta-tegra) or comparable embedded GPU platforms.

  • Knowledge C++ and Python packaging systems and how to deal with cross-compilation.

  • The ability to explain how your work fits into the wider build, development and deployment system.

  • Exceptional ownership and initiative, with the judgment to choose workable solutions for our current stage over the theoretically ideal one.

Bonus

  • Experience integrating GPU / AI-accelerator inference (CUDA, TensorRT or similar) on embedded targets.

  • Background in robotics, drones, connected devices or other products with custom hardware.

  • Experience working with chip vendors or ODMs.

  • Familiarity with secure boot, real-time kernel tuning (PREEMPT_RT) or OTA frameworks such as Mender, RAUC or SWUpdate.

  • French and English. Mandarin is a plus.

You'll Thrive Here If You

  • Enjoy being the go-to person for a critical system and making it easier for others to use.

  • Unblock teammates' requests quickly and pragmatically, and know when "good enough to ship" is the right answer.

  • Stay patient and methodical when a single build takes two hours and a bug only shows up on hardware.

  • Like startup flexibility: changing priorities, short feedback loops and work that ranges from kernel to tooling.

title: Engineering Manager - Unified Platform
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Team

The Unified Privacy Platform team’s mission is to earn the trust of every DoorDash user by upholding their right to privacy, consent, and transparency. We are building a common privacy foundation across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo so Consumers, Dashers, and Merchants can understand how their data is used, control their choices, and exercise their privacy rights through simple, consistent experiences.

Our work is organized around three connected pillars: the Privacy Center, a unified user-facing destination for privacy controls and rights; the Unified Privacy Platform, which captures and enforces consent, policy, jurisdictional requirements, and privacy actions; and Privacy Operations and Intelligence, which gives Legal, Support, Privacy, and engineering operators the workflows, diagnostics, audit history, and automation needed to resolve privacy work safely and efficiently. 

Together, these capabilities turn fragmented, one-off compliance work into reusable platform primitives that can support new products, brands, and emerging regulations.

Location: London, UK. This is a hybrid role, with 3 days a week in the office.

About the Role

DoorDash is looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the Unified Privacy Platform team. You will lead a team of backend and platform engineers responsible for the next generation of privacy and consent infrastructure, including the Privacy Center, the User Consent Platform, privacy-policy decisioning, self-service data-rights experiences, and the operational tooling required to manage privacy cases at global scale.

As the Engineering Manager, you will own and execute a multi-year vision for privacy at DoorDash. You will balance legal and regulatory correctness, user trust, security, reliability, and developer velocity while building systems that work consistently across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. You will be a strategic partner to Product, Legal, Security, Data Governance, Marketing and Communications, and engineering leadership, establishing clear ownership boundaries and turning complex privacy requirements into scalable, self-service capabilities.

What you'll be doing

  • Lead and mentor a high-performing team of backend and platform engineers, fostering a culture of ownership, privacy by design, operational excellence, and thoughtful cross-functional partnership

  • Build the cross-brand User Consent Platform, including canonical consent state, policy and configuration management, consent SDKs, audit history, and consistent enforcement across products and jurisdictions

  • Lead the migration from fragmented legacy consent systems to a single source of truth across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo, while managing compatibility and safe deprecation
  • Define clear contracts with data-governance fulfillment systems and downstream product and storage teams so privacy actions are traceable, retryable, auditable, and correctly reflected back to users and operators

  • Partner with recruiting to build a diverse and inclusive team, attracting and retaining exceptional engineering talent

  • Proven experience designing large-scale distributed systems, service application programming interfaces (APIs), policy or rules engines, workflow orchestration, state machines, data-lifecycle systems, or audit architectures
  • Preferred experience with privacy, consent, data governance, or regulatory systems, including concepts such as the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA), data-subject rights, retention, deletion, and legal holds
  • The ability to translate ambiguous legal, policy, and product requirements into clear platform boundaries, reusable abstractions, and executable roadmaps
  • Strong product sense and the ability to partner effectively with Legal, Product, Design, Security, Data, Marketing, Support, and engineering teams across multiple brands and geographies
  • A growth mindset—you are eager to expand your skills, raise the quality bar, and build enduring systems in a rapidly changing environment

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

descriptionHtml:
Why Join Sales at Ashby

Sales at Ashby is a unique opportunity to sell a product customers genuinely love during an AI-fueled market expansion. Over 5,000 companies rely on Ashby, including OpenAI, Bolt, Statista, Neura Robotics and Monday.com, and our business is durably growing faster than 100% year-over-year. We’re well funded, and on a path to profitability. That's exceptionally rare for a company at our scale, and puts us in the top 10% of benchmarks.

Nearly 1 in 3 of Ashby’s globally distributed team call Europe home! We’ve landed over 1000 customers in EMEA representing ~23% of our global revenue base, with well over 100 in the DACH region, clear evidence of strong product-market fit. We’re doubling down our investment in the region with in-market GTM, CS and Support resources. EU Data Residency and product localisation are committed and coming soon. We believe there is a meaningful opportunity to help modern teams move beyond legacy recruiting software.

Ashby replaces 3-5 tools in a consolidation & efficiency play that’s equally loved by recruiters and CFOs. We’re known as a clear AI-leader in the recruiting space. We are rapidly extending from a best-in-class recruiting product toward a multi-product platform, expanding upmarket, into new industries, and internationally. For sales reps, that means a large market full of legacy tools, and a product portfolio that creates room for both new business and expansion. This is a chance to participate in how a category-defining company wins in its next phase of growth.

We are equally intentional about how we build the business. We have established a remote-first, high-performing sales organization that rewards learning and accountability. We use data to set achievable quotas, and reward sustained impact with competitive compensation and meaningful upside. We prioritize coaching and career development, with AEs advancing to Enterprise & Leadership roles in just a few years — 38% of the team who have been here more than a year have been promoted or taken on a new role!

You will work with people who care about craft, customer outcomes, and winning together—without sacrificing the trust, autonomy, and balance required to do your best work over the long term. Don’t just take my word for it, see what the team has to say about working here.

About this Role

TA tools in the Enterprise represent a huge market opportunity, a $1B+ TAM, and the incumbents are legacy players. We are seeking a German-fluent and Germany-based Enterprise Account Executive to help us win Enterprise (1,000+ employees) accounts by managing the full sales cycle from pipeline generation through to closed-won.

  • 🎯 You are proactive in identifying and pursuing new business opportunities, and comfortable sourcing >50% of your own pipeline. You're both resourceful and innovative in finding new business opportunities.

  • 💻 You can confidently deliver micro-demos before engaging your SE partners. You can't imagine not being fluent in the product you sell.

  • 🎧 You are highly skilled at discovery. You believe in preparation to establish a point of view, and through discovery validate or refine your perspective to identify a project's business drivers aligned to executive priorities.

  • 🤝 You have strong business acumen. You quickly connect the dots between technical problems and their downstream business impacts. You craft compelling business cases with this context.

  • ⚔️ You're adept at competitive or evangelical selling in new or established markets.

  • 🏔️ You skillfully guide prospects through the evaluation—engaging the right stakeholders at the right time to create consensus for a strategic technology decision.

  • 🤓 You enjoy becoming an expert and tailoring discussions to address each prospect’s unique challenges.

  • ⚡️ Your peers describe you as action-oriented and persistent. You're always on the leaderboard for outbound effort and pipeline created.

  • 🔍 Your peers describe you as detail oriented. You write and send crisp follow-up emails, on time. You also take pride in internal operations, like real-time CRM updates. (We use HubSpot, Gong, Chili Piper and Apollo.)

  • ✈️ You are willing to travel at least 25% of the time for customer engagements and events.

Requirements:

  • 🤝 You have 5+ years of full-cycle closing experience and have closed many >$100,000 ACV opportunities

  • 📢 You have experience selling complex platform technologies in a sales-led GTM motion

  • 📈 You are a new business hunter and are confident in your abilities to self-source >50% of your own pipeline

  • 🌍 You have sold to multiple regions within EMEA and have strong written and verbal fluency in both English and German

  • 🇩🇪 You are based in Germany

You shouldn't apply if:

Interview Process

Our interview process is thorough — we aim to ensure each person that joins the team is the right fit for Ashby and will provide ample information for you to assess if Ashby is the right fit for you. The process for this role is as follows:

title: Enterprise Deployment Strategist
descriptionHtml:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

about the role

As Enterprise Deployment Strategist you own deployment and commercial success for a portfolio of telli's largest (tier 1) customers. You lead complex, high-stakes deployments with many stakeholders on both sides, from signature to first production call and from pilot to long-term contract.

what you'll do

Enterprise Pilot Ownership & Commercial Success

  • Build business-case-driven use cases and quantify their impact on the customer

  • Make the case for conversion and expansion: surface the value delivered, close the loop with decision makers and identify upsell opportunities

AI Advisory & Stakeholder Management

  • Navigate the enterprise: understand and navigate complex organizations and stakeholder relationships

  • Shape the customer's AI roadmap beyond the current use case and become their advisor for AI transformation in customer operations

  • Communicate across all levels, from call center agents and team leads to C-level and procurement

  • Scope, structure and execute high-stakes deployments end-to-end for tier 1 customers with multiple workstreams and stakeholders

Technical Implementation

  • Understand the customer's tech stack and workflows (CRMs, dialers, telephony, ticketing, calendars) and shape the integration architecture together with FDEs

Product Insights

  • Be the best read on how enterprises use telli and where the product falls short, and proactively feed learnings to PM and engineering

what makes you a great fit

  • You have >2 years ofexperience owning ambiguous, high-stakes outcomes with large customers (e.g. in consulting, GTM, AI deployment/customer success, or IT implementation)

title: Events Lead
descriptionHtml:
About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

Due to growth, we are seeking an experienced Events Lead to take complete ownership of our events programme and build CuspAI's events function from the ground up.

Your Impact

In this role you will be building the global events engine that accelerates CuspAI and the AI Materials Foundry, which is critical for driving real-world impact of our work across international markets.

Your main focus initially will be executing our flagship in-person Foundry event and subsequent international roadshows across Asia and Europe. Over time you will build out a repeatable event model, assemble an agile agency and vendor network, and establish CuspAI’s experiential presence across global scientific and machine learning conferences. As the team scales, the function will also own internal events.

What You Will Do

Foundry Events & Global Roadshows

  • Own our flagship in-person Foundry event end to end, establishing the core gathering for our global partner network.

  • With Partnerships, design, plan and deliver a regional roadshow of Foundry events across Asia, Europe and North America, creating a repeatable model for international expansion.

  • Run a regular cadence of virtual events to keep the global Foundry ecosystem engaged between in-person moments.

Partner, Customer & Conference Presence

  • With Comms/Marketing and Partnerships, design high-touch events for industrial partners and enterprise customers (e.g. executive dinners, virtual showcases, roundtables) aligned to commercial and ecosystem goals.

  • Own CuspAI’s presence at major conferences (e.g. NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, materials science summits): evaluate sponsorships, oversee booth and recruitment stand design, manage on-site logistics, and report on ROI.

  • Partner with Operations to deliver internal moments such as CuspCon, offsites and all-hands.

Interdisciplinary Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Communications, Product Marketing and Creative to bring CuspAI’s brand identity into physical spaces.

  • Work with Partnerships, Comms/Marketing and Operations to align every event with commercial, ecosystem and company goals.

  • Source and direct external agencies, AV suppliers and local vendors, and own budgets, timelines and post-event reporting to leadership.

Must Have Skills and Qualifications:

  • You are someone who gets excited about enabling world-class scientists and industry partners to collaborate on global sustainability and materials challenges.

  • 5+ years of experience in event management, experiential marketing, or event operations within a high-growth tech, deep-tech, or B2B environment.

  • Track record of delivering high-touch physical and virtual events internationally across EMEA and APAC regions.

  • Strong vendor management experience, with a history of sourcing, negotiating with, and directing production agencies, AV teams, and freelance staff.

  • Proven ability to balance strategic planning (e.g. budget management, roadmap design, ROI measurement) with hands-on, on-site event execution.

  • Excellent cross-functional stakeholder skills, with experience collaborating directly with executive leadership, sales, partnerships, and creative teams.

  • Flexibility to undertake regular UK and international travel for events, conferences, and site visits.

Bonus Points (But Not Critical):

  • Prior experience in a startup or scale-up environment building an event function or operational processes from scratch.

  • Direct experience engaging scientific, research-led, or highly technical audiences.

  • Familiarity with event management software, virtual event tools, and CRM systems (e.g. HubSpot, event platforms).

  • An eye for spatial design, environmental branding, or experiential production.

Additional Considerations

This role could be based in our Cambridge, London, Amsterdam or Berlin offices, with the expectation of being in the office three days per week. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to other locations for collaboration and project work.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

  • Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

  • Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

  • ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

  • Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

  • Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

  • True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other


Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.


CuspAI is an equal opportunities employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

We actively encourage applications from all backgrounds and value the unique perspectives and contributions that diversity brings to our team.

Please let us know if you require any specific adjustments during or after the interview process. We will do everything we can within reason to accommodate.

title: Field Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
The way companies innovate is broken. The systems built to create and protect ideas can’t keep up with the pace of change. Today, 90% of S&P 500 company value is intangible (e.g., in intellectual property) - yet R&D and IP teams spend half their time buried in manual work, sifting through patents and paperwork instead of pushing the frontier forward. The tools of creating and protecting are stuck in the past. We’re here to fix that.

Ankar is building the R&D tools for the AI era and defining what applied research will look like in the next 20 years. We’re building infrastructure and product experiences our customers rely on every day. You’ll translate messy, ambiguous problems into clean, dependable software—and you’ll do it at the cutting-edge of AI.

We’re at an inflection point:

  • We’ve raised >$24M to date from Tier-1 VCs like Atomico, Index Ventures, Norrsken, Daphni, and angels like the Founder of Hugging Face, CEO from Datadog, and Leaders from DeepMind and OpenAI.

  • We’re already working with the world’s most innovative companies including Fortune 500 company L’Oréal and global law firm Vorys

  • Expanding our world-class team with alumni from Palantir, Amazon, and BCG to tackle the $1T+ innovation market. We’re just getting started.

What you'll be doing

Own how Ankar shows up in the market - where we show up, what we do, and how we turn those moments into commercial outcomes. You’ll work closely with Sales and Commercial Development to build field programmes that create and accelerate pipeline.

  • Own Field Marketing end-to-end. Lead everything from industry conferences and webinars to executive dinners, roundtables and targeted experiences.

  • Build programmes around commercial priorities. Understand target accounts, active opportunities and pipeline gaps, and design programmes that create and accelerate demand.

  • Partner deeply with Sales. Drive target account selection, outreach, meeting generation and fast follow-up around every programme.

  • Build account-based experiences. Bring together events, gifting, direct outreach, digital and content to engage strategic accounts.

  • Execute brilliantly. Own logistics, vendors, speakers, stakeholders and timelines across multiple programmes.

  • Measure what matters. Track impact through account engagement, opportunities, deal progression, pipeline and revenue.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in B2B field marketing, owning and executing programmes from events and webinars to targeted account-based experiences.

  • Strong experience partnering with Sales to support target accounts, create pipeline and accelerate active opportunities.

  • Highly autonomous and comfortable managing multiple programmes, stakeholders, vendors and deadlines end-to-end.

  • Creative and commercially minded, with a strong bias towards action and measurable commercial outcomes.

  • Excellent communicator, able to work effectively across Sales, Marketing, leadership and external partners.

This role is not for you if...

  • You need a highly structured environment, a predefined playbook, regular working hours, or a schedule that never requires travel. We operate with high autonomy and ownership, expect our team to go above and beyond, be obsessed with our mission and thrive in ambiguity rather than wait for direction.

  • You prefer long planning cycles and certainty before acting. We move quickly, ship often, and adapt based on customer feedback and new information.

  • You want to manage the work rather than do the work. We're builders first, and everyone is expected to contribute directly to creating exceptional products.

  • You take it personally when ideas are challenged, priorities shift, or work gets redirected. We care more about finding the right answer than defending a particular one.

What we put behind our people

Building at the frontier takes exceptional people. We invest accordingly.

  • Health Insurance : Full private health & dental coverage for you and your dependents.

  • Pension: Flexible pension scheme with up to 5% employer matching on qualifying earnings.

  • Food on us: Team lunches twice a week, plus dinner when working late in the office.

  • Cycle to work: Green Commute initiative scheme (up to £3k) to help you get a new bike tax-free.

  • Way we work: We combine deep, in-person collaboration (3 days/week in our Shoreditch office) with flexibility and trust. What matters is ownership, impact, and results, not where you work from.

  • Visa sponsorship: Yes

title: Finance & Operations Intern
descriptionHtml:
Job description

Today, the Finance & Operations team at Maki is two people. Together we cover finance and operations, including HR and part of legal, across three entities: France, the UK and the US.

That means this internship isn't a back-office job: it's a front-row seat. You will be our first Finance & Operations intern, working hand in hand with our Founding FP&A, who you report to directly, on the processes and numbers that keep the company running across three jurisdictions.

You'll be expected to roll up your sleeves, get into the detail, and own real work from week one. Nothing here is theoretical.

If you want breadth rather than a narrow slice, and you'd rather build processes than inherit them, this is your opportunity.

💪 About your mission

  • Finance operations: Support day-to-day finance: client billing, supplier payments, cash management and financial documents.

  • Reporting & analysis: Contribute to monthly reporting (P&L and cash), to management reports commenting on business performance, and to KPI tracking for board and investor reporting.

  • Planning: Support budgeting and forecasting.

  • People operations: Contribute to the employee lifecycle: onboarding, offboarding, HR documents and employee records.

  • Legal and contracts: Help prepare and track contracts and corporate documents.

  • Be the first answer: Act as the first line of response for the team's day-to-day administrative questions.

  • Build, don't just maintain: Formalise and improve our processes and tools so they scale with the company.

  • Ad hoc projects: Support the team on both one-off and strategic topics.

We're looking for someone who wants to understand how a company actually works, not just one function of it. If you're excited to learn fast, take ownership early, and build something that outlasts your internship, we'd love to hear from you.

🔭 Our vision

Give human resources more-than-human powers.

🎯 Our mission

Build the conversational AI agent that liberates HR teams, advances organizations, and expands human potential.

🎨 Our values

We are still very young and our culture is evolving as we grow together. Nonetheless, below are values we identify ourselves with:

  • Play to Win - Our ambition is limitless. We relentlessly aim for the top, pushing forward to be number one.

  • Push the Boundaries - Innovation drives us. We adapt, evolve, and set new standards to redefine what's possible.

  • Trust is Earned - Trust is our foundation. We hold ourselves to the highest standards of transparency, security, and responsibility.

  • Embrace Intensity - Speed and precision define our approach. We execute with urgency, focus, and purpose to create immediate, tangible impact.

  • Stronger Together - We succeed as one. Collaboration, shared purpose, and collective ownership are at the heart of our progress.

Preferred experience

🧑‍🔧 What we are looking for

  • A Master's student (M1 or M2) looking for a 6-month internship from January 2027, as a gap year or end-of-studies internship.

  • Bilingual in French and English, written and spoken.

  • Rigorous by instinct: you notice when a number doesn't tie, and you care enough to find out why.

  • Comfortable in Excel or Google Sheets: formulas, pivot tables, handling messy data without panicking.

  • Discreet: you will handle confidential data every day.

  • Autonomous: the team is small, so you'll be trusted early and asked to figure things out.

  • Curious about how companies are built, not just how spreadsheets work.

  • Prior exposure to finance, audit or accounting is a plus, not a requirement.

A note on diversity @MakiPeople

"Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of colour are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles."

🌱 Your progression with us

  • Learn from someone who built it: You'll be mentored one-to-one by the person who set up our finance and operations function, not rotated through a large team.

  • Make a real impact: In a team of two, there is no busywork. What you produce is what the company runs on.

  • Build a rare skill set: Few interns get exposure to finance and operations across three jurisdictions at once.

💝 What we offer

Recruitment process

title: Financial Analyst
descriptionHtml:
🏷️ Title: Financial Analyst

👫 Department: Analytics. Reporting to the Head of Analytics, working closely with our Co-Founder & CEO

💰 Salary: £60,000 - £80,000 + equity

🎁 Benefits & Culture: See here.

📈 Equity: A very generous EMI share offering.

🌴 Holiday: 26 days + bank holidays.

💗 Mission: Elevate later life for everybody and build the care sector of the future.

💻 Office Policy: Hybrid with a minimum of 2 core office days per week.

🌍 Office Location: London Bridge, London, UK.

 

🔍 The Opportunity:

Lottie is building the AI operating system for social care. Families find care through our marketplace. Care providers use Found to manage enquiries, occupancy and finances, with Eliza, our AI agent, answering family calls and chats on their behalf.

Lottie is growing fast. Care providers want what we're building, and we're heading into our next stage of growth. We need someone to get under the skin of the numbers, understand what's driving our success, and turn that into the plans, budgets and decisions that shape where we go next.

That's where you come in. You'll be the technical, commercially minded person at our CEO's side - writing the SQL, building the models and bringing the numbers that shape our biggest decisions. No middle man between the founder and the data: you go to the source yourself, work it out from first principles, turn it into a clear recommendation and then help make it happen.

With 2027 set to be Lottie’s most ambitious year yet, you'll own business planning and budgets, support investor relations and future M&A, and partner with teams across Lottie, including our commercial and marketing teams, to help them hit their goals. If you love both the data and the commercial story behind it, this is the role for you!

 

💻 What does this role involve?

  • Shape where Lottie goes next: Work directly with the execs on the biggest calls we make - pricing, where we invest, what we build - and own the analysis that decides them.

  • Sit at the heart of the business: Partner with Commercial, Marketing, Product, Ops and Finance to uncover what's really driving performance, and help each team act on it.

  • Own the financial model: Build and own the company's plans, budgets, forecasts and scenarios, track performance against them, and turn the variances into actions with the teams who own the numbers.

  • Board and investor numbers: Own the numbers for board packs and investor updates - clear, defensible and ready for scrutiny.

  • Turn insight into change: Take a question from analysis all the way to delivery, running it like a PM so the business actually moves.

  • Build, don't inherit: Use SQL, Python and AI to build the tools and processes a scaling company needs, from first principles.

💪 What problems will you be solving?

  • The data behind our success: Why is a new growth channel working so well, and how do we double down on it?

  • Pricing & unit economics: What drives margin in each product, and where pricing and packaging can lift it.

  • Board-ready numbers: Models, metrics and reporting that stand up to the scrutiny of investors.

  • M&A: Identify, evaluate and understand strategic acquisitions that accelerate Lottie growth.

  • Getting to the "why": Moving from what the numbers say to why they say it, and what we should do about it.

👀 We think you'll be a great fit if you…

  • Strong financial modelling: you can build a budget or forecast from scratch, read a P&L, balance sheet and cash flow, and turn it into a clear recommendation for Will. No FP&A title or accountancy qualification needed - a strong data or commercial background with real modelling depth is enough.

  • You are genuinely technical - you write your own SQL, work in git, are comfortable in Python and build financial models from scratch.

  • Work deeply with AI - you use tools like Claude every day to query data, build models and move faster.

  • Think from first principles and get quickly to how a business really makes money.

  • Can take a messy question, get to the data yourself and present a clear recommendation to a founder and leadership team.

  • Enjoy working closely with a founder - direct, curious and comfortable challenging up.

  • Are a builder, not just a modeller - you take a topic, run it like a PM and make it happen across the business at startup pace.

Sound like you but not quite 100%? Apply anyway - we're looking for potential and passion, not a perfect CV match.

 

💔 This role isn't for you if you...

  • Need someone else to pull the data. Here you write the SQL, build the model and own the answer.

  • Want to hand over a deck and walk away. We need someone who sees the decision through and makes the change happen.

  • Like analysis but shy away from action that comes from it. You'll be expected to make the call and defend it with the CEO and the leadership team.

  • Need a clear playbook and constant direction. Most of what you'll work on hasn't been done here before.

  • Want to stay in your lane. This role spans Growth, Product, Ops and Finance, often in the same week.

🔢 Lottie's Interview Process

  1. First interview with Lottie's Talent Acquisition Lead - 20 mins (remote)

  2. Interview with Will Donnelly, Lottie's Co-Founder & CEO - 30 mins (remote)

  3. Technical interviews - SQL, Python and financial modelling (using AI tools is encouraged)

  4. Final interview with Will Donnelly in Lottie’s office.

🤩 Candidate Experience:

  • Pre-Screen & First Interview: You'll receive an email notification, but no specific feedback will be provided at this stage.

  • Technical Interviews: If you are not successful after the technical stage, you'll receive constructive feedback via email and be offered a debrief call with our Talent Lead.

  • Final Interview: For final-stage candidates who are not offered the role, we will provide your feedback live via a phone call.

🚀 Meet Lottie

Founded with a mission to build the care sector of the future, Lottie is creating the AI operating system for social care - designed to unlock profitability for care providers and to make finding care as easy as booking a holiday on Airbnb.

Launched in London in July 2021, Lottie is widely recognised as one of Europe's fastest growing tech companies. Most recently, Lottie was the acclaimed winner of Deloitte Fast 50, LinkedIn Top Startups, The Sunday Times Tech 2026 and Startups 100.

As of today, Lottie offers three core products:

  • Lottie (B2B2C Marketplace) - Free service that helps families find the UK's best care homes and home care services.

  • Found by Lottie (B2B Vertical SaaS) - AI-native OS software supporting care providers to effectively manage their enquiries, occupancy and finances. Eliza by Found is our newest Found module: AI agents that handle care home enquiries - so no family goes unanswered. Launch video here.

  • Seniorcare by Lottie (B2B Vertical SaaS) - Employee benefit helping companies deliver outstanding eldercare support to their employees.

🤩 Why Lottie?

  • Career Opportunity - A career-defining opportunity to work side by side with our CEO on the data and numbers that shape Lottie's next stage of growth.

  • Early Hire Benefits - Be an early hire at one of the UK's fastest growing startups and benefit from fast career progression, as well as a generous stock options package.

  • Mission - Tech for good that aims to build the care industry of the future and to positively impact millions of people's lives. Care is one of the final remaining large consumer industries that is yet to be disrupted and positively revolutionised by technology.

  • Investors - Backed by tier 1 venture capital investors including Accel and General Catalyst.

  • Global Opportunity & Scalability - Be part of a company that is solving a real tangible problem that every family around the world faces at some point in their life.

  • People - Join a kind, talented and mission-driven team that loves coming to work every day.

  • Culture - Excellent employee compensation and benefits, hybrid office policy and outstanding company culture with a 5/5 employee review score on Glassdoor.

  • Award Winning - Acclaimed winner of Deloitte Fast 50, LinkedIn's "Top Startups", the Startups.co.uk 100 Index and most recently 20th in The Sunday Times 100 Tech 2026.

As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

About the Team

The Flight Test organization is a mission-focused, flat, and highly collaborative multinational team that serves as the critical bridge between engineering labs and real-world deployment. Working directly alongside software and hardware engineering, the team runs high-tempo flight campaigns globally to rapidly iterate, validate, and field STARK’s advanced autonomous platforms.

Your Mission

As a Flight Test Engineer, depending on your experience, you will be responsible for the planning, execution, and analysis of flight tests for experimental fixed-wing UAV platforms. You will work closely with the experimental R&D team to conduct flight research or validate system performance and contribute to the next generation of our autonomous flight technologies.

What you will be doing at STARK

  • Plan, coordinate, and execute UAV flight tests in compliance with all applicable safety and operational protocols. 
  • Develop flight test plans, test cards, and flight test hazard assessments.
  • Process and analyse flight data and provide feedback for future system improvements.
  • Work with Ardupilot and PX4-based flight control systems.
  • Document all flight activities, test results, and anomalies thoroughly.
  • Collaborate closely with software developers and hardware engineers to rapidly iterate and improve UAV performance.
  • Contribute to flight readiness reviews, safety review boards and support certification and development activities.

What you bring to the Mission

  • Hold a bachelor’s degree or higher in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Have practical experience planning and conducting system or flight tests in related industry or projects.
  • Have practical experience with data reduction, processing and analysis techniques using tools such as Excel or Python.
  • Have a problem-solving mindset, coupled with an ability to work independently in a dynamic startup environment.
  • Possess excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Be a citizen of a NATO member state (due to export control and security regulations)

Nice-To-Have

  • Active previous experience as a Flight Test Engineer in either crewed or uncrewed aviation.
  • Experience as a UAV / General Aviation pilot (hobbyist, commercial, or military experience).
  • Be familiar with UAV ground control stations, telemetry systems, and flight planning tools.
  • Experience in operating drones as a qualified RPIC during test flights.
  • Hands-on knowledge of developing and tuning Ardupilot and PX4 open-source autopilot systems.
  • Experience with flight test instrumentation and data acquisition systems.
  • Have knowledge of aviation regulations. (EASA SORA, or similar)

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

SECURITY CLEARANCE

Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Flight Ticketing and Disruption Manager
descriptionHtml:

We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway.

Our trailblaze together culture is what drives our success, powered by our people and the way they work. Using progressive technology, we drive cutting-edge innovation and improve how our customers discover, book and experience their holidays. You’ll have the opportunity to accelerate your growth through meaningful challenges, new experiences and the freedom to shape your own path. You’ll create impact for our future by taking ownership, contributing to shared goals and helping shape what comes next, all as part of our enhanced international community of talented, collaborative and passionate teams.

The difference you’ll make

You'll work closely with Commercial, Supply Tech, Product and Finance to own ticketing and disruption performance across our 140+ airline partners, making sure every flight we sell is ticketed correctly and every schedule change is handled quickly, accurately and fairly. Together, the team uses airline know-how, data and automation to protect revenue, reduce manual effort and give customers a consistent experience whenever their travel plans change, in every market we sell in.

Aviation sits within our Enablement function, where everything we do starts with the customer. From the moment someone books to the day they arrive home, Customer Experience teams make sure they feel looked after, especially when things don't go to plan. By turning what we learn from every booking, contact and disruption into better processes, clearer communication and smarter tools, the Customer function helps build the trust that brings customers back to loveholidays time and again.

Your day-to-day:

  • Own ticketing and amendment quality including both managed and self-managed airline relationships, keeping queues clear and disruption handled consistently

  • Own the day-to-day operational performance of the team, maintaining strong operational grip across queue health, ticketing turnaround, SLA adherence and quality. Use data and insight to identify recurring issues, drive continuous improvement and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations that improve performance and customer outcomes

  • Act as the team's subject matter expert for Amadeus Robotics, driving adoption of automation and robotic tools across the team.

  • Share best practice from the core market across all points of sale, keeping process documentation current and consistently applied.

  • Play a central role in getting Flight Ticketing & Disruption ready for new market launches, from process setup to team readiness.

  • Lead, coach and motivate a team of ticketing agents, supporting escalations and day-to-day people leadership.


Your skillset:

  • Experience working across both scheduled and low cost carriers

  • Strong and recent Amadeus GDS experience a must

  • Experience of flight pooling, including the coordination, allocation and optimisation of flight inventory across multiple channels, markets or customer bookings.

  • Experience in managing the operational complexity this creates, ensuring accurate ticketing, timely action on schedule changes, effective queue management and strong control of service levels, quality and commercial outcomes

  • Experience with Amadeus Robotics or other automation tools

  • Knowledge of BSP processes, ADM/ACM notices, ticketing rules and IATA regulations a real advantage

  • Comfortable working with data and reporting to identify issues and track performance.

  • Strong communication skills, able to share best practice and coach others effectively

The interview journey:
