title: IT Systems Automation Engineer (f/m/x)
descriptionHtml:
bonial helps you save time, money and paper!

We are a digital advertising partner for offline businesses - we support retailers in their marketing activities and help them find a new audience. Would you like to join and be a part of digitalisation of retail?

bonial is part of Axel Springer SE and is disrupting the retail landscape as the leading "Drive to Store" partner in Germany and France. Through our platforms "kaufDA" and "MeinProspekt" in Germany, and “Bonial” in France, we connect millions of users with their favorite shops and brands—driving real impact every single day.
We are in the midst of an exciting growth phase, scaling fast and transforming the way people discover retail. At bonial, we thrive in a high-performance, fast-paced environment fueled by motivated, results-driven individuals who are passionate about making a difference. If you’re looking to be part of a dynamic team that’s shaping the future of retail, we’d love to meet you.


bonial welcomes both full- and part-timers!

About The Role

IT Operations keeps the company's core productivity, identity, and device ecosystem running smoothly and securely. As IT Systems Automation Engineer, you will own the design, implementation, and maintenance of automation across our corporate IT platforms (including M365, Google Workspace, JAMF, Microsoft Intune, Atlassian & Slack). You'll reduce manual work for the team, improve consistency and security across the employee lifecycle. You’ll help build the scripts, integrations, and workflows that let a 6-person team support the whole organization efficiently. This is a hands-on engineering role within IT Operations, not a helpdesk position - you'll spend most of your time building and improving systems rather than handling day-to-day tickets.

What You’ll Do

  • Automate the employee lifecycle: Design and maintain automated workflows for onboarding, offboarding, and role changes across M365, Google Workspace, JAMF, Intune, and Slack (provisioning/deprovisioning accounts, licenses, group memberships, and device enrollment)

  • Device management: Build and maintain JAMF (macOS/iOS) and Intune (Windows/mobile) configuration profiles, compliance policies, and automated patch/update workflows.

  • Identity & access automation: Automate group and license assignment, conditional access rules, and access reviews across M365 and Google Workspace, working closely with the security team where relevant.

  • Collaboration tooling: Manage and automate Slack workspace administration - channel provisioning, app/integration approvals, user lifecycle, and usage policies.

  • Scripting & integration: Write and maintain scripts (PowerShell, Google Apps Script, or similar) and use APIs to connect systems that don't natively integrate.

  • Documentation & runbooks: Document automation logic, workflows, and recovery procedures so the rest of the team can support and extend what you build.

  • Monitoring & reliability: Set up monitoring/alerting for automated workflows so failures (e.g., a broken onboarding script) are caught and resolved quickly.

  • Continuous improvement: Identify manual, repetitive IT Operations tasks and propose/build automation to eliminate them.

  • Vendor & tooling evaluation: Assess new automation tools or platform features (e.g., new Intune or JAMF capabilities) and recommend adoption where it adds value.

  • Agentic support: Design, build, and operate AI agents that resolve common IT support requests end-to-end (e.g., password resets, access and software requests, device troubleshooting) via Slack or the service desk, connecting them to M365, Google Workspace, JAMF, and Intune through APIs, with clear guardrails, approval steps, human escalation paths, and audit logging.

  • AI enablement: Roll out and administer AI tools across the organization (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Claude AI/Code, or similar), including license assignment, data access and governance settings, and usage policies, working closely with security, legal, and the works council where relevant, and support employees with onboarding guides, training materials, and best practices.



What We’re Looking For

  • Required:

    • Experience in IT Operations, Systems Administration, or a similar role with hands-on scripting/automation responsibility.

    • Practical experience administering at least two of: Microsoft 365 (Entra ID/Exchange/SharePoint admin), Google Workspace, JAMF, Microsoft Intune.

    • Working proficiency in at least one scripting/automation language (PowerShell, Python, Bash, or Google Apps Script) and comfort using REST APIs.

    • Understanding of core identity and device management concepts: SSO, MDM/UEM, conditional access, device compliance.

    • Ability to document processes clearly for a small team that needs to maintain what you build.

  • Nice to Have:

    • Experience with Slack administration or Slack API/workflow automation.

    • Experience with a scripting/orchestration platform (e.g., Workato, Tines, Zapier, Azure Automation, or similar iPaaS tools).

    • Relevant certifications (e.g., Microsoft MS-102/MD-102, Jamf Certified Admin, Google Workspace Administrator).

    • Familiarity with security/compliance frameworks relevant to endpoint and identity management (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001).

    • Experience working on a small IT team where you own end-to-end delivery rather than a narrow slice of a larger org.

What We Offer:

High growth story - bonial is a high-growth and dynamic company with continuous potential into the future. We are a leading player and a driving force in an industry that is undergoing a massive and a once-in-a-lifetime shift from print to digital.

Innovation & tech - we are a high-tech company focused on innovative technology, leveraging AI and other tools to maximize productivity and efficiency. We leverage these tools to continually enhance the performance of our company and our people, while driving results for our customers and users.

Exciting environment for professional development - strong support for your professional development, backed-up by a feedback culture to help you identify your strengths and opportunities.

Diversity - proud to be an equal opportunity workplace where we aim to enable everyone to show up as their full selves. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and to being a safe space regardless of race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender, gender identity or gender expression.

Wellbeing - we believe mental health is as important as being fit. That's why we're giving you free access to nilo.health, a mental health app. In terms of physical training, other than our awesome gym in the office, we also cover part of the subscription to the Urban Sports Club. We can also offer you a corporate pension scheme so you don't have to worry about your retirement.

Sustainability - together with our Green team, we offer you the opportunity to engage in projects that promote sustainability, environmental development and the impact that we make on our planet.

Flexibility - Currently, we have a policy that allows for up to 20% mobile work, which can be conducted from anywhere within Germany, and the option to work from abroad. Additionally, we offer 28 days of holiday. You also get an extra day for each calendar year (up to 30 days) as well as other occasions (moving, working on a social project, etc).*

Modern office - Zen Rooms where employees can pray, relax or simply have some quiet time; fully equipped gym in the office, and a roof terrace for amazing social events.

Free lunch – whenever you’re at the office, we offer you different lunch options – and it’s all on us! Enjoy your lunch at a nearby restaurant that partners with us! Hot and cold drinks, fruit, regular varied and healthy breakfasts and other snacks at the office are, of course, always available for free for our employees.*

Social Culture – which encourages people to start conversations, build relationships and participate together in the community through regular team events.

Partner for retail - we empower retailers to reach their customers in the most efficient and effective way possible. We see ourselves as a critical business partner for retail, and as highlighted in our Company Vision, we “Enrich local shopping for everyone. Everyday.”

As part of the Axel Springer Group, we also align with the Axel Springer Essentials.


If you think you could fit the bill, we'd love to hear from you!

You can check out our bonial_people Instagram or read more about bonial culture and tech on Medium.

*as per our current Works Agreements

title: Junior Clinical Fellow
descriptionHtml:
Be at the forefront of a new era in patient care

Are you a doctor who has completed Foundation Training and is looking for a unique clinical opportunity? This is your chance to work at the cutting edge of cannabis based medicines, supporting patients with complex and often life changing conditions while gaining experience in an emerging area of medicine.

Join a passionate and forward thinking clinical team in a rapidly growing field where no two patients, or days, are the same. You will work alongside experienced consultants, pharmacists and multidisciplinary specialists, contributing to meaningful patient outcomes while developing your clinical expertise in a progressive and innovative healthcare environment. This role is offered as a 12 month fixed term contract

 

What is the job?

We are recruiting a Junior Clinical Fellow to join our London team. This is a hands-on, patient focused role where you will play a critical part in prescribing and reviewing cannabis-based medicines for patients with complex clinical needs.

Your work will centre on delivering safe, effective and highly personalised treatment, supporting patients across a wide range of conditions.

Collaboration is at the heart of what we do. You will work closely with a multidisciplinary clinical team, contributing not only to outstanding patient outcomes but also to the development of clinical pathways, education initiatives, and service improvements. This role offers a genuine opportunity to grow your expertise and make a lasting impact in a fast-evolving specialty.

This is a full time role contracted at 40 hours per week. Your time will be split across three days on site and two days working remotely, with one Saturday per month required on site. Saturday working is compensated with a day in lieu.

What will you be doing?

  • Conduct clinical reviews via video call with patients during their journey through the clinic.

  • Prescribe medicines and tailor treatments to individual patient needs.

  • Provide expert guidance to patients on treatment options.

  • Clinically check and review CBPM prescriptions for safety and accuracy.

  • Help to answer complex clinical queries and provide guidance to our patient support and other external teams.

  • Maintain accurate patient records in line with GMC standards.

  • Deliver education and training on CBPM to patients, clinicians, and staff.

  • Collaborate with the wider team to streamline processes and improve outcomes.

What do you need?

  • Registered medical practitioner with the GMC and a full licence to practice

  • Completion of Foundation Year 2 (F2) training or equivalent clinical experience including a placement in GP or A&E.

  • Experience working in a clinical setting

  • Knowledge of CBPM is desired not essential or willingness to undergo specialised training

  • Clear and confident communicator across clinical and non-clinical settings

  • Highly effective at managing time and prioritising competing demands

  • Proactive and resourceful when identifying and resolving problems

  • Well-organised, detail-oriented, and able to manage complex workflows

What we offer:

  • Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three) + 8 bank holidays

  • Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions

  • Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, and more

  • Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams and represent Montu at events, with support to grow your skills and impact

  • Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave

  

About Us

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

 

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments.

title: Junior Solution Architect
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij meewerken aan IT-oplossingen die belangrijk zijn voor Nederland?

Ben jij analytisch, nieuwsgierig en goed in het bewaren van overzicht? Vind je het interessant om te begrijpen hoe verschillende IT-systemen, applicaties en infrastructuur met elkaar samenwerken? En krijg je energie van het bedenken van oplossingen én het samenwerken met verschillende teams?

Via het Business & IT-traineeship van The Trainee Company start je jouw carrière als junior IT-professional. Vanuit het traineeship ga je aan de slag als Junior Solution Architect binnen een IT-team in Den Haag waar je meewerkt aan de ontwikkeling en doorontwikkeling van complexe IT-oplossingen binnen het domein Inspectie & Handhaving.

Je hoeft nog geen ervaren architect te zijn. We zijn juist op zoek naar een starter die technisch geïnteresseerd is, snel verbanden legt en zich wil ontwikkelen richting solution architectuur.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Junior Solution Architect werk je mee aan het ontwerpen en verbeteren van IT-oplossingen. Je brengt verschillende belangen en systemen samen en helpt ervoor te zorgen dat oplossingen technisch goed op elkaar aansluiten.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Meedenken over het ontwerp en de doorontwikkeling van IT-oplossingen;

  • Vertalen van functionele en technische behoeften naar passende IT-oplossingen;

  • In kaart brengen van systemen, applicaties, koppelingen en datastromen;

  • Meedenken over de inrichting van architecturen en technische ontwerpen;

  • Samenwerken met developers, infrastructuurteams, business en andere IT-specialisten;

  • Ondersteunen bij migratie- en verandertrajecten;

  • Rekening houden met security, beheerbaarheid en toekomstbestendigheid;

  • Documenteren en presenteren van architectuurkeuzes;

  • Bijdragen aan het bewaken van de samenhang tussen verschillende IT-oplossingen.

Je komt terecht in een omgeving waarin je veel kunt leren van ervaren professionals. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf stap voor stap te ontwikkelen richting een rol als Solution Architect.

Affiniteit met onderwerpen als cloud, infrastructuur, API's, digitale koppelingen, security en IT-architectuur is een pré.


Het Business & IT-traineeship

Via The Trainee Company combineer je werken, leren en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Je start met een intensieve onboarding en ontwikkelt je daarna verder in de praktijk.

Tijdens het traineeship volg je trainingen en behaal je relevante certificaten, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van ITIL, Azure Fundamentals en Agile/Scrum. Daarnaast krijg je persoonlijke begeleiding en coaching, zodat je zowel technisch als persoonlijk kunt groeien.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je bent analytisch en kunt goed verbanden leggen;

  • Nieuwsgierig naar IT en architectuur;

  • Je vindt het interessant om complexe vraagstukken te doorgronden;

  • Communicatief sterk en kunt goed samenwerken met verschillende mensen;

  • Je werkt gestructureerd en houdt graag overzicht;

  • Leergierig en staat open voor feedback;

  • Je kunt technische informatie vertalen naar begrijpelijke taal;

  • Je hebt een relevante HBO- of WO-opleiding afgerond, bijvoorbeeld in de richting van IT, Informatica, Technische Informatica, Business IT & Management of een vergelijkbare opleiding;

  • Bereid om minimaal 2 dagen per week in Den Haag te werken.

Deze vacature is onderdeel van onze werving voor de traineeshipklas die in maart 2027 start. We komen graag nu al met je in contact.

title: Vertriebsmitarbeiter KI-Lösungen (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du findest KI spannend, aber noch spannender, was Unternehmen damit im Alltag wirklich anfangen können? Du redest gern mit Menschen, erkennst schnell, wo in einem Betrieb Zeit liegen bleibt, und willst einen Kunden vom ersten Anruf bis zur Unterschrift selbst begleiten? Dann passt du zu uns.

Ob Berufseinsteiger oder erfahrener Vertriebler: Wichtiger als die Zahl deiner Berufsjahre ist uns, dass du neugierig bist, zuhörst und ehrlich berätst. Du musst kein Entwickler sein. Wie unsere Plattform funktioniert, lernst du bei uns, mit den Leuten, die sie gebaut haben.

Wir sind MintCode Solutions aus Haselünne, ein Team aus 8 Leuten. Neben klassischer IT-Infrastruktur haben wir Nexus entwickelt: eine KI-Plattform, die komplett auf lokaler Hardware beim Kunden läuft. Nexus ersetzt kein ERP und keine andere Software, sondern dockt an die vorhandenen Systeme an. Betriebe automatisieren damit ihre eigenen Abläufe, von der Belegerfassung aus E-Mails über die Angebotserstellung bis zur Wissensdatenbank.

Aufgaben

  • Du erschließt dein eigenes Kundengebiet für Nexus und bist dafür verantwortlich.

  • Du betreust deine Kunden vollständig selbst, von der Kaltakquise bis zur finalen Unterschrift: Es gibt keine Übergabe an einen anderen Vertriebler

  • Du baust den Vertrieb für unsere KI-Plattform mit auf

  • Du planst selbst, welche Unternehmen du in deinem Gebiet ansprichst, und gehst aktiv auf sie zu, per Telefon, über LinkedIn, auf Veranstaltungen und über dein Netzwerk

  • Du führst Erstgespräche und findest gemeinsam mit dem Kunden heraus, welche Abläufe sich für KI eignen und welche nicht

  • Du zeigst Nexus in Demos, online und vor Ort, und erklärst es so, dass auch Nicht-Techniker den Nutzen verstehen

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Technikern die passende Lösung und erstellst das Angebot

  • Du fasst nach, verhandelst und holst die Unterschrift

  • Du bleibst auch nach dem Start der Ansprechpartner deiner Kunden, erkennst, wo Nexus ihnen noch Arbeit abnehmen kann, und baust dein Gebiet Schritt für Schritt aus

  • Du pflegst deine Kontakte und Gespräche so, dass jeder im Team den Stand nachvollziehen kann

  • Du bringst zurück ins Team, was Kunden fragen und brauchen, und redest bei der Weiterentwicklung von Nexus mit

Nexus ist bei Kunden bereits im Einsatz, der Vertrieb dafür steht aber noch am Anfang. Du hast entsprechend viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Und du stehst nicht allein da: Bei technischen Fragen ist immer ein Kollege da, der mit in den Termin kommt oder mit dir draufschaut.

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit:

  • Eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische oder technische Ausbildung, ein Studium oder vergleichbare Praxis, Quereinsteiger sind willkommen

  • Du nutzt KI-Tools selbst und hast Lust, dich tief in das Thema einzuarbeiten

  • Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu und telefonierst gern, auch mit Leuten, die dich noch nicht kennen

  • Du hörst zu, fragst nach und verstehst schnell, wie ein Betrieb arbeitet

  • Du erklärst Neues so, dass es beim Gegenüber ankommt, ohne Buzzwords

  • Du bleibst dran, auch wenn es beim ersten und zweiten Anruf noch kein Ja gibt

  • Du führst Gespräche zu einem Ergebnis und scheust dich nicht, nach dem Auftrag zu fragen

  • Du sagst offen, was du denkst, auch gegenüber Kunden, wenn KI für ein Problem nicht die richtige Lösung ist

  • Führerschein Klasse B und Reisebereitschaft, weil du regelmäßig bei Kunden vor Ort bist

Schön, wenn du das schon kannst (sonst lernst du es bei uns)

  • Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, idealerweise mit Software oder erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten

  • Erfahrung mit Angeboten, Verhandlungen und Abschlüssen

  • Verständnis für Geschäftsprozesse, zum Beispiel aus Buchhaltung, Einkauf, Vertrieb oder Produktion

  • Erfahrung mit ERP-Systemen aus Anwender- oder Beratersicht

  • Erfahrung mit einem CRM-System

Für uns zählen Persönlichkeit, Motivation und Potenzial mehr als ein perfekter Lebenslauf. Wichtig ist, dass du ehrlich berätst und Lust hast, besser zu werden.

Benefits

Ein Produkt, das du zeigen kannst. Nexus läuft bereits bei Kunden. Du verkaufst keine Folien, sondern etwas, das du live vorführen kannst.

Möglichkeit auf einen eigenen Firmenwagen. Bei uns hast du die Möglichkeit, einen eigenen Firmenwagen zu bekommen. So bist du für Kundentermine flexibel unterwegs und musst dir um dein eigenes Auto keine Gedanken machen.

Moderne Tooling-Kultur. KI-gestütztes Arbeiten für Recherche, Angebote und Vorbereitung statt Zettelwirtschaft.

Wellpass oder Streaming-Abo. Sport in tausenden Studios deutschlandweit oder Spotify bzw. Netflix auf uns. Such dir aus, was zu dir passt.

Bildungsurlaub ist willkommen. Kein unangenehmes Gespräch, kein schlechtes Gewissen. Wer sich weiterbilden will, hat unsere volle Unterstützung.

Start-up-Flair. Kurze Entscheidungswege, echte Eigenverantwortung und eine Atmosphäre, in der Ideen mehr zählen als Hierarchien.

Flexible Arbeitszeiten. Leben und Arbeit muss man manchmal jonglieren. Dafür hast du bei uns Verständnis und Spielraum.

Das sehen wir als Standard an

  • Ein modern ausgestatteter Arbeitsplatz

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • 38-Stunden-Woche

Wenn du ein KI-Produkt verkaufen willst, das bei Kunden wirklich im Einsatz ist, dann bewirb dich bei uns!

title: Key Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Key Account Management Team


Our Account Management team’s purpose is to make our key accounts stay and grow with Alan. We created the team in 2020 and we are now 30+.
We are looking for amazing people to help us take care of our growing pipe on Public Sector accounts (Ministries and other public entities).
Being a Key Account Manager at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate experts, with different backgrounds.
We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?


As a Key Account Manager, you will:

  • Handle a portfolio of strategic accounts in the Public Sector

  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships with key stakeholders and display a customer-centric approach to identify the main needs and allow our clients to achieve their goals through Alan

  • Proactively identify potential signals of dissatisfaction and implement solutions to answer them

  • Ensure successful onboarding of new accounts and promote Alan health partner positioning to generate massive adoption by employees and admins

  • Analyze and present consumption reports to customers through business reviews

  • Identify and execute out-of-the-box initiatives to engage our existing customers

  • Renegotiate contracts to guarantee both great value for money to our customers and sustainable profitability

  • Participate in the evolution of our products and services, acting as the voice of our customers when discussing with Product teams

You would be a great fit at Alan if most of this sounds like you:

  • You have at least 6 years of experience in a customer-facing role including frequent interactions with C-Levels

  • You have full working proficiency in French (excellent oral and written communication)

title: Lead AI Product Manager - Product Vertical
descriptionHtml:
About Zego 🚀

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor.

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

Overview of the Product Team

Product Managers at Zego are change-makers. We build and scale data-driven, impactful solutions that enable Zego to offer competitive and personalised insurance. Working in a fast-paced Agile environment, our team thrives on innovation, cross-functional collaboration, and driving measurable outcomes.

We’re building a product organisation where AI isn’t a buzzword - it’s how we work. From rapid prototyping with generative AI to using machine learning models that power our core pricing, our PMs operate at the frontier of what technology can do for insurance.

From enhancing pricing models to streamlining digital experiences, our Product team is instrumental in shaping the future of insurance.

 

About the Role

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager who combines strategic depth with a hands-on builder’s instinct. You’ll own strategic workstreams that span multiple teams and business domains, defining the 6-12 month product direction and shaping how Zego’s products evolve to meet ambitious commercial targets.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy, execution, and leadership. You’ll define new product mechanics and revenue models. You’ll make build-vs-buy-vs-partner recommendations that shape Zego’s competitive position. And you’ll champion an experiment-first culture - using AI to compress discovery cycles, generate sharper insights, and ship at a velocity that sets the standard for the rest of the organisation.

You’ll work closely with Zego’s Leadership Team on strategic decisions, lead cross-functional programmes, and mentor Product Managers - raising the bar for how the entire product community operates.

 

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Set the six-to-12-month product strategy across multiple teams and domains, including the build, buy or partner calls that shape Zego's competitive position.

  • Define and validate new revenue mechanics, from 0 to 1 propositions to upsell and retention loops, grounded in unit economics and customer insight rather than gut feel.

  • Embed rigorous experimentation as the default operating rhythm, so rate of learning replaces opinion as the leading metric.

  • Build reusable AI playbooks, workflows and assets that multiply the whole team's output, not just your own.

  • Design the product metrics and dashboards the business runs on, and use financial, behavioural and usage data to ground every strategic decision.

  • Own company-level programmes with direct P&L impact, accountable for commercial outcomes rather than feature delivery.

  • Coach Product Managers across the organisation, raising the bar for product craft and data capability.

What You’ll Need to Be Successful

  • Strategic product leadership. Significant experience leading product strategy across multiple teams or domains in a high-growth environment, with decisions that moved business-level metrics.

  • Experiment-first operator. You have built experiment cultures, not just run individual tests, and you make build, measure, learn the default rhythm for your teams.

  • Commercial and financial fluency. Deep understanding of unit economics, pricing levers and revenue modelling, and credible with Finance and Leadership on P&L-level decisions.

  • Data mastery. You design the metrics and dashboards the business relies on, and you are as comfortable in Snowflake as you are in a strategy review.

  • Technical depth. Comfortable engaging engineers on system architecture, APIs and ML pipelines, enough to make informed strategic bets.

  • You work AI-first. You will use AI daily here, and we mean daily. You do not need to arrive an expert, but you do need to arrive curious, experiment fast, and take ownership of getting good quickly. People who wait to be trained will find this uncomfortable.

The Zego ways of working 🏡

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London, Gibraltar or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year.

Here is what the last one looked like.

Benefits 🎁

💰 Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year.

🏆 Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution.

📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build

🩺 Private medical insurance.

🏖️ Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new.

💻 Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact.

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? We want to hear from you.

Zego, leading the AI evolution in insurance.

Equal opportunities 🌈

We're an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

You will report to Florence, Anti-Financial Crime Director (Western Europe), and lead Qonto’s EDD production team. Working closely with KYC/KYB, Operations and Anti-Financial Crime stakeholders—including colleagues responsible for regulatory and project-related matters—you will translate agreed requirements into effective day-to-day practices and give the team the support, guidance and production visibility it needs to succeed.

➡️ What you'll do

  • Lead production with rigor: organize daily workloads, monitor incoming cases, backlog and output, and resolve blockers. Establish clear KPIs to track volumes, progress and performance.

  • Support sound EDD decisions: provide second opinions and four-eyes checks, guide complex investigations and risk assessments, and ensure verified sources and clear assessment memos support conclusions. Help the team escalate high-risk cases appropriately.

  • Raise review quality: deepen customer-profile reviews and improve consistency as capacity grows, balancing thorough investigation with prioritization and timely delivery.

  • Keep the customer experience in view: work with customer-facing and Operations teams to make EDD requests clear and reduce unnecessary back-and-forth and delays, while maintaining robust controls and acting firmly when risks warrant it.

  • Develop a growing team: onboard and coach team members through real cases, share best practices and build autonomy. Step into production during workload spikes or capacity gaps.

  • Drive continuous improvement: improve EDD workflows and handoffs with KYC/KYB and Operations, using production insights and quality findings to reduce friction and strengthen delivery. Keep operational procedures clear and current, working with regulatory and project colleagues to embed agreed changes into daily practice.

  • Use AI with judgment: monitor AI-assisted EDD activity and control coverage, and coordinate improvements and bug fixes with Security.

➡️ What we're looking for

  • Relevant experience: you bring solid KYC/AML, EDD or related financial-crime experience, including hands-on production work.

  • Regulatory and investigative expertise: you apply KYC/KYB and AML/CFT requirements to complex customer profiles, verify sources, identify risk patterns and document clear, well-supported conclusions.

  • Production management: you organize work, prioritize cases, monitor backlog and capacity, and use KPIs to improve delivery without compromising quality.

  • Leadership potential: you guide colleagues, give practical feedback and help a relatively junior/new team grow. Formal management experience is not essential; understanding the lead role and being ready to step up are.

  • Stakeholder management and customer focus: you collaborate across teams, communicate clearly and stay composed under pressure. You reduce customer friction without compromising controls or regulatory requirements, challenging requests and escalating when needed.

  • Continuous improvement and technical curiosity: you seek better ways to work, use EDD tools confidently and explore AI with a critical eye on its outputs and limitations.

  • Languages: you are fluent in English and French; another European language is a plus.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • A role with tangible impact: improve EDD production quality, stability and visibility, supporting sound risk decisions and Qonto’s growth.

  • An opportunity to support a growing team: share your expertise and help colleagues build confidence and autonomy as the team expands.

  • A practical improvement mandate: turn production insights into clearer processes, stronger reviews and better collaboration with Operations, AFC and Security.

  • Exposure to evolving compliance operations: help scale operations as Qonto progresses toward becoming a bank, including responsible AI use in EDD.

  • Room to grow: deepen your EDD expertise and develop leadership and coaching skills, with potential future expert opportunities in AFC, Risk & Compliance, AML or Operations, depending on your development and business needs.

➡️ Your future manager

Your manager will be Florence, our Anti-Financial Crime Director (Western Europe).

title: Lead Engineer, Maritime
descriptionHtml:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the role

UFORCE is growing rapidly, and we’re looking for a Lead Engineer, Maritime to take hands-on technical ownership of a maritime product and help turn operational lessons from Ukraine into a reliable, manufacturable system that customers can test, deploy and reorder.

You’ll initially focus on one product, working across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and field teams to solve the most important technical problems and take it from its current configuration to repeatable production and customer delivery.

This is a hands-on engineering leadership role, not a management-only position. You’ll stay close to the hardware, lead system-level trade-offs, investigate failures and make sure design changes are supported by test evidence and reflected in what we build.

We’re looking for someone who combines strong maritime engineering judgement with the ability to bring people together and deliver at pace. As UFORCE’s maritime portfolio expands, there is potential to grow into broader technical leadership, including Chief Engineer, Maritime, based on business need and demonstrated performance.

What you’ll do

  • Own the product’s technical baseline across hull, propulsion, power, onboard electronics, control, communications, navigation, payload interfaces and control systems.

  • Work with naval architecture and marine engineering specialists to maintain the stability, structural, weight and safety evidence supporting the product configuration.

  • Translate customer requirements, operator feedback and field experience into clear engineering priorities and an executable delivery plan.

  • Lead technical trade-offs and systems integration across mechanical, electrical, marine-control and software interfaces.

  • Work closely with Ukrainian product experts and international engineering teams to preserve operational knowledge and develop the product for Western customers.

  • Establish practical requirements, configuration and change control so engineering, manufacturing and field teams work from a consistent, approved design.

  • Lead failure investigation, root-cause analysis and corrective action, verifying fixes through repeatable bench, dockside and sea testing.

  • Demonstrate product performance and reliability through clear test plans, measured results and documented operating limits.

  • Partner with manufacturing and supply chain on design for manufacture, component qualification, approved substitutions, cost and production readiness.

  • Release the engineering package needed for repeatable production, including drawings, bills of materials, assembly requirements and acceptance tests.

  • Provide technical readiness assessments for customer trials and demonstrations, distinguishing proven capability from development goals.

  • Coordinate engineers and specialist partners, make ownership clear and escalate technical, safety or resource risks early.

  • Identify opportunities to reuse architecture, components and engineering practices as the maritime product range grows.

Required Skill

  • Experience personally leading engineering delivery for a complete uncrewed vessel or substantial integrated maritime product, with clear ownership of technical decisions and outcomes.

  • Strong systems integration judgement across mechanical, electrical, propulsion, control, communications, navigation and software interfaces.

  • Experience taking a maritime product from prototype towards repeatable production, including design for manufacture, configuration control and production test.

  • A track record of investigating sea-trial or field failures, identifying root causes and proving corrective actions through testing.

  • The ability to lead engineers across disciplines and drive delivery through influence as well as formal authority.

  • Practical understanding of how design decisions affect component availability, qualification, unit cost and manufacturing quality.

  • An understanding of how marine conditions, degraded navigation, communications resilience and operator feedback affect vessel design and testing.

  • The judgement to recognize stability, structural and vessel-safety implications and involve the appropriate technical specialists.

  • The ability to turn incomplete information into clear priorities, sound technical decisions and measurable progress.

  • Clear, honest communication about product capability, limitations, risks and delivery feasibility.

  • A hands-on approach, high ownership and the judgement to balance speed with appropriate engineering discipline.

  • Willingness to travel regularly to engineering teams, manufacturing sites, sea-trial sites and customers.

Nice to Have

  • Direct experience working with Ukrainian maritime teams, products or operators.

  • Experience adapting products for Western defence customers.

  • Familiarity with applicable defence sourcing restrictions and export-control requirements.

  • Experience supporting customer sea trials, military qualification, vessel classification or marine assurance activity.

  • Experience with naval architecture, high-speed craft, marine autonomy, USVs / UUVs or mission-payload integration.

  • Experience coordinating engineering and manufacturing across countries.

  • Evidence of growing from hands-on product ownership into broader technical leadership.

The nature of combat has changed.

Tomorrow’s battlefield success depends on autonomy, speed, and adaptability.

And UFORCE is ready.

title: Lead Machine Learning Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team

 

Our National Security and AI Safety business unit is dedicated to advancing the responsible development and deployment of AI in support of national security and global stability. From strengthening mission-critical capabilities across national security and intelligence, to working with frontier labs to provide robust AI safety red teaming and evaluation, we work at the frontier of high-stakes, high-impact missions.

We understand that powerful AI systems bring both transformative opportunities and complex risks and we are proud to partner with Government and the biggest tech organisations in the world to ensure AI is not just transformative but is also secure, trustworthy and safe for all.

Because of the nature of the work we do with our Government clients, you may need to be eligible for UK Developed Vetting (DV) and willing to work on site with our clients from time to time.

 

About the role

 

As a Lead Machine Learning Engineer at Faculty, you will set the technical direction for complex AI/ML projects, ensuring models perform at scale and in production over time by balancing technical trade-offs and guiding team priorities.

 

You will lead the delivery of large-scale AI-powered platforms in high-risk environments while defining project roadmaps across multiple complex workstreams.


This is an ambitious, entrepreneurial leadership role where you will act as a trusted technical expert, defending your architectural rationale to senior stakeholders to ensure we deliver high-quality, high-value outputs.

  

What you'll be doing:

 

  • Designing, implementing, and maintaining reliable, scalable ML systems while justifying key architectural decisions for production environments.

  • Driving the development of shared libraries and infrastructure for model deployment, lifecycle management, and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Leading model integration with infrastructure by creating APIs and services that enable scalable AI functionality in applications.

  • Overseeing the delivery of multiple complex workstreams and defining project problems in high-risk environments.

  • Ensuring reliable model performance by defining testing frameworks and model versioning systems for senior engineers to implement.

  • Managing and coaching multiple individuals, setting team-wide development goals to improve technical depth and client delivery.

  • Executing proactive recommendations for adopting new technologies and AI frameworks to maintain Faculty's competitive market position.

  

Who we're looking for:

 

  • You are an expert at defining technical roadmaps and managing project priorities to deliver high-stakes outcomes within high-growth environments.

  • You possess mastery of cloud-native ecosystems and orchestration tools like Kubernetes to automate complex model lifecycles and robust CI/CD pipelines.

  • You have a proven ability to design large-scale, AI-powered platforms and provide the technical justification for critical architectural decisions in high-risk environments.

  • You bring expert-level experience in operationalising models within frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch to solve complex, high-impact business challenges.

  • You define the engineering standards and architecture patterns for agentic systems, ensuring teams build to a consistent, production-grade bar.

  • You demonstrate an exceptional ability to align multi-disciplinary technical teams with broader business objectives and evolving customer needs.

 

The Interview Process

 

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Introduction to the Hiring Manager (30 minutes)

#LI-PRIO

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

title: Lead Product Manager - Business Lines
descriptionHtml:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

📱 Our Product Team

Led by Fabien, our VP Product, Joko's Product team groups the passionate individuals behind our users' delight! From brainstorming to development to launch, the Product team's main mission is to turn ideas into reality by working hand-in-hand with the Engineering, Design, and Business teams.

Joko is organized into four product tribes, each owning a key dimension of the company's value:

  • Business lines owns the current core value proposition, covering online shopping, in-store experiences, and gift cards, each run as a dedicated team.

  • Scale focuses on growing and amplifying this value through growth, international expansion, and shared core user experiences across the app.

  • Juno builds the next value proposition: an AI shopping assistant that finds the right product at the best price in seconds, backed by a universal catalog of what merchants actually sell.

  • AI Platform helps Joko become a state-of-the-art AI company from the inside, owning the internal agent infrastructure, automation layer, internal tools, infrastructure, compliance, security and operational scalability.

💲The Business Lines tribe

Business Lines owns Joko's current revenue engine across three product lines, each run by a dedicated task force:

  • 🌐 Online, Joko's historical core, covers the app, web app and browser extensions. Its challenge is to make sure users discover the right offers, clicks are tracked, purchases are attributed, commissions are approved, and cash back lands reliably.

  • 💳 In-Store owns card-linked offers, where users link their bank card and earn cash back when they pay at partner merchants in physical stores. It is a very different product line, closer to banking, payment integrations and merchant operations.

  • 🎁 Gift Cards lets users buy or earn gift cards from a catalog of brands, and already represents a significant and fast-growing share of company revenue.

Across these scopes, the tribe works on hard, high-impact product problems: improving catch and track rates, reducing funnel leaks, adapting to privacy and browser changes, strengthening payment and affiliate flows, and creating better customer experiences.

🎯 What you will do

As Lead Product Manager for the Business Lines tribe, your mission is to grow and strengthen the revenue Joko runs on today, across Online, In-Store and Gift Cards. You will report to Fabien, our VP Product, lead the Product Managers who own each task force, and personally take the calls that cut across them.

  • Set the tribe's strategy: You will arbitrate between three task forces with very different mechanics and very different economics, decide where the next engineer and the next euro go, and defend those trade-offs in front of leadership.

  • Own the revenue chain end to end: Catch rate and track rate decide whether a purchase becomes revenue, and a fraction of a point there is worth hundreds of thousands of euros a year. You will make sure the tribe knows exactly where the chain leaks, sizes each lever properly, and prioritises accordingly.

  • Go deep where it matters: Affiliate tracking and attribution, card-linked payment integrations, checkout and coupon flows. You will not be the PM writing every spec, but you will be expected to understand these mechanics well enough to challenge a diagnosis and make the final call.

  • Champion the user experience: You will stay close to user needs and pain points across each business line, and make sure the tribe turns them into dedicated features, sharp product improvements and astonishing customer experiences.

  • Navigate the structural challenges: Privacy regulation, browser tracking restrictions, payment ecosystem changes and last-click competition keep changing the rules. You will build the product strategy that keeps the business healthy as conditions shift, rather than reacting to each change as it lands.

  • Lead and grow the PMs: You will manage and mentor the Product Managers on Online, In-Store and Gift Cards, set the bar on funnel analysis, experimentation and delivery, and grow people who can own a revenue stream on their own.

  • Define what healthy looks like: You will set the metrics that matter for each business line, hold the tribe to them, and be accountable for the tribe's contribution to company revenue.

  • Work across the company: You will partner with the B2B teams who own merchant relationships, with Care on the user pain that untracked transactions create, with Data, and directly with the affiliate and payment partners themselves.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: You have 5+ years of experience in Product, including experience leading or mentoring other Product Managers, ideally on consumer products. Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, payments, adtech or affiliate marketing is a strong plus.

  • Data fluency: This is the criterion that carries the most weight here. You can interrogate a funnel yourself, break a metric into its components, and tell a real signal from noise. Much of this job is diagnosis before it is delivery, and you need to be able to do it yourself, not just ask for it.

  • Business sense: You think in revenue, margin and trade-offs. You can size a lever in euros before committing a team to it, and you are comfortable being accountable for a number in front of the exec team.

  • Management: You have a proven track record in people management. You know how to grow Product Managers, set a high bar for rigor, and give direction without taking every decision yourself.

  • Technical appetite: You want to understand how the tracking and the payment integrations actually work: browser behaviour, cookies, redirects, backend pipelines, card networks. Coding is not required, but you will be close to the mechanics every week.

  • Experimentation: You have run real A/B tests, you know how to design one that answers a question, and you can tell a team when theirs will not.

  • Stakeholder leadership: You are excellent at alignment, prioritization and saying no, with merchants, partners and internal teams alike.

  • Resilience: Much of this domain sits outside your control: browsers change, merchants change, regulation changes, competitors change. Problems that never fully close are what motivate you. If you are looking for a blank page and a 0-to-1 product, this is not that seat: this is a mature business with real revenue on the line every day.

  • AI fluency: You are hands-on with AI tools in your own product work. At Joko this is expected daily, across the whole company.

  • Location: Based in France or Spain.

  • Languages: Fluent in English, both written and spoken. French is a plus, but it is optional.

  • Mindset: You have an entrepreneurial mindset, you like challenges, you welcome feedback and you love constantly learning and getting better.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

Compensation: €78.3K – €125.9K

title: Marketing Lead
descriptionHtml:
Own marketing at an AI legal research company that already has 1,900+ firms as customers.

Nylon is an AI-native tax and legal research platform used by 1,900+ accountancy and law firms across the UK, Australia and New Zealand. We were the first product accredited by ICAEW in the Legal Information and Research Software category, and we hold an ACCA affiliation. The UK business has been built almost entirely on outbound sales. It works, and it has taken us a long way. Now we want a second engine, and you would be the person who builds it.

This is our first dedicated marketing hire in the UK. There is no team beneath you yet and no playbook to inherit. There is a working sales motion, a product accountants and lawyers actually use, strong accreditation credentials, and a founder-led company that moves quickly. You will set the marketing strategy and then do most of the work yourself.

What you'll own

  • Pipeline. SEO and content, paid search and LinkedIn, email nurture, webinars and free-trial campaigns. Your number is qualified pipeline handed to our SDR and AE team, and you will be measured on it.

  • Brand and content. Sharpen how Nylon shows up in the UK accountancy and legal market: website, thought leadership, case studies, PR and awards, and the marketing side of our ICAEW and ACCA relationships.

  • Product marketing. Own the messaging. Turn what the product does into language that lands with a tax partner or a managing partner, keep our positioning against incumbent research providers sharp, and equip the sales team with battlecards, decks and one-pagers.

  • Events and community. Get us in front of the right people: ICAEW and ACCA events, industry conferences, our own roundtables and customer community. Some travel within the UK.

  • Measurement. Set up attribution and reporting in our CRM (Attio) so we know what is working, and kill what is not.

What we're looking for

  • 5–8 years in B2B marketing, with at least a few of those in SaaS or a subscription product, ideally selling to professional services (accountancy, legal, financial services).

  • You have built something from little or nothing before: a demand-gen function, a content programme, a launch. You are comfortable being the strategist and the person executing at 4pm on a Thursday.

  • Fluent in the tools: SEO and analytics, paid search and paid social, marketing automation and CRM, and the AI tools that make a small team punch above its weight.

  • You write well. Clearly, quickly, without fluff. Most of what marketing produces is words, and ours need to be credible to accountants and lawyers.

  • Commercially minded. You care about pipeline and revenue, not vanity metrics, and you enjoy working shoulder to shoulder with a sales team.

  • Curious about AI and about how professional services firms are changing. You do not need a legal or tax background, but you need to be able to learn the market fast.

Nice to have: experience marketing to accountants or lawyers; familiarity with ICAEW, ACCA or Law Society ecosystems; hands-on experience with webinar programmes or partnership marketing.

What we offer

  • £55,000–£70,000 base, depending on experience

  • Real ownership: you set the strategy, you get the budget, you build the team as we grow

  • A product customers rely on daily and a market that is being reshaped by AI right now

  • A small, fast, international team across the UK, Australia and New Zealand

Please send a CV and, instead of a cover letter, one page on how you would generate qualified pipeline for Nylon in your first 90 days.

Nylon is the trading name of Law Cyborg Limited. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from everyone. You must have the right to work in the UK.

title: Meewerkstage Architectuur
descriptionHtml:
Jouw impact bij Movares

Jij draagt bij aan de gebouwde omgeving van de toekomst.

Dit ga je doen bij Movares

  • Je werkt mee aan publieke projecten zoals stations, transferia, fietsenstallingen, bruggen en utiliteitsbouw (nieuwbouw en transformaties).

  • Je ondersteunt het team met analyses, ontwerpen, visualisaties en presentaties.

  • Je draait inhoudelijk mee in het ontwerpproces en krijgt ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Tijdens deze stage architectuur draai je mee in het ontwerpproces van studioSK, het ontwerplabel van Movares. Samen met architecten en multidisciplinaire adviseurs werk je aan publieke projecten. Denk aan stations, bruggen, fietsenstallingen of mobiliteitshubs. Je onderzoekt locaties, werkt ontwerpen uit en presenteert ideeën. Daarbij krijg je ruimte om initiatief te nemen en bij te dragen aan projecten die zichtbaar zijn in Nederland.

Dit ben jij bij Movares

  • een hbo- of wo-opleiding in de richting van Bouwkunde, Architectuur of interieurarchitectuur;

  • je hebt de interesse om te werken in digitale tekenprogramma’s zoals Sketch-up, revit en Vectorworks;

  • je hebt ervaring met het Adobe pakket (illustrator/photoshop/indesign).

Een stage bij Movares is een kickstart van je carrière, en dat heeft verschillende redenen. Zo kun je erop rekenen dat de begeleiding door jouw stagebegeleider, je team én campus recruiter Sander op-en-top voor elkaar is. Daarnaast kom je terecht in een groep vol gelijkgestemden. Elk jaar verwelkomen we namelijk tussen de 30 en 40 stagiaires. Hen ontmoet je tijdens de maandelijkse bijeenkomsten van Movares Backstage, waar verbinden met anderen voorop staat. Soms gaan jullie samen lunchen of bezoeken jullie een project. Andere maanden staat er een inhoudelijke sessie op de planning en leer je bijvoorbeeld beter presenteren of adviseren.

En ook als lid van Young Movares, onze jongerenvereniging, staan er regelmatig leuke activiteiten in je agenda. Daarnaast kun je elke tweede dinsdag van de maand aanschuiven bij het Café van de Toekomst: een inspiratiesessie waarbij je samen met je collega’s wordt bijgepraat over onderwerpen en projecten die in onze organisatie spelen. En dat is nog niet alles: je kunt gebruikmaken van onze eigen Academy met ruim 3.000 verschillende leerlijnen, trainingen en e-learningmodules.

Dit krijg je bij Movares

Bij Movares werk je mee aan een uitdagende opdrachten met volop kansen om jezelf te ontwikkelen, een leuke en gezellige sfeer, een kijkje in de keuken van een toonaangevend advies- en ingenieursbureau, volop ruimte voor eigen initiatief en een goede begeleiding. De duur en startdatum zijn in overleg nader te bepalen. Verder krijg je:

  • een aantrekkelijke vergoeding van €550 op basis van een fulltime dienstverband;

  • ruimte voor het vinden van jouw ideale werk-privé-balans;

  • leuke collega’s en een stageplek in hartje Utrecht.

En er is méér. Want stagelopen bij Movares betekent ook:

  • bijdragen aan een schone wereld, omdat je stageloopt bij het eerste bedrijf in Nederland met een Zero Waste-certificaat;

  • lid worden van Young Movares, de jongerenvereniging waar je leert van én met andere jonge collega’s.

Jouw team bij Movares

StudioSK is een ontwerpstudio voor architectuur, stedenbouw en landschap. Ons team is een mix van ervaren ontwerpers en jong talent. In een creatieve werksfeer leveren wij verfrissende ontwerpen en inspirerende adviezen voor vaak complexe vraagstukken. Met architectuur, stedenbouw en landschap in één bureau overzien we de potenties van een locatie, de samenhang en het totale speelveld. We focussen op waardecreatie en leefkwaliteit voor een duurzame samenleving op weg naar een circulaire economie. Zie voor meer projecten: www.studiosk.nl.

title: Mid-Market Account Executive - UK&I
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

We are currently seeking a talented and driven sales professional who will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be £20k to £200k, and typically involve technical POCs, multiple stakeholders, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in United Kingdom. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

This may not be the right role for you if:

  • You aren't willing to put in the work: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You aren't a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focus on winning as a team.
  • You have nothing more to learn: Every Samsarian has a growth mindset and believes that what got us here won't get us there.

In this role, you will:

  • This is a pure hunter role focused on 90% net-new logo acquisition," and "Candidates must have a minimum of 24 months' experience in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role.Work on strategic account mapping & outbound prospecting
  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close
  • Work collaboratively with a team of internal / cross-functional stakeholders to remove deal blockers
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • Previous experience in a pure hunter role focused on 80-90% net-new logo acquisition
  • Minimum of 24 months' experience in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role
  • Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement
  • Experience handling complex mid-large deal cycles
  • Value-based selling approach
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and curious by nature

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Comfortable in a dynamic, customer facing environment
  • MEDDIC experience
  • Excited about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Highly collaborative with a growth mindset

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

title: Monetization Strategist
descriptionHtml:
Monetization Strategist

Paid.ai · London · In-person · Full-time

 

About Paid

Paid is the monetization engine built for the agent economy. Our software allows firms to meter agent actions, price them, bill for them, and prove the value they delivered. Our team helps them get that model right. Backed by Sequoia, Lightspeed, and EQT, we're defining a new category at the centre of the agentic economy.

 

The Role

You will be joining the Monetization Engineering team as a Monetization Strategist. This is perhaps the most important role at Paid, responsible for winning the trust of prospects and delighting customers. You’ll act as the face of the company, interfacing with founders and C-suite executives in live sales, during implementations, and as a partner long after the contract is signed.

You need to be two things: an expert in software monetization, and motivated to make customers successful. You will diagnose the problems faced by a business, design the monetization that achieves their objectives, get it implemented within Paid, and guide their adjustments as it experiences contact with the market. You will then bring those learnings back into Paid, developing best practice, shaping the product roadmap, and iterating on our go-to-market strategy.

Ultimately there are many places this role can go. You will form the nucleus of a rapidly growing function, and we want you to be part of building that. You could also as the business scales move into functions such as Sales, Product Marketing, Product Strategy, Commercial Strategy, or Partnerships.

This is a commercial and strategy role, not a software engineering role.

 

The Software

Paid’s platform is the metering and billing software built for the agent economy. The existing tools on the market count a vendor's ingredients — tokens, calls, seats — and treat every event as immutable as soon as it's written. Paid handles the messy complexity of agentic billing, from effort-based to outcome-based, with end-to-end visibility and auditability from raw signal to billed unit. Our flexible architecture unlocks agentic vendors' commercial creativity, allowing them to confidently adopt the commercial model that best aligns to the value their product provides and customers trust.

 

What You'll Do

Your initial focus will be working directly with customers. As you settle into the role and the team grows your focus will shift towards elements such as internal capability building, winning deals, and running of the business.

 

  • Architect monetization strategies with founders and executives as part of live sales cycles: diagnose issues with their current model, review potential paths forward, and convince them that Paid is the solution

  • Own the outcome after signature, mobilizing Paid and customer resources to translate the agreed model into a successful implementation and rollout

  • Manage the ongoing relationship with the customer, helping them iterate and expand their use of Paid

  • Codify learnings into both customer-facing playbooks, diagnostics and benchmarks, and Paid’s own strategy, product, positioning, and pricing

  • Contribute to business development and thought leadership: content that positions yourself and Paid as foremost experts in this space

  • Shape Paid’s product roadmap based on strategic analysis and your learnings from the market

  • Build and develop the function, taking on direct reports and coaching them

  • Everything you would generally expect in a start-up!

     

What We're Looking For

Must have

  • Directly relevant experience in at least one of: a pricing or commercial strategy consultancy practice working on software monetization, or an in-house role owning pricing or monetization at a software company

  • Ability to engage with senior stakeholders one-on-one: we need to trust you to be alone in a room with an intelligent and sceptical founder

  • Demonstrated experience managing projects end-to-end, from design through delivery

  • Strong analytical capabilities and attention to detail, alongside pragmatism about when they’re required

  • Significant interest in the AI ecosystem, fluency in recent developments, and an understanding of underlying unit economics

  • The willingness and ability as a front-line operator to build spreadsheets, presentations, processes, playbooks, etc., from scratch yourself utilizing AI

  • Strong motivation to take accountability and drive successful customer outcomes, no matter what that takes

  • Based in or willing to relocate to London, willing to travel 20% of the time, typically to San Francisco

Nice to have

  • Experience with usage, output, or outcome-based pricing

  • Start-up experience in a fast growing tech company

  • Ability to advise on Sales best-practices: operating models, compensation scheme design, target & quota setting, etc.

  • Technical fluency: you’re comfortable discussing APIs, SDKs, and iframes

  • Ability to write clear, concise, and elegantly worded prose

  • Front-line experience with a pricing migration and its aftermath: grandfathering, sales enablement, the customer conversations nobody enjoys

Compensation

We are hiring across a range of seniorities: compensation will be competitive, proportionate to experience, and include equity options.

descriptionHtml:
Network Operations Engineer

About us

Foundational is building the most precise picture of Earth and orbit, using lasers fired from the ground. We call it ground truth for orbit.

We design and run low-cost, autonomous satellite laser ranging stations. They measure the distance to satellites with extreme precision, day and night. Our data platform turns those measurements into tracking data and orbit products for satellite operators, space agencies and governments. We also build our own flight-proven laser retroreflector arrays, so any satellite can be tracked.

Our station network is expanding across continents. The data supports resilient navigation, Earth observation and the safe, sustainable use of space.

We're a small, fast-moving team of engineers, scientists and operators in London. We're backed by venture investors and supported by ESA, the UK Space Agency, and Innovate UK.

Position Overview

Our stations run autonomously, and you'll make sure the network does too. You'll monitor stations, respond to faults, and build the tools and processes for our network operations centre.

What you'll do

  • Monitor station health, tracking and data delivery across the network

  • Triage faults, and coordinate fixes with field engineers and host sites

  • Build dashboards, alerting and runbooks

  • Track network performance and report it to the team and to customers

  • Help plan tracking schedules against customer commitments

  • Help shape on-call and shift cover as the network grows across time zones

What you'll bring
