title: Office Coordinator (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

The Role

In this role, you are the first point of contact in our Munich office and work closely with our Workplace Operations Lead to keep daily operations running smoothly. You will run our front desk and front office, and support workplace, fleet, vendor and administrative topics as we continue to scale rapidly. Your proactive, hands-on approach makes sure our team and our visitors get the support they need while we build the future of industrial robotics.

Your Responsibilities

  • Run the Front Desk & Office Organization: Be the central point of contact at our front desk. Welcome visitors and candidates, manage phone and mail communications, and keep the office organized and representative.

  • Own day-to-day back-office operations: Keep meeting rooms and presentation tech setup-ready, manage daily mail and parcel logistics, and oversee kitchen inventory by handling regular orders to keep fridges, drinks, and coffee stations fully stocked.

  • Support Facility & Vendor Coordination: Coordinate cleaning teams, tradespeople, and external suppliers on site, and report maintenance issues to the property manager while ensuring clear tracking and documentation in our ticketing tool.

  • Support Fleet Management: Help with day-to-day fleet tasks such as key handovers, vehicle bookings, maintenance appointments, and communication with leasing companies.

  • Coordinate Travel & Company Events: Book business trips, hotels and appointments, and help organize internal team gatherings, in-office events and company-wide celebrations.

  • Office & Documentation Support: Act as the on-site contact for collecting invoices and documents, check cost centers, upload physical invoices to our expense management system, and support in person with signatures and NDAs.

  • Support Workplace Safety: Help the Workplace Operations Lead make sure health and safety regulations are followed in the office, for example first aid supplies, safety briefings and documentation.

  • Keep Front Office Processes Up to Date: Maintain checklists, documentation and recurring workflows in tools like Notion, Claude and Google Workspace, and suggest improvements where manual work can be simplified.

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Completed vocational training or a degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Facility Management, Hospitality or comparable experience.

  • First experience in a front desk, reception, office assistant or office management role.

  • A service-oriented, friendly and representative presence with visitors and colleagues.

  • A structured and reliable way of working, including when many requests come in at once.

  • An interest in learning new tools. Experience with tools like Google Workspace and Notion is a plus.

  • Willingness to work onsite at our Munich office 4–5 days a week (up to 1 home office day per week).

  • Culture-aligned mindset (e.g., "Hands-on mindset", "Team player", "Pragmatic working style").

  • Very good English skills and fluent German language skills (written and spoken) are required.

Why join RobCo?

  • Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

  • Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

  • As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

  • Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

  • Wellpass membership (7,200+ studios across Germany), regular team events, and a team that takes both the work and the culture seriously

  • Flexible working hours, a modern office, and - depending on the role - the option to work from home.

  • Regular team events - from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that continuously learns and improves, requiring zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. In October 2026, RobCo reached unicorn status with a valuation exceeding one billion US dollars, with its valuation doubling in less than nine months. With $200M raised from investors including Sequoia, Lightspeed, Lingotto, Kindred, Cherry Ventures, and the European Tech Collective, 225+ people globally, and 3.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our Bay Area Lab in San Francisco.

At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements.

title: Onboard Software Engineer - Hyperdrive
descriptionHtml:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft’s Onboard Software group provides the on-orbit software that powers our core products. This is responsible for monitoring and control of major space program elements, including:

  • Flight Products computational environments (including physical and virtual processors);

  • Interfaces with external equipment (imagers, RF, ISL); and

  • Interfaces with the spacecraft bus.

Hyperdrive is the common platform powering every onboard service across our spacecraft.
The team builds the core capabilities other onboard services need to run mission logic—from interactions and housekeeping to events, automated fault detection and recovery, and lifecycle management.
By making complex spacecraft software consistent, observable, and resilient, Hyperdrive helps teams move faster while keeping missions safe in orbit.

We’re hiring for one position across multiple locations - you only need to apply once.
About this role:
  • Design, implement, and refine software with a high degree of ownership, driving impactful features from concept through delivery while ensuring robustness and reliability.
  • Review code, provide clear feedback, and enforce adherence to established development processes, style guides, and design standards to maintain consistency and quality across the codebase.
  • Design and implement unit tests for both self-authored and peer-authored code.
  • Utilize version control systems to create feature branches, push code, and merge approved code into production branches.
  • Contribute to the onboard software architecture through design proposals and collaborative review
  • Participate in the review and enhancement of software development processes and design standards.
  • Coordinate with downstream teams on the release, distribution and adoption of latest releases.
  • In addition to responsibilities within onboard software, you’ll have the opportunity to directly be involved in operating our on-orbit fleet of satellites.

Must Haves:
  • 5+ years' software engineering experience, using programming languages including C/C++ (C++11 or newer) and Python.
  • Experience with version control systems such as Git
  • Experience with continuous integration tools (e.g., GitLab-CI, Jenkins).
  • Experience with build systems (e.g., Make, CMake).
  • Experience with library management and ABI/API version control.
  • Understanding of distributed architecture.
  • Familiarity with networking protocols (e.g., UDP, TCP, IP) and POSIX standards.
  • Experience in developing multi-threaded applications.

Nice to Haves:
  • Familiarity with additional programming languages, such as Go or Rust.
  • Experience with embedded Linux operation, including Yocto, device trees, systemd, and Linux on ARM platforms.
  • Proficiency with unit test frameworks (e.g., pytest, Googletest, Unity)
  • Experience with middleware framework (gRPC, ZMQ/NATS, etc.)
  • Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, K3S, systemd-nspawn)

Some of Our Awesome Benefits:
  • Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success
  • Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best

  • Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand)
  • Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences
  • Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together
  • Relocation assistance to Toulouse when applicable

At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions. We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.
    Who We Are
    Loft: Space Made Simple.
    Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.
    We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.

title: Photonic Integrated Circuit Designer Intern (H1/2027)
descriptionHtml:
About Quandela

Quandela stands as a global leader in quantum computing, driven by groundbreaking technology and a strategic vision for scaling quantum solutions. The company’s unique ability to offer both hardware and software solutions, along with its commitment to build energy efficient datacenters and scalability, positions it to play a key role in the next wave of innovation, and in many strategic and sovereign industrial sectors.

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀

Description of the Team

The internship will be conducted in the Photonic Integrated Circuits (PICs) department ofQuandela. The PICs team works on the production and development of the optical processors of Quandela quantum computers, having in mind performance and scalability.

In detail, the team members carry out electromagnetic and thermal simulations to estimate the performance of the integrated components, prepare PICs layouts to be fabricated in collaboration with external foundries, and take care of both the characterization and the packaging of the fabricated devices.

Your Key Responsibilities

Depending on your experience and the duration of the internship, your work may involve deepening the understanding of existing building blocks, exploring new functionalities or tools, or developing advanced modeling approaches for testing. In particular, the goal of this internship will be to either bridge the gap between fabrication and design, or to evaluate new architecture for quantum processing unit (QPU).

In this role you will be using standard electromagnetic simulations and/or circuit modelling by means of commercial software like Lumerical FDTD, FDE, EME or free-tools (gdsfactory, tidy3d, meow, sax..).

Requirements

  • Enrollment for the whole duration of the internship in a MSc in Physics, Telecom/Electronics Engineering, Photonics, Quantum Technologies or related fields. This position is only valid with an Internship Agreement.
  • Minimal duration is 5 months. Shorter internship will not be accepted.
  • Ideal starting date late Summer 2026.
  • General knowledge of integrated photonics modelling and layout

title: PMO Coordinator
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.


BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Build the machine that builds the machine. Join TechOps at the forefront of advanced manufacturing, we’re building the production system that will enable commercial fusion. The Production lines, tooling, and processes are being developed from the ground up; you'll create the ways of working, not inherit them.

  • Work at the frontier of manufacturing technology. Bring your creativity to evaluate, qualify, and deploy processes with no industry playbook, every component you build and every process you shape goes directly into the core of the stellarator magnet technology.

  • Do work that matters, and see it grow. The hardware you build is the product and your career grows with it, from prototyping and process development through quality and industrialization, alongside exceptional colleagues from around the world.

  • Make an impact you can point to. In a small, fast-moving team, your calls on equipment, quality, and process directly shape how a world-class deep-tech company produces superconducting magnets with results visible on the shop floor, not buried in a slidedeck.

YOUR IMPACT

You’re the reason the PMO’s reporting rhythm runs on time, every time, so no function lead is left scrambling for a last-minute slide the night before a gate review. You bring cost, schedule and risk inputs together into one clear, decision-ready picture for leadership, and you chase the gaps early, before they turn into someone else’s problem in the room.

You’re also the fabric of the PMO. This goes well beyond reporting: you’ll help us make sense of the data we collect, creating unexpected insights, pointing out unseen opportunities and uncovering hidden dependencies. You’ll bring fresh ideas on how we work and challenge how things have always been done, and your insights will shape the decisions that move Alpha forward.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Own the PMO's reporting cadence, pulling together inputs from the Cost Controller, Programme Schedule Manager and Risk & Change Manager into steering committee packs and gate-readiness reports

  • Chase status updates ahead of gate reviews and leadership meetings, flagging anything missing, out of date or inconsistent before it reaches a decision forum

  • Maintain the reporting templates and dashboards (in Wrike or similar) that give leadership a clear view of milestones and status

  • Keep the master calendar of programme deliverables, gates and milestones across Alpha and Stellaris up to date

  • Support the logistics for PMO governance forums, including the Release Gates Authority and steering committees, from scheduling to papers

  • Help with ad hoc analysis of cost, schedule and risk data to support PMO decisions

WHO YOU ARE

  • You've supported a PMO or project controls function on a complex, multi-discipline programme, and you know what it takes to keep many moving parts in view

  • You're highly organised and good at turning input from engineers, suppliers and commercial teams into reporting that's clear, concise and actually gets read

  • You're confident with project management and reporting tools, and you pick up new ones quickly

  • You're fluent in English; German is a plus

  • You enjoy building things that don't exist yet and are comfortable with the pace and ambiguity that comes with it

  • You get real satisfaction from being the connective tissue of a programme: making progress, risks and dependencies visible so the people making decisions can make good ones

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (60 min)

  • Technical Panel (2x60 min)

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

title: Principal AI & Algorithms Engineer (Defence & Security)
descriptionHtml:
Overview 

We have an opportunity for a Principal Engineer in our AI & Algorithms department, working with a particular focus on our defence and security clients. You’ll join a team of talented engineers and scientists designing, building and testing intelligent systems that require cutting edge algorithms.

As one of the senior technical voices in the team, you’ll be architecting the algorithmic approach on our projects, setting the technical bar for others, and helping shape the work we deliver. As well as hands-on engineering, you’ll spend time with clients, using your expertise to win new projects as well as deliver them. You’ll work in multidisciplinary teams that use our labs and computing resources to enable us to deliver ambitious projects.

Much of our defence and security work requires security clearance, so we ask for it up front. You won’t work exclusively in that sector, but a genuine interest in it matters to us. 

We offer a flexible approach to hybrid working, although some of the projects you will be working on will require full-time working in the office.

What you’ll be doing: 

  • Applying data-driven software development in machine learning/AI, applied statistics, and sensor processing, alongside mathematical computing techniques such as digital signal processing, simulation, and numerical optimisation. 
  • Acting as technical lead and architect on our larger, more complex projects, owning the technical solution and the value it delivers to the client. 
  • Setting technical direction and acting as technical reviewer across the department, with your opinion sought by colleagues. 
  • Leading the development of proposals and costed work programmes, turning client problems into work we can win and deliver. 
  • Driving internal capability and demonstrators that keep us at the leading edge and open up new conversations with clients. 
  • Mentoring engineers and conducting technical interviews to help us recruit and grow strong people. 
  • Contributing to how the department works, improving our processes and technical standards. 

What you need to succeed:

  • 5+ years’ experience designing and delivering cutting edge algorithms for intelligent systems, including working on defence or security projects. 
  • Technical skills in one or more of: transformer models, diffusion models, reinforcement learning, machine vision and perception. 
  • A strong undergraduate degree in a relevant technical subject, such as AI/machine learning, computer science, mathematics or, physics. A PhD in a relevant subject is welcome but not required; deep, demonstrable industrial expertise is what matters. 
  • Strong Python and software engineering judgement.
  • The ability to architect the technical approach on complex projects and to review the work of others, including working autonomously as the technical authority. 
  • Experience mentoring and developing engineers. 
  • Experience working with non-technical stakeholders for your work. 
  • Interest in working directly with clients and contributing to proposals and sales conversations. 
  • A genuine affinity for working in the defence and security sector.  

While not essential requirements, we would also be very interested if you have experience with any of the following: 

  • Technical experience with any of: signal processing, edge computing, statistical modelling, numerical optimisation, or simulation. 
  • A track record of building client relationships and leading the technical side of sales campaigns and proposals. 

Some projects at Cambridge Consultants are subject to security restrictions. This role requires you to obtain a Security Check (SC) level security clearance  ( United Kingdom Security Vetting: Applicant ). You must be able to work in the UK without restrictions in accordance with UK National Law and be prepared to successfully undertake an appropriate level of UK National Security Vetting according to UK Government National Security Vetting criteria.

Please be aware that, for roles requiring Security Check clearance, applicants will typically need to have been a continuous resident in the UK for a minimum of 5 years immediately prior to applying for this role in order to meet the requirements for Security Check (SC) clearance.

What we offer:

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays (with the option to buy 10 more a year)
  • Company bonus (profit share)
  • Flexible working patterns and hybrid working
  • Medical insurance and group income protection
  • Employee assistance programme and mental health support group
  • Enhanced parental leave
  • Sabbatical leave
  • Travel insurance (business and leisure)
  • Generous company pension plan
  • Personalised career development and training plans
  • Free breakfast and two-course lunch in the office every day
  • Free onsite parking and we are close to public transport links
  • A variety of events organised by our social committee, ranging from summer and Christmas parties to board game nights and socials at our own rooftop bar!

Why Cambridge Consultants? 

Cambridge Consultants creates exciting and novel breakthroughs in technology and products. Our work on intelligent systems area has helped create world-first and market-changing technologies including real-time AI-enhanced medical imaging, autonomous defence systems against cyberattacks, and edge algorithms to help visually impaired people navigate indoor spaces. We combine our research output with engineering rigour to create innovative and robust solutions to solve complex problems presented to us by our clients. We help clients across a diverse range of markets, including defence/security, healthcare, biotech, industrial and energy, so there is no shortage of variety. 

At the heart of what we do are talented and motivated multi-disciplinary teams empowered to create cutting edge technologies and systems to solve difficult problems for our clients. We offer a diverse, fun, and challenging work environment where you'll have the chance to work on a wide variety of projects that deliver real value using technology.  

We recognise and celebrate individual talent and we understand the importance of letting individuals be just that. Our people are here to do the best work of their lives and our job is to provide the platform for them to do it.

L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA.
Tes missions : Le besoin actuel porte sur des missions “grands-comptes” avec des produits et architectures complexes, développées par plusieurs squads de Theodo : - Engineering : tu t’assures de la satisfaction de tes clients techs (typiquement CTO, VP Engineering clients) et stakeholders business en étant garant de la qualité des architectures et du code produit par tes équipes. - Management : tu manages en direct jusqu’à 4 Tech Leads et t’assures de leur progression notamment technique, ainsi que de celles de leurs développeurs - Améliorations transverses : tu portes des changements transverses techniques ou organisationnels au niveau de ton client et/ou au niveau de Theodo Tes perspectives d’évolutions : Perspectives d’évolution moyen terme : - Managériale : Group Manager - Business : Partnership avec responsabilité d’une plateforme business et/ou d’une practice du groupe L’équipe que tu rejoins : - Ton manager direct : Xavier, VP Engineering du groupe Theodo - Ton binôme sur mission : un Group Product Manager - Tes managés : jusqu’à 4 Tech Leads en direct, ce qui correspond à jusqu’à 16 ingénieurs au total Profil recherché : Caractéristiques - 7-14 ans d’expérience pro - une expérience confirmée en management d’équipes tech - une expérience en service (ESN ou conseil) Hard skills - Maîtrise technologique : nous n’attendons pas du Principal Engineer de coder mais sur le périmètre grand-comptes, nous attendons une bonne maîtrise de Java (Spring Boot) et/ou de Angular, pour être pertinent et légitime sur progression de ses équipes - Capacité à concevoir des architectures évolutives - Intérêt fort sur l’usage de l’IA Générative pour concevoir et développer des produits digitaux Soft Skills - Leadership et pédagogie pour embarquer tes équipes et vulgariser auprès des clients - Capacité à résoudre des problèmes complexes et apporter des changements transverses dans une organisation - Sens business : capacité à creuser les objectifs business d'une fonctionnalité pour identifier la meilleure solution technique Le process de recrutement : - Call de qualification (30 min) avec un(e) talent acquisition manager - Entretien fit (1h) avec un(e) talent acquisition manager - Test technique d’analyse de défaut (à la maison + débrief 1h) - Entretien modélisation (1h) - Entretien dirigeant (1h) - Prises de référence, notamment avec des managers précédentsPourquoi rejoindre Theodo ? L’environnement: 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 De l’épargne salariale avec un mécanisme d’intéressement en partenariat avec Epsor 🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...) 🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50% 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile 🧒 Aides et places en crèche réservées Prêt à nous rejoindre ?

title: Principal Network Architect, Backbone Network
descriptionHtml:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific. 

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

Role Summary

As Principal Network Architect, Backbone Connectivity at Firmus, you will lead the architecture and technical assurance of the backbone connectivity platform that underpins the Firmus AI Factory ecosystem and Firmus AI Cloud. The role directly reports to the Network Engineering team as a principal technical lead and acts as a dedicated support of the Head of Connectivity as the primary technical authority for backbone architecture. You will translate Firmus’s connectivity strategy into a scalable, resilient and vendor-neutral architecture, define the standards and design patterns that guide implementation, and ensure the backbone network positions Firmus as a leader in AI-ready connectivity, with focus on building and evolving Firmus’s national and international backbone across terrestrial and subsea networks, optical transport, IP backbone, data-centre interconnection and partner connectivity. 

The role directly reports to the Network Engineering team as a principal technical lead and acts as a dedicated support the Head of Connectivity as the primary technical authority for backbone architecture. You will translate Firmus’s connectivity strategy into a scalable, resilient and vendor-neutral architecture, define the standards and design patterns that guide implementation, and ensure the backbone network positions Firmus as a leader in AI-ready connectivity. 

This role is responsible for the technical integrity of the backbone architecture across the full lifecycle, from concept and design assurance through delivery readiness, operational resilience and continuous improvement. You will work across carriers, subsea operators, terrestrial fibre providers, data-centre partners and internal engineering teams to ensure Firmus’s network connectivity is high-performance, secure, operationally robust and ready to scale with the company’s AI infrastructure growth. 

Key Responsibilities

As Principal Network Architect, Backbone Connectivity, you will own the technical architecture of Firmus's backbone network and act as the principal technical adviser to the Head of Connectivity, while operating as a senior technical lead within the Network Engineering team. You will convert the Firmus Connectivity Strategy into an integrated, executable backbone architecture spanning subsea and terrestrial fibre, optical transport (DWDM/OTN), IP/MPLS and segment routing, data-centre interconnection and partner connectivity. You will define the reference architecture, standards and reusable design patterns that guide engineers and partners, ensuring every AI Factory and Firmus AI Cloud service attaches through resilient, diverse and scalable backbone nodes free of unmanaged common-mode failure. 

Working across carriers, subsea operators, terrestrial fibre providers and data-centre partners, you will set minimum resilience profiles, validate physical-route and shared-risk-link-group diversity, and provide independent technical assurance that designs can be delivered, operated and scaled safely across their full lifecycle. You will act as technical design authority in vendor and technology selection for backbone and subsea services, lead complex backbone changes and cutovers, mentor the engineering team, and benchmark Firmus's designs against leading global operators and hyperscalers — keeping Firmus at the forefront of AI-ready network connectivity. 

What you’ll bring 

You are, first and foremost, an accomplished network architect for large-scale, mission-critical connectivity infrastructure. You bring deep expertise in national and international backbone design across terrestrial long-haul fibre and subsea systems, including landing-station connectivity, cable-landing diversity, and terrestrial route and duct engineering. You are fluent in optical transport (DWDM/OTN, coherent and client-side optics, ROADM and amplification/regeneration planning) and in IP backbone design, including IP/MPLS, segment routing, EVPN, traffic engineering, peering, transit and internet exchange, and high-capacity data-centre and customer interconnection. You understand how to design resilient, diverse networks free of unmanaged common-mode failure, using SRLG analysis, engineered failure-state capacity and physical-route evidence to prove your claims rather than assert them. 

Across the delivery lifecycle, you are equally at home leading architecture and design reviews, carrier and technology-vendor governance, technical evaluation of backbone and subsea services, change control, cutover planning, and operational-readiness and handover to network operations. You have authored or materially shaped reference architectures, design standards, reusable patterns and architecture decision records at a hyperscale operator, carrier, or equivalent, and you know how to keep an architecture modular and vendor-neutral so the business can flex across managed services, wavelengths, dark fibre and subsea assets as demand and economics change. You are comfortable engaging carriers, subsea consortia, internet exchanges and major equipment vendors, and you can drive value engineering and sustainability outcomes without compromising resilience or performance. 

Above all, you have the temperament of a senior technical leader operating across geographies: strong systems thinking, calm judgement under delivery and incident pressure, the confidence to challenge design and vendor assumptions constructively, and the communication skill to carry a room of network engineers, a customer technical review, and an executive readout with equal clarity. You bring commercial awareness, comfort operating across cultures and time zones, and a genuine passion for building AI-ready network connectivity that performs reliably from day one and positions Firmus as a leader in the field. 

Skills & Experience

The ideal candidate will bring a strong technical foundation in network and connectivity engineering, ideally with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science or a related discipline, together with more than 12 years of progressive experience designing and operating large-scale backbone networks across carrier, hyperscale, cloud or specialist AI infrastructure environments. They will have deep, hands-on expertise as a principal-level network architect or distinguished engineer on national and international backbone programmes, and a proven track record owning reference architectures, design standards and technical assurance across a portfolio of concurrent connectivity initiatives. 

This experience should include end-to-end design and delivery across terrestrial long-haul fibre and subsea cable systems — including landing-station connectivity, route and duct diversity, and SRLG-based resilience modelling — alongside deep expertise in optical transport (DWDM/OTN, coherent optics, 100G/400G/800G) and IP backbone design (IP/MPLS, segment routing, EVPN, traffic engineering, peering, transit and internet exchange). They will have led technical evaluations of carriers, subsea operators and equipment vendors, defined the technical sections of RFPs and evaluation criteria, and worked effectively across the design-to-operate interface with Network Engineering, Data Centre and Operations teams. 

Experience authoring or contributing materially to global backbone reference architecture, minimum standards or interconnection strategy at a hyperscale, carrier or AI infrastructure operator is a strong differentiator, as is experience delivering into APAC markets — particularly Indonesia, Australia and Singapore — under diverse regulatory, licensing and provider conditions. Above all, the successful candidate will combine hands-on architectural depth with the influence and communication skills to lead as a senior technical authority

Location & Reporting

  • This role is based in Sydney, Australia.
  • Reporting to Senior Manager, Networking

Employment Basis

Full-time

Diversity

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionize the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.

title: Principal Researcher
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Team

DoorDash’s mission is to grow and empower local economies. By building intelligent, last-mile delivery technology for local cities, DoorDash connects people with the local businesses they care about — helping grow businesses and the communities that support those businesses. At DoorDash, there are three audiences that are at the core of every decision we make - our Consumers, Merchants, and Couriers. The Research team has a direct link to uncover the unmet needs and pain points of each of these audiences. We bring their voices into the business in order to help set the strategic vision for all of DoorDash’s current and future products.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Principal Researcher to be a strategic research leader for EMEA, shaping what DoorDash builds next. You’ll combine deep expertise in qualitative and quantitative methods to find the unmet needs, behavioral shifts, and market openings that point to new products and new growth. You’ll work as a peer to senior product, design, engineering, data science, and business leaders, and your work will directly inform roadmaps, investment decisions, and company-level strategy.

This role is built for a seasoned researcher who is equally comfortable in a living room interview, a survey dataset, and a leadership review, and who uses AI as a daily tool to move faster and see further, without giving up the judgment that makes research trustworthy. You’ll also raise the bar for the wider research practice by mentoring researchers, sharing methods, and helping the team define what great looks like in an AI-enabled era.

What You’ll Be Doing

Shape Product Strategy: Translate deep understanding of Consumers, Merchants, and Couriers into a clear point of view on where DoorDash should play and win. You’ll frame the highest-stakes questions, bring evidence to roadmap and investment debates, and influence decisions at the director and executive level.

Detect New Opportunities: Proactively identify emerging needs, behavior changes, and white space that point to new products, new verticals, and new growth levers. You’ll size and validate opportunities with a mix of foundational discovery, market and competitive context, and behavioral data, and turn them into concepts teams can act on.

Lead Mixed-Methods Research: Design and run rigorous research end to end, choosing the right method for the question: ethnography, in-depth interviews, diary studies, and usability testing alongside surveys, conjoint and MaxDiff, segmentation, experiment design, and behavioral and log analysis. You’ll triangulate across sources so the “what,” the “how much,” and the “why” tell one coherent story.

Partner with Data Science and Experimentation: Work closely with data science and analytics to connect qualitative insight to A/B test design, metrics, and product outcomes, and to explain the “why” behind results. You’ll help teams learn from what worked, what didn’t, and what to test next.

Apply AI to the Research Craft: Use AI tools and LLMs in your daily workflow for synthesis, analysis, survey and discussion guide design, and scaling qualitative depth, and design human-in-the-loop checks that catch confident but wrong outputs. You’ll help the team identify where AI accelerates research and where it should not be trusted, and contribute to shared prompts, workflows, and standards. You’ll also study how people experience AI-powered features across DoorDash’s products.

Influence and Communicate: Tell compelling, decision-ready stories that move partners from insight to action. You’ll adapt depth and format to the moment, from a fast directional read that unblocks a team this week to a foundational body of work that anchors a multi-year strategy, and you’ll follow through to see that findings change what gets built.

Lead Through Others: Serve as a thought partner and mentor to researchers across levels, review and elevate research quality, and help partners run good research on their own where that makes sense. You’ll help set the team’s research agenda, methods, and standards, and contribute to hiring and growing the team.

Operate Across Brands and Regions: Bring a global lens to your work, partnering across brands, markets, and cultures and adapting approaches to local context so that insights scale beyond a single market.

What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years of experience in user, market, or product research at a technology company (or equivalent depth), with a track record of leading ambiguous, high-visibility work at staff level or above
  • Demonstrated impact on product strategy: examples where your research changed a roadmap, unlocked a new product or line of business, or redirected significant investment
  • Proven ability to detect and shape new product or growth opportunities, from early signal through validated concept
  • Expert command of both qualitative and quantitative methods, including interviews, ethnography, and usability testing as well as survey design, statistical analysis, and experimentation. Working knowledge of SQL, R, or Python for pulling and analyzing your own data is a plus
  • Hands-on experience using AI and LLMs in research (for example, synthesis, analysis, prototyping, or scaling qualitative work), with sound instincts about where they help and where they mislead. Experience researching AI-powered products is a plus
  • Experience in consumer, two-sided or multi-sided marketplace, logistics, commerce, or local services contexts is a plus
  • Exceptional storytelling and executive presence, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders without authority and build trust across product, design, engineering, data science, and business teams
  • A bias for speed and pragmatism: comfortable delivering directional insight quickly while knowing when a decision calls for deeper rigor
  • Experience mentoring or coaching researchers and raising the quality of a research practice
  • Advanced degree in HCI, Psychology, Sociology, Anthropology, Economics, Statistics, Survey Methodology, or a related field preferred, or equivalent practical experience

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

​​💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you’re rewarded for the impact you make.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

title: Process Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Rohlik Group

Rohlik Group is Europe's leading online grocery delivery service. Using technology, we deliver a weekly shop of 25,000 SKUs in under three hours, in 15-minute delivery slots — giving our customers back their time, freedom and flexibility.

We believe the world needs a better food system: more sustainable, more inclusive, and bringing healthier, more personalised food to everyone. In every city we operate, we handpick the best and freshest local produce — from butchers to bakeries — and work directly with farmers through our Farm-to-Door program, alongside the trusted brands and affordable own-label products our customers love.

About the Team

The Automation team designs and implements the innovative processes, equipment and automation solutions that shape Rohlik's fulfillment network. Working closely with local and central teams, we drive scalability, efficiency and innovation across every part of our operations.

The Role

As a Process Engineer, you'll own end-to-end improvement projects across our fulfillment network — from spotting a process that's slow, costly or manual, to delivering a live, working solution on the warehouse floor. Your projects will span both hardware (robotics, automated material handling, conveyor and packing systems) and software (control logic and orchestration optimisation), using whichever combination best solves the problem.

 

What We Offer

  • Unlimited Vacation: Unlimited vacation days for a balanced work-life balance

  • Tax-Free Benefits: Monthly vouchers of €45 tax-free (via become.1)

  • Remote Allowance: €20 monthly allowance towards internet costs

  • Exclusive Shopping Perk: Knuspr Xtra account with 10% cashback in the form of Knuspr Credits

  • Corporate Discounts: Great discounts via CorporateBenefits (fitness, travel, tickets, shopping, and much more)

 

What You'll Do

  • Identify improvement potential across the fulfillment network — on the floor, in the data, and with operations teams — wherever automation or process redesign can meaningfully improve cost, throughput, quality or safety

  • Own the business case for each opportunity: quantify throughput gains and labour impact, calculate payback period, prepare capex/opex estimates, and defend the investment to senior stakeholders

  • Own the full solution end to end, whatever form it takes — physical automation, software/control changes, or a combination of both

  • Standardise delivered work into reusable templates, playbooks and best practices that accelerate future projects

  • Lead implementation from design through testing, installation, integration and piloting, coordinating internal teams, vendors and contractors to deliver a working solution on site

  • Partner with Procurement and Operations across the full lifecycle — from requirements, RFIs/RFQs, vendor evaluation and commercial negotiation, through to a clean handover with documentation, SOPs, support processes and training for operational teams

  • Feed insights from delivered projects into the group automation roadmap and warehouse planning concepts

  • Support site and regional leadership by translating process and performance data into prioritised improvement opportunities

What We're Looking For

Required:

  • Degree in engineering, a technical/analytical field (e.g., mechanical, mechatronics, industrial engineering, logistics), or an equivalent completed vocational training (Ausbildung) / relevant hands-on experience

  • 3+ years of experience in warehouse automation (e.g., robotics, AMRs, AutoStore, sorters, conveyors, packing systems) and process improvement, including end-to-end project ownership from concept to handover

  • Strong analytical skills, capable of both spreadsheet business modeling and floor-level process evaluation

  • Proven project management ability to align Operations, Engineering, Finance, and external vendors

  • Strong negotiation and engagement skills with third-party vendors and contractors

  • Broad interest in both the hardware and software sides of automation

  • Professional working proficiency in English (written and spoken)

  • Willingness to spend regular time on-site at fulfillment centers

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with control logic, orchestration software or WMS integration

  • Working knowledge of Lean or Six Sigma methodologies

title: Product Engineer - AI Finance
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for product engineers to own product areas within Doit's AI Finance.

 

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Engineer, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
A little about us

incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Notion, Linear, Ramp and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.

We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

The role in one line

At incident.io, what you build is yours: the whole loop, from hearing directly from customers what's worth building, to building it, with the trust to run with it and make something you're actually proud of.

What that looks like day to day

You'll spend real time in the codebase, but also on calls with customers, in Slack threads with them, reading their feedback. Understanding what customers need matters as much as building it. Once something's yours, it's yours end to end: the design and planning, the implementation, the testing, the delivery, and the follow up conversation with the customer who asked for it.

Day to day you're working in Go, TypeScript and React. That's just what we use, not a requirement for what you've used before. We care about how you think, not which stack you've clocked hours in.

We build with AI, not around it. Claude Code, Cursor, and Wispr are all standard kit here.

Flat structure, no ladder. People come from all kinds of backgrounds: some have founded companies, some have been CTOs, some are earlier in their careers. Here everyone's the same thing: a builder. The only thing that actually matters is whether you're curious about how the whole thing works, not just your bit of it.

Who you are

  • "If not me, then who" is basically how you operate. You don't wait around for something to be officially yours before you deal with it.

  • You own your work, but you build as a team. You unblock people, back your teammates up, and care as much about the team shipping great things as about your own bit of it.

  • You spot things before anyone asks you to. If a customer's about to notice a problem, you've usually already fixed it.

  • You communicate clearly, whether that's a Slack message to a customer, a design doc, or explaining a tricky trade off to your team.

  • You're comfortable in ambiguity, not just tolerant of it. Early ideation, half formed problems, and shifting priorities don't throw you off.

  • You share work when it's about 70% done, not 100%: drafts, MVPs, rough cuts, because you'd rather get feedback early than polish something in isolation.

  • You’re product minded, not just technically minded. You have real opinions about what should get built and why, and you share them, but you’re just as quick to change your mind when someone makes a better case.

  • You adapt fast. Feedback changes your plan, not your mood.

Supporting you

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

  • Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover - we want you and the people you love to be looked after.

  • Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.

  • First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously.

  • Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.

  • Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.

  • Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.

  • Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

  • Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself.

Compensation: £110K – £200K • Offers Equity

title: Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About us

STRATOS builds the commercial digital twin that large industrial companies run on. We work with global B2B companies to synchronize strategy and execution and ensure commercial success is driven by potential, not gut feel or old data. STRATOS is a category-defining, rapidly growing startup, profitable and majority founder-owned with our Series A still ahead of us, funded by high-profile investors (e.g., Accel) and trusted by 15 global industrial leaders and Fortune 500 customers. Our software integrates complex datasets into a unified solution, combining deep data integration, best-in-class workflows, and cutting-edge generative AI.

The role

Build the core product that every STRATOS client runs on. You take what our Forward Deployed Engineers learn on the ground and turn it into features, tools and agents that work across every deployment. You ship weekly and see real users pick them up.

What you'll do

  • Build and ship product features that commercial teams at our clients use every day, from data models to user interfaces

  • Turn one-off solutions into reusable product, working with FDEs and Commercial Product Managers on what keeps coming up across clients

  • Build front ends, APIs and agents in TypeScript and Python, on Palantir Foundry and our own services

  • Own what you ship, including how it's tested, deployed and monitored

  • Improve the product by talking to users and watching how features get used

You might be a fit if you

  • Have 2+ years building and shipping production software

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

 

What You'll Own

  • Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

  • Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

  • Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

  • Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

  • Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

  • Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

  • Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

  • Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

  • Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

  • Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

  • Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

  • Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Can set direction and still go deep into details.

  • Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

  • Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

  • Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

  • Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.


This Role Is Not For

  • Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

  • Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Créée en 2016, Theodo Data & AI est l'entité Data et IA de Theodo. Notre ambition est d'accompagner nos clients dans la conception et le déploiement de leur stratégie data ainsi que la recherche et le développement de solutions d’intelligence artificielle à l’état de l’art. L'entreprise est en pleine croissance : chaque année, Theodo Data & AI enregistre une croissance de plus de 30 % de son chiffre d'affaires, ouvrant ainsi de nouvelles opportunités passionnantes pour les Theodoers !
Tes futures missions : En tant que Product Manager, ton rôle est d’aider l’équipe à maximiser la valeur du produit en priorisant et livrant des fonctionnalités de qualité, au service de la satisfaction client. - Prioriser et livrer des fonctionnalités à forte valeur ajoutée, en respectant les jalons et les engagements pris auprès du client. - Montrer la valeur et l’avancement de l’équipe en rendant le travail visible et en facilitant les décisions du client (review decks, daily mails,…). - Comprendre les préférences du client et organiser une réaction rapide et adaptée en cas de problème, en s’appuyant sur des outils comme le modèle de valeur, les questionnaires clients et les résolutions de problème. - Piloter le delivery au quotidien en appliquant la méthodologie Lean : gestion du backlog, rédaction de user stories claires et planification des sprints. - Collaborer étroitement avec le client pour comprendre ses besoins, faciliter ses décisions et co-construire les solutions. - Traduire les enjeux produit en exigences claires pour l’équipe technique, en t’appuyant sur l’analyse des usages, l’étude de l’environnement et les benchmarks. - Aider l’équipe à tenir ses engagements en anticipant les risques, en résolvant les problèmes et en contribuant aux routines d’amélioration continue (résolution de problèmes, rétrospectives). Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples : - Pierre & Vacances : a fiabilisé et unifié ses données clients en 13 semaines grâce au développement d’un MVP de plateforme client unifiée intégrant matching, traçabilité et architecture scalable. Une équipe mixte de 5 experts Theodo a consolidé des flux batch et temps réel multi-sources, structuré la gouvernance via tests automatisés et dashboards métier, et conçu une architecture évolutive capable d’intégrer rapidement de nouveaux outils, pour un pilotage business plus fiable et en continu. - Carrefour : conçu et déployé en 9 semaines Store Adaptor, un moteur algorithmique de recommandation d’assortiment pour 1 200 magasins, afin d’optimiser l’espace et la rentabilité. Une équipe mixte de 5 experts Theodo a développé deux algorithmes (prévision des KPI et optimisation des briques d’assortiment) capables de traiter des volumes massifs de données et de s’adapter à la diversité des formats de magasins. Résultat : +7,5 % de chiffre d’affaires. Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu : Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits. Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients. Profil recherché : - Diplômé·e d’une grande école d’ingénieur, entre 2 et 5 ans d’expérience, idéalement en conseil ou dans un contexte avec forte exposition client. - Intérêt marqué pour la conception de produits à fort impact business, avec une appétence pour la tech et de bonnes connaissances sur le sujet. - Excellente aisance relationnelle : à l’aise face aux clients, capable d’adopter la bonne posture et de créer une relation de confiance. - Posture client first : disponible, réactif, à l’écoute, capable de prioriser le client, d’intégrer les retours et d’anticiper les besoins. - Forte envie d’apprendre et de progresser, capable de challenger son équipe, de demander de l’aide et d’accepter d’être challengé.Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo Data & IA ? L’environnement: 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 Prime d’intéressement indexée sur la croissance de Theodo 🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...) 🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50% 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile Prêt à nous rejoindre ?

title: Product Manager digital learning
descriptionHtml:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Compani accompagne les structures du médico-social (EHPAD, services d’aide et de soins à domicile, structures du handicap) à recruter, diplômer et fidéliser leurs professionnels, via des parcours de formation qui transforment les pratiques à l’échelle des professionnels, des équipes et des structures.

Société à mission, nous sommes convaincus que les métiers de l’aide et du soin sont des métiers d’avenir, que l’on devrait être fier de choisir, d’apprendre et d’aimer. Au cœur de notre ADN pédagogique ? Le terrain comme source d’apprentissage et la compétence relationnelle que l’on transmet avec la même exigence qu’un geste technique de soin. Aujourd’hui, nous avons accompagné plus de 700 structures et formé plus de 15 000 professionnels, avec un développement fortement accéléré depuis 2 ans.

Compani fait partie du groupe Alenvi (aide à domicile, maisons partagées pour personnes âgées avec troubles cognitifs). Nous sommes une trentaine de collaborateurs, animés par une culture de solidarité, d’autonomie et d’initiative et basés au Kawaa (café et coworking ESS, Paris Bastille).

Notre besoin

Compani a développé un logiciel SaaS propriétaire. Il permet de planifier, gérer, facturer les formations, en lien avec les formateurs et les structures. Il offre également aux apprenants une expérience digitale, sur laquelle nous souhaitons innover fortement dans les prochaines années en capitalisant sur les nouvelles technologies disponibles comme l’IA.

Nous souhaitons que l’app Compani devienne un vrai compagnon de nos apprenant·es (gestion de leur parcours, modules complémentaires, coaching…) et complète notre accompagnement pédagogique entre deux sessions animées par nos formateur·rices et coachs externes.

Ton rôle : porter la refonte de l’expérience apprenant.e via notre app, mais pas que ! Tu es la porte d’entrée vers tout ce qui concerne l’innovation pédagogique en lien avec le digital learning, avec un objectif : démultiplier l’impact de nos parcours de formation et assurer l’ancrage des apprentissages. Tu vas chercher ce qui se fait de mieux ailleurs, tu construis un réseau d’expert·es et tu ramènes cette innovation chez nous, dans notre bibliothèque pédagogique et dans notre application. Face à une IA de plus en plus standardisée, c’est toi qui construis notre singularité sur le blended. Pour que nos outils soient au service d'une vraie montée en compétences des apprenants. Le terrain de jeu est vaste !

Tes missions

🤝 Au sein du Pôle Offre, tu travailles en binôme étroit avec le·la Responsable offre pédagogique, qui construit nos nouvelles offres de formation et les BU qui les déploient auprès de nos apprenant.e.s.

Rattaché·e à la direction adjointe, tes responsabilités :

  • Tu portes la refonte de l’expérience apprenant·es dans l’application Compani : tu es le·la product manager. Tu recueilles les besoins (BU, partenaires externes) et tu construis la roadmap.
  • Tu contribues aux arbitrages et à la gouvernance produit (LMS, app), en lien avec le Pôle Offre et la tech.
  • Tu déploies la roadmap validée sur l’app, en lien avec 2 développeur·ses internes.
  • Tu contribues aux offres de formation Compani (déjà existantes et nouvelles), avec le·la responsable offre pédagogique, notamment pour les parcours blended.
  • Tu fais vivre une veille active sur l’edtech et les innovations pédagogiques : tu animes ton réseau d’expert·es, tu restes ouvert·e sur l’extérieur et tu traduis cette veille en réalité concrète pour notre secteur et nos offres de formation, en te demandant ce qui est possible avec notre public d’apprenant·es et ce qui apporte réellement de la valeur dans l’apprentissage.

Ce qui te fera aimer ce poste 💛

  • Une mission à impact : chaque outil que tu déploies touche des milliers de soignant·es et d’aidant·es
  • Un terrain de jeu à construire : un pôle récent en transformation, une app à refondre, une bibliothèque d’innovations à créer
  • Une double casquette rare : pédagogie et produit, recherche et terrain
  • Une vraie liberté d’initiative et une démarche entrepreneuriale pour inventer nos façons de faire
  • Une équipe engagée, collaborative, avec le sourire 😄

Profil recherché

🔎 Ce job est fait pour toi si :

  • Tu as au moins 5 ans d’expérience en product management, de préférence dans une edtech. Ce sont tes réalisations qui nous intéressent ;
  • La tech et l’IA, tu les pratiques déjà au quotidien, pas seulement en veille ;
  • Tu as déjà porté un produit numérique (discovery utilisateur, roadmap, specs, mesure d’usage, méthodes agiles) et tranché face à des développeur·ses ou des freelances : priorités, compromis, budget ;
  • Ta grande autonomie te permet d’avancer seul·e sur tes sujets ;
  • Tu es tourné·e vers l’extérieur : tu aimes aller chercher l’innovation ailleurs et faire vivre un réseau d’expert·es ;
  • Tu es une personne engagée, avec une forte appétence pour la mission de Compani et le secteur du Prendre soin ;

Comment nous rejoindre ? Le process de recrutement 👉

  • Échange téléphonique (20 min) avec Béatrice, notre responsable RH
  • Entretien avec Sara, ta future manager et un autre membre du CODIR : tu nous racontes un parcours blended que tu as conçu, puis on échange sur tes pistes d’innovation pour Compani (1 h 30 dans nos locaux)
  • Échange avec 1 ou 2 autres membres de l’équipe, dont Guillaume, cofondateur et qui pilote la tech chez nous, pour vérifier qu’on est bien aligné·es et qu’on veut vraiment aller dans le même sens
  • Prise de références

Informations pratiques

Rémunération : Entre 45 et 55 K€ selon expérience et grille salariale Compani

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today's challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Leveraging Data, AI, and real-time decision-making we turn energy complexity into growth opportunities for our partners. 

By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable and affordable.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?

Lead the localisation efforts for our global energy billing platform, ensuring it meets the specific regulatory, market, and cultural requirements of France, from meter read to bill.
You'll be in charge of the French localisation of the Billing Module—one of the core product domains at the heart of the Kaluza platform. The Billing module processes consumption, pricing, and account data to schedule, calculate, and generate accurate, timely, and compliant invoices throughout a customer’s lifecycle. The module automatically manages billing cycles, generates bills, handles corrections, and produces the data that feeds invoices, billing-related communications, payment schedules, and downstream financial reporting, while powering customer and agent UIs.

This is a hands-on, full-stack product role — you'll work across the whole domain and alongside PMs from other domains and from the global billing teams to ensure the overall billing  journey from meter to bill meets the requirements of French clients.

  • Collaborate intensely with clients and in-country experts to understand their unique needs and requirements, negotiate scope, and build a roadmap.

  • Deep dive into French energy market regulations, translating complex compliance needs into detailed product specifications for the billing system.

  • Define and manage detailed product requirements for features related to country-specific needs from getting a read to generating a bill (meter reading protocols, invoice formats, taxation rules, payment methods, and regulatory reporting).

  • Work closely with engineering, UX, and QA teams to ensure the successful implementation and testing of localised billing functionalities.

  • Act as the go-to expert for global teams on specific French market nuances related to energy billing and customer journeys.

  • Continuously monitor changes in French energy legislation and market practices, proactively adapting the product roadmap to maintain compliance and competitiveness.

About You

Ideally you'll have/be:

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager, or equivalent role in software companies, with a strong track record of successfully localising complex software products for international markets

  • Solid understanding of the end-to-end B2C billing lifecycle including meter data, tariffs, invoicing, and debt management.

  • A track record in regulated markets where billing complexity matters, energy, telecoms, financial services, or similar. Familiarity with the French energy market (ENGIE, CRE, switching, tariff structures) is advantageous.

  • Exceptional ability to translate abstract regulatory text or client requirements into clear, actionable, outcome-driven requirements for development teams.

  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams (engineering, design, legal, operations, client success) to deliver localised solutions.

  • Excellent stakeholder and client management skills, able to lead conversations across requirements, scope, expectations, and roadmap alignment, and communicate technical & market complexity clearly to varied audiences.

  • Proficiency in AI tools throughout all stages of the product lifecycle — from discovery and ideation to delivery and iteration.Fluent in French and English — our platform and many of our teams operate in English, so you move easily between both.

  • A builder's mindset — you're autonomous, learn fast, and aren't afraid to go deep. You're comfortable interrogating a codebase with AI tools, reading an API schema or data model, and writing a SQL query to get the answer you need.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and pace — you can operate effectively when not everything is defined, know when to make a call, and aren't afraid to escalate or ask for help when it matters.

  • Fluent in French and very comfortable in English — our platform and many of our teams operate in English, so you move easily between both

Kaluza Values

Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business: 

Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together

We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.
