title: Product Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
In 2018, Bitvavo launched the first version of its digital assets trading platform, to bridge the gap between traditional currencies and digital assets. By offering transparent fees, a wide range of assets and an easy to use platform, Bitvavo is making the currency of the future accessible for everyone.

In eight years time, Bitvavo has established itself as the market leader in the Netherlands and one of the largest in Europe, with over two million users exchanging tens of billions of digital assets a year.

What is the role about

As a fast paced, highly targeted and highly regulated company, security is more important here than most other companies. That means your impact can be much more material, this role is about working with our brothers and sisters in product and engineering and building security through collaboration. It’s about being an engineer who knows how to use automation and tooling to get more done at pace and to scale security’s impact.

The role includes ‘whole of product’ security - Application, architecture and infrastructure. You’ll understand deeply the threats posed to us by threat actors and where to focus our attention, you’ll be the kind of person who enjoys building long lasting relationships, making impact by really moving the needle and scaling through automation so you are always focussed on the highest value work.

How will you make an impact

  • Threat modelling: Taking an attackers lens on what’s being built and understanding how it could be abused/targeted and being able to bring others on the journey through clear communication.

  • Pen testing/Red teaming/Vuln discovery: Being the threat actor but with a whitebox approach, thinking about what tools can you build to help scale these processes. Thinking about how we bring in more data to find the right issues and surface them with appropriate prioritisation.

  • Communication and relationships: Bringing teams on side by working together with the attackers lens, collaboratively designing best of breed security controls that mitigate threads and support the business and our customers by making them as slick as possible.

  • Going deep on existing MO’s and industry attack knowledge: Understanding deeply the attackers, their motivations and evolving techniques, performing evaluations of our controls to ensure they hold up, continuously iterating and educating.

How will you be successful?

  • Backend/frontend development background with a transition into security engineering

  • 5+ years of experience in secure software development and AppSec

  • Demonstrable record of delivering real world security improvements

  • Deep experience of scaling security through automation including AI and slick processes

  • Experience with Kubernetes, containers and CI/CD

  • Strong AWS and/or GCP experience

  • Strong understanding of AuthN/AuthZ, API security, AI Security and OWASP Top 10

  • Experience with tools such as Burp, Wiz, Snyk, Semgrep, Bug bounty and SAST platforms

  • Experience in fintech, payments, crypto or other regulated industries is a big plus

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think like an attacker to anticipate and prevent security issues

  • Strong Communication: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, capable of presenting complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Bug Bounty participation/Hall of fame/CVE IDs are a big plus

  • Any security certifications are a plus (CISSP, CPTS, OSCP, AWS Security+)

title: Programme Director
descriptionHtml:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

The role

HEX brings together creative talent, emerging technology and industry-leading partners to turn innovation into scalable solutions for our clients.

We’re looking for a Programme Director to lead the end-to-end delivery of a complex, high-profile programme at the intersection of creative production, AI and emerging technology.

You will translate strategic objectives into an integrated delivery plan, bring multiple workstreams together and ensure the programme delivers against its commitments. You’ll take ownership of programme governance, dependencies, risks and decisions, providing the clarity and control needed to navigate complexity and maintain momentum.

Working across senior leadership, technology partners, clients and multidisciplinary delivery teams, you’ll connect the bigger picture with the detail of execution, ensuring everyone is aligned on what needs to happen, when and why.

What you’ll do

Lead the programme

  • Own the integrated programme plan, translating objectives into clear workstreams, milestones, deliverables and success measures.
  • Establish effective governance, clear accountability and a consistent approach to programme reporting and decision-making.
  • Maintain oversight of the critical path, dependencies and delivery commitments, ensuring activity across workstreams comes together to achieve the overall programme objectives.
  • Provide a clear view of programme health, progress and emerging issues, giving leadership the information needed to make timely, informed decisions.

Drive delivery

  • Lead delivery across multiple workstreams, aligning teams on priorities, milestones and interdependencies.
  • Anticipate risks, resolve blockers and drive action on issues before they impact delivery.
  • Manage changes to scope, timelines and deliverables, assessing their implications and ensuring trade-offs are agreed and understood.
  • Challenge assumptions, address competing priorities and keep teams focused on the outcomes that matter most.
  • Hold workstream leads accountable for commitments, following through on actions and intervening where delivery is at risk.

Align clients and stakeholders

  • Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across WPP, technology partners and client organisations.
  • Create alignment across teams with different priorities, ensuring clear ownership, timely decisions and a shared understanding of programme objectives.
  • Lead programme reviews and executive reporting, communicating progress, risks, decisions and required actions with clarity.
  • Act as the central point of coordination for programme delivery, connecting stakeholders and ensuring commitments translate into action.

Deliver measurable outcomes

  • Maintain oversight of performance against programme objectives, milestones, budgets and agreed commercial commitments, working with the relevant commercial and finance leads.

title: Project Manager
descriptionHtml:
Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them.

Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past.

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here.

About the Role

As a Project Manager at Sona, you'll own a portfolio of enterprise implementations end to end, working alongside a Solutions Architect on each project. Assignments are based on capacity and fit rather than a fixed team, so you'll work across sectors, hospitality, retail and social care.

You'll run implementations of Sona's products (HR, Scheduling, Payroll, LMS & ATS) end to end, ensuring delivery meets our scope commitments, budgets and timelines, all while providing an exceptional experience for our customers. You'll partner closely with senior stakeholders from our customers and internally across our Commercial, Product and Customer teams. We're a growing business, so you'll also need to thrive in a fast-evolving environment and be a strong advocate for clarity and communication.


Responsibilities

  • Lead and deliver projects on time, within scope and budget, maintaining the highest quality standards.

  • Manage project risks, dependencies and scope, communicating mitigations and changes clearly to all stakeholders.

  • Act as the primary customer advocate, building strong relationships and managing expectations throughout delivery.

  • Coordinate internal teams, vendors and customers to ensure successful outcomes and efficient resource deployment.

  • Produce clear, consistent documentation and status reports, escalating risks where required.

  • Support our Land and Expand approach by driving strong customer partnerships and early value realisation.

  • Continuously improve project processes and tools to enhance delivery speed, quality and customer satisfaction.

Requirements

  • Proven success delivering enterprise software implementation projects on time, within budget and scope.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including working with C-level executives.

  • Strong leadership and collaboration skills, able to influence without direct authority.

  • Strategic thinker with strong risk management, planning and prioritisation capabilities.

  • Calm, organised and results-driven under pressure, with excellent time management.

  • Confident in presenting, reporting and managing multiple complex projects simultaneously.

  • Comfortable using AI in your own workflow, notes, actions, tracking, and able to explain where you'd trust it and where you wouldn't.

  • Bonus: experience with workforce management or HR software, prior use of Smartsheets, experience managing customers in a frontline or operationally complex industry.

We're a hybrid working team you can expect to work 2+ days/week in our London office (Soho), and 2+ days/week on site with customers.

Benefits

  • Salary: £70,000 - £80,000 per annum

  • Share options

  • 35 days annual leave (25 days standard plus 10 flexible public holiday days)

  • Extra day of leave for every year of service

  • Pension contributions matched up to 5%

title: Python Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Abound

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.


And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.


Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

About the role

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to help us build high-quality, reliable backend systems that accelerate our mission.

This role sits within our mortgage engineering team. You’ll work across the backend stack, owning features end to end: from shaping product and technical requirements through implementation, launch, and iteration.

This role is ideal for a hungry, ambitious engineer who wants to step up quickly; someone with strong engineering fundamentals, high ownership, and the drive to grow into a senior-level contributor.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Build and ship high-quality backend features using Python, Django, RESTful APIs, GraphQL, Pydantic, Postgres, and Google Cloud

  • Own backend work from concept through delivery, including technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and iteration

  • Collaborate with internal teams and external engineering partners to deliver features with cross-team dependencies

  • Work closely with frontend to shape excellent user-facing and internal experiences

  • Bring strong technical judgment to the table, improving not just how systems work, but how they scale and evolve

  • Contribute to backend architecture, API design, data modelling, performance, reliability, security, and developer experience

  • Raise the standard of your own work and the work of those around you

Who you are:

  • Strong hands-on experience building backend systems with Python

  • Practical experience working with Django

  • Experience designing or consuming RESTful APIs

  • Experience designing and exposing GraphQL APIs for frontend applications

  • Experience working with Postgres and relational data models

  • Familiarity with Pydantic, typed Python, or modern Python engineering practices

  • Some experience with cloud infrastructure, ideally Google Cloud, or a strong desire to learn

  • A good eye for clean architecture, API design, performance, reliability, and maintainability

  • A product-minded approach: you care about the “why” behind what you’re building

  • A strong sense of ownership and accountability

  • The ability to uncover unknowns, navigate ambiguity, and turn complex problems into clear, shippable solutions

  • Pride in your craft, clean code, thoughtful reviews, and helping others grow

Ideally, you'll also have:

  • Experience with PDF generation or document rendering workflows

  • Experience in early-stage or fast-moving product teams

  • Familiarity with observability, monitoring, alerting, and infrastructure operations

  • A data-driven approach to decision-making

  • Openness to change, innovation, and the ways AI will reshape how products are built and used

What makes someone successful in this role

You don’t just “take tickets.” You think like a product builder. You’re hungry to learn, quick to take ownership, and motivated by the chance to grow fast. You notice when a system could be simpler, when an API could be clearer, or when a technical decision needs more care.

You’re comfortable stepping into ambiguity, asking good questions, making decisions, and pushing work over the finish line.

How we work at Abound

To be successful here, our culture needs to energise you. Here is how we operate:

  • High Bar & Real Ownership: We are a high-performing team, and we hire people who raise the bar and take pride in great work. We own outcomes, not tasks.

  • We Work Hard: We care about impact, not face time. At key moments, we go the extra mile to deliver for customers and the business.

  • MVP & Iteration Culture: We ship fast, learn from real customers, and continuously improve our products and processes.

  • One Team Collaboration: We collaborate deeply across engineering, product, operations, and the wider business.

  • Thrive in Change: Priorities evolve as we learn what works. We value people who use good judgment, adapt quickly, and stay focused on outcomes.

What we offer

title: QA Engineer - Quantum Computing (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Quantum computing is a new computing paradigm rapidly approaching commercial viability. Our unique approach combines laser-cooled trapped ions with microwave control and tailored magnetic fields. Our next-generation computing machines under development will be able to find solutions to problems that are out of reach today, thus enabling new innovative products and services for a brighter future.

We are looking for a QA Engineer (m/f/d) to join us in Hamburg or Siegen.

You will take ownership of quality across our software platform, from compilation services and the public API to the interfaces used by our operators and customers.

This is a build-from-scratch role: there is no ready-made test suite waiting for you, and no expensive tool that does the thinking for you. You define what good testing looks like here, and then you build it.

You are as comfortable writing a test strategy on a blank page as you are writing the automation that implements it in code.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the testing approach for our platform end-to-end: define what to test, at which level, and why

  • Write test concepts from scratch — risk-based, covering unit, integration, system, and end-to-end levels, and turn them into running, maintained automation

  • Build and own our test automation frameworks in code, integrated directly into our CI/CD pipelines, using your defined tooling

  • Do the exploratory and manual testing that automation can't cover, and know where that line sits

  • Establish quality gates, coverage expectations, and clear bug-reporting practices the whole team can work with

  • Work closely with backend, platform, and hardware teams to test at the boundaries where software meets the machine

  • Raise the testing literacy of the engineering team, so quality is a shared habit rather than a gate at the end


Required Skills:

  • 3+ years in software quality assurance, with real ownership of test strategy, not only executing predefined test scripts

  • Ability to design a test concept for an unfamiliar system: choosing the right test levels, techniques, and priorities from first principles

  • Confident programming ability (Python preferred), enough to build and maintain automation yourself rather than depend on record-and-playback tools

  • Hands-on experience with open-source testing frameworks (e.g. pytest, Playwright, Selenium) and integrating tests into CI/CD

  • Solid grounding in testing fundamentals: test design techniques, the test pyramid, API testing, and when to automate versus test manually

  • A generalist, tool-agnostic mindset, you pick the right approach for the problem, not the one tool you already know

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with experimental physicists and engineers

  • Strong adaptability and a quick learning mindset

  • Good proficiency in English (written and spoken)

Nice to have (Bonus)

  • Experience setting up a QA function or test strategy in an early-stage or greenfield environment

  • Testing distributed systems, APIs, or cloud-native services

  • Performance, load, or security testing experience

  • Exposure to hardware-in-the-loop or lab/control-software testing

  • ISTQB certification, or an equivalent grounding in test theory you actually apply

  • Prior exposure to quantum computing or other deep-tech domains


What you can expect from eleQtron:

  • Competitive salary: We value our team members and therefore provide remuneration that reflects this, additionally rewarding achievements

  • Flexible working hours: We offer personal freedom through a variety of flexible work schedules

  • Team spirit: In our international and diverse team, and with our regular team events, having fun at work is simply part of the culture

  • Further development: We want to grow together, and so we offer our team members needs-based, individualised further training as well as plenty of room for personal development

  • Wellness Package: We offer health-promoting benefits such as fitness programs like UrbanSportsClub to support your well-being

  • Bike Leasing: Stay Mobile and Sustainable with Our Company Bike Leasing Program

  • Moving Benefits: A warm welcome! We are happy to support employees who move for us with a bonus

  • At the forefront: Work at the forefront of technology, where academic research meets commercial applications

  • Modern workplace: We have a high-quality infrastructure with laboratory space, offices and meeting rooms

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What you'll do

The Release, Environments and Change Engineer (REC Engineer) has three key areas of responsibility. You will operate Release, Environments and Change processes and procedures, and you’ll be involved in, and often lead, the identification and implementation of process improvements using AI and other tools.

You will work closely with the REC Manager and Environments Manager and operate the processes they define. These processes may rely on manual activities and controls at first, so you’ll take a leading role in replacing them with appropriate automation, and then identify mechanisms and methods to govern those automated controls.

You will collaborate with Enablement teams and engineering teams across Kaluza to make sure processes are understood, embedded and followed. You’ll be a decision maker with the authority to decline or postpone releases and changes, and you’ll handle client communication where approval is required for a change or release.

  • Operating promotion gates, making promote or block decisions between environments in line with contractual and ways-of-working agreements, and escalating high-risk calls.

  • Facilitating change approvals, release Go/No-Go meetings and release trains, preparing releases against readiness criteria and tracking per-team readiness and environment-deployed status.

  • Using AI-assisted checks to confirm quality gates are met, summarise what changed in a release, score change risk and flag incomplete or stale records, applying your own judgment to improve the reliability of the results.

  • Maintaining complete, accurate change and configuration records, keeping every change traceable across the full environment stack, and managing the change and release calendar.

  • Building and maintaining release automation, including readiness checks, artefact promotion, AI-drafted release notes and notifications, and reporting feeds.

  • Working with engineering teams in real time to roll back failed releases or apply fixes, and coordinating with incident and problem management so planned changes, hotfixes and major incidents stay in sync.

  • Communicating changes and releases internally and externally, supporting environment coordination and validation, running post-implementation reviews and retros, and giving operational input into gate definitions and the wider process.

What you’ll bring 

  • Strong organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to juggle multiple moving parts and spot incomplete records or inconsistencies.

  • Clear communication and strong facilitation skills, comfortable coordinating across teams, leading check-ins, keeping everyone aligned, driving decisions and chasing things through to completion.

  • The confidence to say no and hold the line when something isn’t ready, and to escalate when you’re unsure.

  • Day-to-day use of AI tooling with a critical eye, catching what it gets wrong rather than waving it through.

  • Experience building or integrating AI agents (e.g. LangChain, AutoGen, custom frameworks, MCP-based tooling), with an understanding of prompt engineering and LLM evaluation techniques such as faithfulness, relevance and LLM-as-a-judge, since traditional pass/fail assertions don’t translate well to testing AI agents.

What will set you apart

  • Any exposure to how software gets released or how environments work, even informally.

  • Light scripting or automation experience, or the appetite to learn it.

  • A calm head under time pressure.

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

title: AI Fabric Architect
descriptionHtml:
fal is the generative media ecosystem powering the next generation of AI products. We build the infrastructure, tools, and model access that teams need to move from idea to production, and do it at scale without compromise. For developers and enterprises, fal is the foundation that makes generative media not just possible, but practical: a unified platform where high-performance inference, orchestration, and observability come together to unlock new categories of AI-native products.

As generative media reshapes industries across a market projected to grow by hundreds of billions over the next decade, fal is becoming the ecosystem that ambitious teams build on.

About this role

You are the architect of the network that our GPU clusters run on. You own the fabric end to end, from the NIC in each GPU server through the spine and leaf across the AI fabric, and you know that in AI infrastructure the network is core to the machine. As fal brings its own GPU capacity online across multiple sites, you will define the fabric architecture every site is built from, and then personally make sure it gets built and performs. This is not an architecture-only role. We are a small team moving fast, and the right person is as comfortable writing a port map, tracing a bad optic, or tuning congestion control on the data center floor as they are setting technical direction.

What you will do:

  • Own the fabric architecture for every site: GPU backend fabric (InfiniBand and/or RoCEv2), and GPU frontend Fabric

  • Choose topologies and make the key calls: rail-optimized vs. other designs, InfiniBand vs. Ethernet, oversubscription ratios, and how the fabric scales from one pod to many

  • Turn the architecture into a repeatable network blueprint: cabling plans, port maps, fabric addressing and routing design, and a fabric bill of materials (switches, NICs, optics, cables)

  • Get hands-on with bring-up at each site: be on the floor for the first racks, validate cabling and firmware, configure the fabric manager and switches, and run performance acceptance (NCCL tests, burn-in) before capacity goes live

  • Tune for real workload performance: congestion control, PFC/ECN, adaptive routing, and NCCL settings for both inference and training traffic

  • Debug fabric problems wherever they show up, from a flapping link to a job that’s mysteriously slow

  • Evaluate and select AI Fabric vendors and hardware, and push back with data when something doesn’t meet spec

  • Collaborate across automation and software to help build network monitoring, telemetry, and automation that let a small team run a large fleet, and be the top escalation point for AI Fabric incidents

  • Document as you go so each new site is faster than the last, and help hire and mentor the network engineers who join after you

Qualifications:

  • 7+ years in data center or HPC networking, including direct responsibility for production GPU cluster fabrics

  • A track record of taking GPU fabrics from empty racks to production, with your own hands on the work, not only through vendors or integrators

  • Deep expertise in InfiniBand (NDR/XDR, UFM, subnet management) and/or RoCEv2 lossless Ethernet

  • Strong command of rail-optimized and Clos/fat-tree designs, BGP/ECMP, and EVPN/VXLAN

  • A clear understanding of how fabric design and tuning affect collective communication and real workload performance

  • Comfortable automating with Python, Ansible, or similar

  • Strong Linux skills and the ability to debug across the boundary between host, NIC, and fabric

  • Sound judgment on tradeoffs between cost, performance, reliability, and time to deploy

  • NVIDIA Quantum/Spectrum-X, ConnectX-7/8, BlueField-3 SuperNICs, and/or Broadcom Tomahawk 5-class Ethernet

  • 400G/800G OSFP optics, AOC/DAC, MPO trunking

Nice to have:

  • Experience at a neocloud, hyperscaler AI infrastructure team, NVIDIA networking, or an AI factory integrator

  • Experience with NVLink / NVL72-class rack-scale systems and how they change scale-out fabric design

  • Experience with GPUDirect RDMA and GPUDirect Storage networks

  • Experience building out multiple sites in parallel or on aggressive timelines

  • Willingness to travel frequently to data center sites, especially during build-outs

What we offer at fal:

  • Interesting and challenging work

  • Competitive salary and equity

  • A lot of learning and growth opportunities

  • We offer relocation assistance to San Francisco.

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance (US)

  • Regular team events and offsite

title: Engineering Manager – Platform
descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Engineering Manager – Platform

Reports to: Head of Engineering

Location: UK / Europe

Company Overview:

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we're building this organisation from the ground up. We're looking for people who'd rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of the team you've previously managed.

About the Role

As an Engineering Manager, you lead a team building and operating core parts of Radiant's cloud platform. You combine people leadership, technical judgement, delivery ownership and cross-functional collaboration. You work closely with product, infrastructure, SRE, security and other engineering teams.

This is a hands-on leadership role. It focuses on building strong teams, delivering reliable platform capabilities, and creating an environment where engineers do their best work.

What You'll Do

As an Engineering Manager – Platform, you will lead a team building and operating the platform services customers build on, from virtual machines to observability and security, joining one of our Platform teams: Cloud, Observability or Security. We hire strong managers first, then agree your team with you based on your strengths and interests.

You'll combine people leadership, technical judgement, delivery ownership, and cross-functional collaboration, working closely with product, infrastructure, SRE, security, and other engineering teams. Each team has around nine engineers: principal, senior and mid-level software engineers, an SDET, a DevOps engineer, and a platform engineer. Your first team is a starting point, and moves between teams are normal here.

Our Engineering teams are grouped as follows:

  • Infrastructure: Compute, Network, Storage & Cluster

  • Platform: Cloud, Observability & Security

  • AI: Training & Inference

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of around nine engineers across software, platform, DevOps, and test.

  • Own delivery end to end: planning, prioritisation, quality, and operational readiness.

  • Partner with Product to turn priorities into clear technical plans and achievable milestones.

  • Provide technical leadership on architecture, reliability, scalability, and engineering trade-offs.

  • Set strong engineering practices for design, testing, observability, documentation, and incident learning.

  • Hire, onboard, and retain high-performing engineers. Hiring is a large part of the first year: expect around two hours a day on it.

  • Support career development through regular feedback, coaching, and progression planning.

  • Bring AI-assisted engineering into daily work, within our guardrails.

Your Profile

  • Experience leading engineering teams building cloud platforms, infrastructure, developer tooling, or distributed systems.

  • Proven experience in people management, hiring, coaching, and performance development.

  • A strong technical background: you engage credibly in architecture and design discussions.

  • A good understanding of:

  • Cloud infrastructure: compute, networking, Kubernetes, containers

  • Platform engineering: APIs, automation, IAM, observability, reliability

  • Distributed systems: scaling, consistency, failure handling

  • Engineering operations: incident response, capacity, performance, production ownership

  • Strong delivery and prioritisation skills across competing priorities.

  • Comfortable working closely with product and other engineering leaders in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment.

  • Experience with GPU, HPC, or AI infrastructure is a bonus. Nobody has depth in every area above: tell us which you know and which you want to learn.

What You Bring

  • People leadership: Build strong teams and help engineers grow.

  • Technical judgement: Challenge designs and guide trade-offs without owning every implementation detail.

  • Execution: Create clarity and drive complex work to completion.

  • Systems thinking: Understand how platform components and teams fit together.

  • Operational mindset: Care about reliability, maintainability, and production quality.

  • Ownership: Take responsibility for both team health and engineering outcomes.

  • Curiosity: Learn new domains fast. GPUs, networks excite you rather than worry you.

  • Builder mindset: Much here is not built yet, and you enjoy creating the process, not just running it.

Qualities we look for:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

  • Inspire the change: There's no blueprint for the future. You'll embrace challenges and change

  • You're real and you're true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you'll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you're talking to, you treat everyone the same.

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

  • Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

  • Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

  • Participation in the company shares program

  • Enhanced parental pay & leave

Our process: Talent screen → Hiring Manager → Technical interview (Principal Engineer and Engineering Lead) → Final.

title: Influencer Marketing Manager (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.


Role Overview

As Influencer Marketing Manager, you will develop and run Hilo’s influencer marketing program across our key markets. You will find creators whose voices and audiences fit our brand, negotiate effective partnerships, and shape content that makes Hilo relevant and credible. The role combines brand and performance: you will use data to estimate the potential of each partnership before we invest, measure its results, and apply what you learn to future campaigns.

Work location: Our company operates on a remote-first model. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in Europe. Fluent English and German are a must. Occasional travel to our office in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, or to team events may be required.

Core Responsibilities

  • Identify, assess, and recruit creators across relevant platforms and markets.
  • Develop campaign concepts that balance Hilo’s brand goals with measurable commercial outcomes.
  • Forecast likely reach, engagement, traffic, and acquisition outcomes to guide creator selection and budgets.
  • Negotiate fees, deliverables, timelines, and content usage rights, including rights to use creator content in paid campaigns.
  • Manage partnerships end to end, from briefing and content review through publication and reporting.
  • Build and nurture long-term relationships with creators and brand ambassadors to drive sustained awareness, trust, and advocacy.
  • Collaborate with paid media teams to amplify high-performing creator content across paid social and other relevant channels.
  • Set clear goals, track brand and performance metrics, and compare results with initial estimates.
  • Use campaign data and audience insights to improve creator selection, content formats, and investment decisions.
  • Work across marketing and product to align campaigns with Hilo’s priorities and approved health claims.
  • Build repeatable processes that support growth across the US, UK, Germany, and other markets.

Requirements

Background & Experience

  • At least 2 years of hands-on influencer or creator marketing experience, including managing partnerships from start to finish.
  • A data-driven mindset: you can estimate campaign outcomes, assess performance, and turn findings into better decisions.
  • Strong creative judgment and an understanding of how creator content builds both brand trust and customer demand.
  • Strong negotiation skills and confidence working with creators and their representatives.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and attention to detail.
  • Fluency in English; German is a plus.
  • Experience in health tech, wellness, medical devices, or another category where trust and accurate claims matter is welcome.

Benefits

What Makes You A Great Fit

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do:

Move the Needle — You focus on what truly drives impact for our customers and company. You use data and clarity to guide your decisions and prioritize what matters most. You push boundaries with bold, thoughtful innovation and hold yourself accountable for results.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with high quality. You treat mistakes as learning opportunities, experiment thoughtfully and iterate quickly. You take ownership, act hands-on and always look for smarter, faster ways to get things done, including leveraging AI and new tools.

Team First — You put the team above individual interests, building trust through openness and respect. You encourage healthy debate, challenge directly while caring personally and stand behind team decisions. You act as an owner, stepping in when needed and doing what’s necessary for the team’s success.

Why Join Us?

  • Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies and you can be part of this exciting story.
  • Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.
  • Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.
  • Collaborate with a diverse, passionate and talented team.
  • Competitive compensation, equity program and other benefits (depending on location).

Ready to Move the Needle?

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

title: Member of Technical Staff - Workforce Security
descriptionHtml:
About Black Forest Labs

We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world.

Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use.

Our FLUX models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. We're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. From our labs in Freiburg to San Francisco, we're building what comes next.

 

Why This Role

We develop AI models and run the infrastructure on which those models are trained, deployed, and served to customers. We're looking for an experienced, hands-on security engineer to protect how our staff work: the accounts they sign in with, the devices they use, the third-party tools they rely on, and the agents they delegate work to. You'll work closely with IT, which operates our employee services and devices.

This is an engineering role: you'll spend your time building tools and automations, designing practical controls, investigating escalations, and shipping changes.

 

What You’ll Work On

These are the areas this role draws from; you're not expected to cover
them all at once:

  • Identity and access. Strengthen how staff authenticate and what they can reach: single sign-on coverage, phishing-resistant authentication, and access provisioning and revocation that stay reliable and complete as people and tools change. Design scoped, short-lived credentials for the tools and agents that act on staff's behalf, and improve our ability to detect credential misuse.

  • Endpoint security. Work with IT on device trust, hardening, and visibility across our fleet. Find practical ways for engineers and researchers to install what they need without introducing unnecessary risk.

  • AI agents and staff tooling. Help staff use agents and AI-powered tools productively and safely. Review the threat models, permissions, and data flows of tools staff build or adopt, including coding agents, desktop assistants, browser extensions, and MCP servers. This includes how staff supervise and stay accountable for delegated actions, and the audit trails that make agent activity reviewable. Build sandboxes, credential patterns, and guardrails that make the secure path the convenient one.

  • Third-party tool security. Define a scalable security review for the tools staff use day to day, and work with IT, which owns procurement and provisioning, to build security checks into how tools are onboarded and offboarded. Maintain a current picture of which tools can reach company code, credentials, and customer data as tools are added and retired.

  • Visibility and response. Make sure identity, endpoint, and SaaS telemetry is collected and usable. Investigate escalations and incidents in these areas, verify that we can contain a compromised account or device quickly, and turn findings into lasting fixes.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong experience in identity and access security and endpoint security. Hands-on experience administering an identity provider and a device-management platform.

  • Practical understanding of OAuth, OIDC, SAML, secrets handling, and authorization design. You can trace how an application obtains and uses credentials and find where access controls can be bypassed.

  • Hands-on engineering ability. You can read unfamiliar code, inspect how an app talks to APIs, and write the automation and tooling that replace manual processes.

  • Experience using LLMs and agents in your own work, along with a clear-eyed view of where they help, where they don't, and how they can be attacked or misused.

  • Good security judgment. You can distinguish meaningful risks from theoretical ones and apply controls in proportion to the risk.

  • Experience supporting researchers, engineers, or other highly technical staff, and a track record of finding secure ways to meet their needs.

  • Comfort working with real autonomy and turning loosely defined problems into concrete improvements.

Experience with macOS security, developer tooling, SaaS security, software distribution, agent integrations, or threat hunting would be particularly relevant, but none is a prerequisite. We're more interested in people who have solved difficult security problems for real users than in candidates who can check every box on a technology list.

 

How We Work Together

We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. This role is based in San Francisco, and you’ll join us in the office at least 2 days a week, or one full week every other week.

Everything we do is grounded in four values:

  • Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.

  • Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.

  • Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.

  • Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.

If this sounds like work you’d enjoy, we’d love to hear from you.

Base Annual Salary:

US $180,000 - $225,000 USD + Equity

 

Note: We may use AI-assisted tools to help organize applications. All hiring decisions are always made by our team.

title: Network Architect, Backbone Network
descriptionHtml:
Design and build the global network that connects Radiant’s data centres, customers and future regions.

At a glance

Team: Infrastructure Delivery, Office of the CTO
Reports to: Infrastructure Delivery lead
Location: UK based, with travel to sites and industry events
Work model: Hybrid

Who we are

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale, powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments.

Our Infrastructure Delivery team designs and builds the systems that connect our sites and bring new capacity online. The backbone is a critical part of that work as Radiant expands across regions.

The opportunity

You will own the architecture of Radiant’s global backbone, from the first design decision through build, testing and handover. It will connect our data centres, new developments, cloud and customer interconnects, while meeting demanding requirements for resilience, capacity and data sovereignty.

You will be the design authority for the backbone, working hands-on with a small architecture team, delivery partners, vendors and carriers. Infrastructure Operations will run the network after go-live, so you will bring them into decisions early and give them a network they can operate confidently.

What you’ll do

  • Define the backbone architecture and roadmap, including routing, traffic engineering, site connectivity, transit, peering and private interconnects.

  • Turn customer, capacity and sovereignty requirements into designs that can be built and operated. Work with cluster network, infrastructure, storage, security and data centre teams to resolve trade-offs.

  • Produce high-level and low-level designs, bills of materials, test plans and acceptance criteria. Lead design reviews and approve the technical design before build and handover.

  • Evaluate routing and optical platforms, carriers and proposed designs. Contribute technical requirements and assessments to procurement processes while Procurement owns commercial terms.

  • Establish standards for network automation, a source of truth and streaming telemetry. Validate designs in the lab, investigate complex backbone faults and improve the architecture as the network grows.

  • Represent Radiant in technical discussions with customers, vendors and the wider network community, including at relevant industry events.

What you’ll bring

  • You have owned a multi-site backbone from design through production, including delivery across more than one country. You bring around ten years in network engineering, with substantial carrier, service provider or hyperscale backbone experience.

  • You have deep practical knowledge of BGP, an interior routing protocol such as IS-IS or OSPF, MPLS and segment routing. You can design internet edges, peering, data centre interconnects and resilient paths.

  • You understand optical transport, including DWDM, coherent optics, dark fibre and wavelength services, and can make sound decisions across leased and owned capacity.

  • You have configured and tested major routing platforms, automated network changes with tools such as Python or Ansible, and worked with a network source of truth. You can write clear designs and defend them with engineers, executives and customers.

  • You hold a current expert-level network certification, such as JNCIE-SP or CCIE Service Provider, or an equivalent, and are comfortable travelling to sites and speaking at industry events.

Nice to have: Experience with GPU or AI infrastructure networks, sovereign or regulated environments, long-haul fibre routes, or contributions to the wider network community.

Don’t tick every box? Apply anyway. We hire for potential, and we’d rather hear from you than miss out.

What we offer

Our UK package includes share options, a bonus scheme, 25 days of holiday plus bank holidays, a 5% employer pension contribution, private medical cover, dental and optical support, wellbeing benefits, paid parental leave, dedicated learning time and a cycle to work scheme. Confirm the applicable package with People before posting.

Equal opportunities

Radiant is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, marital or parental status, or any other protected characteristic.

title: RF Systems Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft Orbital is making space simple. We build and operate reliable, shareable satellites that give customers a faster, simpler path to orbit. By combining flight-proven spacecraft platforms with our own hardware and software, we make it easier to deploy missions in space.

As an RF Systems Engineer, you'll contribute to the design, development, and integration of communication systems across our satellite connectivity and next-generation RF payload programs. You'll work on RF system architecture, signal processing algorithms, and performance analysis, collaborating closely with FPGA, embedded software, systems, and hardware engineers to develop and integrate complex RF technologies.

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys working at the intersection of RF hardware and signal processing, solving challenging technical problems, and seeing their work go from initial design to in-orbit operation.


About this Role:
  • Contribute to the design and development of RF systems for satellite connectivity and payload applications, including architecture, requirements, and technical trade-offs.
  • Perform RF link budget analysis and evaluate subsystem performance across S-band, X-band, and inter-satellite link (ISL) applications.
  • Develop and optimize signal processing algorithms for RF payloads using MATLAB and related simulation tools.
  • Support RF payload development across the signal chain, from antennas and RF frontends to ADCs and SDR systems, including signal detection and geolocation.
  • Collaborate with FPGA, embedded software, and systems teams to translate RF requirements into implementable solutions and integrate signal processing algorithms.
  • Define and track system requirements, documenting technical decisions, integration activities, and verification results.
  • Support RF testing, hardware integration, troubleshooting, and performance verification through AIT and in-orbit commissioning.
  • Work across engineering and AIT teams to drive successful development and integration of RF systems and payloads.

    • Must Haves:
  • 2+ years of experience in Radio Frequency (RF) systems engineering, subsystem integration, or a closely related field.
  • Proven experience with RF system integration, debugging, testing, and performance analysis.
  • Experience with signal processing algorithms, including the ability to model, analyze, or evaluate RF signal processing approaches.
  • Knowledge of RF communication systems and subsystems, particularly S-band and X-band communications.
  • Experience with RF link budget calculations and RF system-level performance analysis.
  • Hands-on experience with RF hardware, test equipment, and subsystem validation.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently drive technical activities and collaborate across system and software integration efforts.
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and teamwork skills.

    • Nice to Haves:
  • Experience with Software-Defined Radio (SDR) architectures and development.
  • Familiarity with FPGA-based signal processing, including experience working with FPGA teams to implement digital signal processing algorithms or IP blocks.
  • Knowledge of key SDR components and technologies, including channelizers, analog-to-digital converters (ADC), and digital-to-analog converters (DAC).
  • Experience using MATLAB for signal processing, modeling, simulation, or algorithm development.
  • Experience translating system-level RF and signal processing requirements into FPGA or embedded software implementation requirements.
  • Experience with antenna systems, RF frontends, and RF payload architecture.
  • Familiarity with RF geolocation, signal detection, spectrum analysis, or SIGINT-related applications.
  • Experience with RF testing, integration, and performance verification in an aerospace or satellite environment.

    • Some of Our Awesome Benefits:
  • Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success
  • Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best
  • Health and life insurance, we care about your health
  • Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand)
  • Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences
  • Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together
  • Relocation assistance to Toulouse when applicable
    • *Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions. We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.
    Who We Are
    Loft: Space Made Simple.
    Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.
    We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.
    With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure.

This means building the trusted alternative: robots that are safe, secure, and engineered to automotive standards of scale and durability.

We are well-capitalized and now assembling our team.

Our Locations: Vesoma has two main locations: Munich, Germany and Limassol, Cyprus. This pan-European setup represents our core ambition of building a European technology leader, gives us a great talent base and a strong corporate structure.

Your mission

As a Robot Operations Engineer, you will be the backbone of our hands-on robotic development. You will be responsible for the bring-up of fresh hardware, maintaining our active hardware fleet, as well as owning the "robot gym": our dedicated lab environment where robots undergo continuous testing and AI model training.

Your work ensures that our AI and software teams have uninterrupted access to high-functioning, reliable hardware. Working at the intersection of hardware engineering and AI development, you will oversee prototype bring-up, diagnose electromechanical issues, and create a structured, highly efficient lab environment that accelerates our overall product development cycle.

Key responsibilities

  • Hardware Bring-up: Perform the initial bringing up and commissioning of freshly built prototypes. Ensure the flawless interaction between hardware, firmware, and base software stacks before handing them over for active testing.

  • "Robot Gym" Management: Own and operate the "robot gym." Ensure the lab environment is safe, organized, and continuously optimized to support the AI team's data collection and training operations.

  • Fleet & Inventory Ownership: Track, maintain, and manage the entire inventory of robot prototypes, sub-assemblies, and critical spare parts. Ensure all active units are properly version-controlled and running the latest hardware and firmware configurations.

  • Maintenance & Troubleshooting: Perform routine maintenance, sensor calibrations, and hands-on repairs across the robot fleet. Rapidly diagnose and resolve electromechanical, networking, or system-level issues to minimize testing downtime.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the primary technical bridge between the Hardware and AI teams. Provide operational support, manage hardware allocation requests, and feed critical performance observations back to the hardware engineering team to improve future iterations.

  • Process Standardization: Establish and document clear standard operating procedures (SOPs) for robot operation, safety protocols, lab maintenance, and hardware troubleshooting.

Your profile

We are looking for hands-on engineers who love getting their hands dirty with complex mechatronic systems and take immense pride in keeping a high-tech robotic fleet running at peak performance.

  • Experience: 3+ years of experience in robotics operations, lab management, hardware testing, field engineering, or a similar hands-on electromechanical role.

  • Core Skills: Strong hands-on mechanical and electrical troubleshooting capabilities. Familiarity with Linux environments, basic network configuration, and scripting (e.g., Python or Bash) for system diagnostics and bring-up. Experience managing hardware inventory, using standard lab equipment, and ensuring operational safety.

  • Mindset: You are highly organized, proactive, and service-oriented. You thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced lab environment, possess a strong sense of ownership over your fleet, and understand that the success of our AI development relies heavily on the readiness and reliability of the hardware you manage.

Why us?

  • The Team: Work alongside leadership with a proven track record of building unicorn-scale companies and defining global robotics standards.

  • Smart Strategy: We operate as disciplined fast followers. Capital is timed to the deployment inflection point, avoiding early-mover dead ends to scale fast on proven foundations.

  • Resources: We are substantially internally funded and attract top-tier investors to avoid any capital constraints for our mission.

  • Historic Opportunity: Join at the dawn of a new industry comparable to the rise of the automobile. Help shape the European champion in this trillion-dollar market.

We are an equal opportunity employer.

Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

3 days per week in our London office

Build your enterprise sales career at n8n

n8n is growing rapidly at the intersection of AI, automation and enterprise software. More than 1.7 million active builders use n8n each month, and we’re scaling our enterprise business as more organisations look for ways to connect AI with the systems, data and workflows that run their businesses.

We’re building our SDR team in London and looking for a Sales Development Representative to join us.

You’ll partner closely with Enterprise Account Executives to break into some of the largest organisations in the NEMEA region. This isn’t about maximising email volume. You’ll take a thoughtful, account-based approach: researching strategic companies, identifying the right stakeholders, understanding their priorities, and creating relevant conversations around automation and AI.

If you’re succeeding in an SDR/BDR role and want greater exposure to enterprise selling, strategic account planning, technical buyers and a genuine path towards AE, this could be a great next step.

Why you will thrive at n8n?

Serious momentum. n8n has grown rapidly into a major player in workflow automation and AI, with more than $100M in ARR, 1,400+ enterprise customers, and a $5.2B valuation following strategic investment from SAP.

Build towards AE. We want the SDR role to be a platform for your next step. High-performing SDRs can develop through our structured SDR → AE programme, with live deal exposure, discovery and MEDDPICC coaching, call reviews, and opportunities to take greater ownership of real opportunities alongside experienced AEs.

Learn enterprise selling. Work alongside Enterprise AEs on account strategy, stakeholder mapping, messaging, discovery and opportunity creation - gaining exposure to how complex enterprise deals are built from the start.

Sell where the market is going. You’ll engage technical and executive buyers around AI, automation and some of the most important technology challenges businesses are tackling today.

Use AI to sell smarter. Experiment with AI, n8n and modern sales technology to research accounts, understand buyers, personalise outreach and improve how you work. You don’t need to be an engineer - but you should be curious about technology and excited to learn.

What you’ll do;

  • Build enterprise pipeline: Prospect into a focused set of strategic accounts and create qualified opportunities.

  • Develop account strategies: Partner with Enterprise AEs to identify priority companies, stakeholders, challenges, use cases and engagement strategies.

  • Research your prospects: Understand the business and technical priorities of stakeholders across IT, DevOps, SecOps, Engineering and related teams.

  • Create outreach that gets attention: Develop thoughtful, personalised messaging tied to real account priorities rather than generic sequences.

  • Prospect across channels: Engage prospects through email, phone, LinkedIn and other relevant channels.

  • Lead early-stage discovery: Understand business needs, technical environments, priorities, urgency and potential fit with n8n.

  • Continuously improve: Use Salesforce, Outreach, Apollo, AI tools, coaching and performance data to sharpen your approach.

What we’re looking for;

We’re looking for someone with a strong SDR foundation who wants to develop into an excellent enterprise seller.

You’ll likely be a good fit if you have:

  • SDR or BDR experience in B2B SaaS, software or technology

  • Experience generating pipeline through outbound prospecting within mid- market or enterprise accounts

  • A strong sales track record against your targets

  • Fluency in English (verbal and written) + an additional language is beneficial

  • Confidence engaging senior business and technical stakeholders

  • A thoughtful approach to account research, personalisation and qualification

  • Curiosity about technical products, automation and AI

  • Resilience, consistency and ownership of your results

  • The ability to work from our London office three days per week

Bonus points if you have: experience prospecting into technical audiences; familiarity with buying committees, Salesforce, Outreach, Apollo or MEDDPICC; experience using AI or automation in your own sales workflow.

What success looks like

Success here is about quality, not just activity.

You’ll build a deep understanding of your accounts, identify the right stakeholders, create messaging that earns attention and generate qualified enterprise opportunities that can turn into meaningful revenue.

Along the way, you’ll build experience in enterprise account strategy, technical selling, discovery, AI and automation, and complex B2B sales - giving you a strong foundation for the next stage of your career.

Interested?

You don’t need to meet every requirement to apply.

You will work closely with prospects and existing customers, demonstrating how our AI products can address their specific needs, integrate into their existing technology environments and deliver tangible commercial value.

Acting as the technical counterpart to our Commercial teams, you will lead customer demonstrations, design and deliver workshops, support integrations and help customers understand the capabilities, value and security of our AI products. You will also play an important role in shaping the AI product roadmap through direct customer feedback and market insights.

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

Genomics is a science-led transatlantic TechBio combining large-scale genetic and health data with proprietary analytics to accelerate drug discovery and advance predictive, preventative healthcare. Genomics aims to help people live longer, healthier lives in two ways: super-charging drug discovery and development for novel treatments with our AI-enabled advanced genetic analytics platform, and by helping people understand their personal risk of common chronic diseases through polygenic risk scores - giving doctors and health systems the chance to get the right people into the right prevention, screening and treatment programmes at the right time.

At Genomics, we tackle major scientific challenges in harnessing genomic data to improve human health.

Starker Partner für Deine berufliche Zukunft!

Die LBS Landesbausparkasse Süd ist die Bausparkasse der Sparkassen in Baden-Württemberg, Bayern und Rheinland-Pfalz und Teil der größten deutschen Finanzgruppe. Unsere rund 1.500 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter an unseren Standorten in Stuttgart, München, Mainz und Karlsruhe sowie knapp 950 Vertriebsprofis in unseren Beratungsstellen betreuen unsere Kundinnen und Kunden optimal rund um die Themen Bausparen, Baufinanzierung und Immobilien.

Ein Garant für unseren Erfolg ist unser motiviertes und leistungsstarkes Vertriebsteam. Wir suchen Dich als selbständigen Kundenberater im Vertrieb für Bausparen und Baufinanzierung – auch für Quereinsteiger (m/w/d) geeignet (Handelsvertreter nach § 84 HGB).

Nimm teil an unserem Erfolg und gestalte die Zukunft Deutschlands größter Landesbausparkasse aktiv mit.
#TeamZuhause - sei dabei!

Aufgaben

  • Beratung und Verkauf unserer Bausparprodukte und Baufinanzierungen
  • Cross-Selling-Möglichkeiten, besonders durch die Zusammenarbeit mit Sparkassen, LBS-Immobilienmaklern und Versicherungen
  • Eigenverantwortliche Betreuung und Ausbau Deines Kundenbestandes, Steigerung deines persönlichen Bekanntheitsgrades und Networking
  • Unterstützung von Sparkassen bei der Beratung und Akquise gemeinsamer Kundschaft
  • Selbstmanagement des Tagesgeschäfts: Planung, Dokumentation und Aufbereitung der Kundentermine, Finanzierungsprojekte und verkaufsfördernde Aktionen

Qualifikation

  • Bankenspezifische Ausbildung - gerne in einer Sparkasse oder
  • eine kaufmännische Ausbildung mit vertrieblicher Ausrichtung
  • Erlaubnis zur Immobiliendarlehensvermittlung § 34i GewO von Vorteil
  • Berufserfahrung in der Beratung von Finanzprodukten wünschenswert
  • Unternehmerisches Denken und abschlussorientiertes Handeln
  • Ausgeprägte Kunden- und Serviceorientierung
  • Professionelle Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Benefits

  • Leistungsorientiertes Provisionsmodell inkl. Zielerreichungsprämien
  • Finanzielle Unterstützungsleistung in der Einarbeitungszeit
  • Übernahme eines bestehenden Kundenbestandes
  • Modernes Arbeitsumfeld durch flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung und mobiles Arbeiten
  • Abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben für eine starke Marke mit hohem Bekanntheitsgrad
  • Intensive Vorbereitung auf Deine Aufgabe durch Schulung und strukturierte Einarbeitung vor Ort
  • Laufende, individuelle Betreuung durch erfahrene Vertriebsprofis und Coaches
  • Vertriebskarriere mit fortlaufend professioneller, anerkannter Qualifizierung für Deine Zukunftsperspektive

title: Senior Account Executive (Government, Defense & Intelligence)
descriptionHtml:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.

Candidates should be located in Frankfurt or Berlin

About the role

This is a rare opportunity to build and lead Kpler’s growth across Continental Europe’s defense and intelligence community. You will own the full sales cycle, from first conversation to signed contract and beyond, working with ministries, agencies and public sector institutions where our data directly supports national security and policy decisions.

If you are a natural hunter who thrives on complex, high-value deals and wants your work to matter, this role offers real ownership, visibility and impact.

What you will do

  • Win new business. Own the end-to-end sales cycle, identifying, pursuing and closing high-value opportunities across government accounts.
  • Grow what we have. Manage strategic existing accounts, uncovering upsell and cross-sell potential.
  • Navigate the public sector. Lead us through tenders, RFPs and long procurement processes to win and retain contracts.
  • Build lasting relationships. Become a trusted partner to senior decision-makers across ministries, agencies and institutional clients.
  • Drive regional growth. Deliver ambitious revenue targets and shape our strategy for the region.
  • Work as one team. Partner with Customer Success, Marketing and Product so clients get the most value from Kpler’s solutions.
  • Keep the pipeline sharp. Maintain accurate pipeline and forecasts in the CRM to support data-driven decisions.
  • Be the face of Kpler. Represent us at industry events, conferences and client meetings.

What you bring

  • Experience in SaaS/DaaS/data platform sales to government institutions is a plus.
  • A proven track record of hunter-style sales, consistently meeting or exceeding revenue targets
  • Deep knowledge of government procurement, including tenders and RFPs
  • A strong professional network you can put to work from day one
  • Experience managing large, strategic accounts in multi-stakeholder environments
  • A consultative approach to selling, paired with a competitive, results-driven mindset
  • The ability to juggle multiple complex opportunities in a fast-paced, high-growth setting
  • Fluent English and at least one other major European language (e.g. French, German, Spanish, Italian)
We are a dynamic company dedicated to nurturing connections and innovating solutions to tackle market challenges head-on. If you thrive on customer satisfaction and turning ideas into reality, then you’ve found your ideal destination. Are you ready to embark on this exciting journey with us? We make things happen We act decisively and with purpose, going the extra mile. We build together We foster relationships and develop creative solutions to address market challenges. Don’t let the confidence gap stand in your way, we’d love to hear from you! We understand that experience comes in many different forms and are dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team.
