title: Senior Account Executive - Hospitals
descriptionHtml:
Build something monumental for Healthcare!

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.

We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

About the Role

We’re looking for an Senior Account Executive to grow our footprint across France. You’ll be at the forefront of introducing Tandem’s clinician copilot to providers, partners, and health systems - shaping how we scale across France

This is a pivotal role where you’ll forge high-impact partnerships across the care ecosystem, from provider networks and EHR vendors to resellers and health insurers. You’ll act as a market expert, relationship builder, and operator all in one.

What you will do

  • Identify, initiate, and manage key relationships across the healthcare landscape in France.

  • Open doors with provider groups, EHR vendors, system integrators, payors, and commercial resellers to accelerate Tandem’s reach and adoption.

  • Pitch, negotiate, and close deals that deliver strategic value, working closely with legal, product, and commercial teams to get contracts across the line.

  • Represent Tandem externally in meetings, events, and conferences, positioning us as a trusted digital health partner.

  • Bring the voice of the market back into Tandem, sharing insights that inform product development, regulatory priorities, and local go-to-market strategy.

  • Help build the customer success and support infrastructure that ensures our partners thrive with Tandem.

What You Bring

  • Proven experience with healthcare partnerships, sales, or business development - ideally in health-tech, med-tech, with familiarity of the hospital ecosystem

  • A strong track record of closing strategic partnerships in complex, regulated environments with providers, EHRs, or pharmaceutical companies.

  • Deep knowledge of the French hospital ecosystem - from payors and providers to health IT vendors and regional nuances.

  • A strong local network and ability to build trusted relationships across stakeholder groups.

  • Comfortable navigating clinical, commercial, and technical conversations.

  • Fluent in French and English, with excellent communication skills.

  • Independent operator with the ability to collaborate closely with cross-functional teams.

  • Passion for improving healthcare delivery through thoughtful, impactful innovation.

Bonus Points

  • Experience working with or selling into EHR providers, health systems, or care delivery platforms.

  • Background in medtech, digital health, healthcare

  • Familiarity with EU/French regulatory and compliance environments.

  • Experience in startup or high-growth environments, especially launching new markets.


What we offer

  • Competitive salary, reviewed as you grow, plus stock options

  • 30 days of holiday

  • Paid parental leave

  • €1,000 annual health & wellbeing budget, plus mental-health support whenever you need it

  • A real learning budget and internal growth paths - build your career without leaving Tandem

  • Fully AI native company - let our agents do the grunt work

  • Two company off-sites a year, plus a team budget for the things that bring you closer

  • State of the art office in the heart of Paris, and your choice of IT equipment

Location

We believe the best ideas happen when we’re together. This is a full-time role based in Paris, France. You’ll travel regularly - either to meet clinicians around France or to collaborate with our team in Stockholm.


How to Apply

We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

Our interview process consists of 4 stages:

  1. Screening interview with Talent Acquisition

  2. First interview with our Country Director in France

  3. Working Day - Join us in the Paris office for a day to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.

Culture at Tandem

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.

Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.

Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.

We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.

Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

title: Senior Accountant (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
CMBlu Energy befindet sich auf der spannenden Reise hin zu einem globalen Cleantech-Unternehmen. Unsere Mission: Unbegrenzte Energiespeicherung nach dem Vorbild der Natur ermöglichen – und das für alle, weltweit.  

Was sind SolidFlow-Batterien?   

SolidFlow-Batterien speichern Energie in organischen Molekülen. Der Verzicht auf explosive Materialien macht sie sicher, der Einsatz von sozial und ökologisch konfliktfreien Rohstoffen nachhaltig und die nahezu unbegrenzte Materialverfügbarkeit skalierbar und günstig in der Beschaffung. Das macht unsere patentierte SolidFlow-Technologie zu einem Gamechanger im Aufbau eines globalen klimaneutralen Energiesystems.  

Vom Start-up zum Scale-up: Gemeinsam packen wir es an   

CMBlu Energy entwickelt sich von einem Start-up mit Forschungsschwerpunkt zu einem produzierenden Scale-up, das sich auf dem Sprung in die Serienproduktion befindet. An diesem Ziel arbeiten rund 250 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter bei CMBlu Energy. Unser Hauptsitz ist in Alzenau nähe Frankfurt, mit einer Zweigstelle in Obernburg. Hinzu kommen Tochtergesellschaften in Athen, Griechenland und Petaluma, USA.   

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du unterstützt bei den Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB und IFRS und bei der Konzernberichterstattung
  • Du begleitest die laufende Hauptbuchhaltung einschließlich Kontenabstimmungen, Rückstellungen und Abgrenzungen
  • Du stellst die korrekte bilanzielle Abbildung unserer Geschäftsvorfälle sicher und klärst komplexe Bilanzierungsfragen
  • Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit mit Wirtschaftsprüfung, Steuerberatung und internen Fachbereichen
  • Du entwickelst unsere Accounting-Prozesse und internen Kontrollen in einem dynamisch wachsenden Unternehmen weiter
  • Du pflegst eine hands-on Mentalität und buchst Rechnungen, Reisekosten und andere operative Aufgaben

Dein Profil

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung und Weiterbildung zum geprüften Bilanzbuchhalter oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Berufserfahrung in der Bilanzbuchhaltung und fundierte Kenntnisse im HGB und Grundkenntnisse im IFRS
  • Sicherer Umgang mit ERP-Systemen und MS Excel sowie Begeisterung für digitale und effiziente Prozesse inklusive Nutzung KI
  • Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise mit einem hohen Qualitätsanspruch
  • Kommunikationsstärke, Teamgeist und Freude daran, Accounting-Strukturen in einem Start-up-Umfeld aktiv mitzugestalten

Deine Benefits bei der CMBLU Energy AG  

  • Mehr Netto für dich: Mit der Spendit Card erhältst du jeden Monat 50 € (bei Vollzeit) steuerfrei extra – einlösbar bei zahlreichen Visa-Akzeptanzstellen in deiner Region, ganz flexibel nach deinen Wünschen. Zusätzlich gibt dir die Spendit Card Zugang zu Wellhub, einer Fitnessplattform, über die du bundesweit Fitnessstudios, Kurse und Wellness-Angebote nutzen kannst.
  • Gemeinsam am Erfolg teilhaben: Über unser Virtual Stock Option Program (VSOP) wirst du am Wachstum von CMBLU beteiligt. Vereinfacht gesagt: Du erhältst virtuelle Anteile, die dir – ganz ohne eigene Investition oder Stimmrechte – im Erfolgsfall einen Anteil am Wertzuwachs des Unternehmens auszahlen.
  • Nachhaltig mobil: Wir übernehmen die vollen Kosten für dein Deutschland-Ticket. Über JobRad kannst du dir zusätzlich dein Wunschfahrrad leasen, günstiger als im Laden. Ob Zug oder Rad: Du kommst klimafreundlich und komfortabel ans Ziel. 
  • Frisch und lecker durch den Arbeitstag: Am Standort Alzenau erwarten dich am freshtaste-Verpflegungsautomat täglich frische, bezuschusste Mahlzeiten.
  • Flexibel Sprachen lernen: Mit der App Busuu baust du deine Sprachkenntnisse in deinem eigenen Tempo aus. Den Zugang dazu stellen wir dir kostenfrei zur Verfügung.
  • Sinn, der antreibt: Gestalte mit uns die Energiewende und arbeite an der Weiterentwicklung unserer SolidFlow-Batterie mit. Seit 2026 ist CMBLU ein Unicorn, das bedeutet, unser Unternehmen wird mit mehr als einer Milliarde Euro bewertet. Mit deiner Arbeit gestaltest du dieses Wachstum aktiv mit.
  • Kultur, die verbindet: Bei CMBLU prägen die Werte Verlässlichkeit, Innovation und Unermüdlichkeit unsere Zusammenarbeit. Gelebt wird das auch abseits des Arbeitsalltags: Beim gemeinsamen BBQ, einer Jahresabschlussfeier oder bei sportlichen Aktivitäten im Team. Unsere Erfolge feiern wir gemeinsam, denn sie sind das Ergebnis von Teamarbeit.

Wir freuen uns darauf, gemeinsam mit dir die Zukunft der Energie neu zu denken.

Bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil unserer spannenden Reise.

title: Senior adviseur geotechniek
descriptionHtml:
Jouw impact bij Movares

Jouw geotechnisch advies bepaalt of civiele projecten veilig, uitvoerbaar en toekomstbestendig gerealiseerd kunnen worden.

Dit ga je doen bij Movares

  • Je werkt aan geotechnische analyses, adviezen en ontwerpen voor civiele en infrastructurele projecten;

  • je pakt, afhankelijk van je ervaring, projecten zelfstandig op, van vraagstelling tot advies en ontwerp;

  • je bent sparringpartner voor collega’s en opdrachtgevers bij complexe geotechnische vraagstukken.

Geotechniek bij Movares is breed en adviserend. Je werkt voor verschillende opdrachtgevers aan uiteenlopende projecten, zoals spoor- en railinfrastructuur, civiele constructies en waterbouwkundige werken. Je combineert technische analyse met advies en denkt mee over oplossingen die veilig, uitvoerbaar en duurzaam zijn.

Binnen het team deel je actief je kennis en draag je bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van Geotechniek. Heb je meer ervaring, dan begeleid je ook junior-adviseurs inhoudelijk.

Dit ben jij bij Movares

Je bent een ervaren geotechnisch adviseur die verder kijkt dan zijn eigen berekening. Je overziet het geheel, maakt inhoudelijke keuzes en weet collega’s daarin mee te nemen. Je vindt het leuk om kennis te delen en bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling van collega’s en het team.

Werk je nu bij een gespecialiseerd bureau en mis je de breedte van projecten, de invloed op inhoudelijke keuzes of de ruimte om collega’s te begeleiden? Of wil je jouw geotechnische expertise inzetten in projecten met grote maatschappelijke impact? Dan past deze rol goed bij jou.

Dit breng je ook mee:

  • meerdere jaren ervaring binnen de geotechniek, passend bij een medior-of senior rol;

  • ervaring met Deltares-software (D-serie); ervaring met Plaxis is een pre, net zoals affiniteit met lijninfrastructuur;

  • sterke schriftelijke en mondelinge vaardigheden in zowel het Nederlands als Engels.

Dit krijg je bij Movares

Bij Movares werk je aan opgaven die Nederland verder helpen. Tegelijk krijg je de ruimte om je werk en loopbaan in te richten op een manier die bij jou past. Met goede arbeidsvoorwaarden, veel flexibiliteit en volop mogelijkheden om je te ontwikkelen.

Een sterk fundament

Een goede basis begint bij voorwaarden waarop je kunt rekenen:

  • een salaris tussen € 4.650 en € 7.580 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur;

  • een flexibele pot van minimaal 15% van je jaarsalaris, inclusief vakantiegeld;

  • een goede pensioenregeling bij Zwitserleven, waarbij Movares twee derde van de pensioenpremie betaalt;

  • een NS Business Card voor woon-werkverkeer en zakelijke reizen. Privé profiteer je met de kaart van de dalurenkorting.

Maximaal flexibel

Vorm een manier van werken die aansluit bij jouw leven én jouw ambities. Maak keuzes die bij jou passen:

  • flexibel werken volgens ons Any Time Any Place-principe, passend bij je team, klanten en projecten;

  • De mogelijkheid om twee weken per jaar te werken vanaf je vakantieadres binnen de EU;

  • 20 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen te kopen vanuit je flexibele pot;

  • met je flexibele pot kies je wat voor jou belangrijk is, bijvoorbeeld voor extra inkomen, pensioen, een fiets, bedrijfsfitness, verduurzaming van je woning of het aflossen van je studieschuld;

  • € 750 budget per vijf jaar om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten;

  • € 2,45 netto thuiswerkvergoeding per thuiswerkdag.

Veel ontwikkelmogelijkheden

  • Ontwikkel een loopbaan die past bij jouw talenten en ambities. Kies jouw eigen pad:

  • ruimte om je expertise, ambitie en loopbaan verder te ontwikkelen;

  • leren door te doen, samen met ervaren collega's en met gebruik van een breed aanbod aan ontwikkelmogelijkheden;

  • de kans om actief kennis te delen en mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van ons vakgebied.

Samen groeien

Deel mee in de waarde die we samen creëren en de groei van onze organisatie. Samen voor succes:

  • je flexibele pot groeit mee met de resultaten van Movares;

  • een winstdeling met een doelbedrag van 5% van je brutojaarsalaris, afhankelijk van de resultaten;

  • en de mogelijkheid tot participeren in de waardeontwikkeling van Movares door middel van aankoop van phantom-aandelen.

Jouw team bij Movares

Je werkt samen met een hechte groep geotechnische adviseurs die elkaar makkelijk weten te vinden. Eén dag per week – op woensdag – werken jullie sowieso samen op kantoor in Utrecht. Daarnaast is twee dagen per week op kantoor gangbaar, maar stemmen we locatie en werktijden flexibel af. Er is altijd iemand aanwezig en de lijnen zijn kort.

De sfeer in het team is open en gelijkwaardig. Er is weinig hiërarchie: senioriteit gaat hier niet over ‘boven iemand staan’, maar over kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Collega’s kunnen goed met elkaar opschieten, schakelen snel en staan voor elkaar klaar. Samenwerken doen we bewust, omdat we geloven dat je daar betere oplossingen van maakt.

title: Senior AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the role

The Senior Engineer, AI / ML — Self-Serve Toolchain will build the end-to-end system that lets customers adapt UFORCE models on their own private data without exposing that data to us.

This role spans data processing, foundation-model-assisted labeling, human-in-the-loop QA, active learning, training, evaluation, and model promotion. You will turn an in-flight principal-led capability into a repeatable toolchain that non-expert customers can run safely on-site.

What you’ll do

 

  • Own the ML adaptation pipeline from raw customer data to trained, evaluated, deployable models.

  • Build foundation-model-assisted labeling workflows using tools such as SAM-2, Grounding DINO, open-vocabulary models, LLM steering, and human review.

  • Design self-serve operator workflows using yes/no/maybe feedback and natural-language corrections.

  • Create versioned datasets with lineage, data cards, label provenance, class distributions, and known gaps.

  • Build QA methods that catch systematic pseudo-label errors, missing annotations, and long-tail data gaps.

  • Develop active-learning loops that prioritize the highest-value frames for limited operator review.

  • Build reproducible train/eval pipelines with experiment tracking, model packaging, and promotion gates.

  • Design evaluation around held-out anchor sets, leakage prevention, baselines, slice metrics, and automated approve/reject decisions.

  • Package the toolchain for on-prem, air-gapped, regulated, or customer-held environments.

  • Close the field-failure loop by feeding live failures back into the next tune cycle.

  • Lead and grow a small specialist team around curation, auto-labeling, deployment, and onboarding.

What success looks like

 

  • Customers can run a full adaptation cycle without engineer intervention.

  • Customer data stays inside the customer boundary.

  • The system produces trusted datasets with clear provenance and quality signals.

  • Pseudo-label quality is measured and systematic errors are caught early.

  • The promotion gate can approve or reject models based on evidence, not intuition.

  • Evaluation is protected by anchor sets, leakage controls, slice metrics, and baseline comparisons.

  • Field failures become reproducible inputs to the next training cycle.

  • Synthetic data is used only when it proves value against real held-out data.

  • The toolchain becomes a repeatable capability supported by a small, ramped team.

Required Qualifications

 

  • 5+ years building production ML, AI, or computer-vision systems.

  • Strong Python and PyTorch.

  • Experience owning ML data pipelines, training pipelines, or evaluation infrastructure.

  • Deep CV data experience: detection, segmentation, annotation taxonomies, dataset curation, and data quality.

  • Hands-on experience with model-in-the-loop or foundation-model-assisted labeling.

  • Familiarity with tools such as SAM-2, Grounding DINO, FiftyOne, and annotation platforms.

  • Strong understanding of evaluation: held-out sets, leakage prevention, baselines, slice metrics, and promotion gates.

  • Experience with QA sampling, label-noise analysis, missing annotations, IAA, or alternatives when only one operator is available.

  • Experience with active learning or other methods for prioritizing labeling effort.

  • Ability to reason about dataset economics: quality vs. quantity, long-tail coverage, and cost-per-useful-example.

  • Experience with dataset versioning, lineage, experiment tracking, model registries, or data cards.

  • Strong ownership, communication, and systems thinking.

  • Experience leading engineers as a tech lead, staff engineer, or small-team manager.

Nice to have

 

  • Synthetic data, sim2real, or domain randomization experience.

  • EO / IR / LWIR, remote sensing, maritime imagery, or small-object detection experience.

  • Privacy-preserving ML, federated learning, on-prem, or air-gapped deployment experience.

  • Experience building self-serve ML platforms or tools for non-expert users.

  • Experience with lakeFS, DVC, MLflow, Weights & Biases, Kubernetes, Kubeflow, Flyte, Dagster, Airflow, or Argo.

  • LLM application, context engineering, structured output, or LLM evaluation experience.

  • Exposure to radar, AIS, EO/IR fusion, tracking, sensor fusion, robotics, autonomy, UxV, defence tech, C2/C4ISR, or tactical systems.

title: Senior Application Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $150M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Application Security Engineer to help secure our product and platform through hands-on security architecture and engineering. You’ll work closely with product, engineering, and compliance teams, taking ownership from identifying risks through designing, implementing, and rolling out solutions.

We’re a lean security team, so your work will span security reviews, vulnerability management, platform hardening, automation, incident response, and compliance engineering. Alongside finding and fixing vulnerabilities, you’ll identify opportunities to prevent entire classes of risks through shared security controls and centralized enforcement. You’ll help decide where these investments matter most and build solutions that teams can adopt as the company grows.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and implement shared security controls that prevent entire classes of vulnerabilities and centralize enforcement across applications and services.

  • Partner with engineers on architecture and threat modeling, translating risks into concrete designs for authorization, service identity, tenant isolation, and data protection.

  • Build security controls and secure defaults into application frameworks, service templates, and infrastructure modules, making them straightforward for teams to adopt.

  • Develop automation that connects security tools with engineering workflows, adds context to findings, and automates remediation where appropriate.

  • Own vulnerability management across internal findings, automated tooling, external assessments, and researcher reports.

  • Review code, perform targeted security testing, and manage vulnerabilities through verified remediation. Use recurring findings to identify where a shared control or architectural change would prevent similar issues.

  • Support the compliance team by implementing technical controls, automating procedures, and validating that controls operate as intended.

  • Help investigate security incidents and use the findings to improve architecture, controls, and detection.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in application security, product security, or software engineering with substantial security ownership.

  • Strong understanding of web, API, and distributed-system security, including authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, and sensitive data handling.

  • Experience taking security controls from architectural design through implementation and adoption across multiple services or teams.

  • Ability to design defense in depth, establish clear trust boundaries, and limit the impact of compromised components or credentials.

  • Strong coding skills: you can review production code, contribute fixes, and build maintainable tooling and shared security components.

  • Experience integrating security tools into engineering workflows and using context and automation to reduce manual work.

  • Sound technical judgment, clear communication, and the independence to take an ambiguous problem through to a working solution.

Why join us?

  • Work closely with engineers building AI systems used in critical enterprise operations.

  • Own substantial security projects and help shape a growing security program.

  • Have the autonomy to design solutions, implement them, and see their impact in production.

  • Join a company backed by leading investors.

  • Competitive salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

Our Operating Principles

Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

 

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

 

We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

 

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

 

Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

 

First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

title: Senior Backend & AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
If you've built something before, start here

The hardest part of a startup usually isn't the code. It's finding customers who really need what you build and getting them to change how they work. At Scalera, that part is done: manufacturers, suppliers and contractors across Switzerland, Austria and Germany already run their tenders through us every day.

What we need now are people who can take the next unsolved problem and turn it into a product customers can't do without. If you've founded a company (whether it worked out or not), been the first engineer somewhere, or built something people paid for, this role was written for you.

About Scalera

Scalera is an ETH Zurich spin-off building AI for the €200B+ European construction industry. Large manufacturers and suppliers still run their most document-heavy processes by hand, from reading 300-page tenders to retyping purchase orders into their ERP. We automate them one by one. Our product matching already handles 1,400 tender positions in 16 minutes at 98% precision, work that used to take a sales rep most of a day.

What you'll do

You'll be part product manager, part engineer. You'll spend real time with customers and help shape what we build. Sometimes you'll spot the next problem yourself, and sometimes we'll hand you a clear priority to run with.

  • Spend real time with customers. Join calls and site visits, sit with the people who do the work, and understand why they do it the way they do. You'll know their problems firsthand, not from a ticket.

  • Shape what to build. Turn what you hear into a clear problem, a scope and a plan, and push back when the obvious request isn't the real need. When we bring you a priority, you'll own how it gets solved.

  • Build it. Design and build backend services in Go and Python that turn messy tenders, catalogs and purchase orders into data customers can rely on.

  • Ship, then check. Get it in front of customers fast, watch how they actually use it, and iterate.

  • Own it in production. When something breaks at a customer, it's yours to understand and fix.

  • Build with AI. Use AI heavily in how you work, and design systems that agents can use as well as people.

What success looks like after 3 months

  • There's a part of the product people now think of as yours, and you're the one deciding what happens to it next

  • You've spotted a problem nobody asked you to solve, made the case for it, and shipped a first version

  • You've shipped features from both sources: priorities we set and ideas from your own customer conversations

  • At least once, you've talked us out of building something customers didn't really need

  • You've left a part of the platform simpler than you found it

You'll probably thrive here if

  • You've taken something from zero to one: a company, a product line, or a side project with paying users

  • You've built and run backend systems in production that other people depend on. We care more about your judgment than your language; you're strong in Go or Python and happy to work in both

  • You're solid on data modeling, API design and messy real-world data

  • You'd rather talk to a customer than wait for a spec

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. You can make progress while the problem is still half-defined, which at a startup it usually is

  • You want a large scope of responsibility and are happy to own things well beyond your job title

  • Rapidly changing requirements don't throw you. When customers or priorities shift, you adapt and keep going

  • You enjoy direct customer contact and want to be on customer calls

  • You make things simpler over time, not more clever

  • You write clearly in English. German is a plus, not a requirement

You probably won't enjoy it if

  • You just want to code and go home

  • You don't like talking to customers, whether on calls or on the occasional site visit

  • Ambiguity and chaos bother you

  • You want a well-defined backlog handed to you

  • Your main goal is managing people soon. Here, scope grows with what you own, not with headcount

Our stack

Go and Python (FastAPI), PostgreSQL, GCP, and LLMs throughout the document pipeline. You don't need to know all of it on day one.

How we hire

  1. Screening call (30 min) with our VP Engineering. It's two-way: ask us anything, including the hard questions.

  2. Technical deep-dive call: walk us through something you built from scratch, the decisions you made and what went wrong.

  3. Meet Scalera Day: come to our office in Zürich, work on a real problem with real (anonymized) construction documents, and meet the team.

  4. Offer: if it's a fit on both sides, we'll move quickly to an offer.

Working at Scalera

  • Zürich HQ, four days in the office, Fridays remote

  • Occasional customer visits across Switzerland, Austria and Germany

  • Small team, no bureaucracy. You'll work directly with the CEO, CTO, VP Engineering and Customer Success

  • Competitive salary and equity

Founders and former founders: if you're unsure whether you fit, send a few lines about what you built and why you moved on. We read every one.

Mit der Unterstützung von über 2.000 Mitarbeitenden an unseren drei Standorten in Bloomington, Indiana, USA; Parsippany, New Jersey, USA und Halle/Westfalen, Deutschland, können wir unseren Kunden ein breites Portfolio von Verabreichungssystemen anbieten, darunter vorgefüllte Spritzen, flüssige/lyophilisierte Fläschchen, Verdünnungsmittel für die Rekonstitution, mit Pulver gefüllte Fläschchen und sterile Kristallisation. Neben der GMP-Herstellung bieten wir auch weitere Dienstleistungen an, darunter Unterstützung bei der Formulierung und Entwicklung, Gefriertrocknungsoptimierung, globale regulatorische Unterstützung sowie Sekundärverpackung.

Simtra wird aus vielseitigen Teams in verschiedenen Bereichen gebildet! Werden Sie ein Teil des Teams und unterstützen Sie zukünftig dabei Patienten weltweit lebensverändernde Medikamente zur Verfügung zu stellen.

Wir produzieren in unserem Werk in Halle/Westfalen Arzneimittel zur Therapie verschiedener Krebs- und anderer lebensbedrohenden Erkrankungen. 

Für unser Team suchen wir Dich als erfahrenen Senior Betriebsingenieur / Senior Manufacturing Engineer (m/w/d).

Als Senior Manufacturing Engineer (m/w/d) übernimmst Du eine Schlüsselrolle an der Schnittstelle zwischen Produktion, Technik, Qualität und externen Partnern. Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Anlagen zuverlässig, GMP-konform und zukunftsfähig betrieben werden – und leistest damit einen direkten Beitrag dazu, lebensverändernde Medikamente sicher und effizient verfügbar zu machen.

In dieser Position sicherst Du im laufenden Betrieb die Einhaltung von GMP- und EHS-Standards. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der technischen Verfügbarkeit unserer Produktionsanlagen, einem strukturierten Wartungs- und Ersatzteilmanagement sowie der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Anlagen und Prozessen in der Pharmaproduktion. Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehören:

  • Du verantwortest die Instandhaltung unserer Anlagen, zum Beispiel Kessel- und Rührsysteme sowie Filtrationsanlagen mit Isolatortechnik, und nutzt dafür ein Maintenance Management System
  • Du übernimmst die Planung und Einhaltung des Wartungsbudgets, der Terminierungen und der Leistungsparameter sowie die Koordination interner und externer Dienstleister
  • Als technische Expertin bzw. technischer Experte begleitest Du den Produktionsbetrieb, analysierst systematisch Fehler und Prozesse und treibst Optimierungen mithilfe von Lean- und Six-Sigma-Werkzeugen voran
  • Du erstellst GMP-gerechte Projekt- und Qualifizierungsdokumentationen (u.a. Lastenheft, Pflichtenheft, Risikoanalyse, DQ-/IQ-/OQ-Dokumentation)
  • Du koordinierst und führst Qualifizierungs-, Validierungs- und Optimierungsmaßnahmen durch
  • Als technischer Ansprechpartner (m/w/d) übernimmst Du die Durchführung von Schulungen

Dich erwartet ein technisch anspruchsvolles Produktionsumfeld mit modernen Anlagen, klaren Qualitätsstandards und einem Team, das lösungsorientiert zusammenarbeitet. In Deiner Rolle kannst Du Verantwortung übernehmen, Verbesserungen aktiv vorantreiben und Deine technische Expertise sichtbar einbringen.

Bei uns kannst Du Deine Expertise in einem hochregulierten Produktionsumfeld weiterentwickeln, technische Verantwortung übernehmen und Verbesserungen sichtbar mitgestalten. Wir unterstützen Dich dabei, Deine fachlichen und methodischen Kompetenzen auszubauen und Deine Erfahrung gezielt in anspruchsvolle Projekte einzubringen.

Du bringst mit:

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich der (pharmazeutischen) Verfahrenstechnik oder Maschinenbau, alternativ eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Du bringst einschlägige Berufserfahrung (5 bis 10 Jahre) im Bereich Betriebstechnik mit, gerne mit Schwerpunkt in der Herstellung pharmazeutischer Produkte
  • Du hast Freude daran, technische Projekte eigenverantwortlich zu planen, umzusetzen und gemeinsam mit internen sowie externen Schnittstellen erfolgreich abzuschließen
  • Du bringst Interesse und idealerweise Erfahrung in Automatisierungsthemen mit und möchtest technische Verbesserungen aktiv vorantreiben
  • Ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für komplexe Prozesse, hohe Kommunikationsfähigkeit sowie eine lösungsorientierte und belastbare Arbeitsweise gehören zu Deinen Stärken
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie gute EDV- und Softwarekenntnisse, insbesondere in ERP-Systemen und MS Office, runden Dein Profil ab

Neben einer verantwortungsvollen Aufgabe in einem internationalen Unternehmensumfeld bieten wir Dir ein kollegiales Team, kurze Wege am Standort Halle/Westfalen und die Möglichkeit, technische Themen mit hoher Relevanz für Patientinnen und Patienten weltweit aktiv mitzugestalten.

Das bieten wir Dir:

  • Faire tarifgebundene Vergütung inkl. Sozialleistungen wie ein 13. Tarifgehalt, Urlaubsgeld, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und eine zusätzliche Pflegeversicherung
  • Hauseigene moderne Kantine mit attraktiver Be­zu­schus­sung
  • 30 Tage Urlaub plus Sonderurlaub
  • Wochenarbeitszeit von 37,5 Stunden
  • Job-Rad Leasing
  • Corporate Benefits: Exklusive Rabatte für Mitarbeitende bei zahlreichen bekannten Marken
  • Gute Verkehrsanbindung und kostenlose Mitarbeitendenparkplätze 
  • Berufsbedingter Umzug? Wir unterstützen finanziell im Rahmen unserer Umzugskostenpauschale
  • Kostenlose Betriebssportarten z.B. Badminton, Fußball und Fitnesskurse

Engagierten und begabten Menschen bieten wir interessante Chancen in allen Phasen des Berufslebens. Geschlecht, Alter, Hautfarbe, Herkunft, sexuelle Orientierung und Beeinträchtigungen spielen dabei keine Rolle - im Gegenteil: Wir fördern Vielfalt und glauben, dass Diversität eine Bereicherung darstellt.

Wir freuen uns über die Zusendung der Unterlagen zu Ihrem bisherigen beruflichen Werdegang direkt über unser Online-System.

title: Senior Business Development Manager - Manchester
descriptionHtml:
Business Development Manager

 

OUR MISSION

Carwow is Europe’s leading car-changing destination, transforming how people buy, sell, advertise, and lease cars through technology, media, and automotive expertise. From our beginnings as a reviews site, we’ve grown into one of the largest online marketplaces—facilitating nearly £3bn in car purchases and £1.8bn in sales listings last year alone. In 2024, we acquired Autovia (AutoExpress and Evo), doubling our audience and expanding our reach to 10 million YouTube subscribers, 1.2 million magazine sales, and 350m+ annual online readers. And we’re only just getting started.

 

YOUR MISSION

You’ll drive carwow’s buying platform adoption by winning and onboarding independent motor traders and franchise dealer groups through consultative selling and tailored demos. This is a phone-first role focused on high-volume outreach, with the flexibility to step into the field when it helps close key deals. You’ll be responsible for securing new partners, getting them bidding and buying quickly, and working with Account Management to maximise long-term growth.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Sign up new dealers and drive adoption - bidding and buying - on the Sell My Car platform.

  • Generate new business via cold outreach and inbound leads, primarily over the phone, with occasional field visits when required.

  • Identify and develop opportunities to upsell additional services such as transport, wallet, stock funding, and other upcoming propositions.

  • Approach potential partners and build strong, long-term business relationships.

  • Collaborate with the Account Management team to ensure a smooth handover once accounts are up and running, and support in reactivating dealers who have become inactive.

  • Deliver engaging and persuasive pitches at all levels—from GMs and Group Buyers to Business Owners and Sole Traders.

  • Maintain accurate records in the CRM and manage data effectively.

     

KEY REQUIREMENTS

Please note: We know no candidate will tick every box, so if you feel you’re a strong fit but not an exact match, we’d still love to hear from you. Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Experience in a similar role within the automotive retail industry (essential).

  • A driven, hard-working mindset with the ability to adapt to change in a fast-growing, scale-up environment.

  • A hunter mentality with a passion for prospecting and developing new partnerships.

  • Strong influencing and negotiation skills, with proven business development experience.

  • Confidence in working with data to spot opportunities and risks, and to support growth strategies (without needing to be a data expert).

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the flexibility to adapt to different audiences.

  • Ability to work with CRM tools, such as Salesforce.

 

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Introductory call with the Talent Partner

  • Skills-based interview with the Team Manager and the Head of the Department

  • Role-based task interview with the Team Manager and Director

  • Values interview

 

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Competitive comp package

  • 28 days' holiday plus bank holidays, increasing to 35 with length of service, plus extras for house moves, weddings and more!

  • Employee-friendly share options

  • Pension scheme via Royal London - up to 5% company contribution

  • Vitality private healthcare insurance

  • Life Assurance - 4x annual salary

  • Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner

  • Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave including up to 20 weeks' full pay maternity and shared parental leave, and 8 weeks' full partner pay, as well as fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies

  • Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones

  • 'Work from abroad for a month' annual scheme

  • Generous learning and development budget

  • £500 home office budget

     

DE&I @ CARWOW

Diversity and inclusion is an integral part of our culture. We know that diverse teams are strong teams, so we welcome those with alternative identities, backgrounds, and experiences to apply for this position. We make recruiting decisions based on experience, skills and potential, so all our applicants are treated fairly and equally.

title: (Senior) Business & Financial Analyst (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Foodji macht frisches, gutes Essen im Büro jederzeit verfügbar. Unsere autonomen Foodjis stehen in bald tausend Unternehmen in Deutschland, jede Transaktion, jede Lieferung und jedes Gericht erzeugt Daten. Diesen Datenschatz wollen wir noch konsequenter nutzen und die ganze Organisation befähigen, mit starkem AI-Enablement selbst mit Daten zu arbeiten. Dafür suchen wir dich. 

Du wirst Teil unseres Finance & BI Teams und arbeitest eng mit Controlling und BI. Wir bauen zusammen die Zahlenbasis, auf der Foodji gesteuert wird und gehen Fragen aus dem Business gemeinsam an: schnell, präzise und mit dem Anspruch, jede Frage bis zur Entscheidung durchzudenken.

Deine Mission bei Foodji

  • Ist-Zahlen & Treiber: Du analysierst gemeinsam mit dem Controlling die operativen Treiber hinter den Ist-Zahlen und leitest konkrete Maßnahmen ab für alle Teams.

  • Planung: Du baust treiberbasierte Modelle für Budget und rollierenden Forecast, inklusive Szenarien und Annahmen aus den Fachbereichen.

  • Reporting: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Controlling das Management-, Board- und Investorenreporting weiter, mit Fokus auf Treiber und Ausblick.

  • Business Cases & Unit Economics: Du bewertest neue Standorte, Kundensegmente, Pricing und Initiativen und findest die Hebel für Marge und Wachstum.

  • Metriken: Gemeinsam mit dem BI-Team definierst du Metriken und Business-Logik im Semantic Layer, damit alle mit denselben Zahlen arbeiten.

  • Business Partnering: Du bist Sparringspartner:in für Geschäftsführung, Sales, Account Management, Operations, Culinary und Marketing und begleitest die Umsetzung deiner Empfehlungen.

AI-native arbeiten

AI ist bei uns das Werkzeug, mit dem wir Analytics bauen. Wir arbeiten täglich mit AI-Tools wie Claude und Claude Code, direkt auf unserem Snowflake Data Warehouse.

  • Du nutzt AI, um Daten zu explorieren und zu analysieren sowie für die Automatisierung von wiederkehrenden Tasks.

  • Du prüfst Ergebnisse kritisch, auch die zugrunde liegenden Abfragen, bevor sie in eine Entscheidung gehen, und befähigst andere Teams, selbst mit Daten und AI zu arbeiten.



DAS BRINGST DU MIT

  • 2 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung in FP&A, Controlling, Corporate Finance, Beratung oder Investment Banking, idealerweise in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen.

  • Ein sehr gutes Studium in Wirtschaft, Finance, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Mathematik, Informatik oder einem verwandten Fach.

  • Sehr gute Modellierungsskills in Excel und Erfahrung mit BI-Tools wie Tableau.

  • Nachweisbare Praxis mit AI-Tools für Analytics, z.B. Claude Code, Claude oder vergleichbaren Tools. Zeig uns, was du damit gebaut hast.

  • Tempo und Ownership: Du wartest nicht auf Aufträge, siehst die nächste Frage, bevor sie gestellt wird, und bringst Dinge zu Ende.

  • Ein gutes Verständnis dafür, wie Zahlen, Operations und Go-to-Market zusammenhängen.

  • Du übersetzt komplexe Analysen in eine klare Botschaft, für das Management genauso wie für Kolleg:innen ohne Finance-Hintergrund und sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch.

  • Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse.

  • Ein Plus: Erfahrung in einem Startup oder Scale-up und ein Hintergrund in Food, Retail, Logistik oder einem anderen operativ geprägten Geschäftsmodell sowie Erfahrung mit einem Data Warehouse (z. B. Snowflake), SQL oder einem Semantic Layer.

Noch Fragen?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter!

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

  • Echte Wirkung: Deine Analysen fließen direkt in Entscheidungen von Geschäftsführung und Fachbereichen.

  • Kurze Wege und enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern.

  • Einen modernen Stack (Snowflake, Tableau, NetSuite, AI-Tools) und den Freiraum, ihn weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Ein Team, das gerade neu aufstellt, wie FP&A mit AI und Semantic Layer arbeitet, und dich dabei mitgestalten lässt.

  • Ein Unternehmen, das Hardware, Food und Software verbindet, mit Büro in München.

UNSERE BENEFITS

  • Office Foodji & Lunchit App: Immer bestens versorgt bei uns im Office oder Remote

  • bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente

  • Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung

  • EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich deutschlandweit in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios

  • JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec

  • KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind

  • Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands

  • Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen

  • Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Perspektiven!

  • Flexibilität: Teile dir selbst deine Arbeitszeiten ein - bei uns im Office, zu Hause oder remote aus dem EU Ausland

  • Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür

  • Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam!

ÜBER UNS

Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds.

Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst.

Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür.

Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns.

Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt.

title: Senior Commercial Counsel UK/EU
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

At Trustly, we're building a smarter, faster, and more secure financial future by revolutionizing the world of payments. As a global leader in Open Banking Payments, we are establishing Pay by Bank as the new standard at checkout, providing unparalleled freedom, speed, and ease to millions of consumers and merchants worldwide.

Our Ambition: To build the world’s most disruptive payment network and redefine what the payment experience should feel like.

Trustly is a global team of innovators, collaborators, and doers. If you are driven by a strong sense of purpose and thrive in a dynamic, entrepreneurial, and high-growth environment, join us and be part of a team that’s transforming the way the world pays.

  

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an experienced Senior Commercial Counsel with substantial experience in consumer-facing technology businesses to join our global Legal & Corporate Affairs team at an exciting period in Trustly's growth. You will be responsible for partnering with our commercial teams to draft, negotiate, and close a wide variety of transactions across the EU and UK. This role will work cross-functionally with product, go-to-market, consumer partnerships, compliance, and operations teams at Trustly to support the sustainable growth of a hyper-scale business across the EU and UK. You will manage multiple simultaneous complex negotiations, requiring the ability to prioritise effectively and deliver high-quality work under tight deadlines.

You will be a highly commercial and pragmatic individual who thrives on closing deals and enjoys partnering closely with business teams, to speak with "one voice" to external counterparties whilst launching and scaling products and services. You will possess strong experience working from counterparty's terms and templates, with strong commercial judgment and the ability to efficiently negotiate and close deals whilst protecting Trustly's interests. You will be comfortable pushing back strongly on firm redlines when required - including with internal stakeholders - whilst remaining creative and solutions-oriented when finding paths forward through complex negotiations. You will take pride in being proactive, extremely responsive to the business teams, protecting the business, and enabling innovation through creative legal solutions.

  

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Lead the negotiation, drafting, and review of large, complex commercial agreements with merchants, partners, and financial institutions, including payment processing agreements, merchant services agreements, API agreement, IP licences, data processing agreements, procurement agreements, and third-party provider (TPP) relationships.

  • Draft, review, and negotiate consumer terms and conditions, privacy policies, and other consumer-facing legal documentation in compliance with EU and UK consumer protection regulations.

  • Demonstrate strong expertise in working from counterparty's terms and templates, efficiently identifying and negotiating key commercial and legal issues to close deals quickly whilst protecting Trustly's interests.

  • Proactively manage and lead negotiations and build strong alliances with our commercial team in order to do so, managing multiple high-priority negotiations simultaneously with a focus on getting deals across the line.

  • Partner closely with the Sales team to ensure alignment on negotiation strategy and present a unified voice to external parties, whilst maintaining appropriate independence to push back on Trustly's firm redlines when necessary.

  • Quickly understand Trustly's payment products, technology platform, and integration methods to provide informed, practical legal advice that accounts for technical realities and business objectives.

  • Advise product, marketing, and business teams on consumer protection requirements, marketing and advertising regulations, and regulatory compliance for consumer-facing initiatives, reviewing and approving consumer communications and marketing materials.

  • Partner with Privacy and Compliance teams to ensure consumer-facing products and services meet data protection and privacy requirements, including consent management, transparency obligations, and data subject rights.

  • Develop and maintain Trustly's standard form agreements, playbooks, and contracting processes to streamline efficiency, maintain compliance, and mitigate risk.

  • Support the launch of new consumer-focused product initiatives in partnership with Product Counsel, coordinating with Risk and Compliance teams to ensure commercial agreements comply with applicable laws and regulations.

  • Provide strategic legal advice on contract interpretation and dispute resolution.

  

WHO YOU ARE

  • Law degree (LLB, LLM, or equivalent) and qualified solicitor, barrister, avocat, or equivalent legal qualification in the UK or another EU member state, with experience at a consumer-facing technology business (strong private practice background is required).

  • Strong technical aptitude to quickly understand complex technology products and payment systems, with a proven track record of successfully partnering with Sales and business teams.

  • Comfortable and confident pushing back strongly on firm legal and commercial redlines, including with internal teams, whilst maintaining collaborative relationships and demonstrating creativity and resourcefulness in finding solutions to complex negotiation roadblocks.

  • Proactive, highly responsive, and service-oriented approach to supporting business teams, with genuine enjoyment of closing deals and getting transactions across the line, demonstrating a results-driven mindset and entrepreneurial nature with a bias for action.

  • Experience drafting and negotiating large commercial contracts, consumer terms and conditions, privacy policies, and other legal documentation for digital products and services. Experience in FinTech, payments, or financial services strongly preferred. Experience in gaming is a plus.

  • Knowledge of marketing and advertising regulations, distance selling regulations, and e-commerce requirements.

  • Strong ability to balance regulatory compliance and consumer protection with business objectives, with excellent written and verbal communication skills to explain complex legal issues in simple terms.

  • Experience managing consumer complaints, disputes, or regulatory inquiries, and familiarity with consumer product compliance across multiple EU jurisdictions is desirable

  • Fluency in French highly desirable.

 

WHAT WE OFFER

At Trustly, you will have the chance to solve meaningful challenges alongside some of the brightest minds in FinTech. Together, we are shaping the future of payments in an environment that celebrates curiosity, collaboration, and innovation. You will be challenged and empowered to grow, making a real impact every step of the way.

Our team is as diverse as the global footprint we serve. At Trustly, we foster a workplace where everyone feels they belong—a place where teamwork thrives, ideas flourish, and we never forget to have fun along the way. We are proud and committed to being an Equal Opportunity Employer and believe an open and inclusive environment enables people to do their best work.

Our Fantastic Benefits (varies by location)

🌴 20 to 30 days of holiday to support a healthy work-life balance

🥳 Monthly team outing allowance to enjoy social events with your colleagues

👶 Parental leave top-up additional support for new parents

☕ On-site perks to make your workday smoother

💚 Well being support our health allowance covers gym memberships, massages, and much more to help you feel your best

PLUS additional benefits designed to enhance your work-life experience!

Shape Your Role and Make an Impact

Join a dynamic environment where you can take ownership, drive change, and continuously embrace new challenges. We’re looking for dedicated and highly motivated individuals who thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy collaborating across different areas of the organisation.

title: Senior CRM Strategist
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore. 

VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. 

For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on  LinkedIn #WeAreVML.

Senior CRM Strategist 

Company: VML

Working Model: Hybrid working

Location: Sea Containers office, London, SE1

At VML, we are a beacon of innovation and growth in an ever-evolving world. Our heritage is built upon a century of combined expertise, where creativity meets technology, and diverse perspectives ignite inspiration. With the merger of VMLY&R and Wunderman Thompson, we have forged a new path as a growth partner that is part creative agency, part consultancy, and part technology powerhouse.

Our global family now encompasses over 30,000 employees across 150+ offices in 64 markets, each contributing to a culture that values connection, belonging, and the power of differences. Our expertise spans the entire customer journey building connected brands that drive growth for our clients. We do this by leveraging our 3 core practices; Brand experience, Customer experience and Commerce. Within these practices we offer expertise across communications, commerce, consultancy, CRM, data, production, and technology. We deliver end-to-end solutions that result in revolutionary work.

The Role

As a Senior CRM Strategist, you'll be a key strategic voice within the team, working closely with Client Services, Creative and other disciplines to turn business challenges into effective, customer-focused solutions.

In this role, you’ll focus on one of our major automotive accounts, helping shape CRM strategy across the connected customer journey, from brand consideration and lead generation to end-to-end lifecycle CRM, web experience, and retail activations.

You will work closely in partnership with our data strategy team, using the insight from our access to customer data to shape strategy and drive performance.   

You'll be involved from brief through to delivery, helping shape the strategic direction, inspire creative thinking and make sure the work remains rooted in a clear understanding of the customer and the client's commercial objectives.

You'll work across multiple stakeholders and levels of seniority, so being able to adapt your approach, communicate clearly and build strong relationships will be just as important as the quality of your strategic thinking.

There will also be opportunities to contribute to wider strategic projects and new business, giving you the chance to bring your perspective to different challenges and clients.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the strategic direction across projects, from understanding the brief through to creative development, client sell-in and measuring effectiveness.
  • Turn business, customer, cultural and behavioural information into clear, actionable insights.
  • Write compelling strategic and creative briefs that give creative teams a clear direction and space to do their best work across CRM, digital, social, and dealership assets.
  • Drive the CRM comms strategy across the end ot end custome journey including automated/triggered reminders, seasonal promotional campaigns, and ad-hoc owner messaging.
  • Work closely with Client Services, Creative, Data and Media partners to develop connected, effective solutions.
  • Build trusted relationships with clients and become a confident and credible strategic partner.
  • Present and sell strategic thinking clearly to clients and internal stakeholders at different levels.
  • Use data, research and customer understanding to inform strategic recommendations and strengthen the work.
  • Ensure strategic thinking remains connected to the client's commercial objectives and desired outcomes.
  • Challenge briefs and thinking constructively when there is an opportunity to make the work better.
  • Contribute to pitches, quarterly thought leadership, proactive thinking and opportunities to grow existing and new client relationships.
  • Support and develop more junior members of the strategy team, sharing knowledge and helping raise the quality of strategic output.
  • Bring curiosity and new thinking into the team, keeping up with changes in culture, technology, customer behaviour and the wider industry.

Who You Are

  • Strategically strong: You can get to the heart of a problem, identify what really matters and turn it into a clear point of view.
  • Commercially minded: You understand how strategic thinking connects to client business objectives, funnel performance, lead generation, and long-term customer retention.
  • Confident but collaborative: You're comfortable leading a conversation and challenging a client or colleague, but you're equally happy listening and adapting your thinking.
  • A strong communicator: You can make complex thinking feel simple, whether you're presenting to a senior client or briefing a creative team.
  • Customer curious: You genuinely want to understand what makes people tick and how their behaviours, needs and motivations can influence the work.
  • Low ego: You care more about getting to the right answer than getting credit for having it. You enjoy working with different people and bringing the best out of those around you.
  • Adaptable: You can fluidly navigate different briefs, from building our high-level brand frameworks and strategy houses to detailed CRM journeys, content strategies, and retail activation briefs.
  • sight of the strategic objective.
  • Culturally & Technologically curious: You're interested in what's happening in the world and know how to turn those observations into useful strategic thinking. You stay ahead of emerging tech and media trends - including AI, LLMs, and GEO and know how to turn those insights into useful strategy.
  • A team player: You enjoy working alongside Client Services, Creative and other disciplines and understand that the best work rarely comes from one person working alone.

What You'll Need

  • Proven experience working as a CRM Strategist within an agency environment (automotive is a strong advantage).
  • Connected customer journey strategic experience spanning brand consideration, lead generation (e.g., test drives), and post-purchase CRM/servicing retention.
  • Experience developing strategic thinking from brief through to creative development, delivery, and performance evaluation.
  • A passion for creativity, we want you to do your best creative work at VML
  • Strong understanding of customer behavior, journey mapping, CRM/lifecycle comms, and digital ecosystems (web, search, social, dealership touchpoints).
  • Confidence presenting strategic thinking and recommendations to clients.
  • The ability to interpret data and research and turn it into meaningful insight.
  • Experience contributing to pitches and/or proactive strategic projects would be beneficial.
  • Experience supporting or mentoring junior team members would be advantageous.

What Success Looks Like

  • Strategic thinking that is clear, ambitious and rooted in genuine customer and business insight.
  • Clients who see you as a trusted strategic partner and value your perspective.
  • Creative teams who feel inspired and clear on the opportunity you're giving them.
  • Strong collaboration across Strategy, Creative, Client Services and specialist teams.
  • Strategic recommendations that contribute to meaningful client and business outcomes.
  • A positive impact on the development and quality of the wider strategy team.
  • The ability to bring clarity and momentum to complex challenges.

What's in It for You?

  • The opportunity to work on high-profile clients and commercially meaningful challenges.
  • The chance to work alongside talented people across Strategy, Creative, Client Services and specialist disciplines.
  • A genuinely collaborative environment where different perspectives are encouraged.
  • Opportunities to work across a broad range of strategic challenges and develop your experience.
  • A culture that values good thinking, curiosity, collaboration and people who aren't afraid to challenge the status quo.
  • Strong learning, development and career progression opportunities.
  • A competitive package, hybrid working and access to the full suite of company and group benefits.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP (VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

title: Senior CRM Strategy Manager, Leads Capture (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
The role

Reporting to the Director of Leads & Prospects in New York, you will be a part of the strategy team, supporting global marketing leadership, shaping how HelloFresh Group engages, nurtures, and converts prospective customers across 17 markets and six brands.

You will be responsible for identification and collection of communication consents from leads arriving from acquisition channels. You will actively collaborate with our Product team, to ensure a smooth and customer friendly experience, as well as legal compliance. Once leads are “captured” you will collaborate with the lifecycle team on conceptualization, personalization and localization of global lifecycle journeys for leads and prospects across all communication channels. Working within a distributed, international team across multiple time zones, you will play a key role in aligning strategy and execution globally.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

  • Run the Leads capture program: Defining and implementing the end-to-end lifecycle campaigns within CRM strategy for leads and prospects across different channels (from first touch to conversion). Alongside applying the data-driven segmentation, personalisation, and lifecycle frameworks, leveraging AI as well as dynamic content to drive engagement, conversion, and pipeline quality across international markets.
  • Running Omnichannel Campaigns: Orchestrate all communication channels within lifecycle campaigns (email, SMS, WhatsApp, push, in-app), defining best practices to drive engagement, and contribute to meeting overall team goals.
  • Continuous Improvement of Lifecycle Journeys: Partnering with Brand and Creative teams to bring and continuously improve high-quality, consistent, and locally adaptable CRM communications. Run content and design AB tests and optimizations in our customer journeys. 
  • Global Stakeholder Partnership: For allocated local markets, you will be serving as the CRM partner to global marketing teams, implementing aligned strategy, providing performance insights, and aligning on tactics to achieve the goals. Additionally, responsible for cross-functional collaboration across Analytics, CRM Operations, Product, Pricing, and Brand teams for assigned topics.

What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years experience in CRM, lifecycle, or digital marketing, and ideally in prospect/lead nurture programmes (lead capture, nurture flows, behavioural triggers, and conversion optimisation).
  • Proven mobile channel expertise, including hands-on experience with email, SMS, Push Notifications, WhatsApp, or in-app messaging campaigns.
  • Proficiency with CRM platforms (e.g. Iterable, Adobe, Braze, Bloomreach), data tools (e.g. Google Analytics, Tableau, Databricks), and CDP tools for segmentation, personalization, machine learning, and reporting.
  • Strong analytical skills and a data driven mindset with confidence in building/interpreting performance reports, extracting customer-insights, and decision making. 
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills (in English), a globally collaborative approach and familiarity with generative AI in marketing contexts.

What we offer

Compensation & Financial Wellbeing
  • You’ll receive a competitive salary package, including a HelloFresh-subsidized pension scheme.
  • Enjoy savings on your weekly HelloFresh box.
  • Save with discount schemes and corporate benefits via Vorteile.net

Health & Wellbeing

  • Support your mental wellbeing with access to platforms like Headspace and Spill.
  • Stay active with 24/7 office gym access, a discounted Urban Sports Club membership, and other wellbeing resources.

Flexibility & Work-Life

  • Balance your life with our flexible hybrid model.
  • Recharge with sabbatical leave options in addition to standard time off.
  • Get to work with ease through sustainable travel perks and transportation benefits.

Career & Development

  • Embrace "Learning Never Stops" with internal training, the HelloFresh Academy, and a dedicated budget for German language courses.

Culture & Environment

  • Enjoy tasty in-office meal deals and fresh food options.
  • We support working families with parent-friendly policies, an in-office kids corner, and an on-site babysitter.

Are you up for the challenge?

Please submit your complete application below including your salary expectations and earliest starting date.

After submitting an application our team will review this and get back to you within 5 business days.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Pelico

Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.

We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.

Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.

This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.

About the Role

In your capacity as a Senior DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer, you will be instrumental in architecting the orchestration layer that drives Pelico across all fronts, spanning our global SaaS infrastructure to the most restricted, air-gapped enterprise environments.

Your core mission is ensuring Pelico remains effortless to install, manage, and expand, irrespective of the underlying host. Operating at the crossroads of system architecture, product engineering, and field operations, you will tackle intricate technical hurdles and help define the future of AI-driven industrial infrastructure.

 

What You’ll Do

Build

  • Design and evolve Pelico's deployment architecture across Azure, GCP, AWS, single VM, air-gapped and private cloud environments, using Terraform, Helm and Ansible.

  • Standardize installation, upgrades and tooling to enable true one-click deployment for enterprise customers.

  • Standardize CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure practices to improve engineering productivity, security and reliability company-wide.

  • Support Pelico's enterprise and federal growth, including GovCloud and FedRAMP readiness for regulated aerospace and defense customers.

  • Use agentic engineering and AI-assisted workflows to automate infrastructure operations, deployment and diagnostics.

Run

  • Own production infrastructure (primarily Azure) and internal systems (GCP, OVH — GCP being our main internal tooling environment).

  • Troubleshoot production incidents: load spikes, data-sync issues, network problems, cloud provider outages, security issues and end-of-life components.

  • Build monitoring, diagnostics and runbooks so customer IT teams can operate Pelico independently.

  • Participate in on-call, pushing automation further — target is ~80% automated / 20% manual.

  • Occasional customer-facing support as IT teams deploy and operate Pelico.

 

About You

  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering roles in high-growth or production environments.

  • Solid depth in at least one major cloud provider (Azure, AWS or GCP), with the ability to pick up and work across others — our environment spans multiple clouds.

  • Comfortable with containers (Docker) as the core deployment abstraction.

  • Deep understanding of CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, observability and modern deployment practices.

  • Solid software engineering background, ideally with Java, and an automation-first mindset.

  • Comfortable participating in an on-call rotation, troubleshooting production incidents, and continuously improving platform reliability.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity — you enjoy solving complex infrastructure challenges without waiting for perfect specifications.

  • Strong communication skills, able to collaborate across Engineering, Product and customer IT teams.

  • You actively embrace AI tools as part of how you work, and adopt new ways of working smarter and faster.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted workflows for coding, infrastructure automation, troubleshooting or engineering productivity.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Kubernetes and Helm specifically.

  • Experience supporting enterprise or industrial environments (manufacturing, aerospace, defense or supply chain).

  • Exposure to security, compliance or regulated infrastructure environments (e.g. GovCloud, FedRAMP or air-gapped deployments).

  • Experience in customer-facing or forward-deployed engineering roles.

 

What we offer

  • Work on a highly impactful product that users love!

  • Office locations: In the heart of Paris (75011) and Miami, USA.

  • Stock Options: Available for every employee.

  • Hybrid flexibility: 3 days a week at the Paris office

  • Premium Health Coverage: Up to 70% covered by Pelico (Alan Healthcare).

  • Meal Allowance: €10/day worked, covered at 50% (via Swile card).

  • Transportation Support: 50% public transportation coverage or an equivalent sustainable mobility package.

  • Wellness Benefit: Access to discounted subscription plans for fitness, wellness, and beauty experiences through our partnership with ClassPass.

  • Collaborative Environment: We foster a vibrant, growth-focused workplace where professional development and team connections thrive.

 

Your interview experience

  1. Intro call with Talent Acquisition call (30 min)

  2. Hiring Manager Interview (1h)

  3. Technical Test onsite: 1h30

  4. Leadership conversation + founders (CEO/CTO)

  5. Offer + References, run in parallel

Pelico is an equal opportunity employer. We're committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

About the role 

As a Senior Director Tax, you will lead the Group Tax Department, overseeing all group-wide tax matters and a team of four professionals. You will be part of the Group Finance Leadership Team, working closely with the CFO and company leadership to ensure tax compliance and support special projects.

What you’ll do

  • Lead the team: You will lead and manage the Group Tax Department, which includes direct responsibility for a team of four skilled professionals.
  • Manage tax matters: You will be responsible for all group-wide tax matters, collaborating with local and international group companies on various aspects of (corporate) tax law.
  • Develop strategy: You will continuously develop the group tax and transfer pricing strategy for the Group and identify group-wide tax optimization opportunities.
  • Ensure compliance: You will oversee the group’s tax compliance activities, including preparing corporate income tax and VAT returns for German group companies.
  • Oversee financial reporting: You will be responsible for deferred tax positions (IFRS and HGB) in annual, consolidated, and quarterly financial statements, as well as financial planning.
  • Handle audits: You will lead tax audits and appeal proceedings, and be responsible for selecting and coordinating external consultants.

What you’ll bring
