title: Senior Director, Sales- DACH
descriptionHtml:
The Senior Director, Sales — DACH is a senior first-line sales leadership role responsible for building and driving a high-performing team of Strategic Account Executives focused on net-new logo acquisition and expansion across enterprise accounts in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland (DACH). This leader owns a significant ARR target and is accountable for the full sales cycle — from pipeline creation through close — within the DACH region.

This is a high-visibility, high-impact role that sits at the intersection of enterprise sales leadership and DACH market GTM strategy. You will translate Talkdesk’s business objectives into a regional execution plan, serve as a brand ambassador for the Talkdesk CX platform, and partner closely with Marketing, Product, Channel, and Customer Success to drive durable growth across this strategic European market.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Team Leadership & Coaching

  • Lead and manage a team of DACH-based Strategic Account Executives focused on net-new and expansion opportunities across enterprise accounts in the region.

  • Coach, mentor, and develop AEs to drive high-quality pipeline creation, deal execution, and quota attainment across DACH-specific buying cycles and regional market nuances.

  • Foster a performance culture grounded in accountability, high empathy, and genuine investment in individual career progression.

  • Partner with Sales Enablement to ensure the team is skilled on Talkdesk messaging, competitive positioning, and AI capabilities tailored to the DACH market.

Revenue & Strategy Ownership

  • Own regional DACH strategy and planning, ensuring customer retention, net-new growth, and expansion across core Talkdesk solutions — AI-powered contact center, customer experience automation, and workforce engagement management.

  • Use a data-driven approach to territory design, forecasting accuracy, and pipeline development aligned to Talkdesk’s consumption-based pricing model, adapted for local business practices in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.

  • Translate Talkdesk’s business objectives into a regional DACH execution strategy, ensuring alignment with broader European and corporate goals.

  • Build and maintain a healthy, predictable pipeline (3–4x coverage) and deliver accurate monthly and quarterly forecasts to senior leadership.

Executive Engagement & Brand

  • Actively engage with executive stakeholders at key DACH accounts; lead strategic sales meetings, attend QBRs, and build trusted long-term relationships across a localized enterprise client portfolio.

  • Serve as a brand ambassador for Talkdesk, championing our CX vision and differentiating against CCaaS competitors across the DACH market.

  • Represent Talkdesk at local industry events, conferences, and customer forums relevant to the DACH region.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Collaborate closely with Marketing, Product, Channel, and Customer Success to craft localized go-to-market campaigns, product feedback loops, and customer success programs tailored to the needs of the DACH enterprise customer base.

  • Develop and maintain deep fluency in the Talkdesk solution portfolio — including AI/automation capabilities and key ecosystem integrations (CRM, WFM, and region-specific platforms) — as well as the broader European CCaaS landscape.

  • Provide competitive intelligence and market feedback to Product, Marketing, and GTM leadership to inform roadmap, localized product requirements, and positioning decisions.

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience

  •  5+ years in a senior customer-facing sales leadership role directly managing teams in the DACH region.

  • Proven success leading teams selling to DACH enterprise accounts, with strong command of local, complex, multi-stakeholder buying cycles, European procurement processes, and regional data privacy requirements (e.g., GDPR).

  • Experience working for a global B2B SaaS company that has scaled successfully through rapid growth, ideally establishing a strong foothold in Central Europe.

  • Demonstrated track record of exceeding regional ARR targets, including net-new logo acquisition and expansion, in complex European enterprise environments.

  • Experience with 6- and 7-figure ACV deal cycles; proficiency with enterprise sales methodologies (MEDDIC, MEDDPICC, or equivalent) preferred.

  • Familiarity with CCaaS, CX technology, or adjacent platforms (UCaaS, AI/automation, WFM) strongly preferred.

  • Language skills: Native-level or completely fluent written and spoken German, and professional fluency in English.

Leadership & Team Building

  • Excellent people management skills — high empathy, strong consideration for local workplace cultures, and genuine commitment to individual career progression.

  • Experience building and scaling world-class local sales teams, including hiring, onboarding, and structured enablement across the DACH market.

  • Demonstrated ability to coach AEs through complex, multi-threaded deals and develop talent at all levels of the team.

Competencies

  • Strong command of consumption-based and SaaS pricing models; ability to translate Talkdesk’s value proposition into compelling business outcomes for DACH enterprise clients.

  • Understanding of the development and implementation of large-scale, mission-critical enterprise applications.

  • Exceptional executive communication, presence, and relationship-building skills in both German and English business contexts.

  • Ability to operate with speed and clarity in a high-growth, fast-moving environment across a dynamic regional market.

YOU’LL THRIVE AT TALKDESK IF…

  • You lead from the front — you’re in the deals, coaching in real time, and setting the standard for how the team sells in DACH.

title: Senior Electrical Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij een ervaren Electrical Engineer met een passie voor complexe technische gebouwen in de onderzoeks-, onderwijs- en cultuursector? Als Senior Electrical Engineer binnen de Unit Real Estate werk je aan uitdagende en innovatieve projecten waarin techniek, duurzaamheid en maatschappelijke waarde samenkomen. Met jouw technische expertise neem je verantwoordelijkheid voor complexe elektrotechnische ontwerpen, adviseer je opdrachtgevers en deel je jouw kennis met collega’s.

De uitdaging

Als Senior Electrical Engineer ben je onderdeel van de Unit Real Estate en werk je aan het elektrotechnisch ontwerp binnen uitdagende projecten in de onderwijs-, onderzoeks- en cultuursector. Van nieuwbouw en renovatie tot complexe transformatievraagstukken: jij vertaalt de wensen en eisen van de opdrachtgever naar slimme, duurzame en technisch hoogwaardige oplossingen.

Je werkt binnen multidisciplinaire projectteams nauw samen met collega’s vanuit onder andere werktuigbouwkunde, bouwfysica en duurzaamheid. Vanuit jouw ervaring overzie je de samenhang tussen verschillende disciplines, denk je mee over conceptuele keuzes en neem je verantwoordelijkheid voor de technische kwaliteit van het elektrotechnisch ontwerp.

Je bent daarnaast een inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt binnen projecten. Je adviseert opdrachtgevers en projectteams, begeleidt minder ervaren engineers en draagt actief bij aan het delen en verder ontwikkelen van kennis binnen Deerns.

Tot je verantwoordelijkheden behoren:

  • Je ontwikkelt zelfstandig elektrotechnische concepten en ontwerpen voor complexe gebouwen.

  • Je ontwerpt installaties op het gebied van onder andere energievoorziening, verlichting, sterk- en zwakstroom, data, communicatie en beveiliging.

  • Je maakt complexe technische berekeningen en beoordeelt berekeningen en ontwerpen van collega-engineers.

  • Je voert zelfstandig technisch overleg met opdrachtgevers, architecten, uitvoerende partijen en andere betrokken stakeholders.

  • Je bewaakt de kwaliteit en voortgang van jouw werkzaamheden en signaleert tijdig afwijkingen in planning, kwaliteit of budget.

  • Je stelt technische rapportages, bestekken en andere ontwerpdocumenten op en controleert deze.

  • Je begeleidt en coacht minder ervaren engineers binnen projecten en helpt hen zich inhoudelijk verder te ontwikkelen.

  • Je signaleert kansen binnen projecten, denkt mee over aanvullende dienstverlening en levert waar nodig een bijdrage aan offertes en klantgesprekken.

  • Je volgt ontwikkelingen en innovaties binnen het vakgebied en deelt jouw kennis actief met collega’s.

Het team

Je komt te werken in een hecht team van jong tot oud. Dit team is onderdeel van de Unit Real Estate, die in totaal uit circa 40 collega’s bestaat.Samen werken we aan nieuwbouw-, renovatie- en transformatievraagstukken voor overheden, bedrijven en instellingen van uiteenlopende schaalgrootte. Geen project is hetzelfde. Daarbij werken we veel samen met andere disciplines en expertisegroepen binnen Deerns, zowel in Nederland als daarbuiten.

Juist van integrale en technisch complexe vraagstukken worden wij enthousiast. Als Senior Electrical Engineer speel je hierin een belangrijke inhoudelijke rol. Met jouw ervaring help je niet alleen projecten verder, maar draag je ook bij aan de ontwikkeling van collega’s en het team

Dit ben jij

Je bent een ervaren engineer die technische diepgang combineert met een praktische en oplossingsgerichte instelling. Je kunt zelfstandig werken, maar zoekt tegelijkertijd actief de samenwerking met collega’s en andere disciplines. Je bent in staat om complexe technische vraagstukken te doorgronden, keuzes goed te onderbouwen en deze helder over te brengen aan opdrachtgevers en projectteams.


Daarnaast:

  • Heb je een afgeronde technische opleiding, bijvoorbeeld HIT-E, Elektrotechniek, Electrical Engineering, Energy Technology of een vergelijkbare richting, op minimaal hbo werk- en denkniveau.

  • Beschik je over meerdere jaren relevante werkervaring als Electrical Engineer, Engineer Elektrotechniek of in een vergelijkbare functie binnen de gebouwgebonden installatietechniek.

  • Heb je brede kennis van elektrotechnische installaties en kun je complexe ontwerpen zelfstandig opzetten en uitwerken.

  • Kun je technische vraagstukken vanuit een integraal perspectief bekijken en begrijp je de afhankelijkheden tussen verschillende disciplines.

  • Ben je gewend om met opdrachtgevers, ontwerpteams en externe partijen te overleggen en kun je jouw technische keuzes overtuigend onderbouwen.

  • Neem je verantwoordelijkheid voor de kwaliteit, voortgang en het resultaat van jouw werkzaamheden.

  • Vind je het leuk om jouw kennis te delen en minder ervaren collega’s inhoudelijk te begeleiden.

  • Ben je analytisch, kwaliteitsgericht, resultaatgericht en werk je graag samen.

  • Heb je een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Een goede beheersing van het Engels is eveneens belangrijk.

Dit bieden wij

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4.192 en € 5.891 (op basis van 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van jouw ervaring, kennis en expertise.

  • Een functie van 32-40 uur per week met een bijpassend salaris.

  • Uitdagende projecten voor toonaangevende opdrachtgevers in Nederland en internationaal.

  • Een werkomgeving waarin innovatie en duurzaamheid dagelijks in de praktijk worden gebracht.

  • Aandacht voor jouw eigen ontwikkeling en vitaliteit met ruime opleidings- en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden, fiets- en sportregelingen, flexibele werkuren, 33 vakantiedagen en mogelijkheid tot aankopen van extra dagen.

  • Hybride werken, waarbij je de mogelijkheid hebt om afwisselend thuis en op kantoor in Den Haag te werken.

  • Een team waar samenwerking en collegialiteit voorop staan en waar we informeel met elkaar omgaan.

  • Duurzaamheid zit in onze genen. Dit uit zich bijvoorbeeld in een mobiliteitsbeleid waar gezondheid en duurzaamheid voorop staan. Veel van onze kantoren liggen bij OV-knooppunten, fietsen wordt aangemoedigd en je reiskosten worden 100% vergoed op basis van OV.

Over Deerns
Deerns is als onafhankelijk ingenieursbureau gespecialiseerd in advies, ontwerp en uitvoeringsbegeleiding op het vlak van installatietechniek, bouwfysica, energievoorziening en duurzaamheid. Onze expertises dragen bij aan duurzame, intelligente en toekomstbestendige gebouwen die de processen van onze opdrachtgevers optimaal ondersteunen. We zijn verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp van de installaties en het realiseren van een goed comfort en een prettig klimaat in de meest uiteenlopende gebouwen; van kantoren, tot luchthavens en van ziekenhuizen tot datacenters.

Daarnaast is Deerns benoemd als Great Place to Work!

Kennis maken?

Wil je meer weten over werken bij Deerns? Neem dan contact op met Maarten Borgmeijer (Corporate Recruiter) via +31 6 11 66 75 44. Wil je meer weten over de inhoud van de functie? Neem dan contact op met Rik Maaijen (Unit Director) van Real Estate via +31 6 10 47 21 16.

Ben je enthousiast geworden? Reageer met jouw cv via de sollicitatie button. Je ontvangt binnen drie werkdagen een reactie. Acquisitie naar aanleiding van de vacatures op onze website wordt niet op prijs gesteld. Cv's en/of voorstellen die ongevraagd aan ons worden gemaild worden niet in behandeling genomen!

title: Senior Field Marketing & ABM Manager, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Serval is an AI-native automation platform transforming how enterprises operate. We build intelligent agents that understand real-world workflows and execute them end-to-end — replacing manual processes and rigid legacy systems with adaptive, learning software. Founded in early 2024, Serval is already trusted by companies like Fox, Notion, Perplexity, Vercel, and Brex to automate high-volume, high-friction operational work across their organizations.

At the core of Serval is an agentic AI platform that turns natural language into production-grade workflows. Our agents don’t just respond to requests — they reason, take action across systems, and continuously improve with usage. What began with operational use cases has quickly evolved into a horizontal AI automation layer used across IT, HR, Finance, Security, Legal, and Engineering.

Our mission is to eliminate repetitive, manual work across the enterprise and give teams leverage through intelligent automation. Long term, we’re building the universal AI operations layer — a system of agents that sits across business functions and runs the workflows that keep modern companies moving.

We’re backed by leading investors including Sequoia Capital, Redpoint Ventures, Meritech, First Round, General Catalyst, Elad Gil, and others.

Role Overview

The opportunities that matter most are often the hardest to get in front of. As our first Field Marketing & ABM hire in EMEA, you'll partner directly with Sales to build our field motion in the region from zero: high-impact programs across segments and 1:1 ABM plays for our most strategic accounts. You'll challenge the status quo in field marketing to create unique experiences and moments that open doors, build trust, and move deals forward.

This is a build role, not a run role. There is no EMEA playbook to inherit: you'll write it. Expect increasing scope, budget, and responsibility as our European presence grows, and expect to hire behind you.

Who You Are

  • Creative and opportunistic. You see an opening where others see a closed door. You know that breaking through to hard-to-reach accounts isn't about budget, it's about timing, creativity, and understanding what matters.

  • Allergic to "best practices" that produce mediocre results. You'd rather test something bold than execute something safe.

  • A doer, not a delegator. You're equally comfortable building a Salesforce report, negotiating with a venue in Shoreditch, or sending a llama with an invite around its neck to a CIO's office in Canary Wharf.

  • Comfortable being first. You're energised by an empty calendar and a blank budget line, and you don't need a US playbook translated for you.

What You'll Do

  • Define the EMEA go-to-market strategy for field programs: what we do, where we show up, and how we win across UK&I, DACH, Benelux, and the Nordics.

  • Design 1:1, 1:few, and 1:many field marketing experiences [regional dinners, happy hours, hackathons, out of the box experiences, etc] that align to active opportunities and target accounts.

  • Orchestrate ABM programs with Strategic accounts across channels: direct mail, events, digital, gifting, and content, navigating the practical realities of multi-country execution [shipping, VAT, GDPR, local vendors, language].

  • Partner with sales to understand territory priorities, account dynamics, and pipeline gaps, then actively participate in deal strategy, not just event execution.

  • Adapt what works globally and kill what doesn't travel. Bring the best of our US programs to Europe, and feed EMEA-born ideas back the other way.

  • Track impact through account engagement, pilots started, velocity, and closed-won revenue.

  • Create tight feedback loops with Sales leadership on both sides of the Atlantic to continuously improve territory strategy and program effectiveness.

  • Test unconventional tactics. Push boundaries. Try things that make people's jaws drop.

What You'll Need

  • 5-7+ years experience in field, experiential, growth, or ABM marketing.

  • Experience running programs across multiple European markets, not just the UK.

  • Proficiency with Salesforce, Hubspot [or similar], and intent tools [6sense, Demandbase, or similar].

  • Proven track record of running regional field programs, account-based campaigns, or growth programs that drove measurable pipeline and revenue.

  • Strong data analysis skills. You can build reports, interpret metrics, and make data-driven decisions.

  • Deep experience partnering with Sales teams and marketing to Enterprise and Strategic companies.

  • Creative thinker who can turn a vague goal into a concrete, compelling plan and crush the execution.

  • Comfortable moving fast, experimenting, and adjusting in real time.

  • Strong collaborator who earns trust with Sales quickly, including with a US-based marketing team across time zones.

  • Comfortable with 25% travel across EMEA, up to 50% seasonally.

  • Based in London with the right to work in the UK.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience marketing to IT, Engineering, or Security leaders.

  • Experience as an early or first marketing hire in a new region.

  • Additional European languages.

What We Offer

  • Impact: Be a key player in shaping the success of our product and company.

  • Growth: Build a fundamentally new AI product offering with the support of our experienced team and investors. Grow rapidly with the company.

  • Culture: Join a culture that values innovation, ownership, accountability, and fun.

title: Senior Financial Crime Manager, UK
descriptionHtml:
Crypto.com’s Compliance function safeguards the business and its customers by ensuring the group operates within applicable laws, regulations and industry standards across every market we serve. The function is organised around three core pillars: Regional Compliance, Compliance Advisory: Policies, Product and Governance, and Compliance Support and Oversight. Together, these teams partner with the business to enable responsible growth, uphold our regulatory obligations, and protect the trust our customers place in us.

The Regional Compliance team owns day-to-day compliance execution in-country: local licensing, regulator engagement, exams and audits, and acting as the first line of compliance partnership to the regional business.




About the Role

At Crypto.com , we are building the future of digital and capital markets finance at a global scale. We are looking for a sharp, commercially minded, motivated Senior Financial Crime Manager to join the UK Compliance team reporting to the UK Head of Compliance and MLRO.

In this high impact role, you will hold end to end responsibility for the effectiveness of the UK financial crime framework across our Digital Assets, Capital Markets and EMI business in the UK.

We are seeking an experienced and driven Senior Financial Crime & Regulatory Compliance Manager to support the management and oversight of regulatory compliance and financial crime risks across Crypto.com’s UK Cryptoasset Exchange and Electronic Money Institution (EMI) businesses.

This is a senior role with end to end responsibility for effectiveness and operation of the firm's financial crime framework.

You will provide strategic and operational support across all aspects of the financial crime framework including maintaining a robust controls program and overseeing the continuous evolution and improvements to the financial crime framework including but not limited to advising on risk assessments across clients and products, transaction monitoring and advising the business on financial crime risk matters.

The role requires strong financial crime expertise, ideally gained across digital asset firms, fintech, or traditional financial services , together with a sound understanding of wider UK regulatory compliance requirements. The successful candidate must be comfortable working independently, providing practical advice and engaging with senior stakeholders and Group functions.


Key Responsibilities

Financial Crime Compliance & Oversight

  • Support the UK Head of Compliance & MLRO in overseeing the effectiveness of the UK financial crime compliance framework , including anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing (AML/CTF), sanctions, customer due diligence, enhanced due diligence and transaction monitoring controls.

  • Act as a subject matter expert on UK Money Laundering Terrorist Financing and Transfer of Funds Regulations 2017, Proceeds of Crime 2002 (POCA), Terrorism Act 2000 and associated FCA financial crime expectations, requirements and obligations

  • Support the maintenance and enhancement of the firm’s Business wide risk assessment (BWRA) and customer risk assessment (CRA) methodology

  • Continuously evaluate Assess the effectiveness of transaction monitoring arrangements, including rule coverage, alert generation, investigation quality, escalation processes, case backlogs and the timeliness and appropriateness of customer outcomes and suggesting improvements where required

  • Review complex and higher-risk customer matters, including Source of Funds and Source of Wealth assessments, transaction monitoring investigations, customer risk classifications and decisions relating to enhanced monitoring, restrictions or exits.

  • Act as the senior escalation point for complex onboarding, Source of wealth/funds (SOW/SOF) reviews and high risk exits or restrictions

  • Lead compliance around digital assets requirements including but not limited to Travel Rule, cross border transfers, CARF, CRS, on chain monitoring

  • Review financial crime management information, investigation outcomes and operational performance to identify emerging risks, recurring deficiencies and potential systemic control weaknesses, ensuring appropriate escalation and corrective action.

  • Support financial crime regulatory enquiries, independent reviews, internal audits and remediation programmes, including assessing the adequacy of corrective actions and their ongoing effectiveness.

  • Monitor external developments in financial crime typologies, regulatory expectations and industry practices, including risks associated with cryptoassets, blockchain transactions and traditional payment services.

    • Regulatory Compliance & Governance

  • Provide day to day regulatory compliance advice and support to UK business and operational teams across the Cryptoasset Exchange and EMI businesses.

  • Support the maintenance of the UK Compliance Framework , including regulatory policies, compliance monitoring, risk assessments and reporting obligations.

  • Monitor regulatory developments, assess their impact on the UK businesses and support regulatory change initiatives, including the evolving UK cryptoasset regulatory framework.

  • Provide compliance advice on products, services and business initiatives, including relevant financial promotions, Consumer Duty, payment services and electronic money requirements.

  • Support engagement with the FCA and other UK authorities, including regulatory submissions, notifications, supervisory enquiries and information requests.


    • Requirements

  • 7+ years’ relevant and deep financial crime experience in a FCA authorised firm such as a digital asset firm, fin tech, exchange,EMI/ payments, banking or capital markets regulated financial services businesses.

  • Authoritative understanding and knowledge of UK AML/CTF requirements (MLRs 2017, POCA, Terrorism Act) and relevant FCA expectations such as FCG

  • Practical experience in financial crime compliance oversight, including transaction monitoring, CDD/EDD, customer risk assessments and investigations.

  • Demonstrable experience providing broader regulatory compliance advice, beyond financial crime-specific responsibilities.

  • Good understanding of the FCA regulatory framework and the ability to interpret regulatory requirements and apply them to business operations.

  • Experience assessing regulatory risks, reviewing controls and supporting compliance monitoring, governance and remediation activities.

  • Sharp analytical judgment with the gravitas to push back when risk appetite is challenged paired with pragmatism to find fictionless compliant solutions

  • Strong analytical, written communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work independently and exercise sound judgement.

    Nice to Have:

  • Experience in the cryptoasset or digital asset industry, ideally alongside traditional financial services experience.

  • Knowledge of blockchain analytics, on-chain transaction monitoring and cryptoasset-specific financial crime risks.

  • Familiarity with UK payment services, electronic money regulation, Consumer Duty and financial promotions requirements.

  • Understanding of the developing UK cryptoasset regulatory framework.

  • Experience supporting FCA supervisory reviews, independent assessments or regulatory remediation programmes.

  • Experience working within an international organisation with centralised compliance or financial crime operations.

  • Relevant professional qualifications such as ICA, ACAMS or equivalent.

title: Senior FP&A Analyst - Financial Services
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 7000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

 

Pennylane accélère fortement le développement de ses activités Financial Services / Banking. Pour accompagner cette croissance et sécuriser la trajectoire financière de cette activité stratégique, nous recrutons un·e FP&A Analyst dédié·e aux Financial Services.

Au sein de l’équipe FP&A, tu seras le point de référence financier du périmètre. Ta mission sera de transformer les ambitions business en une trajectoire financière robuste et pilotable, en combinant modélisation, analyse de la performance et business partnering.

Tu travailleras au croisement des équipes Finance, Financial Services, Strategy, Risk et Compliance, dans un environnement en forte croissance et soumis à des enjeux réglementaires spécifiques.

Tes missions


Piloter la performance Financial Services

  • Construire, maintenir et challenger le modèle financier du périmètre Financial Services.

  • Suivre la performance mensuelle : actuals, forecast, budget.

  • Analyser les écarts, identifier leurs principaux drivers et formuler des recommandations actionnables.

  • Produire une lecture claire de la performance à destination des équipes opérationnelles et de la Finance.

Maîtriser les revenus, les coûts et la marge

  • Modéliser les différentes composantes du chiffre d’affaires : acquisition clients, nombre de comptes, mix produit, pricing.

  • Reconstituer et piloter la structure de coûts à mesure que le périmètre est internalisé et se développe.

  • Analyser les coûts directs, indirects, mutualisés, réglementaires, récurrents et exceptionnels.

  • Suivre les indicateurs de marge et construire les analyses de rentabilité pertinentes par produit, partenaire ou segment.

Accompagner la croissance et les décisions stratégiques

  • Évaluer la faisabilité financière des objectifs de croissance et le niveau de ressources nécessaire pour les atteindre.

  • Construire des scénarios et analyses de sensibilité sur les principaux leviers et risques du Business Plan.

  • Préparer les contributions Financial Services aux cycles de Budget et de Reforecast.

  • Challenger les hypothèses des équipes et contribuer aux arbitrages d’investissement.

Construire un pilotage adapté à une activité régulée

  • Intégrer dans les modèles les coûts partenaires, les contraintes réglementaires et les risques opérationnels.

  • Travailler avec les équipes Risk et Compliance pour traduire les enjeux réglementaires en impacts financiers.

  • Faire évoluer les indicateurs, reportings et processus à mesure que l’activité gagne en maturité.

  • Fiabiliser et automatiser les analyses, en lien avec les outils FP&A et les équipes Data.

L’impact attendu

Dans ce rôle, tu contribueras directement à :

  • sécuriser un Business Plan ambitieux grâce à des hypothèses robustes et régulièrement challengées ;

  • améliorer la visibilité sur les revenus, les coûts, la marge et les principaux risques ;

  • donner aux équipes et aux dirigeants une information financière fiable et actionnable ;

  • structurer les réflexes et les outils FP&A propres à une activité Banking ;

  • assurer une communication lean avec les équipes opérationnelles Financial Services.

Ton profil

  • Tu as une expérience solide de 5 ans minimum en FP&A, Transaction Services, audit, conseil financier, contrôle de gestion ou finance stratégique.

  • Tu maîtrises la modélisation financière, les cycles Budget / Forecast et l’analyse des écarts.

  • Tu sais transformer des données complexes en conclusions simples, structurées et orientées décision.

  • Tu fais preuve d’une grande rigueur, tout en gardant une forte compréhension des enjeux business.

  • Tu es à l’aise pour travailler avec des interlocuteurs variés et challenger de manière constructive.

  • Tu as un excellent niveau sur Excel ou Google Sheets ; une expérience d’un EPM tel que Pigment est un plus.

  • Tu communiques avec clarté, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, en français et en anglais.

  • Une expérience dans la banque, la fintech, les paiements ou un environnement régulé est un plus, mais n’est pas indispensable si tu démontres une forte capacité d’apprentissage.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Prendre en charge le pilotage financier d’une activité stratégique en très forte croissance.

  • Construire les modèles, indicateurs et processus de référence d’un périmètre encore en structuration.

  • Travailler sur des problématiques qui combinent finance, stratégie, opérations et réglementation.

  • Être exposé·e à des décisions structurantes et collaborer avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires.

  • Rejoindre une équipe Finance ambitieuse, exigeante et orientée impact.


🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

 

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. title: Senior Frontend Engineer / Technical Lead
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij niet alleen bouwen aan frontendoplossingen, maar ook richting geven aan hoe we onze websites en digitale platformen de komende jaren ontwikkelen?

Wat je over ons moet weten?

Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en wij willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat.

Wat ga je doen?

Voor ons Websites & Portals Platform team zoeken we een ervaren frontend engineer die technisch leiderschap combineert met sterke hands-on kennis van Angular. Iemand die vooruitkijkt, een frontend visie en roadmap kan neerzetten en andere teams kan meenemen in de technische richting.
Je bent dus niet alleen degene die complexe frontend vraagstukken kan oplossen. Je helpt ook bepalen waar we naartoe gaan, welke technische keuzes we maken en hoe verschillende ontwikkelteams binnen die koers samenwerken.

Als Senior Frontend Engineer / Technical Lead speel je een centrale rol in de verdere ontwikkeling van ons frontend platform.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

- het opstellen en uitdragen van de technische visie en roadmap voor frontend;
- het verder ontwikkelen en moderniseren van het frontend platform;
- het ontwikkelen van herbruikbare platformcomponenten voor onze websites en digitale klantomgevingen;
- het maken en bewaken van technische en architectuurkeuzes;
- hands-on ontwikkelen met Angular en TypeScript;
- het inhoudelijk richting geven aan developers en ontwikkelteams die gebruikmaken van het platform;
- het bewaken van standaarden, kwaliteit, onderhoudbaarheid en samenhang;
- het vertalen van behoeften vanuit verschillende teams naar toekomstbestendige technische oplossingen;
- samenwerken met onder andere solution teams, architectuur, security en infrastructuur.

Het gaat daarmee om meer dan software ontwikkelen. Jij helpt de technische koers van het frontendlandschap te bepalen en zorgt ervoor dat die koers ook daadwerkelijk landt binnen de organisatie. Wat deze rol interessant maakt? Je krijgt de kans om op meerdere niveaus impact te maken. De ene keer duik je zelf de techniek in. De andere keer bespreek je een architectuurkeuze, werk je aan de roadmap of help je een ander team om een oplossing binnen het platform goed neer te zetten. Daarbij kijk je verder dan het individuele vraagstuk. Je vraagt je steeds af: hoe maken we het platform eenvoudiger, consistenter, schaalbaarder en toekomstbestendiger?

#LI-DNI


Wat vragen we van jou?

We zoeken nadrukkelijk een ervaren frontendprofessional die technische diepgang weet te combineren met visie en leiderschap.

Je hebt:
- ruime ervaring met frontendontwikkeling;
- diepgaande ervaring met Angular en TypeScript;
- ervaring met NX workspace / monorepo en NodeJS, of vergelijkbare moderne frontendomgevingen;
- ervaring met Azure App Service en Azure Pipelines, of vergelijkbare cloud- en CI/CD-omgevingen;
- ervaring met het ontwerpen en doorontwikkelen van frontendplatformen;
- het vermogen om een technische visie en roadmap op te stellen en uit te dragen;
- ervaring met het inhoudelijk richting geven aan developers of andere ontwikkelteams;
- voldoende senioriteit om technische keuzes uit te leggen en verschillende stakeholders daarin mee te nemen;
- kennis van .NET en API-integraties (pré);
- ervaring met Agile, Scrum en/of SAFe;
- minimaal hbo-werk- en denkniveau;
- een goede beheersing van Nederlands en Engels en woonachtig in Nederland.

Wie ben jij? Je bent technisch sterk, maar bent niet iemand die het liefst alleen met code bezig is.

- Je kijkt verder dan het vraagstuk van vandaag;
- Je ziet afhankelijkheden tussen teams en systemen;
- Je durft technische keuzes te maken en daarvoor te staan;
- Je kunt ontwikkelteams enthousiasmeren en meenemen;
- Je schakelt makkelijk tussen developers, architecten en management;
- Je bent pragmatisch en weet wanneer een oplossing technisch goed genoeg is;
- Je neemt eigenaarschap over de ontwikkeling van het platform.

Je combineert daarmee de kwaliteiten van een senior engineer, technisch sparringpartner en kartrekker.

Wat krijg je van ons?

Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega's die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag.

Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. Uiteraard krijg je een (flexibele) werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam dat behoort tot de beste 7% van de wereld, echt waar. En omdat je ook regelmatig thuis zult werken, ontvang je een budget om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten.

In ruil voor jouw inzet, talent en vaardigheden krijg je naast je salaris plus een vakantietoeslag en een dertiende maand, 27 vakantiedagen (bij een contract van 36 uur) en een OV-kaart of reiskostenvergoeding voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor komt. En, niet onbelangrijk vinden wij, krijg je een goed opleidingsbudget, zodat je jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen. Zo krijg je de kans om door te groeien, binnen ons bedrijf of daarbuiten.

Salaris per maand:
Op basis van cao schaal 16 HAY is de range € 5.082,02 tot € 6.776,03 op basis van 36 uur.

Enthousiast?

Reageer dan snel via de sollicitatie button!

title: Senior GRC Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Team

Come help us build the world's most trusted on-demand logistics engine for delivery! We're building a team of great minds to help us secure and maintain a 24x7, no-downtime, global infrastructure system that powers DoorDash's multi-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and drivers.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior GRC Engineer to help take DoorDash's compliance program from something people run to something the platform runs on its own. Reporting to the Security Compliance Manager, you'll take primary ownership of how regulatory and framework change gets tracked, interpreted, and turned into real controls - one part of a broader GRC function that spans audit, policy, and risk. Day to day, that means less time updating spreadsheets and more time writing the automation, integrations, and control logic that let audit evidence collect itself. You'll also lead major external audits from start to finish and help shape the policies and control standards the rest of the program is built on.This is a hands-on role for someone who already has deep audit and assurance experience, wants to spend more time building than briefing and can move a program forward, and change how people work, without needing the title to make it happen.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Build the regulatory and framework change-management process that keeps DoorDash ahead of new obligations, instead of reacting to them.
  • Move manual, point-in-time compliance work onto Compliance-as-Code foundations: policy-as-code, automated control testing, and continuous evidence collection wired into CI/CD, so audit readiness holds up between audits, not just during them.
  • Design and run agentic workflows for evidence analysis, control testing, and audit response preparation, with a human in the loop where assurance demands it.
  • Partner directly with engineering and architecture teams to design controls into new systems at build time and translate that technical work into the narratives auditors actually need.

title: Senior IT Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Mission

Alan is scaling internationally (800+ employees, 100+ healthcare professionals, 5+ countries) and needs IT Engineers to build and own the internal technology platform every Alaner works on: identity and provisioning, endpoint and SaaS security, the tooling behind our clinics, and the automation that keeps IT from scaling linearly with headcount.

The scope below is what the team owns, not a checklist for one person. You'll be staffed on one or two of these areas at a time, according to your strengths and interests, and it will evolve through time based on company needs and personal appetite.

Staying close to users keeps us building the right things: you'll spend up to 2-3 days a month on IT support, seeing first-hand where friction lives and what's worth automating next.

Scope

⚙️ Platform & automation

  • Own and extend automations on Alan Home, our internal provisioning engine

  • Maintain, extend and improve helpdesk automation, SaaS provisioning flows, and onboarding/offboarding pipelines

  • Own the meeting room AV and room-booking platform as a product, replicable across offices

🔑 Identity & access

  • Own the IT side of the employee lifecycle (onboarding, offboarding, mobility between jobs and countries) across Google Workspace, SSO/SAML and our SaaS ecosystem.

  • Grow our role-based access model: extend it to more tools and refine the permission groups, so access is granted by role rather than case by case

  • Make employee lifecycle events reliable, fast and auditable end-to-end

  • Own access reviews and least-privilege models; produce and maintain the evidence our auditors rely on

  • Own SaaS procurement and license management: vendor relationships, renewals, and cost optimization across our stack

🔒 Endpoint & SaaS security

  • Own the Mac fleet in Kandji: enrollment at scale, role-based blueprints, fleet compliance

  • Cloudflare WARP, SaaS security controls

  • Maintain and strengthen our ISO 27001 certification and drive ACPR and pentest remediation on the endpoint and platform scope

🩺 Health Professionals IT

  • The IT layer behind Alan's clinics: practitioner tooling, equipment, access

  • Role and permission automation for healthcare professionals, and their support and escalation process

🌍 Internationalisation

  • Make international expansion something IT accelerates, not something it slows down: a repeatable process where every new market (Canada, KSA, Armenia...) launches on our standard stack from day one

  • Bring acquired entities onto that same platform

Milestones

First 3 months

  • Acquire technical knowledge on Alan's platform: Alan Home, Google Workspace/SSO, Kandji, Cloudflare WARP

  • Take one project end-to-end and ship a first increment

  • Join the IT oncall team as technical escalation

First 6 months

  • Own a workstream end-to-end

  • Deliver one automation or hardening initiative end-to-end

  • Take up documentation and automation on your scope and reduce significantly the bus factor on it

  • Mentor IT teammates on your core expertise

First year

  • Deliver measurable IT toil reduction on your scope

  • Set the technical standards on your domain: how we build, document and review it

  • Build strong cross-functional partnerships (Engineering, Security, Workplace, Clinic, People, Audit)

  • Contribute to hiring and onboarding new teammates

3 years

  • Lead major projects end-to-end across several communities

  • Be the reference the team relies on across at least two domains

  • Mentor the IT team and beyond, and scale IT without a linear increase in manual work

As the community grows, there is room to take on more responsibility: leading a crew, owning cross-community projects, mentoring, hiring.

What we're looking for

Must-have - Technical/hard skills:

  • 5+ years in IT engineering, platform, systems or corporate engineering, with real ownership of production-facing systems

  • Depth in at least one area (platform & automation, identity, endpoint & security) and demonstrated range beyond it.

  • You write code: not necessarily as a full-time software engineer, but Python, APIs and pull requests in a shared repo should feel normal

  • Structured problem-solving: diagnoses methodically, asks the right clarifying questions, thinks about failure modes and rollback

  • Comfort with regulated environments: health data, ACPR, ISO 27001, HDS

  • Automation & AI appetite: uses AI tools smartly to accelerate their own delivery, with an instinct for what should be automated or delegated to AI rather than repeated

Must-have - Behavioral / soft skills:

  • Ownership & autonomy: drives topics forward without hand-holding, including when they cross into someone else's perimeter

  • Written communication: Alan is written-first; decisions get argued in public documents and challenged by people outside your team

  • Pragmatic judgment: balances "perfect" vs. "good enough", decides with incomplete information

  • Documentation culture: reduces bus factor through clear documentation and knowledge sharing

Nice-to-have skills / Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with an internal provisioning or IdP-driven automation platform

  • Kandji or another MDM at scale

  • Cloudflare Zero Trust / WARP, Datadog

  • Audit remediation experience (ISO 27001, HDS)

  • Multi-country rollouts, or IT integration after an acquisition

  • Having mentored, coached or led a (small) crew

  • Health or healthtech ecosystem familiarity

Languages: Fluent English & Professional French

Compensation: €70K – €83K • €67K – €120K Equity

title: Senior Legal Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The opportunity

We're hiring our first dedicated legal operations team member to sit at the heart of 9fin's growing Legal Affairs function. This is a broad, hands-on role and a rare opportunity to shape how a scale-up in-house legal team runs from the inside out.

You'll own the operational engine of the team: our contract lifecycle platform (Ironclad, which is deeply embedded across sales, procurement and RevOps), our commercial playbook (and developing non-commercial playbooks), our tech stack (including AI implementation), our front-door (right now, ticketing is done in Linear), our knowledge management (currently spread across multiple systems), our reporting and KPIs, and the tracking and governance around outside counsel spend.

You'll also be a project manager and a hands-on partner to the General Counsel. That includes co-drafting monthly and quarterly business reviews, leading and coordinating cross-functional initiatives (for example M&A diligence coordination, trademark portfolio work, or regulatory readiness workstreams), and holding a high bar for organisation so nothing on a small, fast-moving team drops.

You'll report to the General Counsel and work alongside legal colleagues in London and New York. This is a London-based role and we typically expect the team to be in the office three days a week.

What you’ll work on

Below is the shape of the role, laid out as prioritised by Now, Next and Later so you can see the broad strokes of the path ahead - but by no means is this set in stone. Priorities will move as we learn what's most useful in practice and you’ll have a big hand in shaping this further.

Now

  • Tune legal intake - help us build out the “front door” for legal requests across the business.

  • Partner with Sales, Finance, InfoSec and Procurement to streamline deal-desk and approval processes

  • Support on knowledge management and internal policy administration. Consolidate knowledge, templates, and other information in a clean accessible structure.

  • Build our external legal spend tracker from scratch. Categorise spend, log invoices and quotes, match to matter, and produce a monthly view for the General Counsel.

  • Own KPI reporting improvements against our Ironclad-fed dashboards. Expand coverage into intake, spend, cycle times, and other operational metrics.

  • Own operational and reporting support across the Legal function, including responses to internal stakeholders including Finance, RevOps, and the People team.

Next

  • Get inside and own our tech stack and know it end-to-end - Ironclad, Linear, Google Workspace, Notion, and the AI tools we've adopted or are evaluating.

  • Build, maintain and roll out templates, playbooks and self-serve legal resources so the business can move quickly.

  • Own Ironclad workflow hygiene and adoption end-to-end. Work with the team to clean up metadata and archiving, tighten approvals and signatory workflows, and work with commercial counsel to roll out training across sales, procurement, RevOps and other frequent users.

  • Bring structure and visibility across the team. Keep track of open projects, drive follow-through, and make sure balls do not drop across a small team with a lot of surface area.

  • Maintain our sales contract playbook. Keep it current, propose updates as commercial patterns and RevOps feedback surface them, and make sure the team is actually using it.

Later

  • Partner with the General Counsel to produce meaningful Exec-level reporting.

  • Assist with management of large legal projects on GC instruction. Recent examples include M&A diligence coordination, and trademark portfolio work.

  • Support company secretarial administration.

About you

We're looking for a highly organised operator who is energised by building order out of scale-up complexity. You do not need to be a lawyer, but you do need to have run legal operations end-to-end before. The essentials come first below, followed by preferred experience and the traits we care about most.

  • Highly organised with a systems mindset: You keep the plates spinning and notice when one wobbles. You see the workflow behind the task and design for repeatability.

  • Commercial, action-biased, comfortable with ambiguity: You understand what the business needs from legal, get things over the line without waiting to be asked twice, and you're comfortable being the first hire writing the map as you go.

  • Ironclad or equivalent CLM: Hands-on experience with Ironclad or a directly comparable enterprise CLM (for example Juro, LinkSquares, Icertis, Agiloft, Leah). We are deeply embedded in Ironclad and you will own it.

  • Legal operations track record: At least five years' experience running legal operations, contracts operations or a closely adjacent function (compliance operations, legal project management, or legal chief-of-staff), ideally in a scale-up or in-house legal team that is fast paced and where you can demonstrate ownership.

  • End-to-end project delivery: You have owned legal or cross-functional projects on your own steam, including timelines, risks, stakeholders and outcomes.

  • Reporting and data fluency: You can build clean dashboards, work with a KPI framework, and translate metrics into a story someone can act on.

  • Outside counsel spend or panel exposure: Experience setting up spend tracking, panel management or legal project management would be useful, but we're also open to someone with the capability and appetite to build this from scratch.

  • Builder mentality: Experience as a team’s first or only legal-ops hire, or a member of a small team in the early stage of the build-out of a legal ops function, would be a strong advantage.

Benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Financial & Insurance

  • Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

  • Equity

  • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

  • Group Life Assurance

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off

  • 25 holiday days per year

  • Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Growth & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • AI experimentation budget of £800 (UK) per employee to trial AI tools

  • Quarterly team socials

  • Summer and Winter company social events

Hybrid Policy

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

title: Senior Manager, Accounting
descriptionHtml:
With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion. 

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

About the Job

The Senior Manager, Accounting owns the completeness and accuracy of the global operating expense base across the profit and loss statement and related balance sheets for a fast-paced, global business. Operating within the Controllership leadership team, this role leads a team of accounting professionals and runs the global expense close end-to-end across all entities and time zones. The successful candidate will drive a comprehensive continuous improvement agenda to scale the accounting function through standardization, automation, and the adoption of enabling technology. This is an exciting opportunity to take full ownership of global operating expenses and help shape the future transformation of the accounting function to support significant organizational growth.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end global operating expense close cycle under US GAAP, ensuring the completeness, accuracy, and timely delivery of all balance sheet reconciliations and reporting requirements worldwide.
  • Deliver clear monthly and quarterly financial variance analyses to explain commercial drivers, risks, and opportunities while partnering with financial planning teams on spend trends.
  • Act as the primary subject matter expert for operating expense accounting, applying technical principles and critical evaluation to judgment-intensive areas, vendor agreements, and commercial arrangements.
  • Drive the continuous improvement agenda by simplifying, standardizing, and automating close processes through the adoption of artificial intelligence and scaling technologies.
  • Manage and develop a geographically dispersed team of accounting professionals, establishing a high-performing culture focused on mutual accountability, clear goals, and career progression.
  • Foster strong collaborative relationships with procurement, finance operations, and commercial partners to integrate commercial insights into accounting decisions and establish clear process governance.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Professional accounting qualification (such as CPA, ACA, ACCA, CA, or equivalent).
  • Minimum of 10 years of post-qualification experience in financial or operational accounting within a complex, multi-entity global business.
  • Demonstrated experience managing the end-to-end financial close cycle, including operating expenses, accruals, and balance sheet reconciliations.
  • Proven track record of successfully leading, coaching, and developing teams of accounting professionals.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Public accounting experience, ideally with a top 6 accounting firm
  • In-depth technical grounding in US GAAP principles and corporate financial reporting standards.
  • Strong proficiency in driving continuous process improvement, automation, or financial system transformations.
  • Experience managing accounting operations and collaboration across multiple international entities and time zones.
  • Exceptional communication and analytical skills with a demonstrated ability to translate financial figures into clear commercial insights for senior stakeholders.

Benefits and Perks

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year
  • Focus on mental health and well-being:
    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
    • Company-paid subscription to Headspace
    • Annual company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)
  • Paid parental leave
  • 5 weeks paid vacation
  • Time off for your birthday
  • Paid volunteer time
  • Focus on your career growth:
    • Development Dollars
    • Leadership development
    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings
  • Travel Discounts
  • Employee Resource Groups
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Income protection and life assurance
  • Employee Assistance Program - including 24/7 GP & free legal advice
  • Pension plan contributions
  • Discounted gym membership
  • Bike2Work
  • Season ticket loan
  • Social events & Thursday happy hours
  • Free lunch 2 days per week

The best connections happen face-to-face, whether you’re sitting down to dinner or having coffee with a coworker. That’s why OpenTable has adopted a hybrid workplace model. This role aligns with that approach, with an expectation of coming into the office two days a week—giving employees the best of both worlds: in-person collaboration and flexibility.

Work Environment & Flexibility

At OpenTable, we pride ourselves on fostering a global and dynamic work environment. As a team member with us, you will benefit from a schedule tailored to accommodate a global workforce operating across multiple time zones. While the majority of your responsibilities may align with conventional business hours, there will be instances where you are expected to manage communications - via calls, Slack messages, or emails - outside of regular working hours to effectively collaborate with international colleagues, respond to restaurant partners, and/or address urgent matters. OpenTable will always abide by and consider local laws and regulations.

Inclusion

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. We know the best ideas come when we bring different voices to the table, so we're building a team as dynamic as the diners and restaurants we serve—and fostering a culture where everyone feels welcome to be themselves.

If you need any reasonable adjustments during the application/interview process, or on the job, we’re here to support you. Please reach out to your recruiter to request any accommodations.

title: Senior Manager, Resource & Capacity Management (Parental Leave Cover)
descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

4076 - Senior Manager, Global Resource Management – GOC (Parental Leave Cover)

Role Summary and Impact

The Senior Manager, Global Resource Management will play a key role in supporting the effective planning, deployment and utilisation of talent across the Global Operations Centres (GOCs).

The role will have responsibility for the day-to-day Resource Management of selected GOC Global clients, while also leading key RM activities including utilisation reviews, balanced team management, bench governance and cross-GOC RM projects.

Working closely with Capacity Planners, Staffing Strategists, Talent Acquisition, HR and market teams, the Senior Manager will help ensure client demand is effectively resourced, workforce risks are proactively identified, and RM processes are consistently managed across the GOCs.

The role will act as a key operational partner to the GOC RM Lead, taking ownership of defined areas and escalating strategic, commercial or significant workforce decisions where required.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Global Client Resource Management
  • Own Resource Management for selected strategic global clients using GOC talent.
  • Support new global client opportunities and transitions, translating demand into clear resource requirements and staffing plans.
  • Coordinate staffing requirements across multiple GOC locations and disciplines.
  • Work with Capacity Planning and Staffing teams to identify appropriate resources and drive open requirements through to fulfilment.
  • Maintain oversight of the client's GOC workforce, including open roles, upcoming demand, resource movements, backfills and capacity risks.
  • Establish an effective RM cadence with relevant client and market stakeholders.
  • Proactively identify resource issues and drive actions to resolution.
  • Escalate significant commercial, capacity or stakeholder risks to the GOC RM Lead.
  1. Utilisation & Workforce Optimisation
  • Coordinate regular utilisation reviews across GOC teams.
  • Identify under-utilisation, over-utilisation and available capacity and work with relevant teams to agree appropriate actions.
  • Monitor utilisation trends and highlight emerging risks or opportunities.
  • Ensure actions from utilisation reviews are tracked through to completion.
  • Support proactive redeployment of available talent against suitable client demand.
  • Provide concise utilisation insights and exception reporting to the GOC RM Lead.
  1. Balanced Teams
  • Support regular reviews of team structures across GOC clients.
  • Identify opportunities to improve team balance, workload distribution and appropriate management oversight.
  • Work with RM, client and operational teams to address identified team structure or workload issues.
  • Monitor agreed actions and ensure they are followed through.
  • Highlight structural workforce issues requiring longer-term intervention.
  1. Bench Management & Redeployment
  • Own the ongoing coordination and governance of GOC bench activity.
  • Support the rollout of the existing bench framework across additional GOC locations.
  • Maintain visibility of available resources and actively connect relevant skills and capacity with upcoming client requirements.
  • Coordinate appropriate bench project opportunities where immediate billable deployment is not available.
  • Track bench movements and provide visibility of key risks, ageing cases and redeployment opportunities.
  • Work with relevant GOC stakeholders to ensure consistent adoption of the bench process.
  1. Resource Planning & Operational Support
  • Provide support on complex staffing requirements that require coordination across multiple markets, clients, disciplines or GOCs.
  • Assist Capacity Planners and Staffing teams with more complex resource challenges.
  • Monitor key staffing risks, blockers and ageing requirements and help drive them towards resolution.
  • Coordinate with Finance, Talent Acquisition, HR and other functions where additional support is required to fulfil resource needs.
  • Support workforce and capacity planning activities by ensuring emerging demand and supply risks are visible.
  1. RM Projects & Continuous Improvement
  • Own and deliver selected Resource Management projects and improvement initiatives.
  • Support the rollout of consistent RM practices across GOC locations.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify manual RM processes and improve ways of working.
  • Support improvements to RM reporting, dashboards and workforce visibility.
  • Lead agreed workstreams such as:
    • Bench management rollout
    • Balanced Teams
    • Utilisation governance
    • RM reporting and dashboards
    • Process standardisation
    • Skills and capability visibility

Skills & Experience

The successful candidate will ideally have:

  • Experience in Resource Management, People Operations, or a related area is desirable.
  • This is a hands-on role that requires someone who is motivated to make an impact, not simply tick boxes; it requires initiative, ownership and an appetite for challenge.
  • Strong communication, proactive, organisation and influencing skills.
  • Experience managing resource requirements across multiple clients, teams or geographies.
  • Good understanding of utilisation, capacity management and workforce deployment.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to convert workforce data into practical actions.
  • Strong stakeholder-management skills and confidence working with senior stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and drive actions to completion.
  • Experience delivering cross-functional projects or process improvements.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a practical, solutions-focused approach.
  • Ability to operate independently while recognising when issues require senior escalation.

What Success Looks Like

The Senior Manager will be successful when:

  • Selected global clients have clear, proactive RM ownership.
  • Complex staffing requirements are driven to resolution without requiring continuous intervention from the GOC RM Lead.
  • Utilisation and balanced-team reviews result in clear actions and follow-through, rather than simply reporting.
  • Bench capacity is visible and actively managed across GOCs.
  • RM initiatives are delivered consistently across locations.
  • Capacity Planning and Staffing teams have an effective senior operational escalation point.
  • Major workforce risks are identified early and escalated with clear recommendations.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits 

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.  

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.  

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.  Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country. 

Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location

descriptionHtml:
Ben jij een Manager of Senior Manager met een focus op Commercial Excellence en ben jij klaar voor de volgende stap? Ben je op zoek naar een club waar ondernemerschap en groei centraal staan? Mis je de ruimte om echt impact te maken in je huidige rol? Spreekt groei en het meewerken aan innovatieve ontwikkelingen je aan? Dan is dit dé vacature voor jou!

Met meer dan 900 getalenteerde collega's die echt verandering en uitdagingen omarmen, hebben we een unieke "high-daring", "high-caring" cultuur gecreëerd, die buitengewone mensen aantrekt en hen inspireert om de grenzen voor zichzelf en onze klanten te verleggen. Wij geloven dat de optimale werkomgeving gelijkwaardig is en stellen duidelijke doelen om gendergelijkheid te versnellen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior Manager Retail & Products ben je dé gesprekspartner voor bestuurders in de retail, FMCG, (maak)industrie, logistiek en groothandel die hun commerciële organisatie naar een hoger niveau willen tillen: meer groei uit dezelfde markt, de juiste prijs per klant, kanaal en moment, en een salesorganisatie die structureel wint. Van uiteenlopende projecten gefocust op het aangescherpen van groeistrategieën tot Smart Pricing & Revenue Management en Sales Excellence met de bijbehorende capabilities: jij zet de koers uit en zorgt dat die landt.

Daarvoor werk je met multidisciplinaire teams uit strategieconsulting, data & AI, technologie en organisatorische en digitale transformatie. Zo combineer je scherpe commerciële analyses met de data, tools en verandering die nodig zijn om de groei ook echt te realiseren.

Als senior manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor grote klanttrajecten en een vertrouwde sparringpartner op C-level. Je bouwt accounts uit, ziet de volgende vraag van de klant al aankomen en zet die om in nieuwe opdrachten. Daarbij krijg je alle vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid, zowel voor het project als voor de accountontwikkeling.

Daarnaast bouw je mee aan het Retail & Products-team zelf: je ontwikkelt onze Commercial Excellence-proposities, helpt collega’s groeien en bent een drijvende kracht achter onze verdere gezamenlijke groei.

Wat betekent dit voor jou?
Je komt te werken bij een Great Place to Work met zeer tevreden medewerkers en klanten (NPS > 65; ruim boven het marktgemiddelde). Bovendien realiseren we groei met dubbele cijfers en hebben we onze blik stevig gericht op verdere uitbreiding. We zitten met onze eigen succesvolle transformatie midden in een spannend avontuur! · Afgeronde universitaire master.

· Minimaal 8 jaar relevante werkervaring, waarvan meerdere jaren in strategie en digital consulting.

· Sterke management- en communicatievaardigheden; je weet stakeholders te verbinden en C-levelklanten te activeren.

· Sterk analytisch vermogen en conceptueel denken.

· Diepgaande kennis van Commercial Excellence.

· Een groot netwerk in de Retail, Industriële, Logistieke, Groothandel en/of FMCG-sector.

· Je ontwikkelt geavanceerde businessmodellen en langetermijnstrategieën.

· Ondernemende instelling en drive om verandering en groei te realiseren – zowel bij onze klanten als binnen onze eigen organisatie.

Wat we jou bieden:

· Een mooie kans om een actieve bijdrage te leveren aan de verdere groei van de organisatie.

Waarom IG&H?

IG&H helpt toonaangevende bedrijven in de sectoren Gezondheid, Retail & Products en Financial Services te transformeren. Samen met onze technologiepartners van wereldklasse helpen we onze klanten vooruit en blijven we relevant. Met inzichtelijk advies, mooie designs en ongeëvenaarde digitale platforms. Onze uitzonderlijke resultaten komen voort uit het succesvol op elkaar afstemmen van mensen, bedrijfsprocessen en technologie. title: Senior Manager Revenue Accouting
descriptionHtml:
Help make the world more hospitable

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

You’ll own the technical accounting behind how Mews recognises revenue across SaaS, fintech and financial services, and set the standard the wider finance team works to. This role exists because our revenue streams are getting more varied, and every new product, pricing model or payment flow needs a clear, controlled accounting answer before it goes live. You’ll make those calls across all Mews entities and geographies, with the autonomy to shape how it’s done.

Part 1: You’ll lead revenue accounting close, reconciliations and technical conclusions, and manage two revenue accounting team members. You’ll work day to day with Product, Payments, Engineering, Billing and Finance Systems.
