  • Own the application of ASC 606 and IFRS 15 across the organisation, including principal-versus-agent, multiple-element arrangements and variable consideration, and set the revenue recognition policies that follow from it.

  • Build and strengthen revenue controls and SOX readiness, from source and billing systems through to the general ledger, and lead audit requests and remediation.
  • Lead, coach and develop two revenue accounting team members, and drive close automation with BlackLine and controlled, AI-enabled validation of revenue data with proper review and audit trails.

What you would bring

title: Senior Mechatronic System Architect | Medical Robotics (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Senior Mechatronic System Architect | Medical Robotics (m/f/d)

Location: Maastricht, Aachen, and Eindhoven region, working mainly on-site with our development partner in Maastricht. Regular travel to Hamburg and to clinical sites, about 2 to 4 days per month.

Reports to: CTO

About the venture: ROB'E

ROB'E is a Hamburg-based medtech startup and part of the NLC Health Ventures portfolio. We are developing a robotic system that holds and steers a standard transesophageal echocardiography (TEE) probe during structural heart interventions. Interventionalists get stable, reproducible echo views, and echocardiographers no longer have to stand next to the patient in the X-ray field.

Our first-generation prototype has been used in a first-in-human study with published results. We are now developing the next generation from scratch as a fully compliant medical device for CE marking and FDA clearance. The team includes a CTO, a System Software Architect and a Head of Quality & Regulatory.

The role

You are the mechatronic design authority of ROB'E. You own the system architecture, the hardware requirements and the technical decisions for the mechanics, drives, sensing and electronics of our robot. You work on site with our engineering development partner in the Maastricht area and steer their team on our behalf. This is a hands-on senior role: you design yourself, review the work of others and make sure the hardware is safe, verifiable and ready for design transfer.

Responsibilities

  • Define and own the mechatronic system architecture: robotic device, drives, force and torque sensing, real-time controllers, safety supervisor, power supply and the interface to commercial TEE probes.
  • Translate user and system requirements into subsystem and interface specifications and keep them traceable through verification.
  • Act as technical counterpart to our engineering development partner, from ideation, technology and part selection through design reviews and approval of design outputs. Challenge cost and effort and make the make-or-buy call per subsystem.
  • Work closely with the System Software Architect on the hardware/software split, real-time control, and safety architecture.
  • Drive the hardware contribution to risk management (ISO 14971), including design FMEA and risk control measures.
  • Plan and lead hardware verification, pre-compliance and full compliance testing for electrical safety and EMC (IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-1-2) with external test houses.
  • Contribute hardware documentation to the design history file and technical documentation under our ISO 13485 quality system.
  • Build prototypes for verification, usability studies and clinical evaluation, together with suppliers and the development partner.
  • Design for cost and manufacturability from the start and prepare the transfer to series production.

What you bring

Must have

  • MSc or PhD in mechatronics, mechanical, electrical or systems engineering.
  • At least 8 years of hardware development experience, including at least 3 years as a system architect or lead engineer.
  • Hands-on development of active medical devices through design controls, from concept to verified design.
  • Practical experience with IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-1-2 and ISO 14971, and working knowledge of ISO 13485 and MDR.
  • Strong background in motion systems: drives, transmissions, encoders, force/torque sensing and motion safety.
  • Experience steering external engineering partners or suppliers, including technical reviews and cost control.
  • Fluent in English and comfortable working in a small, fast moving startup team.

Nice to have

  • Experience with medical robotics, catheter or endoscope handling, or image guided intervention systems.
  • Knowledge of cleanable and reprocessable device design and single use interface components.
  • Dutch or German language skills.

What we offer

  • A key role in a clinically validated medtech venture, with real influence on the product and the company.
  • Close collaboration with interventional cardiologists and direct exposure to the cath lab.
  • Permanent employment with a competitive salary and an employee stock option plan.
  • A lean, senior team with short decision paths.

Why Join ROB’E?

  • Build a category-defining MedTech company from an early stage
  • Work directly with experienced physician-founders
  • Take ownership across strategy, product, and company building
We would love to hear from exceptional individuals who are excited about building a company at the intersection of AI, robotics, and cardiovascular medicine.

Mews has strong stories and data to offer, and this role exists so that someone owns that conversation: choosing the right journalist for each story, answering inbound questions quickly and accurately, and knowing when to escalate something sensitive. title: Senior Multiphysics R&D Engineer (Electro-mechanical)
descriptionHtml:
With over 140 years of Swiss engineering heritage, Sécheron Hasler Group is a global leader in high-power electrical and electronic equipment. Our solutions power railways, renewable energy, DC and AC networks, and industrial systems worldwide trusted for their precision, reliability, and innovation.

At the heart of modern rail infrastructure, our Traction Power Systems unit delivers cutting-edge DC and AC traction substations, protection systems, power conversion and digital monitoring solutions. Join us to shape the future of sustainable mobility with technology that keeps cities and countries moving. For the expansion of our team, we are seeking to hire in Geneva a dynamic and motivated Senior R&D Engineer.

As a Senior Multiphysics R&D Engineer, you will be involved with the R&D team in the development of cutting-edge high-speed switching devices such as high-speed DC circuit breakers, contributing to the full product lifecycle: from design to application.

You will work at the intersection of electrical and mechanical engineering, bringing expertise in power electronics, dielectrics and thermal advanced modeling, playing a key role in shaping the future of medium voltage switching technology.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to innovative R&D projects focused on high-speed circuit breakers and related switching technologies.
  • Design and simulate electrical switching systems using MATLAB/Simulink, COMSOL MultiPhysics including electromagnetic, thermal, material science and dielectric behavior.
  • Define and execute test plans for prototypes, including dielectric, thermal, and mechanical validation.
  • Interface with cross-functional teams including mechanical, electrical and electronics engineers.
  • Collaborate with manufacturing teams to optimize material processing and industrialization.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical strategy and innovation roadmaps.
  • Contribute to patent filings, technical documentation, and compliance with IEC/IEEE standards.
  • Develop and validate electronic control boards for switching and protection systems.

Requirements

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in R&D for low voltage and/or medium voltage electric equipment.
  • Good understanding of Railway protection systems – Modern DC microgrids.
  • English fluent mandatory, French strong plus.
  • Master’s or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, Applied Physics or similar.
  • Strong understanding of electro-mechanical and magnetic systems.

Strong plus:

  • Experience with testing and validation in high-voltage environments.
  • Knowledge of High-speed DC circuit breakers.

Plus:

  • Good knowledge in power electronics switching devices.
  • Thermal and dielectric analysis.
  • Modeling and simulation in MATLAB/Simulink - COMSOL.
  • Material processing and manufacturing techniques.
  • Electronic board design and integration.
  • CAD 3D design tools (SolidWorks).
  • Curious, attentive to detail, team player.

Benefits

We foster flat hierarchies and direct communication, enabling quick decisions and strong collaboration across all levels. You’ll be trusted with real responsibility and encouraged to take initiative, with plenty of opportunities to grow both personally and professionally.

title: Senior Operations Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Kurz und knapp

Bei Picnic betreiben wir einige der modernsten teilautomatisierten Fulfillment Center (FC) für Lebensmittel Europas - mit einer Mischung aus Robotik, smarter Software und einer People-First-Kultur. Mit über 3.000 EPVs (Electric Picnic Vehicle) liefern wir in über 100 deutschen Städten täglich Lebensmittel aus. Unsere jüngste Investment Runde, an der auch die Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation beteiligt ist, zeigt das Vertrauen in unser Konzept. Als Senior Operations Manager (m/w/d) in unserem FC in Falkensee spielst du eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Sicherstellung der Zufriedenheit unserer KundInnen und Mitarbeitenden.

Sei von Anfang an dabei: Im August 2027 eröffnen wir unser neues teilautomatisiertes FC in Falkensee. Du kannst aber schon früher bei uns starten und dein Onboarding an einem unserer bestehenden Standorte absolvieren - zum Beispiel in unserem manuellen FC in Ludwigsfelde oder unserem vollautomatisierten FC in Oberhausen. So bekommst du einen umfassenden Einblick in unsere Operations und bist bestens vorbereitet, wenn wir in Falkensee an den Start gehen.

Das erwartet dich 

  • Wertstromanalyse: Du leitest Wertstromanalysen zur Ermittlung des Ist-Zustandes von Prozessen, analysierst wertschöpfende und nicht wertschöpfende Tätigkeiten und entwickelst Pläne für den Soll-Zustand, um Prozessverbesserungen voranzutreiben.
  • Projektarbeit: Du entwickelst und setzt Strategien zur Rationalisierung von Arbeitsabläufen um, beseitigst Engpässe und steigerst die Gesamteffizienz von Prozessen innerhalb von Wertströmen.
  • Datenanalyse: Mit ausgeprägter Datenanalyse- und Problemlösungskompetenz identifizierst und behebst du Prozessprobleme.
  • Change Management: Du förderst eine Kultur der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, indem du Lean-Methoden einsetzt, Problemlösungs-Workshops moderierst und funktionsübergreifende Teams befähigst, Prozessverbesserungen selbst zu identifizieren und umzusetzen.
  • Teamleitung: Mit natürlichen Führungsqualitäten förderst du Bottom-up-Engagement und die tägliche Einbindung der Produktionsstätten und Mitarbeitenden, um Kaizen und kontinuierliche Verbesserung voranzutreiben.
  • Verbesserung: Du zeigst eine konsequente Haltung zu den 5S-Prinzipien (Sauberkeit, Organisation usw.) und bringst Erfahrung in der Schulung, im Coaching und in der Umsetzung dieser Verbesserungsstandards mit.
  • Schichtleitung: Übernimm einmal pro Woche die Schichtleitung mit 150+ Lagermitarbeitenden, um weiterhin nah an unseren Operations zu sein.

Das bringst du mit

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium, vorzugsweise im Ingenieurwesen oder Lieferkettenmanagement.
  • 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in großen Lager Betrieben mit, vorzugsweise im Bereich der Automatisierung.
  • Praktische Erfahrung im Bereich Lean Management und/oder Wertstromdesign, einschließlich einschlägiger Zertifizierungen.
  • Außergewöhnliche Führungsqualitäten, mit einer Erfolgsbilanz bei der Motivierung und Führung von Teams zur Erzielung herausragender Ergebnisse.
  • Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten, kompetent im Umgang mit Datenanalysetools wie Tableau und Excel.
  • Praktische Mentalität, die Ideen in die Tat umsetzt und mit gutem Beispiel vorangeht, um den Erfolg zu fördern.
  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Starte durch - mit uns: Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.
  • Nachhaltigkeit als Kern: Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und eine Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.
  • Die Basics: Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit – inklusive Laptop und Handy sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Mitarbeiter-Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.
  • Zeit zum Auftanken: Mit 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche) sorgst du für den perfekten Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Erholung.
  • Verpflegung für Gewinner: Wir kümmern uns um dich. Genieße jeden Tag ein frisches, kostenloses Frühstück und Mittag- oder Abendessen in unserem Fulfilment Center, dazu gibt es reichlich Snacks und Obst für den Energiekick zwischendurch.
  • Unvergessliche Momente: Wir sind mehr als nur ein Team. Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.
  • Wohlbefinden & Gleichgewicht: Wir bieten dir professionelle Unterstützung für deine mentale Gesundheit mit OpenUp.
  • Individuelle Mobilität: Du erhältst einen Firmenwagen (auch zur privaten Nutzung) und kannst zusätzlich unser „Lease-a-Bike“-Programm nutzen. Kostenlose Parkplätze an den Picnic Standorten stehen dir zur Verfügung.

title: Senior Partner Account Executive, UK - Insurance
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role:

We are looking for a strategic and results-driven Senior Partner Account Executive to launch, scale, and optimise partnerships across our ecosystem with a focus on insurance carriers and brokers. Samsara's telematics and dashcam technology already help thousands of customers improve safety and reduce risk - this role will accelerate those benefits by developing high-impact partnerships that drive mutual growth.

You will be the face of Samsara to insurance executives, building scalable programmes that directly influence customer acquisition, retention, and loss cost improvement. If you thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments, are motivated by measurable business impact, and enjoy turning ideas into reality, this is your opportunity to make a difference.

Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

In this role you will:

  • Own and grow our relationships with insurance carriers, brokers and MGAs in the UK
  • Design and run partner programmes that drive customer acquisition, retention and loss-cost improvement - and the Samsara revenue that comes with them
  • Map accounts with partners, pick joint targets and bring Samsara sales into the deals
  • Build the playbook: how we qualify, onboard and scale insurance partnerships

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact - helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your partners are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live. Samsara's top employees do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You want to develop the playbook, not just follow one: Our partner ecosystem is young. You'll define how we take partners to value - from first conversation to joint customers - and build the model that lets those partnerships deliver maximum value for Samsara at scale.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your partners and our customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Strong sales, partnerships, or business development experience, ideally within a B2B technology or insurance-related field and a track record of overachievement.
  • A builder mentality - you thrive in ambiguous environments and know how to create structure, process, and scale.
  • Exceptional relationship management skills, with experience engaging stakeholders from the C-suite to front-line sales teams.
  • A strategic and data-driven mindset, using insights to optimise programmes and drive revenue.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to lead multiple initiatives simultaneously.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working in or with insurance carriers, brokers, or related financial services.
  • Consulting experience, ideally working with insurance companies.

Why Join Samsara?

  • Make an impact: Your work will directly improve safety, efficiency, and sustainability in industries that power the global economy.
  • Work with the best: Join a high-performance, mission-driven team that values collaboration, innovation, and results.
  • Grow with us: We're scaling rapidly, which means new challenges, learning opportunities, and career advancement.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Senior Producer
descriptionHtml:
Scopely is looking for a Senior Producer to join the Live Game organisation supporting the MONOPOLY GO! team. This role is remote within the UK and will support our Barcelona and Sevilla hubs.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and strive to inspire play every day—through our work alongside talented colleagues and through our connection with millions of players around the world.

MONOPOLY GO! is one of Scopely’s flagship mobile free-to-play franchises and one of the largest games in the mobile industry. 

With teams distributed across Barcelona, Sevilla, the United States, and other global locations, this role requires strong production leadership, excellent communication, and exceptional attention to detail.

About the Role

As a Senior Producer within the Live Game organization, you will oversee development across one or more live game workstreams, helping transform product strategy and creative goals into high-quality player experiences.

You will manage development from early planning and team alignment through implementation, integration, QA, release, and live support. This includes coordinating concurrent initiatives, managing complex dependency chains, driving change request flow, and ensuring teams remain focused on delivering meaningful player and business outcomes.

This is a hands-on, in-the-weeds production role requiring both strategic thinking and tactical execution. You will work closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Art, Content, Economy, QA, Localization, Analytics, Live Operations, and Release Management to deliver at the pace and quality expected of a global mobile live-service game.

What You Will Do

  • Own the end-to-end production lifecycle for assigned Live Game development workstreams, from discovery and planning through development, release, and post-launch support.
  • Manage multiple concurrent initiatives with shared teams, resources, dependencies, and shifting priorities.
  • Translate product strategy and roadmap objectives into clear, executable development plans.
  • Build and maintain integrated schedules, milestone plans, critical paths, risk registers, and dependency maps.
  • Coordinate development across Product, Game Design, Engineering, Art, Content, Economy, QA, Localization, Analytics, Live Operations, and Release Management.
  • Establish clear DRIs, requirements, acceptance criteria, decision points, and delivery expectations for major initiatives.
  • Manage the complete mobile live-service development lifecycle, including design alignment, implementation, configuration, integration, QA validation, release readiness, live activation, and post-launch follow-up.
  • Partner with Live Operations and Release Management to ensure development work is compatible with the LiveOps calendar, release cadence, player priorities, and operational requirements.
  • Lead the change request process by assessing the impact of proposed changes on scope, schedule, capacity, quality, risk, and downstream dependencies.
  • Drive prioritization and decision-making around change requests, communicate approved changes clearly, and ensure plans and systems remain aligned with the latest direction.
  • Proactively identify blockers, bottlenecks, gaps in ownership, and risks to delivery. Resolve issues directly where possible and escalate with clear recommendations when necessary.
  • Facilitate milestone reviews, sprint planning, production checkpoints, risk reviews, and cross-functional working sessions.
  • Ensure meetings result in clear decisions, owners, deadlines, and follow-through.
  • Maintain accurate and current project information across Jira, Airtable, Confluence, and other production systems.
  • Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, decisions, and delivery confidence clearly to both senior leadership and development teams across the Barcelona and Sevilla hubs.
  • Partner with Live Operations after launch to support issue triage, player-impacting investigations, post-launch actions, and continuous improvement.
  • Use player data, team feedback, and operational insights to inform prioritization and improve future development planning.

title: Senior Product Analyst, Trust and Safety
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Parcel delivery has a quality problem the industry has learned to live with. Parcels go missing between depots. Parcels get marked as delivered and never reach the customer. Most carriers treat a steady rate of loss as a cost of doing business. Relay is building the delivery company where that stops being true.

That is harder for us than for most, because nearly everyone who touches a Relay parcel is an independent partner. We can't manage them into performance. We have to build the standards, the evidence and the product that make doing the job well the natural outcome. Engineering builds the product changes you design.

Partner Excellence Highlights

  • You own decision-making, not the model: you decide which signals count, which checks become rules, and whether each fix belongs in product, policy or training. The squad lead acts on your calls.

  • Most of a parcel's journey happens between scans. How do you prove a handover happened without making the job slower for the people doing it?

  • A delivery is marked complete and the customer says it never came. How do you tell a wrong address from a handover that went wrong, and put the fix where it belongs: product, policy or training?

  • Some checks can only answer "can't tell". Which are worth making provable, and which should we stop measuring?

  • A whole area, not a slice: you decide what evidence a whole network runs on, and the result is on the street the next morning.

  • Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Product Analyst, Trust and Safety at Relay, you'll:

  • Decide which Partner Excellence problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

  • Design how Partner Excellence decides: which signals count, what evidence the network runs on, and what good looks like.

  • Tell the squad lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

  • Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

  • Go and look when the data and the street disagree: the sort centre, the van, the shop.

  • Get the missing data built, and prove which fixes worked. In a year, the squad can prove every handover in the network.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Have owned fraud, risk or trust decisions end to end: turned investigations into rules, standards or interventions, and owned their number, such as the false positive rate you were held to, rather than building the model.

  • Have run investigations in fraud, risk, financial crime or trust and safety, and decided whether a signal was real or noise.

  • Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or engineers built what you asked for.

  • Have worked somewhere with enough volume for a false positive rate to mean something, where your rules ran live and something happened when they were wrong.

  • Have got records created by teams who didn't report to you, and know how long it takes.

  • Are hands-on and fluent in SQL, with or without AI, and would rather ship a working answer this week than a perfect one next quarter. No logistics experience needed, just the appetite to learn a physical operation fast.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

title: Senior Product Data Scientist

Your opportunity:

AI is shifting how the best products get built. The handoffs between product, design, and engineering are slowing us down. The companies moving fastest are doing it with people who own the full loop, from the user problem to the shipped feature, without losing the thread.

At Taxfix, we’re rebuilding our R&D organization around this idea. We call these people builders.

A Builder has a primary craft, one they’re genuinely excellent at, but they don’t stop there. They stretch across product, design, and engineering as the situation demands, using AI to cover the gaps. They’re accountable to outcomes, not job descriptions.

Taxfix has put €5 billion back into our customers’ pockets and we aren’t stopping there. We operate in Germany, Spain, and the UK, and we’re in the middle of a genuine AI transformation in how we build and how we’re organized.

Assume there’s no designer to give you a Figma file. No engineer to hand the spec to. The magic is knowing what to build, why, and in what order, then making it happen. If building the thing sounds more natural to you than describing it, this role is for you.

 

Your responsibilities and decisions:

  • Take a user problem from rough idea to shipped product. Write the brief, design the flow, prototype it, and get it in front of users, with as few handoffs as possible. Own the full loop.

  • Compress research, synthesis, and spec-writing from weeks into hours. You reach for AI tools not because you’ve been asked to, but because they faster make you faster in delivering high quality outcome. You know when to trust the output, when to edit it, and when to reject it. Use AI as a force multiplier.

  • You structure fuzzy problems, identify what should and shouldn’t be built, and move forward when there are dozens of possible directions. The magic is in the trade-offs, not the feature list. Turn ambiguous ideas into things users can trust.

  • You collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders on AI-related product work, translating AI concepts, capabilities, limitations, and outputs into clear product decisions. You work effectively in hybrid human-AI teams. Work in small, focused teams.

  • You know the metric your team is trying to move. You measure your week by what changed in user behaviour, not by how many tickets moved to Done. Be accountable to outcomes, not roadmaps.

  • You give feedback directly, to anyone, regardless of level. You raise blockers early and in the open. Push back when something’s wrong. Team player who raises the bar.

 

Your profile:

Your craft

  • 5+ years experience in Product Management (ideally in fintech or B2B). You’ve shipped things that real people use, and you can point to the metric that moved when you did.

  • Understand implicitly the product development process - from discovery, to user research to experimentation. You are able to build and defend a compelling strategy that solves user needs.

  • You have a builder track record: you’ve made things with AI, not just written specs about them. Shipped products, agent workflows, or tools real users have touched. Any of these count whether at work or in your personal life.

  • You’re AI-native by default. You use tools like Claude, Cursor, Lovable, or similar regularly. You follow the AI product space closely and you know the difference between a demo and something production-ready.

  • You’ve built personal AI workflows that make you meaningfully faster. You know when to trust AI output, when to edit it, and when to reject it.

  • You’ve gone from user problem to testable prototype without waiting for a brief to be written for you. The output was good enough that a team shipped from it.

  • Low PM baggage: you’re not attached to how product management "should" be done. You care about outcomes, not territory.

  • When designing and shipping AI-enabled products, you consider privacy, safety, fairness, transparency, bias, and accountability. You assess when AI-generated outputs are appropriate for use and raise concerns when risks or limitations are identified.

Your range

  • Across all three disciplines, you can hold your own: in Product you can identify opportunities, assess impact, and prioritize ruthlessly. In Design, you have taste: you know when something looks right but feels wrong. In Engineering, you’ve used AI coding tools to build something real, and you’re not dependent on an engineer to tell you why it’s broken.

How you work

  • Data fluency: you know the metric you were trying to move, and you can say whether you moved it, with healthy skepticism about what metrics do and don’t tell you.

  • You believe in experimentation and ship with velocity to learn quickly. You know your way around AB tests and are excited to try new data science models to learn faster.

  • You’ve worked on products where getting it wrong has real consequences for real people, and that raised your bar, not lowered it.

  • You’ve found a way through blockers rather than waiting to be unblocked. When something was genuinely impossible, you documented why and moved on.

  • You bring an entrepreneurial and independent mindset. You are excited about spotting opportunities and then acting on them.

This role is not for you if…

  • You’re not genuinely excited about being able to stretch across design and engineering functions.

  • You’ve never built an AI prototype and/or shipped code, side projects count.

  • You pride yourself in what you delivered rather than its impact

  • You need certainty, a full brief, or someone else’s research to get started.

  • You don’t believe in fast learning and getting things into customers hands early and use

 

Why Taxfix?

  • Shape the business proposition: Define what Talk360's business offer is and how it's priced, together with our commercial teams.

  • Learn from customers continuously: Use interviews, surveys, support tickets and app store reviews to turn pains into a ranked opportunity roadmap.

  • Experiment fast: Ship small bets, A/B test the journeys that matter, observe real world behaviour and turn results into roadmap decisions.

  • Lead delivery: Work in an agile Product & Tech team; keep scope tight, priorities clear and releases flowing.

  • AI-native execution: Use AI across discovery, specs, analysis and prototyping, and help shape how the team builds with AI.

  • Partner across the business: Work with Revenue, Marketing, Support and Data on go-to-market, acquisition, retention and the metrics that show we're winning.

The Team

You'll join a lean Product & Engineering team where product, design, mobile, web, backend, VoIP and QA work closely together. No silos, no layers: turn a customer insight on Monday into a live experiment by Friday.


What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years in product management, including owning a product line or new proposition end to end.

  • A track record of scaling a product from early traction, with commercial results to show.

  • Hands-on experience with B2B, SMB or prosumer products; telecoms is a plus.

  • Strong discovery skills: customer interviews, research synthesis and jobs-to-be-done thinking.

  • Experimentation fluency: A/B testing, product analytics (Mixpanel or similar) and data analysis and data-driven decision making.

  • Experience optimising MAU, ARPU, LTV, retention and conversion, with the business acumen to make strategic and tactical calls.

  • Experience leading agile, cross-functional mobile product teams, with the technical depth to discuss trade-offs with engineers.

  • Active, daily use of AI across your product workflow: research, analysis, specs and prototyping.


Who you are

  • Growth mindset: You're energised by building a playbook that doesn't exist yet.

  • Ambitious and pragmatic: You aim for 100 but ship the smallest thing that proves the next step.

  • Owner: You act without waiting for permission and own outcomes, not output.

  • Customer-obsessed: You'd rather talk to five customers than debate one assumption.

  • Clear communicator: You align engineers, leadership and partners around one simple story.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity: You make good calls on imperfect data and kill what isn't working, even your own ideas.

  • You're based in or moving to The Netherlands and can be in our office three days a week.


Recruitment process

  1. First call: A short intro call with our recruiter.

  2. Hiring manager interview: A deep dive into your experience with our Head of Product.

  3. Case study: Present a practical Calling for Work challenge to the team at our office.

  4. Meet the CEO.

  5. Reference check

  6. Offer

What You Get

Competitive compensation

  • 77,000 - 90,000 euros per year all-in gross

Learning and growth

  • €1,500 annual personal development budget, plus access to company-wide training sessions to keep learning and evolving.

Time to recharge

  • 25 vacation days

  • Option to swap two public holidays per year for days that better reflect your culture or beliefs

  • Recharge Fridays, unlocked when team targets are met (we’ll tell you more during the interview)

Work from anywhere

  • As a global and diverse team, we encourage you to work from another city or country for up to 2 weeks per year, gain fresh perspectives and spark new ideas.

A team you’ll actually want to be part of

  • Weekly team lunch every Thursday

  • Regular team moments and outings

  • An international and diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond

Set up for success

  • Company laptop and all the tools you need to do your best work

  • Monthly phone allowance and commuting allowance

An environment to grow and make impact

  • A collaborative environment where you can learn from others, take ownership, and contribute to a meaningful mission.

About Talk360

Talk360 has grown into a global communications platform connecting more than 6 million people worldwide. We've successfully spun off our payments business into NjiaPay, stepped into the gap left by Skype, and built a profitable, sustainable business.

We're now expanding beyond our own consumer app through our SDK, enabling partners to integrate Talk360's calling infrastructure directly into their own products.

Our ambition is simple: To become the world's most trusted way to call any phone number.

title: (Senior) Product Manager - Customer Taxation (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

Raisin helps customers grow their wealth through savings and investments without barriers. But even the best products and the smoothest experience lose their value if customers pay more tax than they need to, or have to work out, declare and settle their taxes themselves. The Customer Taxation Team makes sure they don’t.  We design how tax works in Raisin’s tax-advantaged products, a growing part of our offer. Examples include the new Raisin Cash ISA in the UK and the Raisin Kinderdepot, a children’s investment account that uses the child’s tax allowances automatically. We also calculate and withhold tax on the interest and returns customers earn, handle their tax exemption orders and non-assessment certificates, and provide the annual tax documents they need for their tax return. And we send the tax reports that authorities require. 

Raisin is available in many European countries, each with its own tax rules and reporting duties. As new regulations come to our platform, we make sure Raisin complies. You will lead a cross-functional team and work closely with Legal, Compliance, Country Management, Product Operations, Customer Service, Data, and external tax and banking partners. Our goal is for customers to trust that their tax is right, find it easy to manage, use the tax allowances they are entitled to, and have peace of mind.


Your Responsibilities

  • You will own a regulated domain that customers depend on every tax year. Working with an experienced Engineering Lead, you will become the go-to expert for customer taxation at Raisin.
  • Own customer taxation end to end: Define the vision and roadmap together with Product and Engineering leadership. Take each topic from discovery to delivery to measured impact. Decide what we build first, and keep stakeholders aligned on priorities, risks and trade-offs.
  • Keep tax accurate and reliable: Agree with Legal, Compliance and country managers on what correct looks like. Work with Engineering so calculation, documents and reporting stay stable and easy to extend.
  • Grow Raisin’s tax proposition: Shape how tax works when Raisin enters new markets, launches tax-advantaged products or brings on new partners. Find where we can take tax work off customers’ hands, so they don’t have to declare and settle it themselves.
  • Turn complex rules into simple experiences: Translate the  tax rules behind each launch into clear requirements with the edge cases covered. Design the customer experience and see the work through to delivery.
  • Hit the deadlines that cannot move: Make sure annual tax documents and statutory reports go out correct and on time, working with Product Operations. Plan backwards from fixed dates and monitor data quality.
  • Catch errors before they reach customers, and escalate early when a date is at risk.
  • Make tax effortless for customers: Keep self-service for tax exemption orders and non-assessment certificates intuitive, so customers get them right the first time. Give Customer Service the tools to answer tax questions fast, especially around tax season.
  • Shape the team culture: Give and ask for feedback openly, share wins with the team, and treat mistakes as a reason to fix the process.

Your Profile

Must haves:

  • 3+ years of product management experience, including ownership of a technical product such as a back-end, platform or data-heavy service.
  • Experience leading a cross-functional product team and getting engineers and stakeholders behind shared priorities.
  • Experience launching new products or taking products into new markets, with the precision to get every edge case right, because one wrong tax rule can affect thousands of customers.
  • Strong analytical skills and the habit of checking and reconciling numbers yourself.
  • Curiosity about tax and a drive to make it feel easy for customers, even when the rules behind it are not.
  • The ability to learn fast, take feedback well and change course when new facts come in.
  • Energy, a strong work ethic and a hands-on attitude to detailed work.
  • Clear, structured written English, and the confidence to explain trade-offs to senior leaders and say no with a reason.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience in a regulated field such as banking, payments, insurance or tax technology.
  • Strong knowledge of the tax regime in one or more of Raisin’s markets, for example Germany (Abgeltungsteuer, tax exemption orders), or of statutory reporting such as CRS. Tax knowledge is not required. We will teach you.
  • You have built tools for operations or customer service teams.

Important attributes for this role:

  • You bridge product and engineering. You are comfortable discussing data models and architecture trade-offs, and you push for practical solutions that scale.

Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!

At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.

As part of our team, you will benefit from

  • Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year.
  • Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days.
  • A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%.
  • Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month. 
  • Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidize with €25 per month.
  • Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs.
  • Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office.
  • You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation.

Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy

We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

  • Mitarbeiterbeteiligung – Über unser Beteiligungsprogramm profitierst du direkt vom Unternehmenswert. Wächst Silvernova, wächst dein Anteil mit.

  • Entwicklung & Perspektive – Du baust die Produktfunktion bei uns mit auf, mit der Perspektive, sie zu leiten und ein eigenes Team aufzubauen.

So geht es weiter

Uns interessieren deine konkreten Erfahrungen, Entscheidungen und Lernprozesse mehr als eine perfekte Vita. Bei den Bewerbungsfragen reichen Stichpunkte – und zeig uns gern etwas, das du selbst gebaut hast.

title: Senior Sales Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Fundamental XR builds VR and haptic training solutions for the med-tech, med-device, and pharma industries. We're VC-backed and our market position is unique.

We already work with some of the biggest names in the industry; Philips, Johnson & Johnson, AbbVie, Orbis, Abiomed, Vicarious Surgical, Novartis, and Allergan, among others.

Our target markets are pouring investment into VR, AR, XR, and AI right now. That timing, combined with warm accounts that have room to grow and large enterprise logos still
untapped, means the ceiling on this role is high.

Where we see this hire having a real impact

You'll help set the standard for how we sell. Your cadence, outreach approach, and account strategy will become the model others follow.

  • Generate your own pipeline. You'll be responsible for identifying, developing, and selling new business opportunities. We expect the successful candidate to have strong SDR fundamentals, tailored email, proficient on the phone and create bespoke LinkedIn outreach as well as building the confidence to work our target market in person at industry events.

  • Grow warm accounts. Take existing relationships with room to expand and turn them into larger, multi-stakeholder deals.

  • Open up untapped enterprise accounts. Using a ‘scalpel-selling’ approach, with focused, research-led targeting rather than relying on broader, generic outreach.

  • Run a consultative, complex sales process. With deals starting at $150,000 and scaling to $1m+, you'll be managing long sales cycles, multiple stakeholders, and technical/clinical buying committees and need to qualify opportunities through agreed frameworks (BANTC, MEDDPICC etc.).

  • Use data to drive and defend your strategy. You'll need to tell a clear, data-backed story of who you're targeting and why, spot when a channel or approach isn't working and pivot quickly, and double down, increasing cadence and investment on the tactics that prove fruitful.

  • Set the pace for the sales team. As a senior hire, you’ll need to get up to speed fast, develop and present outreach strategy within the first 30 days and execute that strategy

  • Collaborate with other teams. Following our new ‘Solution Sales’ process, where an SME / MedEd / PO is engaged early in customer conversations to appropriately understand customer requirements, define scope and liaising with CSM to define how business outcomes will be measured and articulated to client on live project

  • Strengthen the sales team culture by focusing on delivery and hands-on mentoring of junior team members.

  • Help review our sales software stack helping figure out what works for us, what software or services are critical and supporting the successful roll out

Who we think we be successful in this role

  • Proven track record closing complex, high-value deals (six figures and above), ideally in a solution-sale or enterprise environment.

  • Strong self-starter with genuine experience generating your own pipeline and not just working inbound leads.

  • Comfortable and effective with SDR-style outreach: cold email, LinkedIn, calling and event-based prospecting.

  • Experience selling into large enterprise or matrixed organisations, ideally med-tech, med-device, pharma, healthcare, or another regulated/technical market.

  • A creative, hypothesis-driven approach to sales - someone who tests new angles rather than defaulting to "how it's always been done."

  • Confidence operating without a fully mature playbook, and the drive to help build one.

  • Comfortable working with data and CRM reporting to justify targeting decisions, track what's working, and adjust cadence and channel mix based on results rather than instinct alone.

  • Excellent stakeholder management across clinical, procurement, and commercial buyers.

  • Experience driving smart adoption of available tools using agentic AI for persona and target company research, for example, delivering results faster and at greater scale.

What We Offer

  • Private healthcare with AXA for you and your family

  • A penthouse office in Farringdon with unlimited snacks and soft drinks

  • £250/year work-from-home budget to build a setup that works for you

About Coder

With Coder, enterprises can confidently evolve from human-only development to AI-assisted and autonomous workflows, without sacrificing security, compliance, or performance. Learn more at coder.com.

Interview process 

We believe that the interview process should be transparent, consistent, and enjoyable. We value your time and hope to complete the interview process in two to four weeks, if schedules allow. Through your interviews, you will meet a mix of individual contributors, managers, and senior leaders.

AI use during the interview process

As an AI company, Coder embraces the use of AI tools, and we want to be transparent about our expectations as you navigate our interview process.

Not permitted: Using AI assistance during conversational interviews.

Permitted: Using AI tooling for take-home assessments. Please flag where and to what extent it was used in your take-home. Your submission will not be penalized for using AI as long as it is done honestly.

Our use of AI in hiring

We use AI tools to help manage our recruitment process efficiently and fairly. Specifically:

  • Ashby and Brainerr help us review inbound applications by surfacing candidates who best match the role requirements we've defined. This tool does not make hiring decisions; it helps our team prioritize which applications to review first.

  • Granola takes notes during our interview calls so our team can focus on the conversation with you.

All hiring decisions are made by humans. Our team reviews applications, conducts interviews, and makes final selections. AI tools assist us but never replace human judgment, and these practices are conducted in compliance with applicable data protection, AI governance, and labor laws. Your data is not used to train AI models.

Dein Vorteil im Vertrieb: Du arbeitest mit vorqualifizierten Anfragen von Menschen, die bereits Interesse an dauerhafter Haarentfernung¹ haben. So kannst du direkt an ihren Wünschen anknüpfen und dich auf überzeugende Beratung und erfolgreiche Abschlüsse konzentrieren.

Die hairfree GmbH ist Marktführer für dauerhafte Haarentfernung¹ in der DACH-Region. Mit über 70 Standorten in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz sowie mehr als 100 Mitarbeitenden gehören wir zu den führenden Anbietern im Bereich ästhetischer Dienstleistungen.

Seit über 20 Jahren verbinden wir professionelle Beratung, innovative Behandlungskonzepte und echte Leidenschaft für Beauty. Unser Ziel ist es, Menschen zu einem neuen Hautgefühl zu verhelfen, sicher, individuell und mit höchstem Qualitätsanspruch.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Beraten und verkaufen: Du führst persönliche Beratungsgespräche, erkennst individuelle Bedürfnisse und gewinnst Kundinnen und Kunden für die passende Behandlung.

  • Vertragsabschlüsse erzielen: Du erklärst Angebote verständlich, beantwortest Fragen und führst Interessierte verbindlich bis zum Abschluss.

descriptionHtml:

To achieve this, we have developed the foundations of modern banking through core and payments technology which run natively in the cloud. What we are attempting is hard and means we need great people working together to build great technology.

Thought Machine’s Site Reliability Engineers are the guardians of mission-critical systems for the world's most influential financial institutions. As a member of our elite, globally distributed team, you'll be entrusted with running and maintaining the robust production infrastructure that powers our customers' cutting-edge Core Banking and Payments platforms. This is an opportunity to make a tangible impact on the global financial landscape while collaborating with brilliant minds to solve complex engineering challenges.

This role will be part of the Site Reliability Engineering team at Thought Machine HQ in London, tackling the challenges of automating complex fleet management operations, mentoring team members, promoting communities of best practice within engineering as well as designing operational processes that provide effective interfaces between Thought Machine and our SaaS customers.

The SRE team is deeply involved in tackling the technical challenges of executing Thought Machine’s growth ambitions - expect to be working with senior stakeholders in the organisation and with our customers, and working on programmes and initiatives that are critical to the success of the company.

Duties:

title: Senior Software Engineer, Add-Ons
descriptionHtml:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.
The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

addons.mozilla.org (AMO) is the foundation of the Firefox add-ons ecosystem. It’s a showcase for developers to publish and grow their extensions, and a place of discovery for millions of users who customize Firefox to make it their own. Behind the scenes are the DevHub which enables developers to manage their extensions. To manage the ecosystem there are a series of Reviewer tools and automated moderation systems. 

As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll bring a passion for crafting resilient systems that accelerate our review and moderation teams to provide a first-class experience for Add-on developers. You’ll work closely with engineers, reviewers, developer support, and Add-ons leadership to turn ideas into polished features, modernize the platform and its architecture, and see your work reach millions of people around the world.


What you’ll do: 
  • Deliver major features and architectural improvements across the Add-ons stack, including automated moderation pipelines, Reviewer tools, and DevHub.
  • Help establish and maintain engineering standards across areas such as code review, definition of done, production readiness, runbooks, incident response, on-call practices, coding conventions, and infrastructure as code.
  • Create robust observability systems and data-backed insights.
  • Provide peer feedback, share knowledge and help others grow.
  • Build and improve the systems that enable Add-ons engineering to safely develop, deploy, observe, and operate production services.
  • Improve our CI/CD pipelines using declarative, pipeline-as-code approaches that make changes reproducible, testable, and easy to review.
  • Deliver work iteratively using a visible backlog, short feedback cycles, retrospectives, and demonstrations to stakeholders.
  • Write clear technical documentation, including design notes, Architecture Decision Records, runbooks, and incident write-ups.
  • Work effectively in unfamiliar codebases, tracing requests and asynchronous jobs end-to-end to understand failures and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Collaborate with designers, product managers, QA, and community contributors to deliver end-to-end improvements.
  • Contribute in the open through pull requests, code reviews, and discussions.
  • Work on:
    • Feature development: submission flows, trust and safety signals, DevHub and Reviewer tools modernization.
    • AMO application systems: Work within our Python/Django, MySQL, React/TypeScript, and asynchronous processing systems.
    • Internal developer platforms: Create tools and paved paths that make it easier for teams to ship and operate software safely and consistently.
    • Team Process: Contribute to team ceremonies, execute process improvement, and provide feedback on team effectiveness. 
    • Engineering standards: Help make production readiness, testing, recoverability, documentation, and safe deployment part of the normal development lifecycle. 
    • Platform reliability: Deployments, monitoring, and incident response.

What you’ll bring: 

  • Strong hands-on experience building and maintaining production applications with Python/Django.
  • Experience operating and improving production software systems where reliability and safe delivery matter.
  • Strong experience with CI/CD systems and treating pipelines and infrastructure declaratively as code.
  • Experience designing or improving automated testing and deployment workflows, including integration testing and staged or progressive delivery.
  • Strong understanding of observability as an engineering discipline, including metrics, logging, tracing, service-level objectives, and actionable alerting.
  • Experience building or maintaining internal tools or platforms used by other engineering teams, with an understanding that internal systems have users, reliability expectations, roadmaps, and lifecycle considerations.
  • Experience defining or improving engineering practices such as code review standards, operational readiness, runbooks, incident response, on-call expectations, or definitions of done.
  • Ability to read and understand unfamiliar codebases and trace application behavior across frontend, backend, asynchronous jobs, data stores, and infrastructure.
  • Experience debugging complex production issues and turning what you learn into lasting system improvements.
  • Strong technical writing skills, with experience creating useful documentation such as design documents, ADRs, runbooks, and incident reports.
  • Experience working iteratively with a visible backlog, regular stakeholder feedback, and retrospectives that result in concrete improvements.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills in a distributed team environment.
  • A willingness to share knowledge and mentor peers in operational and reliability practices.
  • Commitment to our values:
    • Welcoming differences
    • Being relationship-minded
    • Practicing responsible participation
    • Having grit

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with Google Cloud and operating Kubernetes.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tooling and policy-as-code.
  • Experience establishing SLOs and error-budget-based reliability practices.
  • Experience with chaos engineering, disaster recovery testing, or production readiness reviews.
  • Experience with trust and safety, automated moderation, abuse prevention, or other adversarial systems.
  • Contributions to open source projects

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla 

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

title: Senior Software Engineer - Runtime Team
descriptionHtml:
PolyAI is the Agentic Dialog Platform for building the conversational enterprise, used to build, run, govern, and improve dialog agents at scale. Powered by Raven, a proprietary dialog model trained on more than a billion enterprise conversations, PolyAI agents are built for complexity, open at every layer, and sovereign by design. PolyAI serves hundreds of enterprises across 75 languages and 25 countries, including Metro Bank, Marriott, PG&E, and UniCredit.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Runtime team at PolyAI.  This team owns the core voice infrastructure that powers every call our AI agents handle - from the moment a phone rings to the moment it hangs up.

You'll work across the full real-time voice stack: telephony, real-time audio streaming and media handling, speech recognition and synthesis integration, LLM orchestration, turn-taking and voice activity detection, call recording, and the data pipeline that captures it all. We operate across AWS and Azure, serving enterprise customers at scale across multiple global regions.

What You'll Do:

  • Design and build features across the voice runtime - from new integrations with third-party contact centre platforms, to improving how our agents handle interruptions and overlapping speech, to scaling our infrastructure for higher call volumes.
  • Own services end-to-end: write code, review PRs from across the company, deploy to production, and support what you ship.
  • Debug complex, cross-service issues in production - the kind where a timing problem involves VAD thresholds, ASR transcription windows, LLM response latency, and audio playback all interacting at once.
  • Contribute to architecture decisions and design documents. The team has strong thought leadership on stateful vs stateless service boundaries, API design, and where responsibilities should live.
  • Collaborate with product facing teams who build on top of the runtime - helping them understand configuration, troubleshooting call behaviour, and unblocking their work.
  • Improve the developer experience: better defaults, less reliance on opaque config, more features controllable through the UI, and better test coverage.

What We're Looking For

Must have:

  • 4+ years of commercial software development experience.
  • Strong experience with real-time or latency-sensitive systems: streaming, media pipelines, networking, or similar domains where milliseconds matter.
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems: gRPC, state management across services, connection error recovery, and working with systems that must not drop calls.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure on AWS (EKS/Kubernetes, Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, Redis) - comfortable deploying containerised services and debugging infrastructure-level issues.
  • Strong written communication - design docs, PR reviews, and async debugging are core to how the team works.

Strong plus:

  • Experience with speech technologies: ASR, TTS, VAD, or end-of-turn detection — either integrating them or working on the systems around them.
  • Experience with Go - this is the primary language for our voice services. Most engineers on the team work across both Go and Python.
  • Experience with Python - parts of our LLM orchestration layer, serverless function runtime, and data pipeline are Python.
  • Prior work on LLM orchestration or agent frameworks: tool calling, function execution, prompt management, context window management, or conversation state machines.
  • Experience with data pipeline technologies: Kafka, ClickHouse, S3-based event stores, or similar.
  • Experience with observability at scale: Datadog, structured logging, SLO/SLI definition, and using metrics to drive reliability improvements.
  • Multi-cloud experience (Azure in addition to AWS).
  • Familiarity with VoIP/telephony (SIP, RTP) or WebRTC (STUN/TURN/ICE, media negotiation).

title: Senior Solutions Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Join Choco, where we build and own solutions that reshape a broken food system.

The global food supply chain is inefficient by design. Waste is high, margins are thin, and most distributor order processes are done over the phone, tracked across broad spreadsheets, and based on intuition rather than strong data.


At Choco, we’re changing that. We build software used daily by food distributors and their customers to run their business. It automates orders, reduces errors, and helps operations run faster and more reliably. Because it’s embedded in daily operations, our SaaS platform has immediate, real-world impact, on efficiency, margins, and how businesses run day to day.

Mission

As a Senior Solutions Engineer, you will deliver fast, reliable, API-driven integrations for our largest customers by translating business workflows into scalable, repeatable technical solutions. You will partner closely with Sales and Customer Success to deliver best-in-class integration experiences that drive adoption and long-term success. This role is primarily customer-facing, with a strong focus on solution design and customer outcomes rather than traditional software development. You'll build integrations primarily with low-code tools, using light scripting where needed.

What You’ll Do

  • Independently design, build, and deliver complex, scalable, and secure integrations between Choco and customer systems using low-code tools (e.g. n8n and Tray.ai).

  • Own complex and strategic integration projects end-to-end, from technical discovery and solution architecture to go-live, ensuring quality, scalability, and long-term reliability.

  • Partner with Account Executives in pre-sales by leading technical discovery, proofs of concept, and integration scoping, advising on feasibility and solution design for complex customer requirements.

  • Act as a technical escalation point, troubleshooting critical integration issues, proactively identifying risks, and driving sustainable solutions.

  • Collaborate closely with Customer Success, Implementation, and Product teams, providing technical guidance, documenting integration designs, and influencing product improvements based on customer needs.

  • Mentor junior Solutions Engineers, providing technical guidance, sharing expertise, and supporting their development through complex projects.

  • Drive continuous improvement of integration architecture, processes, and best practices to increase delivery efficiency, quality, and scalability globally.

  • Independently make technical and architectural decisions within complex projects, escalating only major strategic decisions requiring broader alignment.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in solutions engineering, IT/ERP consulting, or systems integration.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Experience managing end-to-end API integrations, including requirements gathering, solution design, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing support across multiple customer environments.

  • Experience with low-code or automation tools such as n8n, Zapier, and Tray.ai.

  • Basic programming knowledge (e.g. JavaScript or Python) and working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON/XML, webhooks, authentication (OAuth, API keys), and data mapping.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a collaborative, solution-focused mindset.

  • Excellent communicator with the ability to make complex ideas clear and simple.

  • This position requires in-office attendance 3 days per week in our Paris office.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with the ERP or ordering systems common among food and beverage distributors.

  • Background in food distribution, supply chain, or B2B SaaS.

  • Familiarity with EDI, SFTP/flat-file integrations, or basic SQL.

  • Comfort using AI tools to speed up discovery, documentation, and integration builds.

What you get

  • Work on digitalizing core operating systems for food distributors, automating orders, sales and payments in a system that still largely runs on calls and spreadsheets.

  • Work with an AI product with proven product–market fit, already embedded in distributor workflows and directly affecting order accuracy, speed, and margins.

  • Join a global team across 6 countries and 40+ nationalities, building a company that has raised $300M+ and reached unicorn status (~$1.2B valuation) with the ambition to define this category end-to-end.

  • In return, you get real ownership, equity, and the support to do your best work, including competitive compensation, health and wellbeing support, and long-term benefits like a sabbatical (all localized by office).

  • Collaborate with people who want to own outcomes in a messy, real-world system and make it work at scale.

If you want to work on real problems, take ownership, and raise the bar, we should talk.
