title: Senior Technical Advisor, Clinical Services & Health Systems Transformation
locations: United States, Nigeria, Rwanda, Ethiopia, France, DRC, India
descriptionHtml:
Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) is a global health organization that partners locally and globally to create and scale solutions to the world’s deadliest health threats. Millions of people die from preventable health threats. We collaborate to close the gap between proven, life-saving solutions and the people who need them. Since 2017, we’ve worked with governments and other partners in more than 60 countries to save millions of lives. We work toward a future where people live longer, healthier lives, communities flourish, and economies thrive. This is an ambitious vision, and it inspires us and our partners to make progress every day. 

Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) works with governments and partners to strengthen and transform primary health care (PHC) to improve health and save lives. Our approach focuses on making PHC more prioritised, proactive and accountable for outcomes, and strengthening how care is organised, delivered, financed and measured. Drawing on expertise across RTSL's portfolio, we bring together solutions in health system resilience and epidemic readiness, digital health and data-driven decision-making, performance measurement and improvement, and sustainable health financing. We apply these capabilities to address priority health challenges, including cardiovascular health, maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, while strengthening health systems to deliver more equitable, effective and resilient care.  

Position Purpose

The Senior Technical Advisor, Clinical Services & Health Systems Transformation will provide senior-level technical expertise to strengthen how health services are organised, managed and delivered, with an initial focus on improving maternal survival and reproductive health outcomes. Drawing on deep clinical experience and specialized expertise in health systems strengthening, systems thinking, and change management, the role leads complex technical initiatives and supports governments and country teams in identifying systemic barriers to quality care, designing and implementing practical improvements, and strengthening the institutional capabilities needed to sustain results.

Reporting to the Director, Maternal & Reproductive Health, the Senior Technical Advisor works across RTSL's technical programmes to translate evidence and programme learning into effective service delivery improvements. The role exercises significant independent technical judgment in developing and adapting implementation approaches, guides multidisciplinary teams and partners through complex health system challenges, and contributes expertise and learning to strengthen RTSL's broader approaches to more proactive, reliable, and accountable health care.

Work Location: 100% Remote with travel as stated. Eligible for candidates based in the US, UK, Nigeria, Ethiopia, Rwanda, India, France and DRC.

Duration: Full-time employment for a fixed term of 24 months.

Core Duties and Responsibilities

Health Systems and Service Delivery Transformation

  • Apply systems thinking and health systems transformation approaches to identify and address systemic barriers to quality health care, drawing on service delivery assessments and analysis of health system performance.
  • Provide strategic and technical advice to national and subnational governments on health system and service delivery reforms, supporting the translation of national policies and priorities into effective service delivery models and implementation approaches.
  • Provide expert technical guidance to governments and country teams on redesigning clinical care pathways, referral systems, workflows and service delivery models to improve the quality, reliability and continuity of care.
  • Translate findings from maternal death reviews, routine performance data and other sources into prioritised, feasible improvements in clinical care, service delivery and wider health system capabilities.
  • Guide multidisciplinary collaboration with technical specialists across clinical care, digital health, financing and measurement to develop integrated solutions to complex, priority service delivery challenges.

Change Management and Institutional Strengthening

  • Lead the development and adaptation of change management and implementation approaches to enable government and health facility teams to introduce, adapt and sustain improvements in service delivery.
  • Provide strategic accompaniment and coaching to strengthen government leadership, management and institutional capabilities, including decision-making processes, performance management, accountability mechanisms and continuous improvement practices.
  • Design and guide practical implementation approaches, including change management plans, improvement processes, team-based coaching and mechanisms to address barriers to implementation.
  • Promote government ownership and sustainability by embedding improved practices, management routines and accountability processes within existing health systems.

Country Implementation and Technical Support

  • Provide senior technical guidance to country programmes and government partners, supporting the design, implementation and adaptation of health system and service delivery improvements, identifying emerging challenges, and recommending course corrections.
  • Work closely with country teams, government counterparts and implementing partners to identify priorities, address operational challenges and support effective programme delivery.
  • Provide technical leadership on country assessments, programme design and implementation planning, ensuring interventions respond to demonstrated system bottlenecks and country priorities.

Learning, Evidence and Innovation

  • Guide the application of data, implementation learning, and performance measurement to assess the effectiveness of service delivery changes, identify emerging challenges, and inform course correction.
  • Document and synthesise implementation experience, developing practical tools, approaches and lessons that can be adapted and applied across countries and other priority health areas.

Qualifications

Education

  • Clinical qualification in medicine, nursing, midwifery or a related health profession, with experience in clinical service delivery. An advanced degree in public health, health systems, health management or a related field is desirable.

Experience

  • At least 10 years of relevant experience in clinical service delivery, health systems strengthening and service delivery transformation, including substantial experience in low- and middle-income countries.
  • Demonstrated experience working with government institutions and health service managers to strengthen institutional capabilities, embed new ways of working and sustain improvements beyond individual projects.
  • Experience using routine performance data, quality improvement methods, and implementation learning to inform technical decisions, assess results, and adapt interventions.

Skills & Abilities

  • Expertise in applying systems thinking, change management and health systems transformation approaches to diagnose complex service delivery challenges, design practical solutions, and achieve measurable improvements.
  • Proven track record of leading or supporting the implementation of complex health service delivery reforms, including changes to clinical pathways, care models, management practices or health system processes.
  • Deep, nuanced understanding of clinical quality and patient safety, including the organisational, workforce and system factors that influence the reliability and effectiveness of frontline health services.
  • Strong technical leadership, facilitation, coaching, problem-solving, and relationship management skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders, navigate resistance to change and work effectively across clinical, technical and management teams.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex health systems challenges into clear, actionable recommendations and to influence diverse technical, clinical, government and management stakeholders.
  • Willingness to travel internationally, approximately 30%.

Compensation and Benefits

Resolve to Save Lives prides itself on cultivating a supportive, connected remote team doing work that matters. We do everything possible to ensure our employees are connected and set up for success. 

The salary range for applicants based in the US is $120,000 to $135,000 annually. The exact offer will be determined by various factors, such as the candidate's skills and experience relative to the requirements of the role. For applicants based outside the US, salaries are set according to national labor rates for the international NGO sector.  

In addition to a competitive salary, Resolve to Save Lives provides a generous package of benefits, including: 

  • Health insurance for you and your dependents 
  • Contributions toward retirement  
  • Paid annual leave and sick leave, in addition to public holidays 
  • Two paid, week-long organization-wide breaks at mid-year and end-of-year  
  • Professional development and home office setup benefits 
  • Up-to-date computer equipment 

Anticipated Application Deadline: 27 November 2026 (This position may close earlier if a high volume of applications is received before the stated deadline)

RTSL believes its programs are strengthened when they are developed and supported by individuals with diverse life experiences whose understanding of social and cultural issues can help make our work and workforce more inclusive. We encourage applications from and provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, ancestry, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, marital status, organ donor status, or status as a veteran. Resolve to Save Lives complies with all applicable US EEO laws.

title: Senior Technical Programme Manager
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Every payment we process runs on the infrastructure we built. At Checkout.com, the Cloud Platform team owns the cloud foundations that global payments depend on: a large multi-account AWS estate, a growing Azure platform, and the networking and connectivity that reaches card schemes and banks worldwide. We are building a platform that lets product teams run across multiple clouds and regions. We are looking for a Senior Technical Programme Manager who can turn a complex, multi-team technical programme into a plan people trust and deliver against.

This is a senior role in an established, fast-moving team. You will own the multi-cloud and multi-region programme end to end: the plan, the dependencies, the risks and the roadmap. You will bring enough technical depth to work as a peer with our engineers and architects, and pair it with a product mindset: you treat the platform as a product with internal customers, and you judge success by whether those teams adopt it.

As a Senior Technical Programme Manager, you are responsible for delivering the programme across teams you don't manage. You will work closely with your Engineering Manager to shape direction, manage dependencies across pillars, and ensure the programme meets the standards a regulated payments business demands.

What we are looking for:

  • A track record of delivering large infrastructure or platform programmes: a cloud migration, a new region, a cloud landing zone build, a data centre exit, or similar infrastructure related project within a fast paced technology environment

  • Enough technical depth to hold your own with engineers. You won’t need low level knowledge but you should be comfortable discussing networking between clouds and regions, identity and access, infrastructure as code pipelines, and what latency, data residency and failover mean for payments workloads

  • Experience working with cloud providers and partners to align their support and funding with your delivery plan, ideally Azure alongside AWS

  • Product thinking applied to internal platforms: you have treated engineering teams as customers, worked out what they need, and measured whether they adopted it.

  • Clear written and verbal communication with senior stakeholders

  • Proven ability to get commitments from teams and leaders who don't report to you.

  • Experience in a regulated environment, such as financial services or payments

How you’ll make an impact:

  • Run the programme end to end, from sequencing the work through to production, across several teams and multiple cloud providers.

  • Own the roadmap. Understand what product engineering teams need before they can deploy into Azure or a new cloud region, help decide which paved roads come first, and set adoption measures we can report on.

  • Turn architecture decisions into delivery plans. Work with our senior engineers and architects on design trade-offs, make sure decisions get written down, and spot when a decision is blocking delivery.

  • Manage dependencies and risk across teams you don't control, and escalate early, with options, when something is going to slip.

  • Build compliance from the start. PCI DSS 4.0 and SOC 2 apply to most of what this programme touches, and control requirements need to show up in the plan, before any production workloads go live.

  • Keep the delivery records honest. Our roadmap lives in Jira Product Discovery and delivery in Jira; you'll work with the relevant teams to make sure both reflect what is actually happening.

  • Use AI tools in how you run the programme: status reporting, dependency analysis, drafting and keeping documentation current. We use them heavily and expect you to as well.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

title: Senior Treasury Specialist (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Gestalte unsere Treasury-Strukturen und schaffe Transparenz über Liquidität und Cashflows für unsere nächste Wachstumsphase.

Black Semiconductor wächst international und entwickelt seine Finance-Organisation für die nächste Wachstumsphase weiter. Dabei schaffen wir die Treasury-Strukturen und Prozesse, die wir benötigen, um unsere Liquidität zuverlässig zu steuern, finanzielle Entscheidungen fundiert zu treffen und unser internationales Wachstum nachhaltig zu unterstützen.

In dieser Rolle übernimmst Du Verantwortung für zentrale Treasury-Themen - von Cash Forecasting und Liquiditätsmanagement bis hin zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Prozesse und Systeme. Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Senior Managerin Finance & Accounting und dem Finance-Team zusammen, bringst eigene Ideen ein und schaffst Strukturen, die mit unserem Unternehmen und unseren internationalen Gesellschaften mitwachsen.

Du verbindest fundierte Treasury-Expertise mit einer ausgeprägten Hands-on-Mentalität und hast die Möglichkeit, den Aufbau einer zunehmend global ausgerichteten Treasury-Funktion aktiv mitzugestalten.

Warum diese Rolle?

Treasury aktiv aufbauen: Du übernimmst nicht einfach bestehende Strukturen, sondern gestaltest unsere Treasury-Prozesse und Standards in einer entscheidenden Wachstumsphase aktiv mit.

Gestaltungsspielraum statt starrer Strukturen: Du kannst bestehende Abläufe hinterfragen, pragmatische Lösungen entwickeln und direkt umsetzen. Dabei ist Deine Expertise gefragt, auch wenn es darum geht, neue Wege zu finden.

Internationaler Impact: Du wirkst am Aufbau einer global abgestimmten Treasury-Steuerung mit und schaffst die Grundlage für mehr Transparenz und einheitliche Standards über Länder- und Gesellschaftsgrenzen hinweg.

Automatisierung & Skalierbarkeit: Du entwickelst Prozesse und Reporting weiter, nutzt digitale Lösungen und schaffst effiziente Abläufe, die auch mit zunehmender Komplexität funktionieren.

Nähe zu Finance Leadership: Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Senior Managerin Finance & Accounting zusammen und bringst Deine Expertise in Liquiditätssteuerung, Finanzierungsfragen und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Finance-Strukturen ein.

Dein nächster Karriereschritt: Mit dem Wachstum von Black Semiconductor kann sich Deine Rolle perspektivisch zu einer Treasury-Lead- oder Global-Treasury-Manager-Position mit wachsender internationaler Verantwortung entwickeln.

Über uns

Wir verstehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir erkennen Chancen und sehen das transformative Potenzial, das unsere Graphen-Lösungen für die Neugestaltung der Branche mit sich bringen.

Wir laden Dich ein, diesen Wandel gemeinsam mit uns voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Diese Vision ist es, zu zeigen, dass grundlegende Veränderungen möglich sind. Mit Deinem Wissen und Deinen Fähigkeiten kannst Du beweisen, dass Dinge anders – und besser – gemacht werden können.

Gemeinsam haben wir die Kraft, das Paradigma zu verändern, wie die Welt vernetzt ist.

Unsere Technology

Die steigenden Anforderungen der Halbleiterindustrie an leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch werden durch unsere Technologie adressiert. Wir ermöglichen die Verbindung von Chips mit Hochdurchsatz-Computernetzwerken bei minimaler Latenz.

Der entscheidende Faktor ist die Nutzung der einzigartigen physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu vereinen. Dadurch können unzählige Chips miteinander interagieren, als wären sie ein einziges System. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation hebt Rechenleistung und Effizienz auf ein neues Niveau.

Kurz gesagt: Wir vernetzen Chips zu leistungsstarken, energieeffizienten Systemen und überwinden mit unserer Graphen-Technologie die bisherigen Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie.

Deine Aufgaben

Cash Forecasting & Liquiditätsmanagement: Du verantwortest die Weiterentwicklung unserer Cash-Forecasts und schaffst Transparenz über Liquidität, Zahlungsströme und den Finanzierungsbedarf unserer internationalen Gesellschaften.

Treasury-Strukturen & Prozesse: Du entwickelst zuverlässige Treasury-Prozesse, Zuständigkeiten und Standards weiter und unterstützt den Aufbau einer global abgestimmten Treasury-Steuerung über Länder- und Gesellschaftsgrenzen hinweg.

Automatisierung & Reporting: Du identifizierst Potenziale zur Automatisierung von Forecasting, Reporting und wiederkehrenden Treasury-Abläufen und setzt skalierbare, systemgestützte Lösungen um. Gleichzeitig gestaltest du die Weiterentwicklung unserer SAP S/4HANA Cloud aktiv mit und schöpfst deren Potenzial voll aus.

Finanzierung & Analysen: Du unterstützt bei Finanzierungsaktivitäten, beispielsweise im Zusammenhang mit Wandeldarlehen, erstellst Analysen und bereitest fundierte Entscheidungsgrundlagen für interne Stakeholder vor.

Zusammenarbeit & Weiterentwicklung: Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Senior Managerin Finance & Accounting und dem HQ-Finance-Team zusammen, koordinierst Treasury-Themen mit relevanten internen und externen Stakeholdern und treibst Verbesserungen eigenständig voran.

Das bringst Du mit

  • Fundierte Erfahrung im Treasury, insbesondere im Cash Forecasting und Liquiditätsmanagement

  • Hands-on-Mentalität sowie eine strukturierte und pragmatische Arbeitsweise, um Prozesse auch in einem wachsenden Umfeld eigenständig aufzubauen

  • Erfahrung in internationalen Strukturen oder mit mehreren Gesellschaften sowie die Fähigkeit, übergreifende Standards zu entwickeln

  • Interesse an Automatisierung, digitalen Systemen und skalierbaren Prozessverbesserungen

title: SIP Expert
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are looking for a SIP Expert to own the telephony layer that connects ElevenAgents voice agents to the phone network. SIP traffic is moving from early adoption to large enterprise call volumes, so the hard problems are now reliability and latency at scale.

Your general responsibilities will include:

  • Owning SIP end to end, from design doc to implementation, testing and ongoing operation, for a product used by enterprises at scale.

  • Making call flows such as warm transfers dependable, and simplifying how our call services communicate with each other.

  • Diagnosing and fixing load-related failures such as resource exhaustion and dropped connections.

  • Collaborating with support, infrastructure and other teams to turn customer needs into shipped features.

Specific responsibilities might include:

  • Making our SIP edge and routing layer production-ready for large enterprise traffic.

  • Designing and shipping lightweight, lower-latency call-handling services.

  • Supporting carrier and SIP trunk integrations for enterprise customers.

You will join a small team of five, reporting directly to the team lead, with a high degree of ownership and very little bureaucracy.

Requirements

We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, designs, or open source contributions.

We do require:

  • Experience building and operating large-scale SIP/VoIP systems in production, including debugging load-related failures such as port exhaustion, dropped connections and state shared across services

  • Hands-on experience running LiveKit (or comparable real-time media infrastructure) at scale, with comfort in WebSockets, WebRTC and RTP

  • Strong backend engineering in Go or a comparable systems language, and a record of owning projects from design document through launch and maintenance

  • Based in Europe or a nearby time zone, with at least 2 to 3 hours of daily overlap with CET

Bonus: Hands-on experience with Kamailio (or OpenSIPS/FreeSWITCH), or carrier and SIP trunk interconnects.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe or nearby time zones, with the ability to operate in GMT to GMT+4 time zones preferred. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Dublin, London and Warsaw.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Software Development Engineer III, Maps API
descriptionHtml:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

The Maps API team builds and maintains the applications and infrastructure responsible for creating and distributing Mapbox maps. Thousands of customers rely on our services to seamlessly handle billions of requests every day, scale in real-time to global events, and enable designers, developers, and analysts to make and share maps we’ve never dreamed of.

Delivering maps means delivering a model of the world that’s changing all the time and needs to automatically support the world’s edge cases – writing systems, fonts, local regulations, and global boundary disputes.

Our team maintains the highest-traffic read APIs at Mapbox and the distributed ETL pipelines used by internal and external customers to turn data into maps. We’re building new ways for people to visualize location data. Check out our Mapbox maps!

As AI becomes embedded in modern engineering workflows, we value engineers who can thoughtfully integrate AI into design, development, and decision-making. Our interview process will include discussion of how you use AI in your engineering workflow.

What You’ll Do

As a Software Development Engineer III on the Maps API team, you will be responsible for balancing rapid development of new mapping tools against the reliability of our services as they scale into new request volumes, markets, and use cases. In a single week on the Maps API team, you might write application code robust to a world’s worth of data, build and deploy microservices, diagnose complex system behavior as global markets drive traffic in unexpected ways, or facilitate continuous delivery at Mapbox.

In this role, you can expect to:

  • Lead your engineering team to identify and scope out well-defined tasks.

  • Execute on the scope and be accountable for delivering on time with quality.

  • Design systems and make architectural decisions that will keep pace with the rapid growth of Mapbox’s customer base.

  • Mentor your peers through 1:1s, facilitating design and code reviews, and providing continuous guidance to foster professional growth and technical excellence.

  • Promote a culture of operational excellence by meticulously testing and monitoring our systems and code, writing documentation, and being on-call to support the health of our services.

  • Reduce technical debt, share your knowledge, and invest in your teammates’ health and happiness, while optimizing application performance and accelerating feature velocity.

  • Uphold a culture of collaboration, transparency, creativity, inclusion, and data-driven decisions.

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • 8-10+ years of experience building scalable high volume low latency backend services.

  • Proficiency with Python, NodeJS, and native AWS (CDK, ECS, Step Functions, Lambda, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, CloudFront).

  • Experience building mapping and geospatial related products.

  • Familiarity with code versioning tools, such as GitHub.

  • Able to perform independently all the development tasks, based on designs and specs.

  • Self-starter who is communication and outcomes-oriented.

  • An empirical analytical approach. You develop strong hypotheses, conduct spikes, and clearly communicate your findings.

  • A desire to share your expertise through documentation, mentorship, pairing, and both written and verbal discussion.

  • A desire to work with and lead individuals with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

  • High quality mindset -- write unit tests, proactively remedy defects and follow through to production.

Nice to Have Traits for This Role

  • Proficiency in C++

What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

  • We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

  • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

How we support you

  • Hybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable.

  • Country-Specific Care & Coverage: Private health, dental, and income protection plans tailored to elevate your regional statutory benefits.

  • Family-First Support: Family care, maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family.

  • Lifestyle Spending Account: Contributions to support your health, wellness, and personal growth

  • Balance & Brainpower: Mental health support for you and your dependents.

  • Rest & Recharge: Paid time away, company holidays, and generous absence policies.

  • Time Off to Give Back: Dedicated paid volunteering time in addition to your standard PTO.

title: Software Engineer, Agentic AI
descriptionHtml:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

What does the team work on?

Roku TV is where embedded systems, media experiences, and intelligent software come together at massive scale. The Roku TV organization builds technology used on millions of TVs globally, and the team is already applying AI to demanding TV problems in resource-constrained environments where quality, performance, and reliability matter.
As part of this team, you will help define how agentic AI systems are designed, built, and operated for Roku TV use cases. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who treats AI agent design as an engineering discipline: architecting durable systems, grounding them in the right context, integrating them with tools and services, and making them reliable in production.

What is the role?

We are looking for a hands-on, systems-oriented Agentic AI Engineer of roughly 2-5 years experience to design, build, and maintain intelligent agents and copilots that drive automation, accelerate workflows, and unlock new product and platform capabilities for Roku TV. You will own the full lifecycle of agent development—from prototyping and architecture through orchestration, evaluation, deployment, observability, and continuous improvement.
You will contribute directly to Roku’s AI strategy by engineering reusable components, optimizing agent workflows, and ensuring strong real-world performance in production environments.

How will I use AI at Roku? 

At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. 

 
We value your AI skills if have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you. 

What are the responsibilities of the role?

  • Architect, develop, and deploy AI agents and copilots for Roku TV use cases, integrating them with internal systems, tools, and services.
  • Own end-to-end agentic systems from concept to production, including model selection, prompt and context design, retrieval strategies, backend services, and conversational interfaces.
  • Design and implement single-agent and multi-agent orchestration patterns, including handoffs, delegation, and cooperative task execution.
  • Build scalable RAG and context pipelines that provide high-quality grounding for AI systems and keep them aligned with evolving data sources and business logic.
  • Implement tool-calling, function-calling, and MCP-style integrations so agents can safely take actions and interact with the systems around them.
  • Create reusable agent templates, modular components, and paved-path patterns that accelerate adoption across teams and use cases.
  • Establish strong evaluation, observability, and monitoring for conversation quality, task success rate, latency, cost, and overall system performance.
  • Build safeguards that improve production readiness and reliability, including testing pipelines, controlled rollouts, drift detection, and mechanisms that prevent error amplification in multi-step workflows.
  • Prototype quickly, run experiments, and translate successful ideas into durable, scalable software solutions.
  • Partner closely with engineering, product, QA, infrastructure, and cross-functional teams to deliver meaningful business and customer outcomes.

What experience would help someone be successful in the role at Roku? 

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field.
  • 2-5 years of experience in software engineering, AI/ML engineering, backend development, or adjacent domains, with strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to build production-grade systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python, plus experience with C/C++ or another systems language.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM-based systems, including prompt design, retrieval, tool use, memory handling, and agent orchestration patterns.
  • Experience building and maintaining RAG pipelines, agent frameworks, MCP servers or equivalent function-calling architectures, and conversational interfaces.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms, REST APIs, containerization, and modern deployment environments.
  • Experience with observability, evaluation, experimentation, and feedback loops for AI systems in production.
  • Ability to work independently, manage ambiguity, move quickly, and deliver incrementally in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication skills, sound engineering judgment, and a collaborative working style.

Nice to have

  • Experience with multi-agent frameworks or orchestration systems such as LangChain, AutoGen, or Semantic Kernel.
  • Experience with video, audio, TV, or edge-device environments, especially where latency, cost, and hardware constraints matter.
  • Familiarity with ML/DL frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
  • Research experience, paper implementation experience, or a habit of applying emerging GenAI techniques pragmatically to real problems.

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

What are some of the benefits?

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

Accommodations

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to  

What should I know about Roku's culture?

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. 

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002.

title: Software Engineer - Delta Platform
descriptionHtml:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role

Delta builds BLP’s core software: the technical foundation that everything else at the company runs on.

Who we're looking for

Modelling logic and correctness by construction is paramount to us. We aim to express what must be true, prevent invalid states, and keep systems pristine even as they grow.

Thus, we’re looking for highly ambitious engineers who can tackle difficult problems and think precisely. You must be able to make assumptions explicit and use formal, structured reasoning to reach a solution, and explain why it is correct. Typically, strong background in mathematics is a key foundation for this kind of work. We also place a high value on thoroughness and perfectionism.

Tooling wise, we rely heavily on type systems & functional programming.

 

What you'll do

Our work spans four areas, you will usually work on a given project within one of:

  • Infrastructure: Build and operate the cloud infrastructure BLP depends on, covering security, observability and CI/CD.

  • Backend: Develop a large codebase, tackling performance, concurrency and the challenges of distributed systems.

  • ML: Apply the latest AI technology to complex, real-world business problems and turn it into reliable production software.

  • Unbound: Build our product extension platform, enabling BLP to automate arbitrary customer business processes as we scale.

 

What you'll bring

We do not require experience with any particular technology or even industry software development experience.

You should, however, provide clear evidence of the abilities we’re looking for. That evidence could include:

  • strong academic backgrounds (math PhD/MSc or significant olympiad achievements)

  • startup experience (early employee, built productive systems yourself & know what it takes to maintain them)

  • FP experience (have deep understanding of programming languages and are able to discern the various tradeoffs of different paradigms)

 

Flexibility. Work on-site in Zurich or remotely within Europe.

  

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Chez Theodo FinTech, notre mission est de rendre la finance plus utile pour les gens, les entreprises et la société. Entité experte en FinTech de Theodo, nous accompagnons nos clients - des grandes entreprises, des ScaleUps et des StartUps du secteur des services financiers - dans la conception, le développement et la maintenance de produits numériques accessibles, durables et utiles pour la société. En tant qu'experts technologiques dans les services financiers, Theodo FinTech livre en un temps record des produits digitaux exceptionnels avec zéro bug et un haut niveau de sécurité. Nous savons intégrer les API de toutes les plateformes fintech B2B pour créer des solutions de finance embarquée.
Ton équipe : Chez Theodo, les techs travaillent en équipes projet, constituées en fonction des besoins de chaque client. Tu feras partie d’une équipe de Theodoers à taille humaine (4 à 5 personnes), réunissant Software Engineers, Tech Lead et Product Manager. Ensemble, vous collaborerez étroitement avec le client, avec des échanges réguliers pour partager vos avancées, approfondir la compréhension de son problème et faire évoluer le produit au plus près des besoins de ses utilisateurs. Tes missions : En devenant Full-Stack Senior Software Engineer à Theodo FinTech, ta mission consiste à:
  • Coder rapidement sans bug, en t’appuyant sur des assistants coding (Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf).
  • Concevoir les fonctionnalités, aussi bien en étant force de proposition sur le produit mais aussi en identifiant les meilleures stratégies techniques, tout en adoptant nos pratiques de delivery tournées autour du Lean.
  • Tu es membre d'une équipe de 1 à 3 ingénieur(e)s avec un(e) tech lead, un(e) product manager.L’objectif sera que tu puisses rapidement prendre un rôle de tech lead, une fois notre méthode bien assimilée pour transmettre tes connaissances à des développeurs.
Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples :

Sécurisée, scalable dès le lancement et accessible à toutes les banques françaises sans formation, elle a permis de piloter en temps réel le dispositif et de soutenir le déploiement de 115 milliards d’euros de prêts dans l’économie française.
  • Nickel : Pour accélérer la diversification de son offre, l’entreprise lance un mini-crédit 100 % digital intégré à son application, en partenariat avec Floa. En seulement 5 mois (dont 11 semaines pour la V1), une équipe de 5 experts Fintech Theodo conçoit et déploie l’offre, malgré une intégration API complexe et de fortes dépendances internes. Résultat : un parcours fluide mêlant natif et webview, permettant à Nickel d’augmenter la rétention et l’ARPU tout en restant fidèle à sa promesse d’inclusion financière.
Parmi les technos les plus représentées sur nos projets, tu pourras être amené à travailler avec : Java (Spring Boot), Angular, Node (Nest), React (Next), Python… Pour y arriver :
  • Une formation tech sur 6 à 8 semaines sur le refactoring, le debugging, le testing...

  • Tu as un coach qui s’assure de ton intégration dans l’équipe et de ta progression à long terme.
  • Tu as deux formations hebdomadaires : l'une sur la méthodologie et l'autre sur une problématique spécifique.
  • Tu participes au cursus de formation Tech Lead pour te former à ce poste.
Ton profil :
  • Tu as 2 à 5 ans d’expérience en tant que Software Engineer et maîtrises un ou plusieurs de nos frameworks de prédilection : Spring Boot, Nest.js, Node, Angular ou React.js (on cherche aussi un profil expert PHP!).
  • Tu ne cherches pas “juste à coder” : tu fais preuve de proactivité, de débrouillardise d’impact dans ce que tu entreprends.

  • Tu as envie de rejoindre une boîte avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur la qualité de code : notre étoile du nord, c’est le 0 bug.
  • Tu es curieux/curieuse d'en apprendre plus sur le Lean Tech et tu as l’ambition de prendre rapidement des responsabilités avec un rôle de tech lead.
Le processus de recrutement :
  • Un premier call avec un membre de l'équipe de recrutement.
  • Un entretien de fit culturel avec un membre de l’équipe de recrutement.
  • Un test de refactoring libre (1h30 de préparation) suivi d'un entretien dans nos locaux de debriefing avec un(e) tech expérimenté(e) (tech lead ou engineering manager).
  • Un entretien technique de modélisation avec un(e) tech expérimenté(e) (tech lead ou engineering manager).
  • Une rencontre avec Woody, notre CTO et cofondateur.
Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo FinTech ? title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine  – Data Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness.

In this role, you'll build the knowledge construction pipelines: turning everything from a 100k docs/s web crawl to vendor datasets into a graph of what is true about the world, and keeping it correct as data changes.

This is greenfield work with a massive scope. There is no off-the-shelf system for building a model of the world from the open web, so you'll make foundational decisions, from how claims are represented and resolved to how trust is assigned and how the graph evolves over time, that everything built on top of it depends on.

What you'll do

  • Continuously synthesize the live web crawl, vendor deliveries and APIs, and other off-the-web sources into one typed graph: extraction that turns pages and records into ontology-shaped claims, each carrying its provenance, timestamp and confidence.

  • Bring every new source in cleanly: versioned, append-only history with schema evolution, late-arriving and corrected records, and replayable cursors, so every claim traces back to the exact delivery that produced it.

  • Decide what to trust: entity resolution across billions of records (blocking, pairwise scoring, clustering) into canonical people, companies, places and publications, then truth discovery that weighs source reliability, recency and corroboration to reconcile conflicting claims.

  • Keep that picture current and convergent: streams arrive continuously, out of order and at very different rates, so the graph is eventually consistent by design. You'll build incremental computation over change data feeds, where each update is a diff of what changed and every job is idempotent and resumable, so the graph converges to the same state however runs interleave, fail or replay, and readers only ever see committed, consistent versions.

  • Measure precision and completeness: labeled evals for extraction and resolution, per-source coverage and correctness metrics, and lineage that pinpoints which source or stage broke and why.

What we're looking for

  • You've built and operated large-scale distributed data pipelines in production over petabytes of structured and unstructured data, with Spark over a lakehouse format (Delta Lake, Iceberg, Hudi).

  • You understand incremental processing deeply: change data capture, idempotent writes, backfills and reprocessing.

  • Strong in Python and at least one systems language; you can read and tune Spark query plans.

  • You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale.

Bonus

  • Entity resolution, record linkage, knowledge graphs or ontologies

  • Information extraction or truth discovery at scale

  • Lance or other columnar/vector-native formats

Example projects

  • Take a new billion-row dataset from first delivery to queryable entities in days, not months.

  • Keep a graph of hundreds of billions of claims current with incremental updates, so a fact that changes on the web reaches it in minutes.

  • Build a system that knows every company and person in the world, with one evidence-backed record each, resolved across the web and every source we ingest.

title: Solutions Architect - Post Sales
descriptionHtml:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the team

The Customer and Consulting team sits at the heart of how hx delivers lasting value to its clients. As hx continues to expand across global carriers, reinsurers, and specialist MGAs, this team ensures that customers don't just adopt the platform, they transform the way they price and underwrite risk. The post-sale Solution Architect is a critical part of that mission, responsible for making sure the hx platform is deeply embedded in customer ecosystems, from reporting pipelines to security infrastructure and third-party integrations.

This is a team that operates at the intersection of technical depth and customer partnership. The work is hands-on and high-stakes: translating complex customer environments into durable, scalable technical solutions, while building the kind of trusted relationships that drive adoption, margin, and long-term value. You will work closely with Customer Success and Delivery colleagues, acting as the technical anchor across multi-threaded customer engagements.

The team is growing, and there is real scope to shape how the Solution Architect function scales. Whether you are designing AI-first delivery artefacts, contributing reusable patterns to a shared toolkit, or presenting architecture decisions to a Chief Information Officer, your work will directly influence the outcomes customers achieve, and the reputation hx builds in the market.

Check out our Client Services Candidate Hub for a behind the scenes look at the team you would be joining!

What you'll be doing

  • Own the technical relationship with a portfolio of strategic customers, becoming the trusted advisor who anticipates challenges, aligns delivery to outcomes, and ensures the hx platform is embedded confidently within each customer's ecosystem.

  • Design and deliver bespoke integrations between hx and a range of customer technologies, including policy administration systems, data warehouses, BI tooling, and identity providers, applying sound architectural judgement throughout.

  • Drive customer adoption and platform usage by developing structured value realisation plans that translate technical delivery into measurable business outcomes, including faster quote turnarounds, reduced pricing errors, and stronger MI capability.

  • Build AI-first consulting and delivery artefacts that raise the bar for how the team works, creating reusable frameworks, templates, and innovation outputs that can be shared across the broader SA toolkit.

  • Support project margin outcomes by managing delivery scope, surfacing risks early, and coordinating effectively with Customer Success Managers, Delivery Leads, and customer-side technical teams.

  • Contribute to team capability by sharing patterns, leading internal show-and-tell sessions, and helping to codify best practices as the Solution Architect function grows and scales.

What you'll need to have done

  • Able to code to a high standard using Python.

  • Supported the technical delivery of SaaS platform integrations in a team setting. It’s beneficial if you also have experience with AWS architecture, SQL, and a foundational understanding from a computer science or software development background.

  • Built and maintained positive technical relationships with colleagues and stakeholders, including IT and data teams, by communicating effectively across different priorities and environments.

  • Helped communicate technical choices and delivery progress to non-technical stakeholders, using clear, outcome-driven explanations that link integration work to business value.

  • Gained experience in a post-sale or customer-facing technical role—such as Junior Solution Architect, Technical Support, or Implementation Analyst—where you supported the delivery process or customer needs.

  • Used AI or automation tools to enhance the quality, speed, or consistency of your work, with an understanding of where these technologies can add value.

  • Supported the management of delivery processes, such as helping to plan project phases, identify risks, or coordinate with internal or external teams to meet project timelines.

You're unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer to stay in a narrow technical lane and hand off customer communication to others; this role requires genuine ownership across both the technical design and the stakeholder relationship.

  • You need a fully defined brief before getting started; ambiguity is a constant here, and the best work comes from people who move confidently without waiting for perfect information.

  • You measure success by delivery completion rather than customer outcomes; at hx, adoption, margin, and measurable value are the real bar.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you'll do your best work. We're building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

At hx, we're committed to salary transparency. You'll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we're working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we're building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that's competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

£5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

Company pension scheme via Penfold.

Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

Income protection and Life Insurance.

Cycle to Work Scheme.

Additional perks

Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry

Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

  1. Talent Screen - 30 minutes

  2. Hiring Manager interview - 60 minutes

  3. Skills Assessment - 60 minutes

  4. Values interview - 60 minutes

  5. Meet the CEO

  6. We offer!

Our commitment to Diversity

hxer's are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies. We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy.

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

The Specialist Vulnerability Agent plays a critical and empathetic customer-facing role, dedicated to providing exceptional support and holistic case management for our most vulnerable customer population. Building on the core responsibilities of a Front-Line Operations Agent, you will take end-to-end ownership of vulnerable customer journeys from identification to resolution. Your expertise will ensure best-in-class support, accurate vulnerability status assessments, and proactive guidance to frontline colleagues. This role is pivotal in shaping and developing our vulnerable customer processes, drawing upon external best practices to drive continuous improvement and ensure optimal outcomes for those who need it most.

Key Responsibilities

Vulnerable Customer Case Management & Advocacy

  • Take full ownership and accountability for the end-to-end case management of particularly vulnerable customers, ensuring a seamless and supportive journey from initial identification through to the lifecycle's conclusion.

  • Deliver compassionate, accurate, and highly personalised support, consistently striving to provide best-in-class service tailored to the unique needs of vulnerable individuals.

  • Proactively review and validate the accuracy of customers' vulnerability statuses, ensuring appropriate flags and support mechanisms are in place.

  • Act as a subject matter expert, providing essential support, guidance, and insights to other front-line colleagues on how to identify, interact with, and effectively assist vulnerable customers.

  • Be accountable for and take ownership of decisions regarding the best possible outcomes for our vulnerable customers, exercising sound judgment and empathy in every situation.

  • Responsibility and authority to deviate from standard processes, such as ceasing non-regulatory communications, recommending customers for default, and establishing forbearance arrangements beyond typical front-line limits, to ensure optimal customer outcomes

Customer Support & Query Resolution (Core Operational Responsibilities)

  • Deliver exceptional support across products/services, efficiently executing processes to handle complex customer queries via multiple channels.

  • Listen actively and provide clear, accurate responses, adapting communication style to each customer’s needs, including those in vulnerable situations or with complex financial queries.

  • Demonstrate comprehensive knowledge and capability across a wide range of customer service and financial support journeys, ensuring broad coverage for our diverse vulnerable customer population.

  • Take end-to-end ownership of all customer interactions, ensuring every query is managed through to effective resolution or appropriate escalation.

  • Build rapport and trust while maintaining control of conversations, ensuring positive and compliant customer outcomes.

  • Work flexibly across different products and disciplines, adapting to varying service needs and customer queries.

Operational Excellence & Process Execution

  • Meet and exceed targets and KPIs related to customer satisfaction, quality, and compliance by consistently following key operational procedures and applying appropriate judgement to specific customer circumstances.

  • Effectively use AI and digital tools to streamline customer interactions and deliver faster, more accurate service.

  • Identify blockers, process gaps, or recurring issues and communicate these to relevant teams, supporting continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Log all interactions accurately and ensure data integrity for audit and learning purposes.

Continuous Improvement & Process Development

  • Continuously shape and develop our vulnerable customer processes, proactively seeking and integrating external best practices to elevate our support framework.

  • Provide clear, actionable feedback from frontline experiences to enhance our knowledge base, training resources, and AI systems, with a particular focus on vulnerability.

  • Participate in process reviews and contribute suggestions to enhance the customer journey, automation, and operational efficiency, championing the needs of vulnerable customers.

  • Remain up to date with ongoing system, product, and process changes, readily adapting to evolving procedures.

Learning & Development

  • Respond positively to coaching and feedback, using it to improve performance and customer outcomes, especially in complex vulnerability cases.

  • Demonstrate initiative in learning new tools, products, and procedures as they are introduced, with a focus on specialist vulnerability support.

  • Share knowledge and support colleagues, helping to create a culture of collaborative learning around vulnerable customer care.

Experience & Skills

  • Previous experience in a contact centre environment with a demonstrable focus on customer service and/or financial support, ideally including exposure to vulnerable customer interactions.

  • Proven ability to handle complex queries with exceptional empathy, accuracy, and strong ownership.

  • Confident in following structured processes and able to identify opportunities to improve them, particularly within the context of vulnerability support.

  • Exceptional communication, rapport-building, and conflict resolution skills, with a proven ability to manage sensitive conversations.

  • Skilled in using digital tools and comfortable adopting new technologies, including AI-driven platforms, to enhance vulnerable customer support.

  • Organised and able to manage multiple complex cases and tasks in a fast-paced setting.

  • Proactive in offering feedback and participating in process and AI improvement initiatives, with a strong voice for vulnerable customer needs.

  • Demonstrated understanding and application of external best practices in vulnerable customer support.

Behaviours & Approach

  • Deep Customer-focus, with a profound passion for delivering consistent, positive and empathetic outcomes for vulnerable individuals.

  • Resilient, adaptable, and open to constant change and learning, especially in evolving vulnerability frameworks.

  • Collaborative, supportive team player committed to shared success, with a strong ability to mentor and guide peers.

  • High level of accountability and personal ownership for vulnerable customer outcomes and process execution.

  • Constructive, solutions-focused approach with willingness to challenge the status quo to advocate for better vulnerable customer experiences.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base client qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière. Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et les Cabinets Comptable. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherche à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.

Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques. Tu as aussi la charge d'aider les comptables d’entreprises et cabinet à intégrer leurs données sur Pennylane afin de faciliter leur migration.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes liées à la comptabilité : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies en t’appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des principes comptables et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

- Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes en assurant un bon suivi des demandes jusqu’à la résolution complète des tickets pour garantir la satisfaction des utilisateurs.

- Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexe.

- Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie.

- Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".

- Tu portes la voix comme l’usage du client et tu partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration.

- Tu prends le contrôle et mène au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser.

Dans le futur, tu auras des possibilités d'évoluer vers la résolution de questions plus pointues dans l'équipe Support mais aussi vers d'autres équipes telles que les gestionnaires de comptes ou les responsables de la mise en œuvre pour nos clients.

- Expérience d'au moins 3 ans en cabinet comptable (idéalement avoir fait au moins trois périodes fiscales).

- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

- Appétence pour les outils de travail innovants et les nouvelles technologies.

title: Spontaneous Application - Engineering
descriptionHtml:
About us

Owkin is an agentic AI company pioneering Biological Artificial Superintelligence to solve problems in biology where human researchers alone have failed.
Owkin builds K Pro - an AI scientist for pharmaceutical research and strategic decision-making. K Pro orchestrates a suite of AI skills and tools to decode complex biology, accelerate research, and dramatically increase productivity.
K Pro is built on Owkin’s unrivalled multimodal patient data network, state-of-the-art AI for biology and a decade of experience working with pharmaceutical partners.

Excited about Owkin, but don’t see the perfect role yet?

We’re always happy to meet engineers who want to join us, whether or not a role is open today. We welcome spontaneous applications across engineering profiles:

  • AI and LLM engineering

  • backend and platform

  • data engineering

  • infrastructure

  • and more

You might be a good fit if you:

  • Are driven by impact and want to give biomedical researchers intuitive, powerful tools

  • Have built reliable, scalable systems, ideally with LLMs, agents or data pipelines

  • Enjoy working with AI engineering tools, and with scientists, in a fast-paced environment

  • Are curious about biology

What happens next:
If your profile aligns with a current or future need, we will contact you to arrange a conversation. Otherwise, with your consent, we will keep your details on file and reach out when a suitable opportunity arises.

#LI-MD1

What we offer

  • Flexible work organization

  • Friendly and informal working environment

  • Opportunity to work with an international team with high technical and scientific backgrounds

Recruitment Process & Security

  • Please complete the form and submit your CV.

  • Owkin is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, gender, sexual orientation, age, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status or on the basis of disability.

  • Owkin is a great place to work. As a coveted workplace we are, unfortunately, vulnerable to recruitment phishing scams. We urge all job seekers and candidates to be wary of potential scams. Most of these have individuals posing as representatives of prominent companies, including Owkin, with the aim of obtaining personal, sensitive, or financial information from applicants. These scams prey upon an individual’s desire to obtain a job and can sometimes “feel” like a genuine recruitment process. Some red flags are identified below. Should you encounter a recruitment process that claims to be for Owkin but is not consistent with the below, please do not provide any personal or financial information:

  • Legitimate Owkin recruitment processes include communication with candidates through recognized professional networks, such as LinkedIn.

  • Communication is always through an official Owkin email address (from the @owkin.com domain), over the phone or through our applicant tracking system (Ashby).

  • The Owkin talent team do use platforms such as LinkedIn, however if you have any concern or doubt about this contact, please ask for them to send an email from @Owkin.com.

  • The Owkin talent team will not solicit personal data from candidates during the application phase including, but not limited to, date of birth, social security numbers, or bank account information;

  • Legitimate Owkin interviews may be conducted over the phone, in person, or via an approved enterprise videoconferencing service (Google Meets). They will not occur via Signal, Telegram or Messenger

  • Owkin offers of employment are based on merit and only extended once a candidate has interviewed with members of the talent and hiring team. Offers will be extended both verbally and in written format.

If you think that you have been a victim of fraud,

  • Check the identity of the talent team on LinkedIn

  • Check our senior team on our website https://owkin.com/team/

  • Check the existence of the position on our website: https://www.owkin.com/careers#current-opportunities

  • Notify Owkin's recruitment unit at this address contact the following authorities:

    • [FR] https://internet-signalement.gouv.fr/

    • [UK] https://www.actionfraud.police.uk/reporting-fraud-and-cyber-crime

    • [US] https://reportfraud.ftc.gov/

descriptionHtml:

You'll write core foundational code and build reference implementations, but the bulk of routine implementation work belongs to the team.
