title: Staff Decision Scientist, Partner Excellence
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Parcel delivery has a quality problem the industry has learned to live with. Parcels go missing between depots. Parcels get marked as delivered and never reach the customer. Most carriers treat a steady rate of loss as a cost of doing business. Relay is building the delivery company where that stops being true.

That is harder for us than for most, because nearly everyone who touches a Relay parcel is an independent partner. We can't manage them into performance. We have to build the standards, the evidence and the product that make doing the job well the natural outcome. Engineering builds the product changes you design.

Partner Excellence Highlights

  • You own decision-making, not the model: you decide which signals count, which checks become rules, and whether each fix belongs in product, policy or training. The squad lead acts on your calls.

  • Most of a parcel's journey happens between scans. How do you prove a handover happened without making the job slower for the people doing it?

  • A delivery is marked complete and the customer says it never came. How do you tell a wrong address from a handover that went wrong, and put the fix where it belongs: product, policy or training?

  • Some checks can only answer "can't tell". Which are worth making provable, and which should we stop measuring?

  • A whole area, not a slice: you decide what evidence a whole network runs on, and the result is on the street the next morning.

  • Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

The Opportunity

As a Staff Decision Scientist, Partner Excellence at Relay, you'll:

  • Decide which Partner Excellence problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

  • Design how Partner Excellence decides: which signals count, what evidence the network runs on, and what good looks like.

  • Tell the squad lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

  • Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

  • Go and look when the data and the street disagree: the sort centre, the van, the shop.

  • Get the missing data built, and prove which fixes worked. In a year, the squad can prove every handover in the network.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Have owned fraud, risk or trust decisions end to end: turned investigations into rules, standards or interventions, and owned their number, such as the false positive rate you were held to, rather than building the model.

  • Have run investigations in fraud, risk, financial crime or trust and safety, and decided whether a signal was real or noise.

  • Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or engineers built what you asked for.

  • Have worked somewhere with enough volume for a false positive rate to mean something, where your rules ran live and something happened when they were wrong.

  • Have got records created by teams who didn't report to you, and know how long it takes.

  • Are hands-on and fluent in SQL, with or without AI, and would rather ship a working answer this week than a perfect one next quarter. No logistics experience needed, just the appetite to learn a physical operation fast.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

title: Staff Software Engineer - Databases SRE | UK | Remote
descriptionHtml:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we are looking for candidates from the UK, Sweden, Spain or Germany.

About the role:

Grafana Cloud runs Mimir, Loki, Tempo and Pyroscope as multi-tenant SaaS databases across AWS, GCP and Azure in regions worldwide. Our highest-SLA customers depend on them to run their businesses. We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to keep these systems reliable at scale.

The role combines building and operating. You’ll write the software, automation and product changes that make our databases more reliable, including changes to the Mimir, Loki and Tempo codebases where reliability calls for it. You’ll also be on call for our highest-SLA customers and handle the operational work that comes with it. You’ll bring a production mindset to product engineering and engineering rigor to reliability, and you’ll set technical direction across squads.

What You’ll Do

  • Build reliability into the product. Write production code in our services, tooling and the Mimir, Loki and Tempo codebases that makes our databases more resilient, self-healing and scalable as demand grows quickly.
  • Build automation and platform tooling that removes toil and scales our reliability practices across regions and cloud providers.
  • Lead technical design. Author design docs, review others’ designs and PRs, and shape feature design so it’s scalable and operable from day one.
  • Own the SLO framework. Define and evolve per-tenant SLOs and reliability models. Use SLO burn and incident learnings to find and fix the causes of failure in the systems themselves.
  • Improve observability and alerting so we find problems before customers do, and so escalations are actionable rather than noisy.
  • Be on call for our highest-SLA customers. Act as a technical escalation point for complex customer environments. Lead customer-impacting incident response, including customer bridge calls when needed, and write blameless post-incident reviews that lead to engineering fixes.
  • Handle the operational work that comes from on-call. This includes investigating customer escalations, following up on incident actions, tuning capacity and configuration, and turning recurring issues into permanent fixes or automation.
  • Multiply the team. Mentor engineers, teach reliability practices that teams adopt early in development, and work with engineering leadership on roadmaps and product strategy.
  • We highly value those who are intellectually curious, who default to transparency, possess a high bias towards action, and who are also kind (this is important!)

On-Call

Weekday on-call is 12-hour shifts, Monday to Friday, split between North America and Europe so you cover your local working hours. Weekends are covered by a separate 24-hour rotation. You’ll take a weekend roughly once every six to eight weeks.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time building and owning distributed systems in production.
  • Strong production software skills, ideally in at least one object-oriented language. You write clean, tested code and can make targeted changes in large open-source codebases you didn’t write.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems: performance, scaling and failure modes. You can reason about how a system will break before it does.
  • Experience running multi-tenant systems at scale on Kubernetes in AWS, GCP or Azure, with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, Helm or Jsonnet.
  • Hands-on experience designing and implementing SLOs.
  • Experience being on call for production systems. You troubleshoot calmly and methodically under pressure, and you’ve taken part in blameless incident response and written high-quality post-incident reviews.
  • Staff-level technical leadership: driving cross-team projects, setting technical direction and making the engineers around you better.
  • Working knowledge of Linux internals, networking and cloud storage.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Mimir, Loki, Tempo, Pyroscope, Prometheus or other observability and time-series databases.
  • Open-source contributions.
  • Customer reliability engineering (CRE) or customer-facing escalation experience.

About the Team

The Strategic Sales team at SevenRooms is on a mission to reshape the hospitality industry by helping the world’s leading hotel, restaurant and leisure groups own their guest relationships. We partner with multi-venue operators across EMEA as trusted advisors: we take a consultative approach, uncover gaps in how groups manage guest data, operations and distribution, and design solutions that reduce reliance on third-party networks and drive measurable revenue. Since SevenRooms joined DoorDash, we work alongside DoorDash and Deliveroo teams to bring merchants a connected offer across discovery, reservations, delivery and on-premise dining.

About the Role

We’re hiring an experienced Strategic Account Executive to uncover, drive and close new business with enterprise hospitality groups across EMEA. You will focus on hotel groups, multi-brand restaurant groups, and other large multi-venue operators (typically 50+ locations), selling the full SevenRooms platform: CRM and guest data, marketing automation, reservations and waitlist, table and revenue management, events and experiences, online ordering, Voice AI, and group reporting. These are complex, multi-stakeholder, multi-year deals, so you will navigate matrixed organisations, build executive-level relationships and structure commercial agreements that scale across venues and regions. You will work closely with Product, Solutions, Customer Success and Onboarding to make sure every enterprise partner launches successfully and grows with us.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Win new enterprise logos. Own a named-account strategy across hotel and restaurant groups with 50+ venues, building and running a pipeline through targeted outbound, partnerships, industry events and executive networks.
  • Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. Map decision-makers across operations, marketing, IT, finance, procurement and group leadership, and build consensus around a clear business case.
  • Sell a platform, not a point solution. Articulate how SevenRooms unifies guest data across venues to drive direct bookings, repeat visits, higher spend per cover and lower commission costs, and tailor the story to each group’s priorities.
  • Run the full sales lifecycle. Take deals from first conversation through discovery, executive presentations and live demos, commercial and financial deal structuring, RFP responses, security and legal review, contract negotiation and close.
  • Negotiate multi-year, multi-venue agreements. Structure pricing, rollout phasing and contract terms across brands, regions and entities.
  • Partner cross-functionally. Work with Solutions Consulting, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Onboarding, Customer Success and DoorDash and Deliveroo teams to shape rollout plans, integrations and long-term account growth.
  • Be a trusted advisor. Bring market insight, benchmarks and hospitality expertise to senior operators, and champion their success well beyond signature.

We’re excited about you because…

  • You have 8+ years of B2B enterprise SaaS sales experience with a consistent record of meeting and exceeding quota
  • You have experience selling complex, multi-faceted platforms to mid-market and enterprise customers, ideally in hospitality, hotels, restaurants, leisure or adjacent verticals
  • You have deep knowledge of, or strong relationships within, the hotel and hospitality industry
  • You have experience building relationships with C-level and executive stakeholders and navigating large, matrixed organisations
  • You have experience structuring and negotiating complex, multi-year deals, and managing RFPs, procurement and security reviews
  • You are an outstanding presenter in person and virtually, with strong business acumen and natural curiosity
  • You are self-driven, organised and comfortable managing a long, multi-threaded pipeline with forecast discipline
  • You are tech-savvy and quick to learn new tools; you have worked with Salesforce, RFP management tools or similar systems
  • You are open to regular travel across EMEA to meet clients face-to-face
  • Nice to have: fluency in a second European language, and experience selling CRM, marketing, reservations, PMS or POS technology

About SevenRooms

In 2011, Joel Montaniel, Allison Page, and Kinesh Patel founded SevenRooms after noticing that hospitality operators were missing a critical ingredient in the systems they were using to run their business: guest data. What began as a mission to help restaurants better understand and serve their guests evolved into a powerful platform used by merchants around the world.

With best-in-class tools for marketing, operations, and guest experience — all deeply integrated with its industry-leading CRM — SevenRooms empowers operators to drive revenue, streamline operations, and deliver experiences that keep guests coming back.

In 2025, DoorDash acquired SevenRooms to strengthen its in-store strategy and expand its merchant-first offerings. The combination brings together DoorDash’s scale, reach, and digital innovation with SevenRooms’ in-store capabilities to support hospitality businesses across every channel — from discovery and delivery to on-premise dining.

As DoorDash builds out its in-store capabilities, SevenRooms plays a central role in enabling merchants to grow their businesses and connect more meaningfully with guests, whether they’re ordering online or dining in. This move reflects DoorDash’s broader commitment to empowering local businesses, fostering stronger connections between consumers and the places they love, and building technology that meets merchants — and their customers — wherever they are.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

title: Strategic Finance Business Partner - Senior Vice President
descriptionHtml:
About AlixPartners

At AlixPartners, we solve the most complex and critical challenges by moving quickly from analysis to action — when it really matters.

We create value that has a lasting impact on companies, their employees and their communities.

By understanding, respecting and acknowledging the needs of our employees, clients and communities, AlixPartners actively fosters an inclusive environment. We firmly believe in the value that diversity of experience brings, and we are committed to continuously improving our initiatives, policies and practices. We commit to creating space for authenticity, growth and equality for everyone.

AlixPartners has adopted a hybrid working model to offer flexibility and support our employees' work-life integration.

What you'll do

In this role as Strategic Finance Business Partner (France), you can expect a fast-paced, hands-on position in finance, working with the local French Leadership on driving the country’s performance as well as with the wider strategic finance team for the EMEA region.

You will be a trusted strategic finance partner to the French Country Leader and Managing Director & Partner group, translating financial data into actionable insights and proactively challenging business decisions to support sustainable and profitable growth.

In supporting the finance function, you will work closely with colleagues in accounting and other Corporate Services functions (HR, Legal, IT, Business Development, etc.) in our fast-moving, rapidly growing company.

Ideally, you are an experienced business partner with a strong customer focus and the ability to build and maintain interpersonal relationships. You will work closely with the French leadership team and the wider Managing Director & Partner group and successfully handle demanding financial topics.

You are joining at an exciting time and will help modernize the finance function and support the company's long-term success. This role plays an important part in our strong growth, and you will have the opportunity to help shape it and build your own finance career at AlixPartners.

The Strategic Finance Business Partner – France is a full-time position with hybrid working arrangements, based in our Paris office. The role reports to the EMEA Head of Strategic Finance. Your responsibilities also include:

Proactive coordination with the French Country Leader and Managing Director & Partners to provide financial expertise and support, focusing on company growth, improving profitability and strengthening working capital management to reduce DSOs

Acting as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, offering proactive financial insights, recommendations and constructive challenge on key business and operational decisions

Preparation and ownership of annual budgets and monthly forecasting processes

Supporting business planning and capacity planning, including financial analysis to improve resource allocation and profitable revenue growth

Providing the financial resources needed to ensure strategic business development, client retention and increased client profitability within country, service and industry groups

Close collaboration with the engagement analyst team to ensure a continuous flow of information on project-related challenges, or specific issues, and to support their resolution and discussion

Identifying revenue risks arising from significant working capital or engagement challenges and responding appropriately

Supporting the Managing Director & Partner group on the running of their projects, including pricing, project set-up, WIP and AR management

Proactively challenging stakeholders on engagement economics, fee structures, profitability and financial risks, and driving appropriate corrective actions

Preparing the monthly financial management information (MI), including insightful commentary and analysis

Developing and implementing dashboards, KPIs and regular performance-review routines across clients, engagements and Managing Director & Partners, translating analysis into clear business recommendations

Monitoring performance against long-term strategic and short-term operational plans and supporting the Country Leader in defining the measures needed to achieve agreed financial targets

Carrying out ad hoc analyses as needed to maximize profitability in terms of revenue and working capital

What you'll need

Experience in strategic finance, FP&A or finance business partnering with senior stakeholders, ideally in the professional services or consulting sector

A strong foundation in accounting and financial controlling, combined with relevant professional experience; seniority and scope of experience will be assessed against the role requirements

Advanced proficiency in MS Office, with a particular focus on Excel and PowerPoint

Excellent written and verbal communication skills

The ability to stay calm and focused under pressure

Strong analytical and organizational skills with great attention to detail

Proven ability to influence and constructively challenge experienced stakeholders, including senior business leaders

Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to turn complex financial analyses into practical, actionable recommendations

A proactive, hands-on, solutions-oriented mindset and the confidence to take ownership of financial performance topics

A mindset that prioritizes continuous improvement, supporting personal development, colleague development and the optimization of business processes and interactions

The ability to grasp the big picture while considering company-wide implications

A collaborative team player who values transparency and takes a straightforward approach

Knowledge of SAP S/4 HANA Cloud, SAP Analytics Cloud (finance systems) or a similar ERP system for enterprise services is preferred

The ability to build a comprehensive understanding of the company over time and find new ways to expand value creation for our firm

In addition to a positive work environment, the company offers a comprehensive compensation package with an excellent performance program. AlixPartners is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status or disability.

title: Strategic Sales Director, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day. 

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

 

About the role:

As a founding Strategic Sales Director you will focus on some of the largest companies in EMEA, working on big strategic deals that will change the trajectory of the company. You’ll identify and articulate how Cresta can unlock significant value for our customers, build relationships with key executives and evangelize cutting edge AI technology. As an early member of the team at a growing startup, you’ll have the opportunity to help define our sales process, participate in regional expansion strategy and help build the EMEA region, starting with success in the UK.

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment and is passionate about using cutting-edge AI to solve real-world business challenges. You'll help shape our sales strategy, influence cross-functional priorities, and contribute to building a high-performing, customer-obsessed sales culture.

 

Responsibilities: 

  • Own the sales experience while building and managing relationships with key decision-makers and executives 
  • Run complex sales cycles from initial contact to close
  • Prospect for new clients, design product presentations and business cases, develop and deliver proposals, negotiate and close contracts
  • Develop a command of the Cresta product, the Contact Center market, our unique competitive differentiators, and our customers’ needs
  • Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Customer Success and Engineering to deliver an exceptional customer experience
  • Own and hit your number

Qualifications We Value:

  • 7+ years of SaaS software sales experience at an enterprise level, with referenceability of consistently delivering to sales quotas in this time
  • Experience negotiating, structuring and executing complex enterprise-level agreements
  • Prior experience leading cross-functional teams through large deal close processes
  • Ability to articulate contractual, technical, and financial value points to customers, including C-level executives
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with experience presenting to C-level executives
  • Ability to be in London easily, often at short notice. Also, the ability to travel domestically and internationally up to around 25% of the time

Perks & Benefits:

We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child
  • Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office
  • Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced
  • 20 days of vacation time to promote a healthy work-life blend

Compensation at Cresta 

Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table.

The posted base salary range represents what we expect to pay for this role in a given location. Final offers are shaped by factors like experience, skills, education, and geography. In addition to base pay, total compensation includes equity and a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family.

This role is variable target compensation eligible. There is potential to exceed target earnings when goals are surpassed.  

OTE Range: $215,000 – $230,000 Pound Sterling + Offers Equity

Our use of AI in recruiting: We may use AI tools in our recruiting process, which require human review and oversight. If you have questions about our use of AI or wish to opt out, please contact
Recording & AI transcription: We do not authorize candidates to record or use AI transcription of any interview by phone, notetaker app, AI glasses, or other device. Candidates may request an exception or accommodation for review during the interview process as needed.

Recruiting impersonation scams: We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. title: System Test Engineer
descriptionHtml:
⌕ Job Overview:

This role sits at the centre of how Salience Labs takes our photonic switching technology from prototype to reliable deployment in AI networks. You will define, build and operate our system test capability, covering complex opto-electronic setups, automation and structured test execution.

We need someone with a clear, organised and outcome driven approach, able to design test strategies from first principles and communicate progress with data led clarity.

Success requires strong technical depth, solid operational discipline and the ability to work quickly and precisely in a lab environment. You will shape how we validate our switching hardware, ensure test readiness at each milestone and remove bottlenecks through smart automation and process improvement.

✎ What you'll be doing

  • Help design and implement the system level test strategy for Salience’s photonic switching platform, covering test planning, setup definition, execution and reporting.

  • Build and maintain complex optical and electronic measurement setups with strong attention to stability, repeatability and safety.

  • Automate test sequences and data capture pipelines to minimise manual overhead and accelerate learning cycles.

  • Develop and communicate a clear view of test readiness, critical paths and parallelisable work.

  • Create plans, timelines and prioritisation frameworks that reflect real engineering constraints.

  • Optimise existing test processes by identifying wasted effort, anticipating failure modes and preparing setups ahead of hardware arrivals.

  • Collaborate closely with Photonics, Electronics, Firmware and Product teams to ensure test outputs align with system level performance requirements for high bandwidth, low latency switching.

  • Drive a culture of disciplined execution with a clear understanding of the commercial end goal.

  • Help shape and lead the function with competence, judgement and reliability, even before any formal line management is introduced.

𓏗𓏗 What we're looking for

  • Strong experience working hands on in lab environments involving complex optical, photonic or mixed signal electronic setups.

  • Demonstrable ability to build, debug and optimise measurement systems, and automate test workflows.

  • Comfortable operating in environments where test coverage, data quality and repeatability underpin every decision.

  • Ability to plan rigorously, track progress, think in parallel and flag risks early.

  • A background that may include photonics, optics, MEMS, mixed signal electronics, semiconductor test or high-speed transceiver validation.

  • Experience with automated test frameworks, scripting for test automation and data analysis tooling.

  • Fluency in Python (NumPy) and familiarity with VISA/SCPI protocols is essential.

  • Strong organisational capability, able to set expectations, anticipate bottlenecks and maintain momentum across multiple teams.

  • Based in the UK or willing to relocate, with consistent presence required in the Oxford lab.

✧ Even better if you

  • Have experience scaling system test infrastructure for high performance communication or switching hardware.

  • Are comfortable developing automated analysis pipelines to support data led decision making.

  • Have previously led or mentored test or validation teams.

  • Bring understanding of reliability, environmental or system level testing for optical or networking hardware.

title: Talent Acquisition Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du willst Menschen gewinnen. Und an Ergebnissen gemessen werden.

Für uns hat Recruiting dieselbe Energie wie guter Vertrieb: Chancen erkennen, eine überzeugende Ansprache entwickeln, viel umsetzen und konsequent am Ball bleiben.

Du planst und drehst Recruiting-Ads und Content. Du knüpfst Kontakte, entwickelst dein Netzwerk und gehst im Active Sourcing auf interessante Menschen zu. Du testest neue Ansätze, führst Gespräche und hältst die nächsten Schritte verbindlich nach.

Was dich antreibt: Verantwortung, eine hohe eigene Schlagzahl und sichtbare Ergebnisse. Klare Ziele geben dir Orientierung. Leistungsabhängige Vergütung motiviert dich. Du willst selbst beeinflussen, was du erreichst.

So gewinnst du die richtigen Menschen für unser Team

Bei Rügamer & Steiner rekrutierst du für unser eigenes Unternehmen – von Sales über Projekt- und Accountmanagement bis zu Content und AI/Tech. Dafür verbindest du mehrere Wege:

  • Recruiting-Ads: Du entwickelst Botschaften und Videoideen für unsere Stellen und planst die Aufnahmen gemeinsam mit uns. Vor der Kamera stehen unter anderem Aurelian, Simeon und Noah – gelegentlich auch du selbst.

  • Content: Du planst und drehst Inhalte, die unsere Arbeit, unser Team und die beruflichen Möglichkeiten bei uns sichtbar machen.

  • Netzwerk: Du baust aktiv Beziehungen auf, erschließt Empfehlungen und bringst interessante Menschen zusammen. Zum Beispiel organisierst du ein monatliches Abendessen mit Account-Managern aus Düsseldorf: zum Kennenlernen, für fachlichen Austausch und um langfristig Kontakte zu Menschen aufzubauen, die unser Team verstärken könnten.

  • Active Sourcing: Du findest passende Kandidaten und sprichst sie persönlich an – über LinkedIn, Nachrichten und Telefon.

  • Gespräche und Nachhalten: Du klärst Erfahrung, Motivation und Erwartungen, hältst Kontakt und bringst gemeinsam mit den Teamleads der einzelnen Abteilungen die nächsten Schritte bis zur Entscheidung voran.

Du schaust dir an, welche Ansprache funktioniert, welche Inhalte Interesse wecken und über welche Wege passende Menschen kommen. Daraus entwickelst du die nächsten Maßnahmen. Du verantwortest, dass aus deinen Aktivitäten gute Gespräche und erfolgreiche Besetzungen entstehen.

Das bringst du mit

Du hast bereits Menschen gewonnen und Stellen besetzt – in einer Personalberatung, im Inhouse-Recruiting oder für dein eigenes Unternehmen.

Oder du kommst aus Vertrieb oder Marketing und willst deine Erfahrung jetzt im Recruiting einsetzen. Du weißt, wie man Zielgruppen versteht, Interesse weckt, überzeugende Gespräche führt und aus ersten Kontakten konkrete Ergebnisse entwickelt.

Entscheidend ist, dass du Menschen gewinnen kannst, eigenständig ins Handeln kommst und bereit bist, dir das Recruiting-Handwerk anzueignen. Zeig uns anhand konkreter Beispiele, was du selbst vorangebracht und erreicht hast.

Du kommunizierst überzeugend auf Deutsch und Englisch, organisierst mehrere Suchen gleichzeitig und hältst Zusagen zuverlässig nach. Du hast Lust, sichtbar zu werden, Ideen auszuprobieren und dich an Ergebnissen messen zu lassen.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

Du arbeitest eng mit den Gründern und den Verantwortlichen unserer Fachbereiche zusammen. Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss darauf, mit welchen Menschen wir unser Unternehmen weiter aufbauen.

Du gestaltest unsere Ansprache mit, entwickelst neue Wege der Kandidatengewinnung und übernimmst Verantwortung für deren Umsetzung. Klassische HR-Verwaltung gehört nicht zu deiner Rolle. Bei Kampagnentechnik und Videoschnitt arbeitest du mit den jeweils Zuständigen zusammen.

Dein Arbeitsort ist unser Büro in Düsseldorf. Wir bieten eine unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit mit 40 Stunden pro Woche und 26 Urlaubstagen.

Leistung soll sich für dich lohnen

Unser Ziel ist, dass du bei uns 100.000 € und mehr im Jahr verdienen kannst. Für die Position sehen wir eine Gesamtvergütung von 6.000–12.000 € brutto im Monat inklusive variablem Anteil vor. Wir suchen jemanden, den klare Ziele, Verantwortung und leistungsabhängige Vergütung motivieren – und der seinen Erfolg selbst mitgestalten will.

Zeig uns, wie du Menschen gewinnst

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein konkretes Beispiel: Wie hast du passende Menschen erreicht, ihr Interesse geweckt und daraus ein Ergebnis entwickelt? Das kann eine Besetzung sein oder – bei deinem Quereinstieg – ein passendes Beispiel aus Vertrieb oder Marketing. Ein Satz dazu reicht für den ersten Schritt. Alles Weitere besprechen wir gemeinsam im Call. Bitte ohne vertrauliche Personen- oder Kundendaten.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
descriptionHtml:
This is a 12-month maternity cover contract, with working hours of 22.5 hours per week, spread across Monday, Thursday and Friday. One day per week will be office-based in Canary Wharf.

The Role

It is the responsibility of the Talent Acquisition team, to ensure that euNetworks is attracting and hiring top talent across Sales and Technical Departments, locations and career levels. Identifying people who will hold to our value that We respect and trust one another and all of our stakeholders.

As a Talent Partner you will build relationships with hiring managers across multiple functions and geographies, developing an extensive knowledge of the talent in their teams to then identify and recruit both internal and external talent. You will prioritise diversity, equity and inclusion throughout the hiring process, securing top talent for permanent and contract roles.

What will you be doing?

  • Maintaining an organised and compliant Applicant Tracking System to ensure the recruitment process is smooth and efficient. To include regular functional reviews and improvements.
  • Stay up-to-date on industry trends and best practices

What do we want from you?

Essential

  • Talent acquisition experience; either as an external recruitment consultant or an internal talent acquisition role.
  • Experience interviewing for Sales and technical positions is an advantage

  • Experience pro-actively sourcing passive candidates.
  • Knowledge of various job sites and resources for active candidates.
  • A passion for Diversity, Equity and Inclusion and experience applying this to recruitment processes.

If this position is of interest but you don’t think you meet all of the criteria listed, please consider applying still. euNetworks looks to recruit people with the right attitude, potential and ambition and for the right candidate, we will provide further training and support to enable you to develop in the role.

euNetworks operates a hybrid working policy and flexible hours are available.

What can we offer you?

We’re a multi-faceted company that has been consistently growing for over 10 years but we remain committed to our company values and hiring people who want to be part of the team and make a contribution.

We invest in our people by offering a range of benefits and development opportunities that are shaped to fit each of the countries we operate in.

Our Family Friendly Policy delivers enhanced and inclusive parental benefits that can viewed here. For more detail on our bonus system, holiday allowance and other leave entitlements contact us directly at -----

Our Love To Learn initiative delivers focused company wide training sessions across a range of skills, suitable for every role and level. These are complemented by individual training and progression plans. We partner with industry specialists to offer comprehensive mental wellbeing support and training.

We offer early career opportunities including apprenticeships, internships and an established graduate programme.

Please let us know if you have any accessibility requirements or questions to assist you through the selection process and your decision making.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

Our company values drive our behaviour and form the basis of how we operate our business, work as a team and as individuals. We respect and trust one another and all of our stakeholders. We embrace diversity and inclusion in all that we do. Building a diverse, equitable and inclusive culture is a priority at euNetworks.

We strive to ensure a welcoming environment, where everyone can provide equally respected input, in a safe place, judgment free. Our employees work together through our ‘You Belong Here’ initiative to deliver meaningful developments and programs for the benefit and inclusion of all.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and seek people looking to build a long and meaningful career at euNetworks. We commit to providing each individual with the support, continued learning and the tools to achieve their goals and an environment in which they can thrive.

title: Talent Lead
descriptionHtml:
You make sure the best people apply to Pivotal's programs, and that we select the right ones.

  • Salary: £86,750–£155,500 per year, depending on seniority. We may be able to pay more for exceptional candidates.

  • Location: London, at our office at LISA

  • Hours: Full time

  • Visa: We can sponsor a Skilled Worker visa, but approval isn't guaranteed.

Why work at Pivotal

Pivotal finds people who can work on the biggest risks from advanced AI and gets them working on them. Since 2024, 135 fellows have taken part in our fellowships, and alumni now work at METR, Apollo Research, UK AISI and GovAI. We have grown from 2 staff in 2024 to 10 today, and we plan to reach at least 16 in 2027. Read more about us at pivotal-research.org, and about what it is like to work here.

What you will own

You’ll own how people find Pivotal’s programs and how we select them. This runs from the first time someone hears about us to the final decision, which you make with mentors. In 2027 we plan up to 4 more application rounds, and for our Q1 2027 round we received 5,000+ applications.

The primary focus will be to grow the number of strong applicants, including people from outside the usual AI safety pipeline, such as mid-career professionals. You’ll also run selection at scale, which is getting harder because AI-written applications make written answers a weaker signal. You’ll design each round, check afterwards whether it picked the right people, and change it when it did not.

  • Outreach and marketing. Grow the number of strong applicants for each program through channels, campaigns, partner organisations, and presence at universities and conferences.

  • Communications for applicants. Program pages, application guidance and messages to applicants.

  • The selection process. Design and run each round: forms, AI-assisted screening, contract reviewers, work tasks, interviews, and final decisions with mentors and Research Managers. Keep it fair, fast and compliant with data protection law.

  • Learning from results. Track which selection signals predict good fellowships and careers. This includes fellows who did worse than expected and strong applicants we turned down. Change the process based on what you find.

Who does well in this role

  • You have run recruiting, admissions, marketing or talent search for a selective program or organisation, and you can show results.

  • You have good judgement about people, and you can make it explicit so that others can apply it consistently.

  • You want to find out if your process works, and you change it when it does not.

  • You are good at outreach & communications, including outside the AI safety community.

  • You use AI tools well, for example to screen at scale, and you know where they fail.

  • You care about reducing catastrophic risks from AI. You do not need a research background.

We don’t expect anyone to be strong in all of this. If the role excites you, please apply, even if you match only part of what we describe here.

How we hire

We review applications as they come in, so applying early helps. The process has these stages:

  • Written application. A short form and your CV. It takes about 30 minutes.

  • Automated video interview. About 10 minutes. You record short answers to a few questions, at a time that suits you.

  • Work task. About 2 hours, based on real work in this role. We pay you for this time. You may use AI tools, as you would in the job. Tell us which ones you used and how.

  • Personal interview. About 45 minutes. We discuss your work task and how you would approach the role. With your consent, we record it so that more of the team can review it.

  • Work trial and references. Up to three paid days working with us at our office in London. We also speak to two referees, after asking you.

If you need an adjustment at any stage, such as extra time, tell us and we will arrange it. If you have questions, email ----- £86,750 – £155,500

Du willst als Account Executive Steuerkanzleien im Raum Düsseldorf oder München für eine neue Art der Zusammenarbeit mit ihren Mandanten gewinnen – am Telefon, per Video und vor Ort in der Kanzlei? Als eine:r der ersten Account Executives für unser deutsches Kanzleisegment baust du dir dein eigenes Gebiet auf, verantwortest den gesamten Vertriebszyklus bis zum Onboarding und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Firms-Team den Vertriebsansatz für den deutschen Markt – mit dem Rückenwind eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs Europas.

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs Europas – seit 2025 auch in Deutschland. Das haben wir seit der Gründung 2020 erreicht:

💻 Wir haben uns als All-in-One-Plattform für Buchhaltung, Finanzen und die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Unternehmen und ihren Steuerberater:innen etabliert – KI-gestützt, cloudbasiert, mit offenen Schnittstellen.

Deine Mission

Deine Mission ist es, Steuerkanzleien in deiner Region für Pennylane zu gewinnen – du baust dir deine Pipeline selbst auf, überzeugst Kanzleiinhaber:innen in der Demo und vor Ort und begleitest deine Kanzleien vom Abschluss bis zum erfolgreichen Onboarding.

Dein Team

Full-Cycle Sales: Du verantwortest den gesamten Prozess – von der Qualifizierung über die Produkt-Demo und den Abschluss bis zum Onboarding und Account Management deiner Kanzleien.

Outbound ist Kern: Rund 50 % deiner Pipeline baust du selbst auf – per Telefon, LinkedIn, Branchenevents und Kanzleibesuche. Ergänzt wird das durch Inbound-Leads und Empfehlungen. Wer nur auf Inbound wartet, wird hier nicht glücklich; wer gern aktiv Türen öffnet, umso mehr.

Starkes Setup: Dabei bist du nicht allein: Unser eigenes Customer-Success-Team in Berlin unterstützt dich bei Onboarding und Betreuung deiner Kanzleien, damit du genug Zeit für die Neukundengewinnung hast.

Regional organisiert: Du betreust eine feste Region – Düsseldorf/Nordrhein-Westfalen oder München/Bayern – per Inside Sales und vor Ort in den Kanzleien. Deshalb suchen wir dich dort, wo deine Kanzleien sind.

Im Aufbau: Du kommst zu einem kleinen Team von Account Executives dazu, das mit dir wächst – bald unter der Führung eines Team Leads Sales Firms in Berlin.

Beratender Vertrieb: Du gewinnst Kanzleiinhaber:innen und Partner:innen für eine neue Art der Zusammenarbeit mit ihren Mandanten. Du machst den Nutzen von Pennylane für den Kanzleialltag konkret und schaffst Vertrauen in die Einführung einer neuen Plattform.

Remote in deiner Region: Du arbeitest aus dem Homeoffice oder Coworking in deiner Region und bist regelmäßig bei Kanzleien vor Ort, auf Messen und bei Verbandsveranstaltungen. Etwa einmal im Monat kommst du für Team-Treffen in unser Berliner Office.

Du wirst für den Erfolg deiner Region verantwortlich sein durch:

  • Du baust eine systematische Outbound-Akquise für Kanzleien auf – Zielkundenlisten, Sequenzen, Events, Vor-Ort-Besuche – und hältst deine Aktivitätsquoten hoch.

  • Du führst Bedarfsanalysen und Produktdemos durch und begleitest komplexe Entscheidungsprozesse mit mehreren Stakeholdern bis zum Abschluss.

  • Du sorgst gemeinsam mit Customer Success für eine reibungslose Übergabe und baust deine Kanzleien aus, indem du die Anzahl der über Pennylane betreuten Mandanten steigerst.

  • Du dokumentierst deine Pipeline sauber im CRM und nutzt Pipeline- und Conversion-Daten, um dich selbst zu steuern.

Als Account Executive – Steuerkanzleien sind deine Ziele vielfältig:

  • Du erreichst deine Vertriebsziele und hast nach 3 Monaten eine qualifizierte Pipeline, nach 6 Monaten deine ersten Kanzleien und erste Referenzen.

  • Du baust ein Netzwerk von Botschafter-Kanzleien auf, die Pennylane weiterempfehlen.

  • Du vertrittst Pennylane auf Branchenevents, Fachmessen und Veranstaltungen von Steuerberaterverbänden in deiner Region.

  • Du bringst deine Markteinblicke in Product, Marketing und das SME-Sales-Team ein.

  • Du teilst deine Learnings und baust das Playbook für die nächsten AEs mit auf.

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Vertrieb mit – mit komplexen, erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten, mehrstufigen Deal-Zyklen und mehreren Stakeholdern – und hast nachweislich Abschlüsse erzielt, die du selbst angebahnt hast.

  • Ein Plus: Du kennst den Markt der Steuerkanzleien oder das Accounting-/Fintech-Ökosystem – oder hast an Steuerberater:innen, Kanzleien oder andere Berufsträger verkauft. Wenn nicht, bringst du die Neugier mit, dich schnell einzuarbeiten.

  • Du hast selbst Outbound gemacht: Kaltakquise bei Inhaber:innen und Entscheider:innen schreckt dich nicht – sie ist dein Hebel.

  • Du bist ein Builder: Du hast schon einmal ein Gebiet, einen Markt oder einen Prozess aufgebaut – idealerweise in einem schnell wachsenden Umfeld (Start-up oder Scale-up) – und baust Vertrauen auf, bei Kanzleiinhaber:innen wie im Team.

  • Du bist gern draußen: Field Sales ist für dich kein Kompromiss, sondern der Grund, warum du diesen Job willst – Kanzleibesuche, Messen und Verbandstermine gehören für dich dazu.

  • Du bist offen für Selbstreflexion und fühlst dich wohl dabei, Feedback zu geben und zu empfangen.

  • Du arbeitest bereichsübergreifend mit anderen Abteilungen zusammen – Marketing, Customer Success, Product und dem französischen HQ.

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2) – deine Kund:innen sind deutsche Kanzleien – und gutes Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit Paris.

title: Technical Marketing Engineer
descriptionHtml:
The role

Neural Concept is looking for a Technical Marketing Engineer to turn emerging engineering technologies into compelling demonstrations, technical content and joint partner stories.

You will explore how Neural Concept can work with technologies from partners, primarily NVIDIA, and prototype new engineering workflows. You will then translate that work into strong demos, videos and articles that make our technical depth tangible to the market.

Your content work will also extend beyond partner initiatives. You will stay close to our Research, Frontier, Vertical Solutions and Product teams to understand what they are building, identify stories worth taking to market and produce technical content independently. You will turn the work into a technically credible article explaining the method, findings and implications.

This role sits within Marketing and works closely with Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, Research, Product, Engineering and our Vertical Solutions teams.

Your mission

Make Neural Concept’s technical capabilities visible and understandable.

You will combine hands-on engineering work with strong market judgement. You will start with the audience and the story we want to tell, then build the right prototype or content to prove it.

The goal is to create credible and visually strong demonstrations of what becomes possible when Neural Concept connects with emerging AI and engineering technologies. These are marketing prototypes, not production-ready integrations. They must communicate the concept clearly and remain technically accurate.

What you will do

Drive technical co-builds with partners

  • Explore partner technologies and identify where they can create new engineering workflows with Neural Concept.

  • Lead technical co-build initiatives, with an initial focus on the NVIDIA ecosystem, including technologies such as PhysicsNeMo, Warp, Omniverse and agentic frameworks.

  • Build prototypes that combine Neural Concept capabilities with partner products and infrastructure.

  • Work directly with partner technical and marketing teams to shape joint stories.

  • Turn technical exploration into demos, videos, event content and other co-marketing assets.

  • Identify new opportunities for joint content, launches and market visibility.

Produce technical marketing content

  • Write technically grounded articles, explainers and demo narratives.

  • Create and present demos for partners, events, campaigns and executive conversations.

  • Develop demo scripts and work with design or video specialists to produce polished assets.

  • Repackage internal prototypes and engineering work into content that external audiences can understand and remember.

  • Help Product and Partner Marketing communicate technical mechanisms precisely, without unnecessary complexity.

Build for the audience

  • Define the audience, message and desired outcome before starting technical work.

  • Make deliberate choices about what needs to work end to end and what can remain a prototype.

  • Prioritise a clear story, strong visual execution and market relevance.

  • Simplify the experience without oversimplifying the technology.

  • Validate technical claims with the relevant internal experts before publication.

What we are looking for

  • A strong engineering background

  • The ability to build technical prototypes independently. Experience with Python and AI or engineering software is strongly preferred.

  • Knowledge of one or more relevant areas: machine learning, physics AI, simulation, CAD/CAE, geometry processing, engineering software or agentic systems.

  • Evidence that you can explain technical subjects through writing, demos or video.

  • A marketing-first mindset. You think about the audience and the intended reaction, not only the technical implementation.

  • Strong visual and product judgement. You care about how a demo looks and how clearly it communicates value.

  • Comfort working with external technology partners and coordinating across technical and marketing teams.

  • The ability to move quickly through ambiguity and build enough to prove a concept.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

This role may suit you if

  • You are an engineer who has repeatedly moved towards storytelling, demos, content or developer marketing.

  • You enjoy experimenting with new technologies and immediately think about how to show their value.

  • You want to influence how a deep-tech company presents its capabilities to the market.

  • You prefer building a convincing prototype and narrative over maintaining production systems.

  • You can challenge a technically impressive idea when it does not serve the audience or the message.

This role is probably not for you if

  • Your primary interest is delivering reliable customer implementations or maintaining production integrations.

  • You optimise technical work without considering how an external audience will understand it.

  • You see writing, storytelling and visual presentation as tasks to hand over after the engineering work is complete.

  • You are uncomfortable making pragmatic trade-offs when building exploratory prototypes.

How the role complements Product Marketing

Our Product and Technology Marketing function owns the broader product narrative, positioning and business value. The Technical Marketing Engineer brings deeper hands-on engineering capacity.

The two roles work together: Product Marketing defines the story and market context; the Technical Marketing Engineer explores the technology, builds the proof and contributes the technical content.

What success looks like

Within the first year, you will have:

  • Established a repeatable technical co-build motion with NVIDIA and other priority partners.

  • Produced partner demonstrations that create concrete content, event and relationship opportunities.

  • Built a steady flow of high-quality technical articles, demos and videos.

  • Made complex Neural Concept capabilities easier to understand without weakening their technical substance.

  • Become the bridge between Marketing, Engineering and partner technical teams.

title: Technical Product Manager - AI Neobank App
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building a AI Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

     

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

     

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

     

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: User Researcher
descriptionHtml:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

Summary

Dust is hiring a User Researcher to be the connective tissue between our users and the teams building for them. This is a high-leverage, embedded research role — your work will directly shape product decisions, inform GTM positioning, and surface the insights that help us serve customers like Datadog, 1Password, and Cursor at a higher level. You'll be the first dedicated researcher on the team, which means you'll build the function from the ground up, sitting close to the people shipping the product every day.

What you'll do

Build and own the research function

  • Define the research practice at Dust: methodologies, tooling, cadences, and documentation standards

  • Establish a consistent feedback loop between qualitative insights and product and GTM decisions

  • Create reusable research assets and templates the whole team can leverage

Run end-to-end research studies

  • Design and execute qualitative and quantitative studies — interviews, usability tests, concept tests, and surveys

  • Identify the highest-leverage research questions and prioritise ruthlessly against the roadmap

  • Deliver findings in formats that drive action, not just documentation

Partner with Product and Design

  • Embed into product and design workflows so research informs decisions before they're made, not after

  • Participate in roadmap discussions as a consistent, evidence-based voice for the user

  • Challenge assumptions with data when it matters — and when it's uncomfortable

Support GTM and customer understanding

  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success to surface patterns across customer conversations

  • Help position Dust's value more precisely by understanding how users actually describe their problems and outcomes

  • Contribute to ICP definition and segmentation work grounded in primary research

Scale your impact with AI

  • Integrate AI-assisted research tools into your practice to move faster and cover more ground

  • Build systems that allow the team to self-serve research insights without requiring your direct involvement every time

Requirements

Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same 3 dimensions. Aptitude, Attitude and Agency.

Aptitude

  • Strong mixed-methods research skills — you know when to go qualitative, when to go quantitative, and how to triangulate both into a clear point of view

  • Experience running and synthesising user interviews at pace without sacrificing rigour or clarity

  • Ability to translate complex user insights into decision-driving narratives that land with engineers, PMs, and founders alike

  • Track record of research directly influencing product or business decisions — not just documentation that gets filed and forgotten

  • Actively integrates AI tools to increase research velocity and coverage, treating it as a core part of how you work

Attitude

  • Genuinely user-obsessed — you bring the user into conversations that aren't explicitly about research

  • Direct communicator who surfaces uncomfortable findings without softening them out of usefulness

  • Low-ego and collaborative — equally comfortable partnering with an AE on a sales call as running a structured usability study

  • Energised by ambiguity and the challenge of building from scratch in a lean environment without a playbook

  • Makes the people around them sharper by actively sharing what they're learning

Agency

  • Identifies the most important research questions without waiting to be briefed — you see what's missing and move on it

  • Owns projects end-to-end: from framing the question to delivering the insight to following up on whether it changed anything

  • Builds research infrastructure that creates leverage for others, not just one-off outputs for yourself

  • Comfortable making judgment calls about when research is the right investment and when it isn't

  • Has expanded scope in past roles by solving problems no one assigned them

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

descriptionHtml:
Wir versüßen Ihr Leben…!

Diese Leidenschaft leben wir seit 1907.

Seitdem haben wir uns mit viel Herz und Engagement zu einem der führenden Confiserie-Unternehmen in Deutschland entwickelt. In 2025 haben wir die Marke Leysieffer erfolgreich in unser Unternehmen aufgenommen.

Wir stellen eine große Bandbreite hochwertiger Confiserie-Spezialitäten her. So sind wir gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden zum Marktführer für handwerklich hergestellte Macarons, Baumkuchen, Dominosteine und schokoladenüberzogene Torten gewachsen.

Unser Familienunternehmen wird in vierter Generation vom Inhaber Christian Rabbel geführt. Unsere über 150 Konditoren und Fachkräfte beweisen jeden Tag aufs Neue ihr handwerkliches Können mit viel Liebe zum Produkt und Ideenreichtum für unsere Kunden.

Alle Produkte und Verpackungen sind echte Handarbeit -made in Germany- und werden im eigenen Haus entwickelt und designt. Daher sind Rabbel-Produkte für unsere Kunden individuell und einzigartig. Mit unserem Reinheitsgebot versprechen wir unseren Kunden allerbeste Rohstoffe und den Verzicht auf Konservierungsstoffe oder andere nicht natürliche Zusätze. Unsere Umwelt ist uns sehr wichtig. title: VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

  • Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
  • Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
  • Over $300 million raised in funding
  • 3,000 Tideans globally
  • We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE ROLE

Tide is hiring a VP of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Ongoing Monitoring. You will report directly to the Chief Data and Technology Officer. Ongoing Monitoring protects our members by detecting fraud, financial crime and regulatory risk across every transaction Tide processes. The engineering, data science and platform capability behind it is one of the most technically demanding estates at Tide.

You will be accountable for the engineering strategy, organisation and execution across all Ongoing Monitoring value streams: real-time transaction monitoring for bank payments fraud, acquiring fraud, Anti Money Laundering, Counter Terrorist Financing, sanctions and prohibited activities monitoring, and the tooling our financial investigators depend on. That means ML models in production, agentic AI inside regulated workflows, and multi-market screening infrastructure that stands up to regulatory scrutiny.

This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, near real-time platform engineering and applied AI. Our first line operations teams are the primary internal customer, our second line sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise detection quality and reduce fraud losses while driving the cost of monitoring per member down, and scale agentic solutions where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.

As VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring you will:

  • Set the engineering strategy for Tide's fraud, financial crime and ongoing monitoring platforms
  • Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science, ML engineering and analytics engineering, primarily based in Hyderabad with product leadership split between Hyderabad and London
  • Lead managers and senior engineers, and build the leadership bench underneath you
  • Work with multiple stakeholders across risk, operations, business, design, product and engineering
  • Own the Decision Engine and Decision Intelligence Platform as shared capabilities, unifying domestic and international payment flows
  • Own the model lifecycle end to end, from development through backtesting, shadow deployment and staged rollout to production performance monitoring
  • Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, including migrating Ongoing Monitoring agents onto Tide's shared agentic infrastructure and holding the line on our agentic governance framework
  • Deliver measurable risk and efficiency outcomes: lower fraud losses, higher automated alert throughput, and a falling ongoing monitoring cost per member
  • Build the operating model that connects first line operations, second line risk and compliance, payments and acquiring engineering, KYX, AI Platforms and data science leadership behind one roadmap
  • Apply principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated

This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. Ongoing Monitoring is where we prove that trust scales, across every transaction we process. You will shape how quickly we protect our members, how confidently we enter new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Experience leading engineering organisations in fraud, financial crime, risk or another real-time decisioning domain
  • Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes across fraud detection and mitigation, unit economics reduction and workflows automation
  • Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live and fast iteration of model development 
  • Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with second line risk and compliance functions and with regulators
  • Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality
  • Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and align several functions behind one roadmap, operating model and set of priorities
  • Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight would be a bonus

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans: 

  • Competitive Compensation –  Competitive salary and share options.
  • Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
  • Parental Leave – Maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
  • Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
  • Health Insurance – Public health insurance plan.
  • Retirement Planning – Public pension scheme on eligible earnings.
  • DeutschlandTicket via Spendit - Employer funded free, unlimited travel throughout Germany on all local public transport (not valid in ICE, IC/EC).
  • Urban Sports Club Membership - Employer funded M membership to help you live a healthy and active lifestyle.
  • Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
  • Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
  • Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
  • WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
  • Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.
  • Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model thatsupports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. 

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community. 

#LI-AC1 #LI-Remote

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

  Disclaimer   It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:
  • Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
  • All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
  • Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
  • Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at

Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.
